Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Station 14123 Dash R. Cluster detected in 13.4 kHz band. Report immediately to station chief... TAGGERDY or GRANT. Threat level: Critical.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Code word: Spyglass. Repeat: Spyglass.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Emergency. Emergency.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: If, uh, you're receiving this the Officer of the Watch isn't available.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Automated sensors are picking up a mass of Scorched. Report to Defiance forward defense.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: This is, uh, not a drill.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: This is Jacob again. That's right. Still alive. Still stuck in the fucking Valley Galleria!

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: There's ghouls all over this place, and I. Am. Screwed.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: I ain't got a bullet to my name, and I lost my machete in the last ghoul that wanted to tussle.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: You know, the more I think about it, this is all Charlie's fault. I never should have listened to that bastard.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: He's got a thing for Ella, and I'm pretty sure he just wanted me out of the way.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: He's the one that sent me here after those damn flowers.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: He planned this... I swear, if I get out of here, he's a dead man.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: Somehow, I survived the night. Not sure how those things haven't' found me yet, but I won't complain.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: Lucky me, I found some old candy bars and a Nu'Cola. I can't tell if Life's toying with me or not.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: 'Cause if it's going to keep me fed just to throw me to the wolves, me and God are gonna have words when I get to them pearly gates.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: I did some reflecting last night. Thought about how stupid it is I'm in this situation on account of some girl. Just stupid.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: But Ella... She's smart. Smarter than I'll ever be. And nice. I never did meet a girl that'd give me the time of day. Karly don't count, she's kin.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: But to think all I wanted was to get Ella those flowers she wanted for experiments... not worth dying over, no siree.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: Fuck you, Charlie, I made it! I'm alive, and I made it out of that God forsaken shit hole of a mall.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: I got daylight to burn, and I'm heading to Harpers Ferry. I even found a few goddamn flowers for Ella.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: May not be the right ones, but I ain't coming back empty handed... And once I'm back... Charlie Walker is a dead man.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: Once I get my hands on him, I'm gonna --

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *gunshot*

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: The hell...?

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *thud*

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: *coughing*

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *footsteps*

Speaker: 00002CB9:NPCM_FS_Charlie:VTYP
Text: Didn't expect to see your face out here, Jakey. Least not alive anyways.

Speaker: 00002CB9:NPCM_FS_Charlie:VTYP
Text: Oh no, don't get up on my account.

Speaker: 00002CB9:NPCM_FS_Charlie:VTYP
Text: Tell you what. I'll take these here flowers, and give them to Ella with your regards. All you gotta do is die. Deal?

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: *coughing* *wheezing*

Speaker: 00002CB9:NPCM_FS_Charlie:VTYP
Text: Figured you'd be on board.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *gunshot*

Speaker: 0007D905:TW007_FemaleParkWorker_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Hello Sir! Welcome to Wavy Willard's Water Park. How can I help?

Speaker: 0007D8FB:TW007_OtisPike_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Uh, howdy. Was wondering where that box is for mail? The one that puts the special stamp on the letter?

Speaker: 0007D905:TW007_FemaleParkWorker_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Oh! You can find it over by the Crocolossus Mountain entrance. Right over that way.

Speaker: 0007D8FB:TW007_OtisPike_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Hey there Freddy. Where's your nanny? You know what? I have a surprise for ya! Don't want the other kids to see though, they might get jealous.

Speaker: 0007D9B0:TW007_FreddyWood_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What is it?! What's my surprise? I want to see it! Please! Please! Where is it?

Speaker: 0007D8FB:TW007_OtisPike_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I don't think your nanny will like it. Let's take off your ID there so she can't find ya. Then I can take you to the surprise!

Speaker: 0007EFC5:TW007_ParkAnnouncer_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Ssssssssssss! What's that sound boys and girls? Sssssssssss! Sssssssssssssssssss! Ssssssslither Sliiiiiiide! Swoosh, splash, sssssssss!

Speaker: 001849E9:NPCF_SFL02_Nari:VTYP
Text: Lucy just told us she thinks she found the perfect hideout in some sewers under Dyer Chem.

Speaker: 001849E9:NPCF_SFL02_Nari:VTYP
Text: Yep, you heard that right. Sewers.

Speaker: 001849E9:NPCF_SFL02_Nari:VTYP
Text: *sigh* I'm pretty sure that's a step down from just plain old swamp, but at this point, if it keeps Sara safe, how bad can it be?

Speaker: 001849E9:NPCF_SFL02_Nari:VTYP
Text: Either way, the radiation's through the roof, so Lucy managed to get her hands on some crazy prototype hazmat suit for me.

Speaker: 001849E9:NPCF_SFL02_Nari:VTYP
Text: And I get a snazzy ID card now to get inside, so here's hoping I don't lose it.

Speaker: 001849EA:NPCM_SFL02_Randy:VTYP
Text: Hey, Ella. Randy here. I'm pretty sure I'm done for on account of my leg being blown off.

Speaker: 001849EA:NPCM_SFL02_Randy:VTYP
Text: I wanted you to know you were right. We tracked them ghouls to Haven, and Christ All Mighty, they were talkin' and hollerin' sure as you an' me.

Speaker: 001849EA:NPCM_SFL02_Randy:VTYP
Text: I mean, we all heard them stories 'bout talking ghouls. I just never thought I'd bare a-witness to 'em.

Speaker: 001849EA:NPCM_SFL02_Randy:VTYP
Text: And I ain't the only one. Kendyll knew it, sure as I did. But Duncan wouldn't let up. He didn't care they were beggin' to be left alone.

Speaker: 001849EA:NPCM_SFL02_Randy:VTYP
Text: But I did. If them creatures still got the mind God gave 'em, then who are we to take that away?

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: All right. It's recording. Thank you again for reaching out to me. I was ... more than a bit surprised to receive your letter, Senator.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Of course, Ms. Carter. I hope you didn't find the journey too arduous.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: It was... an experience. I'm frankly just glad it didn't turn out to be a prank.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I apologize for that. Maintaining a low profile is... a requirement for my family and I now.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And why is that? Is it related to why you left your position as Senator so suddenly?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: It is the reason, Ms. Carter. There are sinister forces at work in the halls of government.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: In my time as Senator, I became aware of ... plans made by those in power. Plans of an unconscionable nature.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: When they found out what I knew, they threatened my life and the life of those I love. I ... I simply could not be a part of that anymore.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Of the government?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Of the United States, Ms. Carter. We've asked you here to carry a message to the nation on our behalf.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I and my fellow members of the Free States will no longer be shackled to the putrefying corpse of this nation. And any man or woman who values their lives must join us.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Men and women of conviction must strike out on their own and build for themselves secure, underground refuges, using whatever tools they can...

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: ...because when the end comes - and it will come any day now, Ms. Carter - there is no one we can trust but ourselves.

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Penny. It's Edie. Things are looking... bad for the test launch.

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Dominick locked his system down tight when he found out... the real plan for we had for purifiers. We're trying to manually reestablish access to his terminal...

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: But that's going to require some serious juice. And with your father hogging all the power for his Motherlode project, well, we've got a couple of options.

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Option one -- if you can get me the materials for one of those Ignition Cores the research boys came up with...

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I could plug into that test reactor on the second floor to power the decryption system.

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I've already got the schematics sitting on my bench; all I need's the parts.

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Otherwise... otherwise, we're going to need to track down that luddite and get the password directly.

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I think Dom was staying in a trailer down by the Nuka-Cola plant.

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The call's yours to make, Penny, and we should make it fast. Your father already thinks this project's been a waste.

Speaker: 0019BD07:MTR01_EdieBachmann_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: It's time we showed them what the real future of this company looks like.

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: 'Evening sir. Sheriff Darcy. Can I ask what you're doing out here?

Speaker: 001C7362:MTNM02_BlacksiteVictim_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Nothing. Do not talk about collecting data for project Orbuculum. Everything is normal.

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Huh. Awfully late for a... Spruce Knob Park Ranger to be wandering around the woods outside of our little town here.

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Can I get a name and ID from you sir?

Speaker: 001C7362:MTNM02_BlacksiteVictim_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Douglas Martin Schultz. ID Number PS59683. Reporting for delivery.

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Okay buddy, right. How about you move along. Head on home, or wherever else you need to be for the night.

Speaker: 001C7362:MTNM02_BlacksiteVictim_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Okay. Heading to Spruce Knob Campground for next data transfer.

Speaker: 001C7362:MTNM02_BlacksiteVictim_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Begin Recording: Orbuculum tape SK004-A081677. Previous tape, SK004-A073077 full. Continuing on route to site SD001 outside Sons of Dane Compound.

Text: Oof, that smarts! Where the hell am I, and why do I feel like I should be heading to a place called Sugar Grove? Gotta find my way home..

Text: This is Project Somnus Director CAPT Joyce West Interviewing Agent DWS746. Agent. Please state your name for the record.

Speaker: 001C7362:MTNM02_BlacksiteVictim_VOICEONLY:NPC_

Speaker: 0019BD80:MTNM02_BlacksiteDirector_VOICEONLY:NPC_
SpeakerName: Project Somnus Director CAPT Joyce  West
Text: Good. Your ID is PS59683. Please repeat your name, followed by your ID number for our voice identification system.

Speaker: 001C7362:MTNM02_BlacksiteVictim_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Douglas Martin Schultz. ID Number PS59683.

Speaker: 0019BD80:MTNM02_BlacksiteDirector_VOICEONLY:NPC_
SpeakerName: Project Somnus Director CAPT Joyce  West
Text: Okay. Next, as a test, I'm going to slap you across the face.

Speaker: 0019BD80:MTNM02_BlacksiteDirector_VOICEONLY:NPC_
SpeakerName: Project Somnus Director CAPT Joyce  West
Text: You are not to react under any circumstances. You will not remember the physical contact nor the pain response at all.

Speaker: 0019BD80:MTNM02_BlacksiteDirector_VOICEONLY:NPC_
SpeakerName: Project Somnus Director CAPT Joyce  West
Text: Now, tell me, how are you feeling?

Speaker: 001C7362:MTNM02_BlacksiteVictim_VOICEONLY:NPC_

Speaker: 001ECDCA:MTNM02_CurtisWilson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: December 14th, 2076. I, Curtis Wilson, and Sheriff Scott Darcy, have infiltrated the Huntersville Quarantine as part of our investigation.

Speaker: 001ECDCA:MTNM02_CurtisWilson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What we've seen and found is shocking. There are no civilians here, only big, green, hulking monstrosities locked up like animals.

Speaker: 001ECDCA:MTNM02_CurtisWilson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: There are documents that suggest West-Tek involvement. We should investigate the nearby Research Center. I found a password for a Dr. Khan: kafka3.

Speaker: 001ECDCA:MTNM02_CurtisWilson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I wouldn't be surprised if...

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Shut it, someone's coming.

Speaker: 001ECDED:MTNM02_ArmyOfficer_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Hey, you're not authorized to be here! Who...

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Damn, we've been compromised! Go go go!

Speaker: 001ECDCA:MTNM02_CurtisWilson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: ...Shit, I dropped the tape!

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: My god, this place stinks to high heaven!

Speaker: 001ECDCA:MTNM02_CurtisWilson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: We've got another terminal over here. I'm going to try that password. Hmm. Looks like it's taking an audio recording.

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Who cares? Not like anyone's around to check it.

Speaker: 001ECDCA:MTNM02_CurtisWilson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Looks like they were experimenting on some advanced mutations. Some really messed-up stuff.

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Hey looks like the power to this other room's been cut. Looks like I can reconnect the wires.

Speaker: 001ECDCB:MTNM02_ScottDarcy_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Mother of mercy...

Speaker: 001ECDCA:MTNM02_CurtisWilson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Scott... What did you do. What the fuck is that thing?

Speaker: 001ECDCA:MTNM02_CurtisWilson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Fuck! Get inside and close the door. We'll stay in there until it goes away!

Speaker: 00283ED7:EN01_WhitespringTapeNarrator_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Greetings, esteemed Congressman or Senator. Welcome to the future of the United States government. Welcome to the Whitespring.

Speaker: 00283ED7:EN01_WhitespringTapeNarrator_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Designed with comfort and safety in mind, the Whitespring Bunker - located directly below the lavish resort of the same name...

Speaker: 00283ED7:EN01_WhitespringTapeNarrator_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: ... will act as your very own oasis in the event of a hostile nuclear strike.

Speaker: 00283ED7:EN01_WhitespringTapeNarrator_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: All you need to do is present the enclosed access card upon your arrival and our automated bunker management mainframe will do the rest...

Speaker: 00283ED7:EN01_WhitespringTapeNarrator_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: ... guiding you through the process of getting to know your new home, all while supporting the continuation of the necessary functions of government.

Speaker: 00283ED7:EN01_WhitespringTapeNarrator_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: So, when the inevitable comes, won't you join us at... the Whitespring?

Speaker: 002894CA:NPCM_KnightWilson:VTYP
Text: Attention.

Speaker: 002894CA:NPCM_KnightWilson:VTYP
Text: Attention. You heard me. This ain't an ice cream social. Officer on deck.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Some of you already know this - but it's time for everyone to get a full brief on Operation Spyglass.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Grant?

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Before comms died, West Coast sent us plans for a listening device that can track the source of the Scorchbeasts.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: The Paladin's code named it "Ground Zero."

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: The range on the module's... not great. But we've been working with Pre-War spy stations.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Their accuracy's garbage, but if the stations give us a broad area the module should be able to dial it in from there.

Speaker: 002894C0:NPCF_SquireEvelyn:VTYP
Text: That's what you've been working on, Doc? Knowing where the bastards are coming from will be a real big help when the Scorched are murdering us.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: I know you've all been pushed hard. But you are Knights and Squires of the Brotherhood of Steel. Discipline is expected of you.

Speaker: 002894C0:NPCF_SquireEvelyn:VTYP
Text: Sorry, Paladin.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Yes. As soon as the listening stations are online it'll transmit a message to our emergency station if it picks up the right frequency.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: If that happens on your watch, grab the Scribe's Scanning Module and mobilize. We don't know how long the station can track Ground Zero.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: The Scanning Module needs to triangulate. The Module will walk you through it step-by-step.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Just keep placing it at targets coordinates until it gets a lock.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: There is... however, a snag. The Module uses similar, uh, frequencies to the Scorchbeasts' echolocation.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: And, well, they don't like it one bit.

Speaker: 002894C0:NPCF_SquireEvelyn:VTYP
Text: You've got to be shitting me. So we turn it on and we're painting a target on our backs, right?

Speaker: 002894C0:NPCF_SquireEvelyn:VTYP
Text: And what then? Just sit there?

Speaker: 002894CA:NPCM_KnightWilson:VTYP
Text: Mind your tone and language, Evelyn-

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: No. We hold the line here. Week after week, month after month. And the more Scorchbeasts we kill, the more that keep coming.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Elder Maxson didn't task us with holding Defiance. The job's to end them for good.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: You all know what's at stake if the Scorchbeasts breach the perimeter in force and nest elsewhere.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Spyglass is mission critical. And if the Operation means painting a target on your back, you'll do it and you'll like it.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Dismissed.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: Yes, they're mutated as all get out. But at their core, physiologically, they're bats.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: And as such they're constantly using ultrasound echolocation.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: For normal bats, Pre-War at least, echolocation is quite limited.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: Ultrasound is absorbed by the atmosphere - detection beyond 20 to 30 meters isn't really practical.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: But the Scorchbeasts emit powerful ultrasound vibrations with an unparalleled range. Usually, this is to their advantage.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: However, we can use this against them.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: If the Scorchbeasts have a single colony and if you can set up a large scale detection network focused to the 103.4 kHz frequency you may be able to track down their source.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: Enclosed are the schematics for a Sonic Scanning Module. It's range is still limited.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: You'll have to find some way of monitoring a larger area.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: God dammit, Ella... What the hell... What the shit HELL am I doing here?

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: Breathe dammit. You can do this.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: This is Jacob Lerner. Probably soon to be deceased on account of some crazy, whack-job scientist, chasing after some goddamned plants.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: If anyone finds this, this here's my last will and testament. I want my baseball and mitt to go to Scott.

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: All my smokes and liquor are for you, Karly. Let's see here...

Speaker: 002A905F:NPCM_FS_Jacob:VTYP
Text: My snack cakes, those are for Charlie... no strike that, and screw you, Charlie! You're half the reason I'm in this mess to begin with!

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm William Breyer, investigative reporter for the Charleston Herald.

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm currently standing just outside the security fencing of one of several Hornwright Industrial sites that have cropped up around the area in recent months.

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm here tonight to try and get some answers about what has become known in certain circles as "The Motherlode project."

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Could this be the answer local mining families have been looking for? A series of new mining projects that could reinvigorate the local economy?

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Or, as environmental groups have suggested, could these be a fresh set of toxic disposal sites, poisoning the ground beneath our feet?

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: At the very least, according to local experts, the area's recent increase in seismic events can almost certainly be tied to these sites.

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And now I'm here to see for myself what's really going on.

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I've just made my way up to a small gap in the first line of fencing. The security here is intense. Barbed wire. Armed guards. Feels like a warzone.

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm making my way over a small ridge and I--

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Mother of god... the ground's shaking and-- oh my god... what is that?

Speaker: 002C3EAB:MTR05_HornwrightWorker_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Hey! You! This is private propert-- Shit, it's that reporter. Jesus! He's got a gun!

Speaker: 002C3EA9:MTR05_Reporter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Gun? Wait, this isn't a --- ah! Ah....

Speaker: 002E10A8:NPCF_SFL02_Lucy:VTYP
Text: To anyone who will listen. My name is Lucy Harwick, and I'm here with many others just like me.

Speaker: 002E10A8:NPCF_SFL02_Lucy:VTYP
Text: We may look like those mindless things we call ghouls, but we're not.

Speaker: 002E10A8:NPCF_SFL02_Lucy:VTYP
Text: We're still people. REAL people with thoughts and feelings, and all those other things that make us all human!

Speaker: 002E110D:NPCM_SFL02_Dan:VTYP
Text: Lucy, they're here!

Speaker: 002E10A8:NPCF_SFL02_Lucy:VTYP
Text: Shit. Everyone grab a weapon. We're not going down without a fight!

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *People prepping*

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *shots firing*

Speaker: 002E10A8:NPCF_SFL02_Lucy:VTYP
Text: Duncan, I know that's you! You're making a mistake!

Speaker: 002E9F01:NPCM_SFL02_Duncan:VTYP
Text: You're one of them, Luce! There's no way I'm letting any of you walk out of here alive!

Speaker: 002E112E:NPCF_SFL02_Kendyll:VTYP
Text: Lucy? Is that you? Duncan, you're crazy! We need to stop firing!

Speaker: 002E9F01:NPCM_SFL02_Duncan:VTYP
Text: Kendyll, stand down! Don't you point that gun at me.

Speaker: 002E112E:NPCF_SFL02_Kendyll:VTYP
Text: Duncan, please, listen to them! We can't --

Speaker: 002E10A8:NPCF_SFL02_Lucy:VTYP
Text: Jesus, Duncan, you killed her?

Speaker: 002E9F01:NPCM_SFL02_Duncan:VTYP
Text: None of you ghouls are getting out of here alive, and nothing's going to stand in my way of finishing this job!

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *shots firing* *people dying*

Speaker: 002E9F01:NPCM_SFL02_Duncan:VTYP
Text: There. It's done. You hear that, Lettie? For you and the kids.

Speaker: 002E9F01:NPCM_SFL02_Duncan:VTYP
Text: Looks like I'll be joining you guys. Real soon...

Speaker: 002E9F01:NPCM_SFL02_Duncan:VTYP
Text: *dies*

Speaker: 002F16C5:_CUT_Holotape_SURV_Tutorial:VTYP
Text: Vault-Tec welcomes you to your new world! Happy Reclamation Day!

Speaker: 002F16C5:_CUT_Holotape_SURV_Tutorial:VTYP
Text: First things first. Find a source of water. But note, drinking from local streams and ponds could make you sick. Just bottle the water for now.

Speaker: 002F16C5:_CUT_Holotape_SURV_Tutorial:VTYP
Text: Next, establish a base camp and construct a cooking fire to boil the water you've collected to make it safe to drink.

Speaker: 002F16C5:_CUT_Holotape_SURV_Tutorial:VTYP
Text: Then it's time to hunt and gather food. Plants and animals may have undergone mutations making it difficult to tell what they once were. But not to worry, they're almost certainly still edible.

Speaker: 002F16C5:_CUT_Holotape_SURV_Tutorial:VTYP
Text: But remember, always cook your food!

Speaker: 002F16C5:_CUT_Holotape_SURV_Tutorial:VTYP
Text: Despite your best efforts, at some point, you're going to get hurt. But don't fret. You'll be able to craft old fashion healing salves from foraged plants at your cooking station.

Speaker: 002F16C5:_CUT_Holotape_SURV_Tutorial:VTYP
Text: These first few days are bound to be challenging! But don't give up!

Speaker: 002F16C5:_CUT_Holotape_SURV_Tutorial:VTYP
Text: Humans survived through the darkest of ages. And you, dear survivor, are among the best and brightest humanity has to offer.

Speaker: 002F16C5:_CUT_Holotape_SURV_Tutorial:VTYP
Text: Good luck out there!

Speaker: 001A6428:EN01_AgentGrey_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Commencing op summary, Agent Grey reporting. Blackwell won't be causing anymore problems.

Speaker: 001A6428:EN01_AgentGrey_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The bypass holotape got me into the bunker as expected ... though a longer range is recommended for future models.

Speaker: 001A6428:EN01_AgentGrey_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Essentially had to play the thing standing on top of the access panel to get it to work. Without the lures to distract those... freaks, I might be dead instead of the Senator.

Speaker: 001A6428:EN01_AgentGrey_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Once inside, I was briefly halted by Blackwell's laser grid, but resetting the power allowed me to grant myself clearance.

Speaker: 001A6428:EN01_AgentGrey_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Recovery of the access card to our facility was... less successful. I found a keypad, but was unable to decipher the code.

Speaker: 001A6428:EN01_AgentGrey_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Recommend sending in a specialist to collect it.

Speaker: 001A6428:EN01_AgentGrey_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm proceeding to the next target, after which I'll...

Speaker: 001A6428:EN01_AgentGrey_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Wait... what happened to the power? ... the lures!

Speaker: 000219CA:CrDeathclaw:VTYP
Text: *roar*

Speaker: 001A6428:EN01_AgentGrey_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Oh god.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Senator, I have to say, this wasn't the conversation I was expecting. You want people to flee their homes? It sounds like you're trying to start a panic.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If my words scare you, Ms. Carter, then it means hope is not lost. Because we should all be scared.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: They came after my family because of what I discovered and I was one of their own. What hope do everyday men and women have against such forces?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The only recourse left to the average American is to flee the population centers, head into the wilderness...

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: ...where one can find at least some hope of escaping the lurid gaze of those in government plotting against us.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: But this nefarious government force. Who are you talking about, Senator? Has there been some sort of invasion of Chinese agents?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Hmph. No, Ms. Carter. This subversion is home-grown.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: A cabal of the highest ranking officials in the land: the Executive branch, the Department of Agriculture, captains of industry...

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: ... all conspiring to perform unspeakable experimentation on those they claim to serve, and who are convinced that you and I are nothing but pawns in their sick games.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The only option left to any of us is to step away from the board all together.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And what does this mean for your role as Senator? Are you formally resigning?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Yes, Ms. Carter. Consider this interview my personal resignation from this government and this nation.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Now, if you wouldn't mind my daughter and I have much to do. We're on our own out here, after all.

Speaker: 00330B95:NPCF_SFL02_Jacqueline:VTYP
Text: My brother's finally given in and let me go out on my first hunting party mission with Duncan.

Speaker: 00330B95:NPCF_SFL02_Jacqueline:VTYP
Text: I gotta admit, I'm a little nervous. I'm pretty good with a gun, but Duncan's party is the best of the best.

Speaker: 00330B95:NPCF_SFL02_Jacqueline:VTYP
Text: Even better, I get to hang out with Kendyll who we all know is the coolest woman in all of Harpers Ferry. Nothing scares her!

Speaker: 00330B95:NPCF_SFL02_Jacqueline:VTYP
Text: I've heard about her taking on deathclaws and yao guai all by herself! Not to mention more ghouls than you can count.

Speaker: 00330B95:NPCF_SFL02_Jacqueline:VTYP
Text: So between her and Duncan, I hope I can live up to my reputation as the best shot on guard duty. I have some serious people to impress.

Speaker: 00330B95:NPCF_SFL02_Jacqueline:VTYP
Text: Robbie's terrified for me. I know there's a huge difference between patrolling a walled in town versus roaming out in the Swamp...

Speaker: 00330B95:NPCF_SFL02_Jacqueline:VTYP
Text: But I need this experience. Besides, I'll never learn if I don't get out there, right?

Speaker: 00335973:NPCF_SFL02_Lettie:VTYP
Text: Hey there, big guy. It's your lovely wife, coming to you "not-live" by way of this rickety old recorder that miraculously still works.

Speaker: 00335973:NPCF_SFL02_Lettie:VTYP
Text: I figured, what better way to wish my amazing husband a happy anniversary then a very private, seductive, borderline x-rated holotape?

Speaker: 00335973:NPCF_SFL02_Lettie:VTYP
Text: And then I remembered... we have kids! Get in here boys!

Speaker: 00335974:NPCM_SFL02_Micah:VTYP
Text: Hi, daddy! Mommy told me to wish you both a happy anniversary and remind you how lucky you are since she's so pretty.

Speaker: 00335975:NPCM_SFL02_Lucas:VTYP
Text: And that she dated you even though you didn't like sports!

Speaker: 00335974:NPCM_SFL02_Micah:VTYP
Text: And -- and she likes it when you do the dishes. And when you teach us to play baseball even though she's better than you!

Speaker: 00335975:NPCM_SFL02_Lucas:VTYP
Text: But she does not like it when you snore!

Speaker: 00335973:NPCF_SFL02_Lettie:VTYP
Text: Lucas Alexander, I said no such thing! Duncan, I said no such thing!

Speaker: 00335975:NPCM_SFL02_Lucas:VTYP
Text: But you do, mommy, you tell me each -- every morning!

Speaker: 00335973:NPCF_SFL02_Lettie:VTYP
Text: Ok, enough you two, get out of here. Go play with the other kids.

Speaker: 00335973:NPCF_SFL02_Lettie:VTYP
Text: *happy sigh*

Speaker: 00335973:NPCF_SFL02_Lettie:VTYP
Text: You don't suck at baseball, but you do snore... and I wouldn't trade you for the world.

Speaker: 00335973:NPCF_SFL02_Lettie:VTYP
Text: Even in times like this, I look at all you've given me, all you've done for us, and I couldn't ask for a better husband.

Speaker: 00335973:NPCF_SFL02_Lettie:VTYP
Text: Happy anniversary, to the best man I know. I love you, Dunkie.

Speaker: 0033C767:CUT_SF08_RangerBarnes_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: It's those damn mole rat's fault. Hate the things. Buggers never stop coming. Park's never safe.

Speaker: 0033C767:CUT_SF08_RangerBarnes_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Fight the varmints off every day. Bombs drop and now I'm a glorified groundskeeper, you know?

Speaker: 0033C767:CUT_SF08_RangerBarnes_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Make some improvised explosives, right? Kill them all, I'm thinking.

Speaker: 0033C767:CUT_SF08_RangerBarnes_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: No good. Trap's too touchy. One killed a visitor today. First visitor in months.

Speaker: 0033C767:CUT_SF08_RangerBarnes_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Park safety's my responsibility. Total failure.

Speaker: 0033C767:CUT_SF08_RangerBarnes_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Have to disarm the mines. The Moe suit...maybe it could shield me from a blast?

Speaker: 0033C767:CUT_SF08_RangerBarnes_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Maybe not. I'll do what I have to. Park must be safe again.

Speaker: 0038F1B0:NPCM_FS01_Rory:VTYP
Text: I found the mother lode, baby. Some bunker tucked away in the swamp. I bet it's got supplies for at least a couple years stashed away inside.

Speaker: 0038F1B0:NPCM_FS01_Rory:VTYP
Text: Now it's just a matter of breaking in, but that damn girl holed up in there's got some sort of terminal controlling the locks on the door.

Speaker: 0038F1B0:NPCM_FS01_Rory:VTYP
Text: If I didn't suck at hacking I'd be in there by now. Four tries and you're locked out. It's bullshit. But I ain't gonna let anyone else know.

Speaker: 0038F1B0:NPCM_FS01_Rory:VTYP
Text: That place and everything inside is all mine. No sharing here! Just a matter of getting that damn password.

Speaker: 0038F1B0:NPCM_FS01_Rory:VTYP
Text: I just gotta wait for that Abbie chick to leave and come back. Then I sneak in the door behind her, and BAM. She's dead, and I'm living the dream.

HolotapeName: Survivor Stories collected by Dassa Ben-Ami
Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: It's been ten whole days since everything changed... and right now we -- as humans -- need to survive.

HolotapeName: Survivor Stories collected by Dassa Ben-Ami
Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: I'm Dassa Ben-Ami and I am... er, I was... a PhD Anthropology student at Vault-Tec University.

HolotapeName: Survivor Stories collected by Dassa Ben-Ami
Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: If you're listening to this then you survived too, and well, I hope you're okay. But if you aren't then I want to help.

HolotapeName: Survivor Stories collected by Dassa Ben-Ami
Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: I'm documenting survival techniques from other survivors so that humanity has a chance to rebuild.

HolotapeName: Survivor Stories collected by Dassa Ben-Ami
Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Maybe if I interview enough survivors I can make a survival guide...

HolotapeName: Survivor Stories collected by Dassa Ben-Ami
Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: If you're still listening... look for my survivor interviews. Read them. Learn from our mistakes and successes.

HolotapeName: Survivor Stories collected by Dassa Ben-Ami
Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Survive. The future depends on it.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: If you're listening to this, then one of our Protectrons has been compromised. Maybe by you. Or maybe you were just in the wrong place at the wrong time. It doesn't matter.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: This world... it isn't going to get any better if we don't help each other. Try to keep people safe.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: The Responders need you. You might not think you're the type, but trust me, none of us sign up. We're called.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Head to the church in Flatwoods. We'll be waiting for you.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: *Bell Chime*

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: The Monster Mash will begin shortly, please gather in the Commons.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: On your marks... ready... set... GO!

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Mr. White reminds his Music Theory class that their final compositions are due on Monday.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Students are reminded that dress-codes will still be enforced today. Costumes must conform to code or you will be sent home.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Congratulations to the Varsity Math Team for winning all of their matches last night at the regional semi-final Math Meet! "Goooo Math-a-maniacs!"

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: The Party Planning Committee reminds everyone that next week Monday is Monster Mash Monday!

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Students are reminded that tampering with smoke detectors in the lavatories is grounds for immediate expulsion.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Ms. Way has misplaced her glasses again. A reward is offered for their return or information regarding their current whereabouts.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Tonight's after school detention has been canceled. Happy Halloween.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Mr. LeMay sends his heartfelt apologies about yesterday's demonstration to his 4th hour Chemistry Class. Also, anyone wishing to sign the "get well card" for Mr. LeMay should stop by the office before they leave for the day.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Mr. Chiaverina's 4th hour photography class would like to remind all students and faculty that their portrait studio sessions will begin on Monday and continue through the week over the lunch period. Please sign up soon, spots are filling up fast.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: This is a reminder that auditions for "A Midsummer Night's Dream" are after school next week Wednesday. You have until Tuesday to sign up with Mr. Miller.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Students wishing to attend the Debate Club's "Lunch-a-thon Get-a-long," should report promptly to the theatre at at the start of their lunch period.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Mrs. Roesch reminds all German Club members that permission slips for the annual ski trip are due no later than the end of the school day.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Attention students: The Honor Society's Senior Breakfast has been canceled due to lack of interest.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Students are reminded to encourage their parents to participate in the "Bake Off Take-Off" to raise money for plane tickets for the Marching Band's trip to Japan.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Mr. Lemon would like me to remind his 2nd and 4th hour "Intro to Psychology and Sociology" classes, that permission slips for the Allegheny Asylum field trip are due next week Wednesday.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: Ms. Werner reminds all of her AP English classes that their "Figurative Language, Symbolism, and Heroism" presentation drafts are expected to be in her mail box no later than 6pm this evening.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: The Facilities Department warns students, yet again, that anyone caught reprogramming classroom assistants or flip signs will face severe reprimand and consequences.

Speaker: 0013F9E9:AnnouncerM_CB_WatogaHighschoolPASystem:VTYP
Text: An important message for all students, faculty, and visitors. Please immediately comply with all directions issued by Protectron security robots. Failure to comply may result in unfortunate incidents.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Hello Appalachia! This is your deadly neighborhood Raider, Rose, and I'm back in business. Now, I know it can be lonely out there.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: But, I'm here to keep things interesting!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: If you miss the explosions, mayhem, and pure chaos of the early days after the bombs dropped, then I'm here to help!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Stay tuned! Tootleoo for now, girls and boys!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Hey all you aspiring raiders, out there! You know you want to get rich and live a life of luxury, just like your pal Rose did back in the day.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: A little blue birdie from Vault 76 let it slip that there's a treasure; a trove of unimaginable... stuff, buried somewhere right under our noses!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: So, let the hunt begin! Trust me, it's gotta be super good, or else why would it be hidden all this time?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: If you're interested in joining the baddest gang of outlaws in the Wasteland, come find me at the Top of the World. Chem addicts welcome!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Freeloaders need not apply. Unless you're freeloading from some other unfortunate sap out there, in which case, who the fuck cares, am I right?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: And before you get any funny ideas about trying to take me down, just remember who survived all alone out here.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Let me tell ya, it ain't the Responders, and it ain't the Brotherhood of Steel, that's for sure. So, let that sink in for a minute or two.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Hey friends, Rose here with the traffic and weather. Looks like almost everyone's still dead, so traffic's at a standstill.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Good luck with that commute. As for the weather, we're looking at scattered rad storms in the forecast, so cancel those weekend picnic plans!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: This next tip is for all of you people out there who aren't made of metal, or aren't already ghoulified, scorched, mutated, or who knows what else.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Life after the bomb is full of radiation, and getting worse every day, as civilization as you know it continues to crumble and melt down.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: If you can't be a robot, be smart, and carry protection. Pop some Rad-X and you'll be good to go in all but the most radioactive situations.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: If not, any large dosage of recreational chems will do in a pinch. You'll be so messed up, you won't care that your skin is melting away.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: But be kind, and try to bring any extra chems to share with your friend Rose before you die a horribly painful death.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: This has been Rose with another helpful survival tip.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Hey everyone, I'm getting pretty bored up here.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: If you can set off some nice explosions to let me know you're thinking of me, I'll be sure to find a way to thank you.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Of course, don't get your hopes up. What, do you think I'm loaded up here, just ready to give out presents like I'm Santa Claus or something?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: No, you'll get the mild appreciation of a psychotic robot lady. Isn't that enough?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Look, pretty much everything and everyone is dead out there. You've got to take what you can get.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Just be glad I'm not out there murdering you, too.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Sorry about my little outburst earlier. These chems are putting me through the moods, know what I'm saying?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Speaking of, here's another helpful tip for all of you out there!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Has this ever happened to you:

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: One day you're walking around minding your own business, and some sort of hulking monstrosity jumps out of nowhere and gets all up in your face?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Whip out some Psycho, in a convenient pre-measured syringe. Plunge that baby into your arm, and in no time, you'll be a force to be reckoned with!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Take on the beastliest of beasts. Carve 'em up like Sunday dinner.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Then, come on back to Rose and show your thanks for such a helpful tip by giving her any more Psycho you've found.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Remember, chems are bad for you, except when they're good! Then again, don't take it from me, I'm an addict!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: For those of you just tuning in... what took you so damn long?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: You missed a hell of an apocalypse while you were gone. I'm sure most of you lucky bastards were huddled safely together in one of those Vaults.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Must have been quite the shock to your system.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: What's it like crawling out of your safe little underground bunker and getting a nice big dose of reality?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: While you were all having birthday parties and sleeping on fresh linens, we were out here forging a new world order, where only the strong survive.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: And, let me tell you, the Raiders were at the top of the food chain... at least until the Scorched came around.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Now, you want to survive? You want to be able to live long enough to send those Scorched back into the ground where they belong?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Then, stick with me. Become a Raider. Don't trust anyone ... Well, except for me. You can trust me. Don't trust anyone... but me.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Forget rebuilding society. It ain't worth it. Follow me, and you'll learn all sorts of useful Raider skills, such as:

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Killing people and taking their stuff.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Intimidating extortion techniques.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Decorative corpse arrangement.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: And more!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Just come see me, Rose, at the Top of the World, and ask how you can be part of this amazing opportunity!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Dweebs, narcs, and other losers need not apply.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Alright, I'm back. Just had to check a trap to see who it killed. The answer is, no one worth worrying about.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Ever wonder how I manage to stay so sharp and alert?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Day in and day out, all I ever do is work the Radio booth and try to rebuild the greatest gang of Raiders the world's ever seen. It's tiring!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: It's Mentats, people. That's how you do it. I'm not saying these little pills will make you smarter, but I've done studies, you see.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Many, many studies. Like, daily studies. And let me tell you, they perk you right up. It's like kickstarting your brain.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: You'll see and hear things you didn't think you could see and hear, and boom, you'll feel like a certifiable genius while you're at it.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Take 'em when you want to feel smart in front of your friends. And, if you find any, feel free to drop by and we can conduct some more studies.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: It's story time, with Rose!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Once upon a time, there were two groups of people:

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: One group of good people who needed food and supplies.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: And, one group of bad people who had food and supplies.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: The good people asked the bad people to share, but the bad people said no.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: The good people realized that dead people don't need food and supplies, so, they grew a spine, went to where the bad people lived, and killed them.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Then, the good people went to bed with full stomachs and whatever else they needed. The end!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: The moral of the story is: be a Raider, because everyone else is a loser. If you want to know more, you know where to find me.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Just checking in with all my listeners in the Appalachia Wasteland. I feel like I need to educate you some more about all the chems out there.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: If I don't, how will you know what to bring me when I ask for it? And, you can use them too!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Now, maybe you were too young before the war, or maybe you were one of those straight-laced weirdos who were too good for chems.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Well, buckle up, because it's a new world out there, and you're going to need all the help you can get. Take Buffout, for example.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: If you came fresh out of the vault, your body is probably weak and ineffective from all those years living in luxury, eating your canned Cram.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Take yourself some Buffout. Run longer, and hit harder! You'll be a star athlete in no time, no training required!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Just look at how strong I am! I can crush a human spine with a single metal claw, and it's all thanks to Buffout!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Be careful though, it's incredibly addictive. Don't blame me for any side effects.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Hello world! Wait, was that supposed to be funny? I was trying to think of a joke, and came up with that instead.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Whatever, don't mind me, I've been doing a lot of chems.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: I want to let you all in on a little secret. There's a reason why I'm alive and no one else is.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: They all sucked. Not all of them were losers, I guess. Some of the Raiders were cool. Of course, I'm not sure I'm allowed to say they were all bad.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: But I'm here and they're not, so you figure it out. I was the only one smart enough to survive, and not succumb to radiation or starvation.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Then again, I've got this sweet hideout where no one can touch me.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: It used to be pretty boring and lonely out here, but ever since that vault opened, there's an endless stream of entertainment.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Honestly, I'm hoping someone out there survives, because I've been thinking a lot about starting a brand new Raider gang.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: And, we're going to need some easy pickings when we're back in business.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Maybe someone would be willing to help me out, and maybe I'd be willing to let said someone live when the Raiders rule again.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Maybe not though, I'm a fickle mistress. Rose, out!

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Have you been following my advice and taking all your chems, kiddos?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Are you not quite feeling yourself anymore when you run out?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Well, I've got bad news for you. Congratulations, you're addicted! What now, you may ask?

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Well, you could try to ride it out, but I wouldn't recommend it.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: You could recruit an unsuspecting lackey to keep bringing you more, a favorite of mine.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Or, you could shut up and deal with the fact that you're going to feel like crap until you find more.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: It used to be you could just go to the doctor and get a prescription for Addictol, but good luck with finding either of those.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Maybe you'll get lucky and figure out how to concoct your own cure, but I sure as hell don't know how, so don't ask me.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: And if you manage to survive the withdrawal, maybe you'll think twice about taking advice from strangers.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Just another helpful bit advice from your friend, Rose, who did not in any way tell you take all those chems.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: Calling all... [static] This is... [static] Rose.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: If... [static] ... hear me... [static] Top of the World [static] Pleasant Valley.

Speaker: 0019C051:RDR_Contact_Rose:NPC_
Text: I need help... [static] so we... [static] if you think you can... [static] look forward... [static] meeting you.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: ATLAS Project, Research Log, #104.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: Lieutenant Marcs and I have begun calibrating the ion beam accelerator.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: We've hit a plateau at the 300 MeV threshold. Micro-variations in the magnetic flux are disrupting the Betatron induction loop.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: The Lieutenant is working on a firmware update for the coil controller. She said she'll have the 'wobble' out by Monday.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: Assembly of the main device remains on schedule. The Air Force is nothing if not punctual.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: Colonel Oberlin is still pressing for the facility to be fully operational before the end of the year.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: As much as I want to see my research in action, we need to proceed carefully. If this goes wrong, the results could be catastrophic.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: ATLAS has the potential to change the world. Or destroy it.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: ATLAS Project, Research Log 292. 93? 93.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: It's been five months. Five months since that day.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: They abandoned me. The military never believed in ATLAS. It was just another weapon. When the nukes fell, what did it matter?

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: ATLAS, this research... it's been my life's work. We need ATLAS. The world needs ATLAS. Now more than ever.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: I have to finish it. Everything I need, it's all here. I just need time. And hands.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: I've activated all of the robots. They're security bots, they were never programmed for this. But it's all I've got. I can make it work.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: I've replaced the main lens. Finished the particle analysis. I think the accelerator is finally stable.

Speaker: 002B907A:NPCM_LC112_IsaacHammond:VTYP
Text: I'm so tired. But I have to keep going. Just a little more. It's almost done. Almost done.

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: To whoever hears this: I was just following orders.

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: Check my terminal. It's all there. This whole fiasco, it goes all the way to the top. Poseidon. The military. The government. They were all in on it.

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: The protests had to stop. They sent in the Guard. And the gas.

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: The gas. HalluciGen Gas. It was supposed to make them turn on each other. That's what they said.

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: 'Violent riot in union camp!' 'Protest ends without without a shot fired!'

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: Something went wrong. They rushed the lines.

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: We couldn't see in the smoke, but... they must have ripped their gas masks off. The soldiers turned.

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: I thought we were safe. The plant was sealed. They couldn't get in.

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: We forgot about the old expansion. They never installed the security doors there. They made it into the tunnels. Then the plant. They're everywhere.

Speaker: 002B907E:NPCM_LC006_BrentOlson:VTYP
Text: There's no way out. There's no way out.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Hello, dear. Welcome to the Order of Mysteries.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: I'm sure you're a little nervous. I know, it's a lot to take in. But the girls wouldn't have invited you here if they didn't think you were ready.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Eight years ago, I began training the girls we adopted to fight like the Mistress of Mystery, the hero I played for all those years on the radio.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Does that sound a little silly? I suppose it did to me too, at first.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: But the world needs the Mistress. It needs people with the strength to face the darkness, the will to survive against any odds. It needs you.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: It's time for you to join our sisterhood - the Order of the Mistresses of Mystery.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: You won't have to walk this path alone. For the next few months, you'll be training with one of your sisters.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: If you have someone you want to work with, that's fine. If not, Cryptos will assign you a mentor.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: And as soon as I get back, we'll sit down for tea, just the two of us. I promise.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Good morning.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: I'm sorry to drop this on you. Tiana hasn't reported in from her last mission. Olivia and I are heading out to investigate.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: I have a lead on a raider scouting party. I need you to follow up on it.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Standard protocol: Secure the location, look for signs of raider activity, and report back to the manor.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Be careful, dear. I can't bear to lose anyone else.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Congratulations, dear. I'm sorry I can't be with you today, but I'm sure the other girls can walk you through your vows.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Things have been difficult for us of late.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: In eight years, we've only lost one member of our family. In the past three months, we've lost seven. All to raider ambushes.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: I've asked Eve to accelerate our training program. If the worst should happen, we need everyone to be ready.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: In order to become a full member of the Order, you will need to master the tools of the Mistress of Mystery: sword, shot, and shadow.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Work with Eve and your mentor. When the time comes to prove yourself, Cryptos has the details.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *door creaks*

Speaker: 003666F3:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers_WithADifferentDisplayName:VTYP
Text: Brody?

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: Hey.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *kiss*

Speaker: 003666F3:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers_WithADifferentDisplayName:VTYP
Text: You're late.

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: I know, I know. Sorry. This is Blackwater territory - we've had issues with them lately.

Speaker: 003666F3:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers_WithADifferentDisplayName:VTYP
Text: Spare me. Any news?

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: The last two raids have gone well. We lost a couple of guys, but nothing like before.

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: The boss said he'd take your deal.

Speaker: 003666F3:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers_WithADifferentDisplayName:VTYP
Text: Finally.

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: I can't believe it. Babe, you and I are moving up in the world.

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: Do you have the tape?

Speaker: 003666F3:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers_WithADifferentDisplayName:VTYP
Text: Not yet. I found the program I need. Meet me here next week, and I'll have it for you.

Speaker: 003666F3:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers_WithADifferentDisplayName:VTYP
Text: Until then, I've got another ambush site picked out. You think you can do this?

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: Hmm. Lewisburg? Yeah, Kerry's gang is down that way.

Speaker: 003666F3:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers_WithADifferentDisplayName:VTYP
Text: All right, I'll set it up. Anything else?

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: No, we're good. See you next week.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *footsteps, door closes*

Speaker: 003666F3:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers_WithADifferentDisplayName:VTYP
Text: Idiot.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Phantom Device
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: First and foremost, the Mistress of Mystery was a master of stealth, subterfuge, and infiltration.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Phantom Device
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Your own talent and training are essential. But there were times when even the Mistress needed more.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Phantom Device
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Part smoke bomb, part cloaking field, the Phantom Device threw her foes into disarray while she made her most daring escapes.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Phantom Device
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Frederick has found a way to make a real Phantom Device. But it requires two components we have in short supply.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Phantom Device
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Search Cryptos for leads on Stealth Boys and HalluciGen Gas.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Phantom Device
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Use your training to infiltrate your targets, secure the items, and return them to the production facility.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Phantom Device
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Good luck, dear. And be careful.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Blade of Bastet
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: In combat, the Mistress of Mystery relied upon her speed, agility, and training in the martial arts, including the art of the sword.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Blade of Bastet
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: For many years, her favored weapon was the Blade of Bastet, a legendary sword passed down from hero to hero across the ages.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Blade of Bastet
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: The time has come for you to earn your own blade.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Blade of Bastet
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: First, you'll need to locate a sword with historic significance. That symbolism matters - you'll treat it with respect. Cryptos should have some leads.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Blade of Bastet
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Then, you'll need to pick up one of Frederick's Swing Analyzers and attach it to your sword.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Blade of Bastet
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: The Analyzer will collect data on your stance and swing as you wield it against different foes.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Blade of Bastet
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Once the Analyzer has finished its work, Frederick should be able to hone your sword into a blade worthy of the Mistress of Mystery.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Voice of Set
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: The Mistress of Mystery is not a sniper. She is not the Silver Shroud, leaping into the fray with his silver submachine gun blazing.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Voice of Set
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: But she does carry a pistol. It is a tool, like any other, to be used when the situation requires it.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Voice of Set
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: The Mistress' iconic revolver was the Voice of Set. It had... a variety of powers.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Voice of Set
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: To be frank, it did whatever the writers needed it to do. I received more than a few letters about that.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Voice of Set
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: But for us, that variety is essential. We need tools capable of meeting any challenge. Your mission is to help expand our options.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Voice of Set
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Cryptos has leads on a number of prototype weapons that were in development before the war. You will be assigned to retrieve one of them.

HolotapeName: Order of Mysteries - The Voice of Set
Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Bring the plans to Frederick, and see what he can make of it. He never fails to amaze me.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: In mastering the tools and techniques of the Mistress, you have earned the rank of Seeker. Your training is almost complete.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: In order to become a full member of the Order - a Mistress of Mystery - you must complete a mission worthy of the Mistress herself.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Continue to hone your skills. When the time comes, Eve will assign you a Mistress-rank mission from the mission board.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: This will be your final test. When you return, your sisters and I will be proud to welcome you into our ranks.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: If you're listening to this, you are now a full member of our order - a Mistress of Mystery. Congratulations, dear.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Since I'm not telling you this in person, I suppose it also means that I have... passed.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: As I record this, I'm in my sixties. No one lasts forever, especially given what we do.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: For most of my life, I was an actress. I would never have imagined any of this.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: But after the war, there were so many orphaned girls. They needed a home. They needed something to aspire to. They needed hope.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: All I had to offer them was a comic book hero. But... maybe that was enough.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: I'm sure Eve, or Olivia, or whoever follows them as Headmistress, has trained you well. You have her, and your mentor, and your sisters to lean on.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: And whatever happens to this world, you have the skills to face it.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Do your best, dear. I know you will.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: This mission is open for volunteers. It may well be a suicide mission. But at this point, I don't know what else to do.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: There have been three ambushes in the past week. Three more of our sisters killed. The raiders seem to know our every move.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: We need someone to infiltrate the raider stronghold at Pleasant Valley.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Find out how they know about us and our plans. Do whatever you have to do to stop them. And get out alive, if you can.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: If you make it back, report to me in my office for a full debrief.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: This may be the most difficult mission I've ever posted. But it's also the most important.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: The future of the Order of Mysteries depends on your success. Good luck.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *footsteps*

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Hello, mother.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Olivia. Why?

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Wake up. Look around you, mother. This isn't one of your comic book fantasies.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: You're no hero. You're just a sad old woman who couldn't face the world. And you dragged all of us into your delusion.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: How many people have we killed? Hundreds? For what? Nothing changes. There will always be more raiders.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Because they're right.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: There are no heroes. This is a world of villains. The strong survive. They rule.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: And mother? I am the strongest. You made me the strongest.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: I'm done living in the shadows. Done playing my part in your little farce. I've made my choice. It's time I took my place in the real world.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: You're worse than the raiders ever were. And far, far more dangerous.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: I'm sorry, Olivia. You've left me no choice.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *draws sword*

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Hmph.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *intense battle*

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Gaah!

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: I'm... so sorry, Olivia. I wish... I wish it hadn't come to this.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: A hero to the end.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Brody? You can come out now.

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: God, I've never seen anything like that...

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: That's it, then?

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Yeah. She was the last. It's all over.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Give me a hand, would you? Let's get out of here.

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: Sorry. One last thing?

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *cocks gun*

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Brody, what?

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *gunshot*

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Aah....

Speaker: 00347306:NPCM_MoM_Brody:VTYP
Text: Now it's over.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: All right, all right, settle down.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: I know the last few weeks have been a shock. We all hoped we could stay here forever.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: But when you stop and think about it, we've been blessed. So many people have had it so much worse.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: For the past year, The Whitespring has been our home. A shelter from the storm just outside the gates.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: It's time for us to face that storm.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: But we're ready. Ready, like none of us was on that day.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: We've had time to plan, to prepare, to stock up. To find friends to share the road ahead.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: The Whitespring bought us that time. Let's make the most of it.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: Ladies and Gentlemen, one last toast. To The Whitespring.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: Dave? Dave, honey, it's Joyce.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: I... I don't know if you'll ever get this. But I wanted to make sure there was something here, if you came looking, if you made it.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: God, where to start?

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: It's... it's about two-thirty in the morning. New Year's. 2079.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: I've been here for the past year, since the war. Me, a couple of the staff, about a hundred guests. And the robots.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: Never thought I'd be grateful for the robots.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: We made out all right. Even made me manager. Can you believe it?

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: But... we have to go. Paula and I, we're leaving for Charleston in the morning.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: I've missed you and the girls. Missed you so, so much. Take care of them for me, all right?

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: All my love. Always.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: They keep coming. They, they just keep coming.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: Rob. Rob saw them first. Three. Just, just three, out on the Seventh. Easy shots from up here.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: At first, we thought it was fun. Tried to see who could, who could pick them off. Extra points for the head.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: Then, then Rob went missing. Went down to the range. Wasn't far. Wasn't, wasn't back by dark.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: Then Ted. Zack. Zack, Phil, Mark. God, Mark. They dragged him. I can, can still hear him screaming.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: Now we're three. Just, just three. Can't run. Can't hold. Can't.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: They're, they're coming. They're coming!

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Mr. Ainsley. I wanted to remark upon the fascinating design of your new Springhill golf course.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: You appear to have seven holes. Seven. What a curious number.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Nine, I could understand. Or perhaps six, played thrice. But... seven.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Most courses put ever so much effort into varying their holes. You appear to have liked your third so much, you repeated it immediately.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Or take the cart paths. One normally takes such little note of them.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: I had a wonderful chance to reflect on that during the three-mile drive from the fifth hole to the sixth.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: And then, seven. Ah, seven. Such a slope. It would make a fabulous ski run.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Not that teeing off with a four hundred yard putt wasn't a unique experience.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: I confess, when I heard you had carved up your championship golf course for housing tracts, I was concerned it might have impacted the quality a little.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Clearly, I underestimated the scope of your ambition.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Cordially yours. Henrietta Winchester.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: And... recording. All right. What are we looking at?

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: I've got nothing.

Speaker: 003D61C7:LC060_PaulaHamilton_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Really, Lew? Really? You set up the damn things. Don't tell me you don't know how to hack them.

Speaker: 003D61C7:LC060_PaulaHamilton_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Can't you just shut them off? Or keep them from turning on us? There has to be a way.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: Paula-

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: No. Really, no. I'm sorry, Paula. We've tried everything.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: Not just me, every guest who can work a terminal. We've been locked out. We're getting kicked out. And there's nothing we can do.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: Paula, how's the training going?

Speaker: 003D61C7:LC060_PaulaHamilton_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Friedrich's classes are a joke, but the guests have been pitching in.

Speaker: 003D61C7:LC060_PaulaHamilton_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The Warrens picked up a few things on safari. Sgt. Tommelson's been teaching marksmanship.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: Tommelson? That crank who thinks the communists are bugging his room?

Speaker: 003D61C7:LC060_PaulaHamilton_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Yeah. Best we got.

Speaker: 003CDB02:NPCM_LC060_LewPalmest:VTYP
Text: God.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
