Text: At least people have been stocking up. The 'All-You-Can-Carry' Shopping Spree was a hit. No one turned that down.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: Anyone have anything else? Robert, how're things?

Speaker: 003D61CB:LC060_RobertMitchell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Keepin' on.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: Good. The Gala's on Sunday, so this may be our last staff meeting.

Speaker: 003CDAFF:NPCF_LC060_JoyceEaston:VTYP
Text: Whatever happens... we did all we could, this past year. I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Tannin! Another scotch.

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: Ma'am.

Speaker: 003D61C5:LC060_DorothyOrris_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What about you, Liz? Have you made up your mind yet?

Speaker: 003CDB10:NPCF_LC060_ElizabethWhite:VTYP
Text: Oh, Bill's keen on Charleston. We were social with the Governor. I'm sure he'd make arrangements for us.

Speaker: 003D61C6:LC060_SophiaHollingsworth_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Evans? That snake?

Speaker: 003D61C5:LC060_DorothyOrris_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: He always was for sale. Not a terrible thing, if you're the buyer.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Can you imagine, parading into town like a troupe of beggars?

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: And Charleston, no less! It always was a slum. Now? With refugees swarming like flies? Ugh.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: No, the resorts are the better option. If The Whitespring won't have us, we should try Pleasant Valley. Even Sunnytop.

Speaker: 003CDB10:NPCF_LC060_ElizabethWhite:VTYP
Text: Sunnytop? Really?

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: I'm not there for the skiing. Or the clientele.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: But I'd rather stay at a shoddy lodge than take my chances with... whatever might be going on down in the valley.

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: Ma'am.

Speaker: 003CDB09:NPCF_LC060_HenriettaWinchester:VTYP
Text: Just set it down. Now, let's finish this rubber. Dollar a point?

Speaker: 003CDB13:NPCM_LC060_ChrisEvetts:VTYP
Text: It's funny what comes to mind at a time like this.

Speaker: 003CDB13:NPCM_LC060_ChrisEvetts:VTYP
Text: When I was little, I used to come here with my grandfather.

Speaker: 003CDB13:NPCM_LC060_ChrisEvetts:VTYP
Text: Every morning, we'd sit right here, have donuts, read the paper. Just the two of us.

Speaker: 003CDB13:NPCM_LC060_ChrisEvetts:VTYP
Text: Everything changes. They got rid of the donuts. And the staff. And the whole world.

Speaker: 003CDB13:NPCM_LC060_ChrisEvetts:VTYP
Text: But this spot... it's still here.

Speaker: 003CDB13:NPCM_LC060_ChrisEvetts:VTYP
Text: Joyce did her best. They all did. I hope they make it out there.

Speaker: 003CDB13:NPCM_LC060_ChrisEvetts:VTYP
Text: As for me? I'm going to stay right here. Have one last donut. And whatever happens, happens.

Speaker: 003CDB13:NPCM_LC060_ChrisEvetts:VTYP
Text: Everything changes. But in the end? I can't imagine a place I'd rather be.

Speaker: 002FBECF:U04_NPCM_V94_AntonioSalavar:VTYP
Text: Hello, Gabby.

Speaker: 002FBECF:U04_NPCM_V94_AntonioSalavar:VTYP
Text: I'm sure you didn't expect to hear from me again. After the divorce, custody fight, the whole excommunication thing... maybe you don't want to.

Speaker: 002FBECF:U04_NPCM_V94_AntonioSalavar:VTYP
Text: But I'm worried about you and Angelique.

Speaker: 002FBECF:U04_NPCM_V94_AntonioSalavar:VTYP
Text: I'm working for Vault-Tec now. I put your name in for Vault 94.

Speaker: 002FBECF:U04_NPCM_V94_AntonioSalavar:VTYP
Text: They're looking for an entire community dedicated to peace and nonviolence. Your congregation would be perfect.

Speaker: 002FBECF:U04_NPCM_V94_AntonioSalavar:VTYP
Text: Think on it. After everything that's happened... you deserve it.

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: The hell's that?

Speaker: 002FBF21:U04_NPCM_V94_Billy:VTYP
Text: Lotta rads here, boss.

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: Lucas, check the terminal.

Speaker: 002D0B02:U04_NPCM_V94_Lucas:VTYP
Text: On it.

Speaker: 002FBF21:U04_NPCM_V94_Billy:VTYP
Text: These people are nuts. No weapons! Nothing! They didn't even try to fight back!

Speaker: 002D0B2E:U04_NPCM_V94_Red:VTYP
Text: I'm not complaining. Hell of a score.

Speaker: 002FBF21:U04_NPCM_V94_Billy:VTYP
Text: Sure, sure. But all that work to get in here, what do we find? A fucking briefcase?

Speaker: 002D0B02:U04_NPCM_V94_Lucas:VTYP
Text: Boss? Terminal says it's a... G.E.C.K.. 'Garden of Eden Creation Kit'.

Speaker: 002D0B2E:U04_NPCM_V94_Red:VTYP
Text: Some religious crap?

Speaker: 002FBF21:U04_NPCM_V94_Billy:VTYP
Text: This ain't no idol. C'mon. And what's with all the rads?

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: Radiation. Huh.

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: You know, boys... I think this here's some kind of mind control device. It's what drove all those saps crazy.

Speaker: 002FBF21:U04_NPCM_V94_Billy:VTYP
Text: Mind control? You serious?

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: You got a better explanation? I'm already feeling a little off.

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: Let's just waste this thing and get out of here. Red, light it up.

Speaker: 002D0B2E:U04_NPCM_V94_Red:VTYP
Text: You got it.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *draws minigun*

Speaker: 002D0B02:U04_NPCM_V94_Lucas:VTYP
Text: No, wait--

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *explosion*

Speaker: 002FBEBC:U04_NPCF_V94_PastorGabriellaSalavar:VTYP
Text: This meeting of the Vault 94 Community Council is now in session.

Speaker: 002FBEBC:U04_NPCF_V94_PastorGabriellaSalavar:VTYP
Text: Today's the day. Our first guests should be arriving--

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *door opens*

Speaker: 002FBEBC:U04_NPCF_V94_PastorGabriellaSalavar:VTYP
Text: Ah, you're early! Good morning. On behalf of--

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: Shut it. What the hell's your game?

Speaker: 002FBEBC:U04_NPCF_V94_PastorGabriellaSalavar:VTYP
Text: I... what?

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: You send out all these 'Ambassadors': "All are welcome!" "Come, join us!" "We have food to spare!"

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: And you think we'd just waltz into a fucking trap like that?

Speaker: 002FBEBA:U04_NPCM_V94_TyroneHayes:VTYP
Text: Oh god.

Speaker: 002FBEBC:U04_NPCF_V94_PastorGabriellaSalavar:VTYP
Text: Gentlemen, I assure you, this is no trap. We would be happy to share...

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: 'Share'. Right.

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: You're stalling. Boys?

Speaker: 002D0B2E:U04_NPCM_V94_Red:VTYP
Text: Boss said to start talking, lady.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *Guns drawn*

Speaker: 002FBEBC:U04_NPCF_V94_PastorGabriellaSalavar:VTYP
Text: Please, put your guns down. This is a peaceful community.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *gunshot*

Speaker: 002FBEBA:U04_NPCM_V94_TyroneHayes:VTYP
Text: No!

Speaker: 002FBECE:U04_NPCF_V94_AngeliqueSalavar:VTYP
Text: Mother!

Speaker: 002D0B0D:U04_NPCM_V94_Cole:VTYP
Text: Fuck it. Just kill them.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *gunfire*

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: *static* ...gangs are on the move. We must... *static* ...The Order cannot... *static*

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: *static* ...Riverside Manor is... *static* ...raiders are closing in... *static*

Speaker: 004E60EA:NPCF_MoM_NatashaHunt:VTYP
Text: This is the Infirmary log for Tuesday, September 17th. Mistress Natasha Hunt reporting.

Speaker: 004E60EA:NPCF_MoM_NatashaHunt:VTYP
Text: We have two active cases.

Speaker: 004E60EA:NPCF_MoM_NatashaHunt:VTYP
Text: Alexis is in critical condition following the accident in the Hall of Trials earlier today.

Speaker: 004E60EA:NPCF_MoM_NatashaHunt:VTYP
Text: I've done my best to stabilize her, but I'm no surgeon. She's lost a lot of blood. If she goes into shock... there's not much we can do.

Speaker: 004E60EA:NPCF_MoM_NatashaHunt:VTYP
Text: Laura is still recovering from bone worms. Her bloodwork is clean, but I've recommended light duty for the next two weeks.

Speaker: 004E60EA:NPCF_MoM_NatashaHunt:VTYP
Text: There was one minor incident today: Olivia commandeered an entire bag of Stimpaks and took off without a word.

Speaker: 004E60EA:NPCF_MoM_NatashaHunt:VTYP
Text: I've put in a complaint, but... Headmistress' daughter and all. She never changes.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Frederick Rivers, Production Log, #194.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Been a busy week. Janet and I finally got the new Fabricator all wired up. Should've done this years ago.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Briana was our first guinea pig, uh, I mean, user. Her blade turned out fine, but her Phantom Device had a bit of a valve leak.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Had to clear the lab until we could vent the gas. Nasty stuff.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Janet really deserves most of the credit. It's a slick system, and networking it into Cryptos will save us a lot of bookkeeping.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Beyond that? Usual mix. Shannon wants a recording device for her next mission. Isabella's gun prototype needed some work.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Oh, and Eve has me working on some new programs for the Hall of Trials - have to keep the girls on their toes. They certainly keep me on mine.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Frederick Rivers, Production Log, #209.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: This whole thing still amazes me sometimes.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Take Cryptos. I needed a mainframe to run Shannon's training room. My buddy Zack at RobCo had a mothballed old DIA project he wanted to unload.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: I didn't give a damn about the price. It looked impressive. And it's been one hell of a machine.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: The girls have done a fantastic job collecting intel over the years.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Rachel, Janet, and I spent the last two weeks pruning the database down, and we've still got more leads than we know what to do with.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Oh. Rachel had an idea for an automated query system for mission assignments.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: I took a look at her code. Nice piece of work. I think our old mainframe's in good hands.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Frederick Rivers, Production Log, #212.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: I've started digging into Kent's old idea for ballistic weave.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: It's ambitious, I'll give him that. Finding the right pattern is going to be-

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Hmm? Oh, Shannon. Sorry, didn't hear you come in.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: What are you up to, dear? Another log? Does anyone ever listen to these?

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: I don't know. Maybe they'll come in handy for Janet, some day. She practically runs the place now. I just tinker.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: You do more than that. I could never have done this without you.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: I know that look. What's bothering you? Olivia?

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Our daughter is two days late. Again. Frederick, I don't know what to do with that girl.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: She's smart, talented, but... she never listens. She won't take orders. When I try to correct her, she just storms off. Do you think you could-

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: Dear, I love you both. I can't get in the middle of this. The two of you need to talk this out.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: We've always put a lot of pressure on her. She's not perfect, but she's an incredible young woman. Remember that.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Yeah. Yeah, I know.

Speaker: 004E60EC:NPCM_MoM_FrederickRivers:VTYP
Text: It's past midnight. Come on, let's get to bed. I can finish this in the morning.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: All right. Let's keep this brief.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Vanessa and Briana are missing. Given recent events, we should assume they've been ambushed.

Speaker: 004E60F2:NPCF_MoM_EvelynJackson:VTYP
Text: What do you mean, 'assume'? Are we just giving up on them?

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Of course not. But-

Speaker: 004E60F1:NPCF_MoM_JanetTyler:VTYP
Text: We should send rescue teams. Groups of three or four. They can't possibly take us all on.

Speaker: 004E60F0:NPCF_MoM_EveDevoir:VTYP
Text: We're shorthanded enough as it is. We can't have everyone on search and rescue.

Speaker: 004E60F2:NPCF_MoM_EvelynJackson:VTYP
Text: Dammit. None of this makes sense! We've fought those bastards for years!

Speaker: 004E60F2:NPCF_MoM_EvelynJackson:VTYP
Text: Any one of us could take down an entire raider squad by ourselves. Most of us have!

Speaker: 004E60F2:NPCF_MoM_EvelynJackson:VTYP
Text: But now, all of a sudden, we're the ones getting wiped out? Why? What changed?

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: I don't know. But we have to find a way forward.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Eve, I want you to ramp up our training program. The younger girls need to be able to defend themselves.

Speaker: 004E60F0:NPCF_MoM_EveDevoir:VTYP
Text: Of course.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Olivia, watch the manor. If you see anything suspicious, report back at once.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Sure.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: I mean it. No games. No pursuit.

Speaker: 00347305:NPCF_MoM_OliviaRivers:VTYP
Text: Yeah, got it.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: Everyone else: I'm going to post a new mission this afternoon. I won't assign it out, but... I want you all to take a look at it.

Speaker: 00347304:NPCF_MoM_ShannonRivers:VTYP
Text: If anyone has any better ideas, see me in my office. Dismissed.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: All right, calm down. We've all...

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: Calm down? Erik, what kind of a scam is this?

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: I know this isn't what you expected. I'm still trying to process it all, too.

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: Bullshit. You worked for Vault-Tec! You had to know!

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Jeanette, I already told you-

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *bangs fist*

Speaker: 00588206:U07_NPCM_HansMemling:VTYP
Text: So. The door has sealed. There is no way for us to reopen it.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Apparently not.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: And it's just the five of us in here?

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: That's right.

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: That's crazy. You could fit an entire town in here!

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: I want to know about the experiments. Are there really ten thousand creatures in cryo here?

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: And instead of preserving them, you want us to experiment on them. Induce mutations. Optimize for lethality.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Those are our orders. You will all have weekly research quotas to meet.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: And if we refuse? Or fall short?

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Anyone failing to meet their quota, or otherwise trying to rebel, will be... eliminated.

Speaker: 00588206:U07_NPCM_HansMemling:VTYP
Text: You can't be serious.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *footsteps*

Speaker: 0006E5A2:RobotAssaultron:VTYP
Text: Sir.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: I'm afraid so.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: Molly Cooper, Biology. Log, um, 280.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: What is this?

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: The specimen record is blank. No vitals, no measurements, no source data. Just an ID: 'X-001'.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: The cellular structure is unlike anything I've ever seen. I can't even identify the organelles.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: I ran it through the DNA sequencer. Twice. But... nothing. Nothing at all.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: I talked it over with Nina, and she's going to try splicing into some of the cellular structures at random, just to see what happens.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: It's a longshot, but we have a quota to meet. Fucking Vault-Tec.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Genetic Research Log, Week 100. Retrospective.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Our first mutations were simple enough. Venom. Regeneration. Electrogenesis. Natural phenomena with well-understood biochemical processes.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Despite my initial misgivings, developing, adapting, and enhancing general-purpose mutagenic sequences has been a fascinating challenge.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: So much so that I fear we have set the bar too high.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Erik's quotas are ever more aggressive, even as potential research targets grow increasingly elusive.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Molly and I have moved on to more speculative mutations. Chameleonization. Pyrokinesis. Cryokinesis.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: But after that... I am less certain. This pace is maddening. How much longer can we maintain it?

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Genetic Research Log, Week 142.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Specimen X-001 has been a most remarkable success.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: I confess, I was skeptical when Molly showed me her analysis. There was little to work with, given its... unique biology.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: As an initial bench test, I spliced each of our extant stable mutations into separate samples.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: They all worked. Flawlessly. As if we had spent months adapting them.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: And then the mutations... spread.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: They somehow shifted from one sealed petri dish to the next, until all of the samples exhibited all of the mutations. Fascinating.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: I wanted to proceed to live subject testing immediately, but all of our attempts to resuscitate a specimen have been blocked.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Hans is looking into it. In the meantime, this transference capability merits further investigation.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Genetic Log, Week... 148? 148.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: There is little progress to report. Too little.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: The Shifting mutation is still unstable. When stressed, subjects will shift or... or phase, or...

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: ...whatever it is. It works. But it's inconsistent. Uncontrollable.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: Without some understanding of the underlying physics or biology, there is little I can do to stabilize or improve on it.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: If I could study the original specimen, perhaps I could make some progress.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: But there is, apparently, only one subject, in a secured cryonics bay, with military access controls.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: I've no doubt Erik could get in, but he has refused.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: I have put everything into this research. I'm out of time.

Speaker: 00588205:U07_NPCF_NinaValaya:VTYP
Text: I will not make my quota. Forgive me, Molly.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: *sobs*

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Get ahold of yourself.

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: Bastard. Nina's dead, Erik! Dead! All because of your damn quotas. If you can't show a little compassion, shut the hell up.

Speaker: 00588206:U07_NPCM_HansMemling:VTYP
Text: Hey, now.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: I regret what happened to Nina. I truly do. But we're wasting time.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *click*

Speaker: 00588206:U07_NPCM_HansMemling:VTYP
Text: What?

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: There. That should disable the sensors. Listen carefully.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: They aren't 'my' quotas. They never have been. They're set by the Mainframe. Look, here are next week's numbers.

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: God. There's no way...

Speaker: 00588206:U07_NPCM_HansMemling:VTYP
Text: Why didn't you tell us?

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: It's on a hair trigger. If it detects anything, any word of conspiracy or sedition, it will kill us. I had to be sure.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: The only way we survive the next week is to take it out.

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: You want us to fight our way out?

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: We don't have to. For the past two years, I've been working on a virus. SERAPH.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Upload it into the Mainframe, and it can take over, shut down the system, the experiments, everything. It can let us out.

Speaker: 00588206:U07_NPCM_HansMemling:VTYP
Text: The EMS-

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: -won't be a problem. I designed that system. My students wrote the damn protocols. I can beat it.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: We can't go on like this. I'm... I'm in. For Nina.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Jeanette? Hans?

Speaker: 00588206:U07_NPCM_HansMemling:VTYP
Text: I... all right.

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: What the hell. Sure.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Here's what I need from you. We move on Saturday, just before the quota check. Be ready.

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: Sensor discrepancy detected in: the Overseer's Office. Applying cancellation algorithm... done.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Have a good week, everyone. Dismissed.

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: And... down. Go, go, go.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *Running*

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: Robotics control failure in: the Mainframe Wing. Activating Emergency Fabrication Protocol FS-401.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Jeanette. Circuits 10, 18, 57.

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: Got it.

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: Fabrication system: offline. Activating Emergency Repair Protocol CR-889.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: 889, that's... Hans, we need a reactor brownout.

Speaker: 00588206:U07_NPCM_HansMemling:VTYP
Text: All right, give me a minute.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: 109's next. Jeanette?

Speaker: 00588208:U07_NPCF_JeanetteHiggins:VTYP
Text: Ready on the detonator.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Molly, are you in?

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: Sorry, sorry, just a-

Speaker: 00588206:U07_NPCM_HansMemling:VTYP
Text: Brownout in 3, 2, 1...

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *Power failure*

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: Power fluctuations detected in: the Engineering Wing. Activating Emergency Stabilization Protocol ES-109.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *Explosion*

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: Detonation in: the Cryogenics Wing.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: That should do it.

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: Activating Superceding Protocol Omega.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: Erik?

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: That's not in the database. What...?

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: Protocol confirmed. All exits have sealed to prevent a containment breach.

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: Calculating optimal process to exterminate all personnel in the Vault. ...done. All remaining personnel may now be terminated.

Speaker: 00588207:U07_NPCF_MollyCooper:VTYP
Text: I'm locked out!

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Here, I got it. Cover the door!

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *Fighting*

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Damn it, almost...

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: Data upload from compromised system detected. Suspect data stream has been quarantined.

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: What? Bypass, bypass!

Speaker: 00588204:U07_NPCM_ErikDeMarcos:VTYP
Text: Gah!

Speaker: 0041F807:U07_AnnouncerF_V96Mainframe:VTYP
Text: All residents have been terminated. Operation: successful. Have a nice day.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Responders field manual project, entry one. Maria Chavez speaking.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I've been thinking about where to start. What's the first thing, the most important thing, we can teach our members?

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: It has to be radiation, that silent killer, omnipresent in the world around us.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: We've lost too many good men and women to the terrible effects of radiation. Most didn't know they'd been exposed until it was too late.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Our rations of Rad-X and RadAway are too limited to treat everyone, but I've been working on a way to extend those supplies.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I've found a way to create diluted variations of both Rad-X and RadAway, cutting the base chems with purified water.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I wrote the formulas down while I was at Arktos Pharma, but some ghouls chased me out.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I need to get back there so I can do some trials. I'm confident it'll work, but I'd like to be completely sure.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: After that, I'll head to AVR medical and start work on the next chapter. Hopefully there won't be ghouls there, too.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Responders field report. Maria Chavez speaking.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Being here at AVR Medical really brings back memories. My mother worked at this place for years as a nurse.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: When I was a child, back before the war, I got sick for days. Supply shortages had driven the price of medicine beyond what we could afford.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Lucky for us, my mom wasn't just a nurse, but also a natural green thumb. We had a garden with all kinds of herbs and flowers.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: She treated me with home-made herbal remedies.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Today, disease is rampant. There are countless viruses and bacterial infections out there, and we need a way to deal with them.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I was hoping I might find something here to help treat all the sick and injured refugees we've got back at the airport.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Unfortunately, the place has been picked pretty clean by now, and there isn't much left.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: So, having had basically no luck in this creepy abandoned hospital, I've decided to turn instead to my mother's wisdom.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I've put together some herbal tea recipes that should mitigate the symptoms of the more common sicknesses. It's not a cure, but it's something.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Well, I think I'll wrap this up.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Guess I'm off to pick some flowers.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: It's all falling apart.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: Kamara signed up with the Responders. Brian's fallen in with the anarchists up in the mountains. And Eric... why did he have to complicate things?

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: He didn't take it too well when I told him I don't feel the same way about us. He just walked away. I'll probably never see him again.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: I used to think it was up to me to make sure our plan didn't fall into the wrong hands. But now... Hell, what difference does it really make?

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: I don't have much time left. I feel so sick. My hair's falling out. Maybe if someone finds this... maybe you can finish what we started.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: The school... hiding a secret. A secret that might help you survive. Find the training room terminal. Learn about... the plan.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: So sick, can barely... barely... *gurgling sounds*

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: My name is Maria Chavez, and I am about to die.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: The Scorched have overrun our defenses. They're coming for us all. If you find this, please listen carefully.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: We were called the Responders. After the bombs fell, we tried to help people. Maybe I can still help you.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: The terminal nearby... if it's still there, use it. Learn about the inoculation project. It might just save your life.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Shit... they're here. I'm out of time. Read the terminal. Learn about the Scorched. Remember us.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: And... good luck.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: Wait, is that... you brought a holotape recorder?

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: Oh, um... yeah. There's something I wanted to document. Don't worry, it's nothing weird, I promise.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: Anyway, you asked where I like to go to be alone and think, and here we are.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: When I was a student at VTU, I always thought Summersville was one of the prettiest towns I'd ever seen. It was... quaint, you know? Old-fashioned.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: Now it's lost all of its charm for me. I just see a sad, decaying place filled with the ghosts of a forgotten world.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: What draws you here? Is it the silence?

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: The view, actually. You can see the floodlands perfectly from here.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: The mud flats? Why? There's nothing to see there. It's a ruin.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: Because I never want to forget how lucky I am to be alive.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: I volunteered for the mission to Pleasant Valley because I was bored and wanted some excitement in my life. I know, I was young and stupid.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: We weren't even an hour outside the city when we heard the blast from the dam. We looked on as the river washed half of Charleston away.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: I lost every friend I had on that day, and for a long time, I felt like it was unfair that I survived. Like I should have died with them.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: But that all changed on the day I met you, Amy. You gave me a reason to want to be alive.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: That's why I wanted to ask you...

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: Jeff, don't. I know what you want to say, but... now isn't the time. I don't know if it ever will be. I just can't think about that right now.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: It's not that I don't care about you, but I have my work on the environmental monitoring program, and you've got your duties to the Responders.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: People are counting on us to be selfless. To put their needs ahead of ours.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: I know, but part of rebuilding the world is... well, having families again, and I think that's an important responsibility, too.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: Besides, why even bother trying to survive if there aren't things worth living for?

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: Look... if this is too soon for you, then I'll wait until you're ready. Just promise you'll tell me if you change your mind.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: Okay. I promise.

HolotapeName: Field Report: Mama Dolce's Food Processing
Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: Responders field report, Sanjay Kumar speaking. Recon mission to Mama Dolce's Food Processing plant nearly complete.

HolotapeName: Field Report: Mama Dolce's Food Processing
Speaker: 002D158F:NPCM_DaveStrauss:VTYP
Text: Shh! Not so loud, Mister Sanjay! I can hear more of those little robots with the red stars walking around nearby.

HolotapeName: Field Report: Mama Dolce's Food Processing
Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: If the robots are a concern, go and deal with them. You're supposed to be my security escort, aren't you?

HolotapeName: Field Report: Mama Dolce's Food Processing
Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: As I was saying, recon mission wrapping up now. What I've found here is very promising. There's a good chance I can get these machines operational.

HolotapeName: Field Report: Mama Dolce's Food Processing
Speaker: 002D158F:NPCM_DaveStrauss:VTYP
Text: Where are all these robots coming from, anyway? What are they doing here? Maybe we should just get out of here.

HolotapeName: Field Report: Mama Dolce's Food Processing
Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: Pull yourself together, man! I swear, you're the most timid security volunteer I've ever met.

HolotapeName: Field Report: Mama Dolce's Food Processing
Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: Where was I? Ah. I recommend we return with a mechanical team to investigate the possibility of restoring this facility to full operational status.

HolotapeName: Field Report: Mama Dolce's Food Processing
Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: This concludes my report.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: Jeff, I really hope you got my message and my hint was clear enough to help you find this holotape.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: I'm leaving the cabin. These Brotherhood of Steel guys haven't found out where I live yet, but they might.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: I'm going to hide out in the place we had our first date. Come and meet me there when you can.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: I locked out my environmental monitoring program with a password and I'd like you to have it.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: After everything the Brotherhood has put us through, there's no way in hell they're getting my research.

Speaker: 0001C580:NPCF_AmyKerry:VTYP
Text: I hope you can find me soon. Until then, be safe and... I love you. I should have told you much sooner, in person.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: My name is Hayley Porter. I'm making this holotape because I don't have much time left.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: I hope... I pray someone finds this. That someone... that you... can finish what we started.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: There were four of us once, but now it's just me. The others... Brian, Kamara, Eric... all left for reasons of their own.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: We were so close to learning the secret... to finding what Vault-Tec was hiding in the school.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: If you're listening to this, find my terminal in the training room. The password is... "Inevitability".

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: Learn about the plan. Learn about what Vault-Tec was hiding. Maybe it can help you. Maybe it can help everyone.

Speaker: 000594F5:NPCF_HayleyPorter:VTYP
Text: Maybe you can do what we failed to do. Survive...

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Responders field manual project, entry two. Maria Chavez speaking.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: When I was a child, back before the war, I got sick for days. Supply shortages had driven the price of medicine beyond what we could afford.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Lucky for us, my mom wasn't just a nurse, but also a natural green thumb. We had a garden with all kinds of herbs and flowers.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: She nursed me back to health not with prescription drugs, but with home-made herbal remedies.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Today, disease is rampant. There are countless viruses and bacterial infections out there, and we need a way to deal with them.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I've put together some herbal tea recipes that should mitigate the symptoms of the more common sicknesses. It's not a cure, but it's something.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Well, I think I'll wrap this up.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I better get back to the airport and see if Sanjay got that questionnaire set up. He said it would be done by now.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: This is Maria Chavez speaking, and today is December 25th, 2092.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Once, in the world before the war, this would have been a joyous time to celebrate with loved ones. Now it's a time to reflect and to mourn.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: It was on this day ten years ago that we lost so much in the tragic event we call the Christmas Flood.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I'm making this recording in the hopes of ensuring the flood and its victims are never forgotten.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I suppose the story really begins in November of 2077, the month after the war.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Survivors from the Pleasant Valley Ski Resort sent a group to Charleston to ask for help and supplies. The city leaders turned them away.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: There was so much chaos and so much need back then, I suppose it was an impossible request to grant.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: The failure to secure help led to a change in leadership for the survivors at the ski resort.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: A cold and brutal man named David Thorpe took charge, and he shaped those people into something terrible.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: They took what they wanted by force and killed anyone that stood in their way.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Years later, Thorpe's girlfriend Rosalynn led a raid on Charleston. They were spotted early, and a fight broke out.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: A few of them escaped, but Rosalynn was injured and taken prisoner along with some of the other raiders.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: By then, the Responders were more or less running things in the city, and we were doing pretty well for ourselves.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: We felt confident we could confront the raiders on their home turf, so we sent a group up into the mountains to see if we could make a deal.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: We hoped we could get them to leave us alone if we agreed to release some of the prisoners. We were wrong.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Thorpe had somehow got his hands on a mini-nuke, and he used it to blow the Summersville Dam on Christmas morning.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: We lost almost everything; our homes, our supplies and most of our friends and family.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: The days and weeks that followed were the hardest of my life, but somehow, we held together.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: We kept the idea of the Responders alive, even though there were only a handful of us left.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: That's the story of the Christmas Flood. Tell your children, tell everyone you meet. Let's keep the memory alive for as long as we can.

Speaker: 002D158F:NPCM_DaveStrauss:VTYP
Text: Sutton... I grew up here. Seems kind of quiet and lonely now.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Well it ain't as lonely as you think. This place crawls with ferals, an' ferals is why we're here, rook. It's time for some live-fire training.

Speaker: 002D158F:NPCM_DaveStrauss:VTYP
Text: Ferals?! Those things give me the willies! All that hissin' and raspin' and jumpin' around... but then you remember they used to be folks like us.

Speaker: 002D158F:NPCM_DaveStrauss:VTYP
Text: Oh no! What if some of them are my relations? Or, I mean, they used to be.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Hey! Get your head in the game, rook! Quit makin' these things out to be more than they are.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Well all come from around here, an' we all had families an' homes that we lost when the bombs fell. Sutton's just a place. The airport's home now.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Get ready. I'm going to make some noise an' draw them out. Just remember your trainin' an' you'll do fine.

Speaker: 002D158F:NPCM_DaveStrauss:VTYP
Text: Oh lord, please forgive me if any of these things is a cousin.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Really? You're going to record this?

Speaker: 00511A7F:NPCM_LeoChase:VTYP
Text: You're damn right I am! I want Madigan to hear about this when he gets back. I want him to know what you're trying to pull here!

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: You are way the hell out of line, Chase!

Speaker: 00511A7F:NPCM_LeoChase:VTYP
Text: I'm out of line?! I ain't the one agreeing to send the Fire Breathers on a suicide mission without our best man!

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: That's enough! Both of you, stop it!

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Look... Leo... the reports, they're talking about a horde of Scorched on the other side of those mountains.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: You know as well as I do that sealing the tunnel's our best chance to stop them. Maybe our only chance.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: If the Fire Breathers don't move now, everyone dies. It's just a matter of when.

Speaker: 00511A7F:NPCM_LeoChase:VTYP
Text: We just need more time! He's coming back. I'm telling you, he'll be here! We just... need time.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: We are out of time, Leo.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Melody's going to lead the mission. She's got experience in this kind of thing, and I'd trust her with my life. With all our lives.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Now turn off that damn recorder and do your duty, Fire Breather.

Speaker: 00511A7F:NPCM_LeoChase:VTYP
Text: Yes ma'am.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: Hey everyone, this is Derek, making my final report on the events at Harpers Ferry. Hopefully this reaches you all safely.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: Whatever happened here, it was big. The whole area is... it's devastated. If any of our people survived, I can't find a trace of them.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: I talked to some of the locals. They say creatures came from the sky and laid waste to the town.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: Some of the ones who got hurt in the attack were transformed or something. They apparently turned into monsters and attacked anyone they could reach.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: Raleigh says he and his people are going to seal themselves up in their bunkers and try to figure out a way to fight these creatures.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: In other words, we won't be getting any more help from these Free States guys.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: Maria, I was hoping you could get in touch with Ella, see if maybe she can lean on Raleigh a little, get him to see that this isn't the way.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: If you ask me, I think it's damn selfish of them to turn their backs on the rest of us, on people who need their help to survive.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: There's nothing else l can do here. Guess we can scratch Harpers Ferry off the map.

Speaker: 0051A5A9:NPCM_DerekCastle:VTYP
Text: I'll be heading back soon, but I want to check in on the some of the farms along the way. Should be about a week.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: This is Hank Madigan. Message to any Fire Breathers running through here after me.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Had to dodge more robots and turrets than I can count, but I found what we were looking for.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Atomic Mining Services were the barons of Ultracite. Had a lab right here in this office. I think they might have found a way to help us out. Even if they didn't know it.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Turns out once all the fuel is spent, there's a hunk of material left behind. This depleted Ultracite doesn't play nice with the normal stuff. Turns corrosive.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: AMS was thinking disposal and containment. I'm thinking weapon.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Scorched walk around with chunks of Ultracite stuck in them. We modify some guns to fire depleted Ultracite. See if that makes those assholes melt.

Speaker: 0043A4D0:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown03:NPC_
Text: Condemned. That's what they told me. Five generations lived under this roof, and now the government, my government, is taking it from us.

Speaker: 0043A4D0:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown03:NPC_
Text: I asked the agent what they're going to do with it, and you know what he told me?

Speaker: 0043A4D0:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown03:NPC_
Text: Just buy an apartment up in Watoga. Ain't that supposed to be the city of the future? Then he sneered at me and laughed.

Speaker: 0043A4D0:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown03:NPC_
Text: We'll see who's laughing when they try to drag me out of here.

Speaker: 0043A4CF:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown02:NPC_
Text: Dad, I know you wanted me to stay, but I'm leaving. I... I have my daughter to think about now. This whole town is dying, and you don't even see it.

Speaker: 0043A4CF:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown02:NPC_
Text: The government, the mining companies, Vault-Tec... they want West Virginia to run by the machines.

Speaker: 0043A4CF:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown02:NPC_
Text: Don't you get it? There won't be any work once Watoga is finished. They won't... they won't need people anymore.

Speaker: 0043A4CF:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown02:NPC_
Text: I'm sorry. I really hope one day you'll understand.

Speaker: 0043A4CE:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown01:NPC_
Text: Twenty-five years on the force, and they're saying I won't be getting my retirement package. Say they can't afford it, anymore. Lucky them, they get to decide that.

Speaker: 0043A4CE:VoiceOnly_HolotapeBogTown01:NPC_
Text: I asked if maybe if I could be transferred to Watoga, take some kind of desk job, but they're not hiring. The robots are handling all the security, they told me.

Speaker: 0043A4D1:VoiceOnly_WatogaEstates01:NPC_
Text: I can't believe some of the riff-raff that's made it through the application process.

Speaker: 0043A4D1:VoiceOnly_WatogaEstates01:NPC_
Text: I was told Watoga would be an exclusive neighborhood, but the caliber of some of the people they've allowed in. Hmph.

Speaker: 0043A4D1:VoiceOnly_WatogaEstates01:NPC_
Text: They would never have been accepted if I was in charge, that's for sure.

Speaker: 0043A4D2:VoiceOnly_WatogaEstates02:NPC_
Text: This is the third time this week I've seen protestors marching outside of Watoga.

Speaker: 0043A4D2:VoiceOnly_WatogaEstates02:NPC_
Text: For the amount of money we're paying, I expect a certain level of security. How is anyone here safe with those mobs screaming at us all day?

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: Scouting report. Brotherhood Squire Schultz.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: Everything in this entire shopping plaza is a load of junk. I thought this place was meant for rich people. Why were they buying all this crap?

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: At least the storefronts give you plenty of places to hide. The bots are everywhere. Might be the only things worth salvaging if I could get the drop on one.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: Scouting report. Brotherhood Squire Schultz.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: Kerwood Mine is almost completely flooded. Going down into that brine without Power Armor or a stronger set of lungs seems suicidal.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: It's too bad. My recon instincts are telling me there could be something good down there. Maybe a way into that locked room.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: Scouting report. Brotherhood Squire Schultz.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: This old antique store has been a good source of supplies. I've stashed some weapons and ammo in the shed out back.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: Scavenging runs into Watoga have been... mixed. The robots are everywhere and you never know when a turret is going to pop out of its hiding place and start filling the area with lead or laser fire.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: I really should've paid more attention to during training.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: Scouting report. Brotherhood Squire Schultz.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: This whole trainyard is half-sunk in the ground. Anyone in the middle of that mess is just begging for a sniper to pick them off.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: These two warehouses seem to be the only good defensible position. There's a nice walkway between them and plenty of places to get the drop on someone.

Speaker: 0031F414:NPCM_SquireSchultz:VTYP
Text: Heh. I might actually be getting the hang of this.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: Hospital Incident Report. Resident Psychiatrist Doctor Kessle.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: One of the junior nurses has suffered a nervous breakdown.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: His assignments included Patient 5A3, whose afflictions manifest in habitual self-harm.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: Patient 5A4, who - while not violent - does aggressively grab and paw at whoever is trying to administer care.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: And also Patient 5B7, who breaks down into loud, un-consolable fits of crying with no apparent cause or trigger.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: That, and the constant attention and sanitary cleanup required throughout the day for all of his charges, was too much for the young nurse.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: We found him standing outside the door to one of the patient rooms, carrying a tray of food but not moving anywhere.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: One of the other nurses noticed he had been standing in place for over an hour.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: When he finally responded to our attempts to get his attention, he seemed surprise that any time had passed.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: During our exit interview, he broke into tears. He wanted to know if something was wrong with him. If he would end up here as a patient.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: I explained that nervous exhaustion was a common ailment, especially for hospital workers.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: Maybe after some months of rest, he could re-apply for his job. That didn't seem to console him.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: Hospital Incident Report. Resident Psychiatrist Doctor Kessle.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: We had a fight breakout today. All the patients in the dining area for the morning meal and all the attending staff were present.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: Patient 3E2 has never had any problems with violence but can be verbally abusive to whoever happens to be in the area.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: The staff intervened, but Patient 3E2 broke free from restraint by biting into one of the nurse's hands.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: Another nurse and I chased her down the hallway, while the rest of the staff tried to contain the patients in the dining room, who were obviously agitated by what just happened.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: We were finally able to hold her and administer a sedative, and the unfortunate nurse whose hand had been torn open received treatment.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: All the other patients have returned to their routines, but Patient 3E2 and 7C1 will need to be monitored in case this is the start of habitual violent behavior.

Speaker: 005117A2:NPCM_DoctorKessle:VTYP
Text: The prognosis for either of them being released has slipped even further into statistical irrelevancy.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: This is Foreman Hibbs. United States Department of Energy.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: If you're hearing this, then, welcome aboard and all that.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: I'm sure the Human Resources folks have gotten you situated, but there's one thing I need to make sure we've drilled into ya, so you're gonna get it again.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: Blackwater Mine is a government Uranium site. That means you're a federal employee, now.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: And all those background checks and security interviews you went through wasn't just for fun.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: Every yield we fail to bring up is a national security problem. One less missile gets made. One less power plant gets fuel.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: Department of Energy isn't messing around. I'm not messing around.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: So stop listening to this and get back to work. Let's dig up some shiny rocks and hope they don't make us sterile.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: This is Foreman Hibbs. United States Department of Energy.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: Blackwater Mine has changed a lot over the years. Plenty of you already know what happens when a mine tunnel hits groundwater, so the pumps shouldn't be too surprising.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: But yeah, just to put any rumors to bed, we're also trying some new ways of getting at those precious rocks.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: And yes, it involves melting the Uranium while it's still underground and siphoning it up. Sure beats hauling it by hand, if it works.

Speaker: 005119C5:NPCM_ForemanHibbs:VTYP
Text: Now don't think that means any of you are getting extra time-off. Stop listening to this and get back to work.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Well this next one pretty much sums it up for me. Here's Bing Crosby, backed up by the Andrew Sisters, with "Don't Fence Me In."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: This next one goes out to all you Dwellers looking for the perfect, and I mean perfect, spot for your camp. It's Bing Crosby, singing "Don't Fence Me In."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Well Mr. Bing Crosby, you would've loved Appalachia. More wide open land than you can shake a mildly-irradiated stick at.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Hey there! Would you like to weirdly feel happy AND sad at the same time? Well here's your chance - it's "Bubbles In My Beer."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here's a nice happy sounding song, as long as you don't listen to the lyrics. It's Bob Wills singing "Bubbles In My Beers"

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: That, my friends, was Bob Mills. Don't be a Bob, and sit around feeling sorry. Get back out there. Do something! Build a camp! Start a trading business! You can do it! I believe in you!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I don't claim to fully get what this song is about, but I do claim to have cleared some space in the studio here for dancing. I suggest you do the same! Here's "Doin' The Uptown Lowdown."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Some of you Dwellers who are good with musical instruments, you should get together and learn that one. What a fun tune!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Doesn't that song sort of describe Appalachia these days? Whole bunch of different folks getting together to party. Of course, the definition of "party" varies. Like, a lot. Still, though!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Louis Jordan might not be so keen on visiting these days (at least not without a gas mask), but here he is with "Salt Pork, West Virginia."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: That one could do with a bit of updating, don't you think? Any of you Dwellers want to record "Ash Heap, West Vriginia?" Probably not, huh.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Patsy Montana is up next, and I've just gotta ask: has this ever worked for any of you? Ever?! Here's "I Didn't Know The Gun Was Loaded."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here's Patsy Montana explaining how to get away with murder: "I Didn't Know The Gun Was Loaded."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I think I can speak for most of us when I say we've known a Miss Effie or two in our time. They never learn, do they?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: The sound of that little gun going off makes me laugh every single time. Every time! Thank you, Ms. Montana.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here's a song near and dear to my heart, reminding us that we carry with us the places and people from our past. It's "In a Shanty In Old Shanty Town."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I know it's not the same for everyone, but for me, there are moments where I miss where I came from, and the family and friends no longer with us. Be grateful for what you have, friends, but don't forget where you've been.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: In case you were wondering, Haile Selassie was actually a ruler in Ethiopia back in the day. Don't let anyone tell you listening to the radio is a waste of time - it's educational!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: And now, in "making the best of a bad situation" territory, here's "Sixteen Tons" by Tennessee Ernie Ford.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Company stores may not exist any more, but this is one I think most of us can relate to. Life isn't easy, friends - enjoy what you can.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: How many bottle caps do you think it would take to equal sixteen tons? Bet one of you smarty-pants Dwellers can do the math on that...

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Coming up next is "Dark as a Dungeon" by Tennessee Ernie Ford. If any of you out there were thinking about taking up coal mining, listen well!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: This next one goes out to the fella in a blue 76 jumpsuit who was recently seen headed into Gauley Mine. Hope you're able to hear it!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Not exactly one to lift your spirits, is it? Bet the old Garrahan and Hornwright companies weren't super happy with this being played on the radio...

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Not only does this work as a sort of caution about what you're willing to risk to make a buck, but it can be taken very, very literally. Be careful out there!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: This next one is just a beautiful song, but always leaves me a little sad... But that's okay, right? Part of being alive, and I sure am grateful to be alive. Here's "Shenandoah" by Tennessee Ernie Ford.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Next up is "Shenandoah" by Tennessee Ernie Ford. A programming note, this station does not condone interacting with rivers in any significant way, unless you have a whole lotta Rad-Away lying around.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Okay, do you ever sing along with that, but try and get your voice as low as his? No? Just me? Ehh, I can live with that.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: The Andrews Sisters here have a great message for us all. Maybe some more'n others, if we're bein' honest... Lookin' at you, Crater!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: And now, here are the very prolific Andrews Sisters with "Straighten Up and Fly Right."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: My, my. Can you imagine, three sisters all able to get along well enough to sing together? I wouldn't make it through a single song with my brother, no way.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I feel like we're missing some pretty crucial information in that story. Why on earth would the monkey agree to that ride in the first place? That's what I want to know!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here's one that might cheer you up on a rad-stormy day, or serves as an excellent background for watching someone fall down repeatedly.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: That was "Happy Days Are Here Again", which... well, hey. You're alive, ain'tcha? Pretty decent reason to be happy.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: In my humble opinion, if you're in the right frame of mind then they're all happy days.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Oh, now this next song is one of my favorites. Just a sweet reminder that there are things out there that are worth livin' for.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Coming up next is Crazy He Calls Me". If you ask me, the only thing crazy about Billie Holiday is how amazing her voice is!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Doesn't Billie Holiday just have the most beautiful voice? Every time I've heard that song, since I was a little girl, just been carried away by it.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Take a page from Billie Holiday, and believe you can do the impossible. It can make all the difference.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: There's been a few times in my life I needed to pick up a gun, and every single one of 'em, this next song went through my head.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: The Andrews Sisters and Bing Crosby are back again, this time with "Pistol Packin' Mama."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Remember, ladies: just 'cause Bing Crosby tells you to put down the gun, doesn't mean you have to!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: These days, you're likely to run across a Pistol, Combat Shotgun, Super Sledge, Gauss Rifle, Gatling Gun Packin' Mama. You can never be too prepared!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Dear Hearts and Gentle People is coming up next. This one always makes me smile, thinking about the people in my life who fit that description...

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Whether Appalachia has always been your home, or you're a more recent arrival, this next song is for you.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Those "dear hearts" and "gentle people" are out there, everyone. And wherever they are, that's where home is. Don't forget that, okay?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here's the best lesson about personal responsibility set to slide guitar that you'll ever hear. "Nobody's Fault But Mine" by Blind Willie Johnson.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Next, Blind Willie Johnson struggles with accountability, in "Nobody's Fault But Mine."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Mr. Johnson lays it out pretty clear, doesn't he? Regardless of circumstances, the choices we make are what really matter.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I really like this song, but sometimes I'm reminded that this idea goes both ways. You can be presented with the worst of circumstances but still make the right choice. It's up to you!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Hope you weren't doing anything important, because it's time to dance! Here's "Steel Guitar Rag" by Bob Mills!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here's "Steel Guitar Rag." Like Bob Wills says, "Kick it off, Leon."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: ...I really wish I knew how to play steel guitar. I'm working on the tuba, but that's... well, let's just say it's coming along, but very slowly. And loudly.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I hope that song is some good inspiration for any of you out there playing the steel guitar. It's got such a great sound.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: So... I can't say I totally agree with Cass Daley on this, but let's just say if you find good people out there in the world, do what you can to stick with them.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Now we've got Cass Daley, with "A Good Man Is Hard to Find."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Oh Cass, sweetie, raise your standards just a little bit! You're worth it! Well, it's a fun tune anyway.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Is a good man hard to find? I haven't been looking. You know what IS hard to find? Ballistic fiber. Oh my gosh.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Dad always used to ask if I had ants in my pants when I couldn't sit still. I guess maybe Chick Webb's dad did the same thing, since here he is singing about it.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: If you've been looking for a good excuse to get up and move, here it is! It's "I Can't Dance, I Got Ants In My Pants" by Chick Webb.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I love that one because it sounds like a bunch of friends just hanging out and having a good time. Insect phobias aside, of course.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: You know that song is from a long time ago, because these days you couldn't fit more than one ant in your pants. And you definitely wouldn't want the pants back afterwards.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here comes Chick Webb, with a really fun instrumental called "Midnight in a Madhouse."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I have been some places that would qualify as "madhouses" and they are nowhere near as entertaining as that song. Just sayin'.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I am in no way suggesting you take this song completely literally, but, well... Do what you've gotta do, friends. Here's "When I Get Low, I Get High."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I bet we've all known at least a few friends who have lived life by the motto of "When I Get Low, I Get High", right?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Given the state of things, this song can be a convenient excuse to, shall we say, over-indulge. Moderation, friends! It's all about moderation!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Bet you ten caps you can guess this next song within the first three seconds!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Coming up next is "Mr. Sandman" by the Chordettes. I guess I'd wish for someone, too... if I didn't have to worry about radiation, disease, ticks the size of my head, Scorchbeasts... you get the idea. Anyway, fun song!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Isn't that one a classic? I feel like everyone knows the first few lines, then after that they're often just mumbling along, not knowing the rest of the words. Always fun to see.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I'm not saying you all owe me, but when I got here, the equipment was days away from breaking down. You were all saved from hearing this song, and only this song, repeating endlessly forever.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: You think Cole Porter would be surprised by where the world ended up since writing that song? I figure he'd shrug his shoulders and say "yeah, why not."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Get ready, because here comes Count Basie with "Jumpin At the Woodside."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I feel like that could've gone on for another twenty minutes of solos, and it sure sounds like everyone playing would've loved doing it.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: This song used to crack me up as a kid, and it sure sounds like they had fun recording it. It's the Andrews Sisters with Danny Kaye, singing "Civilization."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I just love that someone, somewhere, decided the phrase "Bingle, bangle, bungle" was worth using as a song lyric. I hope it makes you smile too.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Haven't seen "Ol Man Mose" around lately? Welllll, here's why!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Wondering what's up with "Ol Man Mose?" Here's Eddie Duchin to fill you in.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Just a friendly reminder to look after your neighbors, everyone. We're all in this together, after all.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: If no one ever told you, it's bad manners to stare in your neighbor's windows. Yes, even if they're dead.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Up next it's "Mister Five by Five." Did you know this song was written about a real person? I can't remember his name, but he sang for Count Basie. I'm not sure this is how I'd want to be remembered...

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: That was, if you hadn't picked up on it, "Mister Five by Five." I always feel just a little bit bad for the poor guy that song was about. But it sounds like he was a pretty good dancer, so good for him!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I've heard some of you Dwellers tickling the ivories, but can you keep up with "Pig Foot Pete"? Here's Freddie Slack and Ella Mae Morse.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: What would the modern equivalent of this be? "Deathclaw Steak Pete"? Doesn't quite have the same ring to it... "Mutt Chops Pete"? Nah, that just sounds like you're making fun of his face... I'll keep working on it, friends.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: If I'm gonna make up a nickname for someone I really like and/or admire, I'm probably not going to go with "Pig Foot" or anything of the sort. What do you think, friends?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: And now for something with just a little bit more 'twang', here's "Walking The Floor Over You" by Ernest Tubb.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Ah, lost love. Is there a more significant source of inspiration for music? I think not, my friends. Let's hope you all fare better than Mr. Tubb.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: My brother Matty as a kid, boy did he laugh at Fats Waller blurting out "B-b-b-believe me." Ohh, Matty. Wherever you are, I hope you can hear this and I hope you're still laughing.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Oh, do I relate to this one. Just me and the radio, here by myself, got nearly everything I love within arm's reach. Here's "Ain't Misbehavin."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Hope that you all enjoyed that one, friends, and that you're all on your best behavior, too.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I don't know about you all, but being a kid, sipping a Nuka-Cola, and dancing around the camp listening to this song... there's no feeling like it. Makes me happy every time I hear it. Here's 'Jukebox Saturday Night.'

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Did you crack open a Nuka-Cola for that? I sure did! Also, I am running low on Nuka-Cola. Donations are appreciated.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: It's a tough world out there, and you can't always count on everyone. Here's Henry King and his orchestra with "Just a Fair Weather Friend."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I'll say this, friends. It's true that there are people in the world who will let you down. But it should just make you appreciate the folks who are always there for you even more.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Not everyone is a fair weather friend. You find the people who are there for you no matter what, and you stick together!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I Don't Want to Set the World On Fire is next, and don't worry, Ink Spots. Someone already beat you to it!... Too much? Too soon? Sorry.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: It's a good message, friends. Keep things small, simple. Focus on the good things, the things that really matter. Oh my goodness, I'm such a broken record!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I know things might seem bad, but don't give up! Despite what the Ink Spots say, it's NOT all over but the crying! Heck, keep going, and cry while you do it! Multi-task!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Hello, friends. I'm Julie, this is Appalachia Radio, and these are the Ink Spots, singing "It's All Over But the Crying."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Well, that one sure is a classic. Hope you enjoyed it!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Next up it's the Ink Spots, singing "Maybe." I have known and loved this song my whole life! I hope you love it too.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: So it seems that sitting around, pining for your lost love, leaves you plenty of time to write songs about it! Here are The Ink Spots, with "Maybe."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: That song is just so timeless. Feels like it's been around forever, doesn't it?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here's a song about the three people you can always rely on: Me, myself, and I. It's "We Three" by the Ink Spots.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Remember, friends: you're not alone out there. The world is filled with people, and you share the same goals with at least some of them. Take care of yourselves and each other, okay?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Dear Ink Spots: I admire your commitment, but I think at this point it's probably just better if you, you know, move on.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Let's call this one a cautionary tale about self-destructive behavior. I'm not telling you how to live your lives, just trying to help you live your best ones. Here's Jerry Irby.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: And now, in the "Unwieldy Song Title" department, here's "Answer to Drivin' Nails in My Coffin" by Jerry Irby.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Mister Jerry Irby would've just loved Nukashine. It's like ALL the nails, and the coffin, and everything, you included, shoved into a blender. And that's IF you remember any of it!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: If drinking to excess is your biggest vice these days, you're still better off than a whole lot of people. No judgments here, friends!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here comes "Heading Down the Wrong Highway" by Johnny Bond. And Johnny, as long as that highway isn't overrun with super mutants or feral ghouls, it could be worse, buddy.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: What do we think, friends? Is Johnny here being too hard on himself? Sounds about average for the folks I know!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: No matter where you are, friends, you can always change course. It's never too late!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I'm told there's a certain traveling merchant out there who really, really loves meat. He asked for songs about it, and this is about as close as I can get. Enjoy!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: You know him, you love him: here's Roy Brown, with "Butcher Pete."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Butcher Pete: how much should we read into this song? You make the call!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I'm sorry, what's that? It's a metaphor? Ohh, you don't say!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I wish I knew the story behind this next song, because it was written so long ago, but it's so appropriate pretty much every day in Appalachia. Here's "Praise the Lord and Pass the Ammunition."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: That one goes out to anyone that may, now or in the near future, be fending off an angry Scorchbeast. Good luck!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: It's a little passive-aggressive, but it seems to work for him: here's Milton Brown with "Keep Knockin But You Can't Come In."
