Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Next, for any of you who may have recently emerged from a Vault, tell me: is this what it was like that whole time in there? Just wondering.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I like to imagine that one as the ultimate battle of wills: do you get tired of knocking before I can't take the sound of it anymore? Who will emerge victorious?!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Coming up next is Nat King Cole with "Orange Colored Sky", a phenomenon which used to occur for only natural reasons...

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I hate to break it to you all, but if you see an orange colored sky, grab the Rad-X. Lots of it. That ain't love out there!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Next up, looks like the Commodores with "Uranium." Bop along if you like.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Do you think at any point those guys said "hey, this is kind of a weird thing to write a song about", because I wonder about it all the time.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here's the Five Stars with "Atom Bomb Baby", a song that suggests they may not have made the most responsible choices when it came to relationships...

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I'm sure they meant it as a compliment, but I don't know... something about comparing your girl to an explosive device that can destroy the world... you see what I'm saying, right?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Next we've got some high drama on the open plains. Here's "Ghost Riders in the Sky" by Sons of the Pioneers.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Next up is a song that... well, it's not really the most subtle of hints, is it? Here's "Ghost Riders In the Sky" by Sons of the Pioneers.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Do you all think the cowboy in question did actually change his ways? Well, good lesson in there for all of us. Yippie-yi-yo, friends.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I sometimes wonder what kind of stuff you'd have to get up to in life that it takes a sign like this to change your ways. Never seen ghost cows here, never plan to.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: This next song was one of my mom's favorites. She'd get so excited every time it came on the radio, without fail. Here's "Opus Number One" by Tommy Dorsey.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I know I say "it's time to dance!" for so many of these songs, but this time I really mean it. Unless you are literally fighting for your life (which I realize may be the case for some of you) you'd better stop what you're doing and dance.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Oh my goodness, does that one swing! Am I allowed to say that every part of that song is my favorite part? It's too hard to decide otherwise.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Okay, so am I an awful person? I was thinking about this next song, "Two Left Hands" and how it's just figurative, only... maybe now there are a few folks out there with two left hands. Like, literally. And then I laughed. A lot. And now, while the song plays, I will feel bad for laughing.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Coming up next, it's Freddie Slack and his orchestra with "Two Left Hands."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I can't be the only one who wants to see a duet with Mr. Two Left Hands here and Pig Foot Pete, right? Who's with me?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Next we've got Wouldn't It Be Nice... now isn't that a phrase we all say in our heads about a dozen times a day?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Break out your surfboards, because here come the Beach Boys with "Wouldn't It Be Nice."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: As soon as I hear that harp playing, I get all excited, because I know what I'm in for. It's really just kind of a perfect song, isn't it?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Okay everyone, here it comes. Grab your pals, maybe a banjo, and belt it out along with the radio. I know you've been waiting for this one!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Terminals here in the station say this was the most popular song pre-war. I can't take a real survey, but I'm betting it's still true today. Here's "Country Roads."

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Still get goosebumps, every time I hear it. You do too, don't you? Aww, I know you do.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Stimpaks won't heal these burns... Here comes the "Ring of Fire!"

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Is there anybody out there who hasn't been burned by love? Maybe if you've been locked in a Vault by yourself... Gosh, now that I think about it, which is worse?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Hey friends, Julie here. Wanted to take a second to talk about something important to me - this radio station.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I try not to talk about myself too much, but maybe you've heard me mention it before: I'm only 23, but I've had more than my share of bad times.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I don't say that to get you to feel sorry for me. I know that so many of you out there have had difficult lives, too. Some far, far harder than mine.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I say it because I want you to know I can relate. I know what it's like to lose family and friends. To struggle.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: But there's one thing that always kept me going, always meant something to me. It's this place. This radio station. This music.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: These songs, playing out across the world for everyone to hear... they meant so much to me.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: They'd remind me of good times, of people I care about. Things that really matter. They offered... hope. I know it's cheesy, but it's true.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: When I heard that people were coming back to Appalachia, I knew I had to make the trip. To find this radio station, and make sure it stays running.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I'm not gonna act like it's mine, like I own it or anything. I've fixed some things up, sure. But I didn't build Appalachia Radio, it doesn't belong to me.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: I want to make sure it stays on the air, because... Maybe it can give someone else hope. Maybe... Maybe that someone is you.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: So, I hope you hear this music, and it makes you smile, or makes you think of someone you care about. That's what it's here for. That's what I'm here for.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: ...I guess I should probably get back to actually playing all that music I keep talking about, huh?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: You're listening to Appalachia Radio, an enduring source of happiness in a sometimes unbelievable world.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: One of the few things left in this world that hasn't been pulled apart for loose screws and circuit boards, this is Appalachia Radio!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Held together by duct tape, willpower, and a near-crippling fear of silence, this is Appalachia Radio.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: From Clarksburg to Welch, from Flatwoods to Watoga, and everywhere in between, you're listening to Appalachia Radio!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Here at Appalachia Radio, I've recently gotten my hands on a Collectron. He is absolutely adorable, but has zero respect for personal boundaries.

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Can I interest you in a block of concrete?

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: Oh my gosh, get OUT of here you big goofball!

Speaker: 0059B4C6:RadioAppalachia_Julie:NPC_
Text: You're listening to Appalachia Radio: It's like a Super Stimpak... for the soul. Hmm. That sounded better in my head.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: We need all hands at the Morgantown Airport base. I repeat, all Responders report to Morgantown Airport right away.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Bring any weapons you can. The Scorched are coming, and there's a lot of them.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Please hurry. There's not much time. Chavez out.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: This message will repeat.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: Hi folks, this is Jeff Nakamura of the Responders.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: We've set up a camp at Flatwoods, and we're offering supplies, medical treatment and survival training to anyone in need.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: Look for us in the church across from the Flatwoods tavern, and if you can volunteer some time to help out, we could definitely use it.

Speaker: 00235D8E:NPCM_JeffNakamura:VTYP
Text: This message will repeat.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: They killed my brother! Those bastards at the Grafton Steel Mill killed Billy.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: Mandatory overtime they called it. He should never have been on those catwalks.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: I can't even bury him. When you fall into a vat of molten steel there's nothing left of you.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: I'll get them for this. I'll show those bastards.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: I've uncovered a conspiracy between the government and Grafton Steel. Kickbacks, wink and nod inspections, bribes, you name it.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: There's no telling how big this is. I think they bugged my house, so I've moved to a cabin in the woods where nobody can find me.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: Yesterday I had to shoot a woman. She claimed she was just hiking, but I know she was an agent sent to spy on me.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: I've booby trapped my cabin. They're attaching listening devices to the raccoons to spy on me.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: But I'm too smart for them. They can't get past my traps.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: I saw a fox look funny at me today. They might be using them too. If I see another one come around, that will prove it.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: The air raid sirens. The ground shaking. It's Billy. He's telling me it's time. Everyone is thinking about the bombs. They won't notice me.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: All I have to do is sneak in to Grafton Steel and use my secret formula. Then their smoke stacks will begin spewing toxic dust all over the valley.

Speaker: 002B78EF:NPCM_DariusAngler:VTYP
Text: Then they'll be sorry they hurt Billy. They'll be sorry and dead.

Speaker: 002B78F1:NPCF_IsabelSmithWaltz:VTYP
Text: It's my first day here. Oh, this is Isabel Smith-Waltz. Can't forget introductions.

Speaker: 002B78F1:NPCF_IsabelSmithWaltz:VTYP
Text: The rangers are all so friendly, but this place is kind of weird.

Speaker: 002B78F1:NPCF_IsabelSmithWaltz:VTYP
Text: So this fort was supposed to be a rebuilt frontier fort, but the railroad went through the place where it really used to be, so they had to put it here.

Speaker: 002B78F1:NPCF_IsabelSmithWaltz:VTYP
Text: Then they found out the guy who wrote the book that described the fort made most of it up. Crazy, right?

Speaker: 002B78F1:NPCF_IsabelSmithWaltz:VTYP
Text: So it doesn't even look like the real one. We call it a 'representational frontier fort.'

Speaker: 002B78F1:NPCF_IsabelSmithWaltz:VTYP
Text: Now they want to start running civil war battle recreations here. But that never happened either. But they say it will bring in lots of money.

Speaker: 002B78F1:NPCF_IsabelSmithWaltz:VTYP
Text: Some people just to appreciate real history.

Speaker: 002B78F2:NPCM_JamesWaltz:VTYP
Text: Some days I wish I had never inherited Hemlock Holes.

Speaker: 002B78F2:NPCM_JamesWaltz:VTYP
Text: Who names a golf course after a poison? My father, that's who.

Speaker: 002B78F2:NPCM_JamesWaltz:VTYP
Text: And, to top it all off, we're stuck out here in the ass-end of the country.

Speaker: 002B78F2:NPCM_JamesWaltz:VTYP
Text: I've bought one of those fancy Mr. Handy chefs. Maybe some community cookouts will drum up more business.

Speaker: 002B78F4:NPCM_GeorgeSmith:VTYP
Text: This is Director George N. Smith recording what may be my final memo.

Speaker: 002B78F4:NPCM_GeorgeSmith:VTYP
Text: The earthquakes that followed the nukes cracked the dam somewhere.

Speaker: 002B78F4:NPCM_GeorgeSmith:VTYP
Text: I can't see the rupture, but the lake level has dropped dramatically.

Speaker: 002B78F4:NPCM_GeorgeSmith:VTYP
Text: The Pioneer Scout Camp got it worse though. Some sort of underground sink hole dropped most of it to below the normal lake water level.

Speaker: 002B78F4:NPCM_GeorgeSmith:VTYP
Text: Ironically it's now at the new beach front level. If the reservoir were full, it would be totally submerged.

Speaker: 002B78F4:NPCM_GeorgeSmith:VTYP
Text: I'm heading out now to see if anyone out there needs help. I don't know what I'll find. This is George N. Smith signing off.

Speaker: 002B78F6:NPCF_CooperLu:VTYP
Text: The holotape machine is on it's last legs, so I'm recording this for whoever comes along that might find a working one.

Speaker: 002B78F6:NPCF_CooperLu:VTYP
Text: My name is Cooper Lu. I'm the last survivor of Clarksburg. After everything fell apart, a lot of them left for Morgantown.

Speaker: 002B78F6:NPCF_CooperLu:VTYP
Text: There was some arguing over who got the guns from the shooting range, but a few warning shots settled that.

Speaker: 002B78F6:NPCF_CooperLu:VTYP
Text: A while later a bunch of us got sick when the water turned funny colors. It took them a long time to die.

Speaker: 002B78F6:NPCF_CooperLu:VTYP
Text: That just left me, Jill and Ande. Some god damn mutated bear thing got them. Now it's just me.

Speaker: 002B78F6:NPCF_CooperLu:VTYP
Text: I'm going to head out east and see if I can find people. Anyone listening to this should do the same. Goodbye, probably forever.

Speaker: 003B91C0:AnnouncerM_TW002_PrisonWarden:VTYP
Text: This is the warden of Eastern Regional Penitentiary.

Speaker: 003B91C0:AnnouncerM_TW002_PrisonWarden:VTYP
Text: Our last prisoner count came up woefully short. Obviously there has been a mass breakout.

Speaker: 003B91C0:AnnouncerM_TW002_PrisonWarden:VTYP
Text: I'm authorizing prison marshals to seek out escaped prisoners.

Speaker: 003B91C0:AnnouncerM_TW002_PrisonWarden:VTYP
Text: Due to overcrowding and the logistics of caring for live prisoners, immediate use of lethal force is authorized.

Speaker: 003B91C0:AnnouncerM_TW002_PrisonWarden:VTYP
Text: Hmm. There seems to be an issue with the marshal's visual recognition system.

Speaker: 003B91C0:AnnouncerM_TW002_PrisonWarden:VTYP
Text: No time to fix it now. I must stop those escapees!

Speaker: 00511796:NPCF_DaraGibson:VTYP
Text: It's my first day at camp! I already made a friend. It's a Ms. Nanny bot named Lauren. She's really nice.

Speaker: 00511796:NPCF_DaraGibson:VTYP
Text: We do lots of fun things here, but the food is terrible. It's this green glop that they say is made from plants all around the camp.

Speaker: 00511796:NPCF_DaraGibson:VTYP
Text: The lake is really pretty. We can see the steel mill and the dam from our camp. I like the way the orange water from the steel mill glows at night.

Speaker: 00511796:NPCF_DaraGibson:VTYP
Text: Tomorrow we're supposed to learn how to hunt for our own berries. Whatever we find we get to put into the processing machine.

Speaker: 00511796:NPCF_DaraGibson:VTYP
Text: I'm getting kind of tired Mom and Dad. It's been a busy with lots of fun. I'll make more holotapes later.

Speaker: 0051192A:NPCM_RichardMudge:VTYP
Text: Just got back from a town council meeting. Bunch of pansies. No vision. No brains. No balls.

Speaker: 0051192A:NPCM_RichardMudge:VTYP
Text: I'm going to drag the lot of them into the 22nd century if it's the last thing I do.

Speaker: 0051192A:NPCM_RichardMudge:VTYP
Text: Since I have dirt on most of those yellow belly piss ants, they won't have much of a choice.

Speaker: 0051192A:NPCM_RichardMudge:VTYP
Text: Tourism! That's what this place needs. Bunch of wide-eyed marks wandering around spending their cash on shit they don't need.

Speaker: 0051192A:NPCM_RichardMudge:VTYP
Text: Grafton steel is the past. Water parks and shooting ranges are the future.

Speaker: 0051192A:NPCM_RichardMudge:VTYP
Text: But I have to be careful. Grafton Steel is a big campaign contributor. Can't let them think I don't have their backs.

Speaker: 0051192A:NPCM_RichardMudge:VTYP
Text: At least not until I stab them there.

Speaker: 002B8DBF:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeBridge_Carl:VTYP
Text: Doug, it's Carl. I've left for Camden Park to meet our buyer.

Speaker: 002B8DBF:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeBridge_Carl:VTYP
Text: ...Doug, I've taken your key to the west door.

Speaker: 002B8DBF:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeBridge_Carl:VTYP
Text: I'm sorry, but I can't keep coming back to find new dings and scratches, just because you can't resist taking our "little project" out for a spin.

Speaker: 002B8DBF:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeBridge_Carl:VTYP
Text: We're trying to sell this thing, remember?

Speaker: 002B8DBF:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeBridge_Carl:VTYP
Text: ...Look, assuming this guy shows, I'll be back by this evening. The buyer's a military type. He wants to make the trade while riding the Widow Maker.

Speaker: 002B8DBF:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeBridge_Carl:VTYP
Text: No idea why. I think he's living out some kind of personal spy fantasy.

Speaker: 002B8DBF:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeBridge_Carl:VTYP
Text: That's fine by me - I've wanted to try that ride since I was a kid.

Speaker: 002B8DC4:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeResort_Jamey:VTYP
Text: Dad's gone outside...He's gone outside...

Speaker: 002B8DC4:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeResort_Jamey:VTYP
Text: Tracy and I can't see him from the windows. We're not supposed to look anyway. Whatever was screaming out there...Well...we don't know what it is.

Speaker: 002B8DC4:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeResort_Jamey:VTYP
Text: I think it was coming from the pool.

Speaker: 002B8DC4:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeResort_Jamey:VTYP
Text: Mom said that Dad had to go looking for the other campers. If they're still alive, they might have food.

Speaker: 002B8DC4:NPCM_NewRiverGorgeResort_Jamey:VTYP
Text: ...I guess they could have food either way.

Speaker: 002B8DCC:NPCM_OrwellOrchards_LotteryRepresentative:VTYP
Text: held on the 10th of this month!

Speaker: 002B8DCC:NPCM_OrwellOrchards_LotteryRepresentative:VTYP
Text: Your names are attached to "Lucky Hits!" lotto ticket '59-28-42-88'.

Speaker: 002B8DCC:NPCM_OrwellOrchards_LotteryRepresentative:VTYP
Text: We are overjoyed to tell you that this ticket was November's lucky lottery winner!

Speaker: 002B8DCC:NPCM_OrwellOrchards_LotteryRepresentative:VTYP

Speaker: 002B8DCC:NPCM_OrwellOrchards_LotteryRepresentative:VTYP

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: Attention, inmates. This is Warden Brennan speaking.

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: This morning, you were fitted with what the guards told you was a "Prisoner Collar."

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: This collar is an explosive device that will detonate if you attempt to leave Eastern Regional.

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: Now, before some of you panic and try to remove the collar, I feel it's important to advise you that doing so will also detonate the device.

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: Please don't think of these collars as a punishment, think of them as a benefit.

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: You will no longer be under scrutiny by guards, and you will no longer be forced to sit in your tiny cells as punishment for your crimes.

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: If you stay within the confines of this facility, you're free to roam about and do what you please.

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: However, if any of you choose to abuse this newly-found freedom, know that I will not hesitate to manually detonate your collar.

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: Provided we understand each other, I am certain that the rest of your sentence at Eastern Regional will pass quietly and comfortably.

Speaker: 002B8FB4:NPCM_LC043_WardenBrennan:VTYP
Text: Your cell doors are now unlocked. Enjoy your new life without bars, inmates.

Speaker: 002B8FBE:NPCM_LC034_Samuel:VTYP
Text: I talked to Sheila yesterday about finding some food. She said she'd give me the info about a place if I grabbed some for both of us.

Speaker: 002B8FBE:NPCM_LC034_Samuel:VTYP
Text: I agreed, and she pointed me to an old building nearby filled with machines that could make something she called "cream."

Speaker: 002B8FBE:NPCM_LC034_Samuel:VTYP
Text: I never heard of it, but she promised that it tasted good and it would keep us both from starving.

Speaker: 002B8FBE:NPCM_LC034_Samuel:VTYP
Text: According to her instructions, all I had to do was push a button and the machines would start cranking out bottles.

Speaker: 002B8FBE:NPCM_LC034_Samuel:VTYP
Text: What she forgot to tell me was that it would be loud as hell and attract every creature in earshot.

Speaker: 002B8FBE:NPCM_LC034_Samuel:VTYP
Text: It took everything I had to fight the things that swarmed the building. I barely made it out of there alive.

Speaker: 002B8FBE:NPCM_LC034_Samuel:VTYP
Text: If anyone finds this, tell Sheila that I'm keeping all of the damn bottles of cream. Next time, she can come get her own.

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: This is Deputy D.B. Walton. Interview started at 3:35AM.

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: All right, Mr. Pickins. Tell me everything that happened by starting from the beginning.

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: I was out behind my hotdog stand taking out the trash when I saw a light shining from the woods.

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: At first I thought it was a hunter with a flashlight, but then the light started... changing.

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: Changing? How?

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: Well, the light started turning different colors.

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: First it was blue, then green, then red, then back to blue. Or wait, maybe it was green, blue, red. No, actually, it's red, blue...

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: Yep, we get it. What happened next?

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: I suddenly got real dizzy, and I dropped the trash bag I was carrying. Next thing I knew, I was on the ground. .. I don't even remember falling.

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: I looked up, and that's when... that's when I saw it.

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: It? Can you be more specific?

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: It was a man, but it also wasn't a man. It had gray skin and these huge black eyes. And, and it was wearing like a spacesuit or something.

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: What was really weird was that it wasn't saying anything, but I could hear it anyway. In my mind.

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: It told me to follow it onto its spaceship.

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: Sigh. "The Flatwoods Monster," again?

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: All right, I've heard enough. Colton Pickins, I'm arresting you for drunk and disorderly conduct and indecent exposure.

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: Indecent what? What are talking about? I didn't do anything wrong!

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: Colton, we found you on the roof of your shack, buck naked, yelling at the top of your lungs.

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: Your blood alcohol was .23 and it took four deputies to get you into handcuffs.

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: We all go on a bender now and then, but you need to keep it at home.

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: What? No! Come on! You have to believe me.

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: The monster MADE me drunk, it... it was experimenting on me! Controlling my mind!

Speaker: 002B8FC7:NPCM_LC064_ColtonPickins:VTYP
Text: When are you people going to do something about the Flatwoods Monster?! It needs to be killed!

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: I've had enough. Just get him out of here.

Speaker: 002B8FC6:NPCM_LC064_OfficerWalton:VTYP
Text: This is Deputy D.B. Walton. Interview terminated.

Speaker: 002B8FCB:NPCM_LC068_CarlAddington:VTYP
Text: Well, another hunting season comes to a close. I guess we should start packing up the lodge.

Speaker: 002B8FCC:NPCM_LC068_WestleyAddington:VTYP
Text: Yes, I suppose we should.

Speaker: 002B8FCB:NPCM_LC068_CarlAddington:VTYP
Text: What's the problem? This was a great season.

Speaker: 002B8FCC:NPCM_LC068_WestleyAddington:VTYP
Text: I know. It's just, well, it's getting quite boring. We hunt the same thing, every year.

Speaker: 002B8FCB:NPCM_LC068_CarlAddington:VTYP
Text: Oh my god, then what do you want? If you have something to say, then spit it out already!

Speaker: 002B8FCC:NPCM_LC068_WestleyAddington:VTYP
Text: All right. Before you judge, hear me out.

Speaker: 002B8FCC:NPCM_LC068_WestleyAddington:VTYP
Text: What if we hunted something new? Something that was a real challenge for a change. Something that could fight back.

Speaker: 002B8FCC:NPCM_LC068_WestleyAddington:VTYP
Text: We circulate an advertisement offering a free weekend at the lodge. People will have no idea what they're really getting into. It's perfect!

Speaker: 002B8FCB:NPCM_LC068_CarlAddington:VTYP
Text: Wait. Are you talking about hunting... humans?

Speaker: 002B8FCC:NPCM_LC068_WestleyAddington:VTYP
Text: Oh, don't act so surprised. You know it makes sense. I can see it on your face.

Speaker: 002B8FCB:NPCM_LC068_CarlAddington:VTYP
Text: Do you really think we can get away with it?

Speaker: 002B8FCC:NPCM_LC068_WestleyAddington:VTYP
Text: With our wealth, dear brother, we can get away with anything.

Speaker: 002B8FD1:NPCF_LC199_Thea:VTYP
Text: Lenny just had to have those eggs.

Speaker: 002B8FD1:NPCF_LC199_Thea:VTYP
Text: I told him to leave the damn things alone because we didn't know what the hell laid them.

Speaker: 002B8FD1:NPCF_LC199_Thea:VTYP
Text: But that greedy bastard didn't listen and now we're being stalked by mama deathclaw.

Speaker: 002B8FD1:NPCF_LC199_Thea:VTYP
Text: She's already killed two of the gang, dragged them off to who knows where.

Speaker: 002B8FD1:NPCF_LC199_Thea:VTYP
Text: And Lenny? Yeah, he ran away. Didn't even try to put up a fight.

Speaker: 002B8FD1:NPCF_LC199_Thea:VTYP
Text: Now the deathclaw is back, and I doubt the rest of us will make it through the night.

Speaker: 002B8FD1:NPCF_LC199_Thea:VTYP
Text: So thanks a lot, Lenny. I hope those goddamn eggs were delicious, because they cost us our lives.

Speaker: 002B8FD5:NPCM_POI210_Adam:VTYP
Text: I had just gotten back from my pre-dawn hunt when the bomb hit. I could see the mushroom cloud from the front window of the house.

Speaker: 002B8FD5:NPCM_POI210_Adam:VTYP
Text: The way the window framed the explosion was strange, almost like it wasn't really happening. It was too perfect, too... beautiful.

Speaker: 002B8FD5:NPCM_POI210_Adam:VTYP
Text: Luckily Johnson's Acre was too remote to be damaged, but I'm betting it won't be long before I start feeling the effects of the radiation.

Speaker: 002B8FD5:NPCM_POI210_Adam:VTYP
Text: Whether I want to or not, I'm going to have to travel into Charleston to try and gather supplies before they're all gone.

Speaker: 002B8FD5:NPCM_POI210_Adam:VTYP
Text: Damn it, if I'd only brought more than a weekend's worth of food, I could have stayed here where it's safe.

Speaker: 002B8FD5:NPCM_POI210_Adam:VTYP
Text: If you're listening to this message, that probably means I found somewhere else to lay low... or I never made it at all.

Speaker: 002B8FD5:NPCM_POI210_Adam:VTYP
Text: Maybe having a roof over your head for the night will give you hope, god knows we can all use a little bit of that right now.

Speaker: 002B8FD8:NPCF_POI219_InitiateFowler:VTYP
Text: Great job, Tieggs. Now what are we supposed to do?!

Speaker: 002B8FD9:POI219_InitiateTieggs_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: How was I supposed to know the vehicles would sink into the bog?

Speaker: 002B8FD8:NPCF_POI219_InitiateFowler:VTYP
Text: They weigh something like 60 tons, genius. Of course they're going to sink.

Speaker: 002B8FD9:POI219_InitiateTieggs_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I didn't hear you chiming in with all this wisdom after I hot-wired the damn things.

Speaker: 002B8FD9:POI219_InitiateTieggs_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And it was your idea to bring them back to Paladin Taggerdy. No, no, no. I'm not taking any blame for this.

Speaker: 002B8FD8:NPCF_POI219_InitiateFowler:VTYP
Text: I didn't tell you to actually do it, I was just saying it would be great if the Brotherhood had these in their arsenal.

Speaker: 002B8FD9:POI219_InitiateTieggs_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Look, maybe we can go get another one and try to tow them out of there.

Speaker: 002B8FD8:NPCF_POI219_InitiateFowler:VTYP
Text: Are you nuts?

Speaker: 002B8FD8:NPCF_POI219_InitiateFowler:VTYP
Text: First of all, we'd be abandoning our post.

Speaker: 002B8FD8:NPCF_POI219_InitiateFowler:VTYP
Text: And second of all, do you even know if there are any more armored vehicles we can use around here? No.

Speaker: 002B8FD9:POI219_InitiateTieggs_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Sigh. Sorry, I was just trying to help.

Speaker: 002B8FD8:NPCF_POI219_InitiateFowler:VTYP
Text: Well, there isn't much we can do about it now.

Speaker: 002B8FD8:NPCF_POI219_InitiateFowler:VTYP
Text: Look, um... we're all strung out from these long duty shifts.

Speaker: 002B8FD8:NPCF_POI219_InitiateFowler:VTYP
Text: Why don't I take first watch so you can get some rest?

Speaker: 002B8FD9:POI219_InitiateTieggs_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Thanks, Fowler. You're the best.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: We'd been wandering for weeks until we came across an old shantytown that was built before the war.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: I convinced Kelley that we both needed rest and this would be the perfect place.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: The radiation sickness she was suffering from was making her weak and I knew she was no longer fit to travel.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: With a roof over her head, I was finally confident enough to head out and look for supplies. Biggest mistake I've ever made.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: I scoured the area for most of the day until I finally stumbled across an old army outpost loaded with medical supplies.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: Excited, I rushed back to the shantytown and my dear Kelley.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: When I got there, I found her... she was dead... and her body was being... eaten by wild dogs.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: Killing the creatures made me feel better, but the feeling didn't last.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: This was my fault. I left her alone, left her to die. She depended on me, and I failed.

Speaker: 002B8FDC:NPCM_POI220_Parker:VTYP
Text: If you can hear me, Kelley, know that I will always love you and that I'm sorry. Sorry about this damn war, sorry about everything.

Speaker: 002B8FDF:NPCM_POI265_ProfessorGreebley:VTYP
Text: People told me my theories weren't possible. They mocked me and called me a "foolish old man."

Speaker: 002B8FDF:NPCM_POI265_ProfessorGreebley:VTYP
Text: Well, I'm here to tell you that the possibility of time travel is not only real, but that it can be accomplished interdimensionally!

Speaker: 002B8FDF:NPCM_POI265_ProfessorGreebley:VTYP
Text: I've revolutionized this radical concept, a new way of thinking about skipping across timelines.

Speaker: 002B8FDF:NPCM_POI265_ProfessorGreebley:VTYP
Text: Instead of using the traditional and often clumsy use of gravity for time travel, I've discovered a way to punch a hole in the fabric of our reality.

Speaker: 002B8FDF:NPCM_POI265_ProfessorGreebley:VTYP
Text: By slipping through this fissure in time and space at a high rate of speed, it's my belief that instantaneous time travel will occur.

Speaker: 002B8FDF:NPCM_POI265_ProfessorGreebley:VTYP
Text: In a few weeks, I will be attempting to slipstream through dimensions using a monorail system as my chariot.

Speaker: 002B8FDF:NPCM_POI265_ProfessorGreebley:VTYP
Text: If you wish to attend this historic event, I will be at Pylon V-13 of the Appalachian Monorail System.

Speaker: 002B8FDF:NPCM_POI265_ProfessorGreebley:VTYP
Text: Be there and witness history!

Speaker: 002B8FE5:LC184_TechnicianStone_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Okay, K-117M. In your own words, please describe how you feel.

Speaker: 002B8FE2:NPCM_LC184_K117M:VTYP
Text: I... feel different... like my mind is not my own...

Speaker: 002B8FE5:LC184_TechnicianStone_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Do you remember who you were?

Speaker: 002B8FE2:NPCM_LC184_K117M:VTYP
Text: Yes, I was... Billy Seevers... a man living in... in...

Speaker: 002B8FE5:LC184_TechnicianStone_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You don't remember where you're from?

Speaker: 002B8FE2:NPCM_LC184_K117M:VTYP
Text: No... I... what's happening to me? Can you... make me better?

Speaker: 002B8FE5:LC184_TechnicianStone_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm asking the questions, K-117M. If you're patient, I'll help you. Okay?

Speaker: 002B8FE2:NPCM_LC184_K117M:VTYP
Text: Yes, I... understand.

Speaker: 002B8FE5:LC184_TechnicianStone_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Good, good. You're doing really well, K-117M. Now, one more question.

Speaker: 002B8FE5:LC184_TechnicianStone_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If we asked you to help us, would you do exactly as we command?

Speaker: 002B8FE2:NPCM_LC184_K117M:VTYP
Text: Yes... anything. I just want to... go home... home... wife? Where's my wife!?

Speaker: 002B8FE5:LC184_TechnicianStone_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Uh, she's fine K-117M. Calm down please.

Speaker: 002B8FE2:NPCM_LC184_K117M:VTYP
Text: No! What have you done to my wife?! Bring her to me, now! I'll kill all of you!

Speaker: 002B8FE5:LC184_TechnicianStone_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Code red in Interrogation Room B, I repeat, code red!

Speaker: 002B8FE6:NPCF_LC184_K120F:VTYP
Text: When they took me from Huntersville, I thought I was being taken to a hospital.

Speaker: 002B8FE6:NPCF_LC184_K120F:VTYP
Text: I've been sick for days, but no one at this place seems to care.

Speaker: 002B8FE6:NPCF_LC184_K120F:VTYP
Text: This room they've left me in looks more like a cell. They keep the door locked at all times.

Speaker: 002B8FE6:NPCF_LC184_K120F:VTYP
Text: The nurse that visits me is the only other person I've seen since I've gotten here, and he won't talk to me.

Speaker: 002B8FE6:NPCF_LC184_K120F:VTYP
Text: He keeps giving me injections, but I don't feel any better.

Speaker: 002B8FE6:NPCF_LC184_K120F:VTYP
Text: What's happening to me? Why is my skin changing color? Do I have a disease? No one will tell me anything!

Speaker: 002B8FE6:NPCF_LC184_K120F:VTYP
Text: I can't stand this anymore. I just want to get out of this place and go home.

Speaker: 002B8EFD:NPCF_Wilma:VTYP
Text: Movie idea: Robot Rebellion. A Red Rocket Mega Stop tale of terror.

Speaker: 002B8EFD:NPCF_Wilma:VTYP
Text: With all services automated, who do you turn to when the robots are programmed to kill?

Speaker: 002B8EFD:NPCF_Wilma:VTYP
Text: Eh, last part needs some work, but I'll get Carly to spice it up. Maybe this trip wasn't such a waste after all.

Speaker: 002B8F01:NPCF_Becca:VTYP
Text: Hey Riley, it's mom! Just wanted to send you this holotape you can play in case you miss us.

Speaker: 002B8F01:NPCF_Becca:VTYP
Text: We're so proud of you going on your first big adventure! You're going to have so much fun with all your friends!

Speaker: 002B8F01:NPCF_Becca:VTYP
Text: I want you to be sure to listen to everything the scout masters and rangers tell you.

Speaker: 002B8F01:NPCF_Becca:VTYP
Text: Remember, most of them are real people, so you can't throw things at them them like your Ms. Nanny.

Speaker: 002B8F01:NPCF_Becca:VTYP
Text: So I don't want to hear any bad reports or get any phone calls in the middle of the night.

Speaker: 002B8F01:NPCF_Becca:VTYP
Text: Mommy and daddy are on vacation, too, okay?

Speaker: 002B8F01:NPCF_Becca:VTYP
Text: We love you very much, and miss you every day! And remember... Best behavior!

Speaker: 002B8F04:NPCF_Sarah:VTYP
Text: Brandon managed to stick me with cleanup duty underneath the Widowmaker.

Speaker: 002B8F04:NPCF_Sarah:VTYP
Text: Apparently, some group of kids really lost their lunch on there.

Speaker: 002B8F04:NPCF_Sarah:VTYP
Text: Typical vomit chain... All it takes is one, and the rest follow suit.

Speaker: 002B8F04:NPCF_Sarah:VTYP
Text: The pics were priceless by the way.

Speaker: 002B8F04:NPCF_Sarah:VTYP
Text: But the real joke's on Brandon. I found a 100 dollar bill down there plus the usual change.

Speaker: 002B8F04:NPCF_Sarah:VTYP
Text: People say it's not worth it, but I gotta get out of here somehow... and if sifting through barf for cash makes that work, so be it.

Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: Sanjay's log: Tygart Water Treatment.

Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: Where to begin. This place is so far gone. I mean... how? It's not like this building got nuked or anything.

Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: Was this place run by animals? Are people that incompetent?

Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: We've got fully corroded purifiers, filters, unused mind you, covered in some... black sludge.

Speaker: 00235D8C:NPCM_SanjayKumar:VTYP
Text: Maria's not going to be happy about this.

Speaker: 002C60DE:NPCM_RE_ObjectCT01_Ford:VTYP
Text: Found some ridiculous robot that upgraded me to a deputy.

Speaker: 002C60DE:NPCM_RE_ObjectCT01_Ford:VTYP
Text: Jokes on him, I guess. Like I'm going to go grab these bombs and turn them in like some honorable citizen.

Speaker: 002C60DE:NPCM_RE_ObjectCT01_Ford:VTYP
Text: I'm keeping these babies for myself. Wiring's a bit gunked up, but I think I can make them work.

Speaker: 002C60DE:NPCM_RE_ObjectCT01_Ford:VTYP
Text: Just going to disarm this switch here to make sure it doesn't -- *explosion*

Speaker: 003337EB:NPCF_RE_ObjectCT02_Kora:VTYP
Text: Raleigh gave the all clear. Not sure what I expected, but it definitely wasn't this.

Speaker: 003337EB:NPCF_RE_ObjectCT02_Kora:VTYP
Text: I knew the government would get us nuked. Easy population control that you can just blame on the Chinese.

Speaker: 003337EB:NPCF_RE_ObjectCT02_Kora:VTYP
Text: Get rid of the unwanted lower class, cherry pick the middle. Leave the government and military to restore whatever order they want.

Speaker: 003337EB:NPCF_RE_ObjectCT02_Kora:VTYP
Text: But look at this place. Have fun restoring this infected, mess of a world, you dipshits!

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Howdy stranger! Er... oh god, I can't believe I said that. This is stupid.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: You're all alone. No one to hear, no one judging... and you can't say a simple line. Great.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Hey there...! Survivor? Bleh, equally terrible.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Welcome to my humble bunker where we're all dead! By the way, how about you do a crap ton of super dangerous work that I promise you is worth it?

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: You're on board, right? Of course you are, because the fate of humanity depends on it!

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: And my work here is done!

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Ok, I can do this. I can do this. It's for them, not for you. I can do it for them. I can do this.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Scenario 5. A worst case. This recording means my bunker is running on auxiliary power.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: You have... ideally four hours, potentially less, to somehow restore power and save this system!

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Let's see. Generator manual is here. Spare parts at Thunder Mountain, that would be fun. Tools...

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Forget it. There's about a million reasons here, and I seriously can't cover them all.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Maybe the bunker is sinking. Maybe one of those beavers on buffout chewed through the power lines. Maybe the generator just gave up on life.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Can't win 'em all, Abbie! Moving on... Another holotape for the trash.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Dear holotape. I'm pretty sure... that everyone I know is dead.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: If we hadn't bothered with this stupid, stupid system... they'd all still be here.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Well, guess what? If you all die, that kinda defeats the purpose!

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: Why couldn't we just... stay in our bunkers? Why'd we even have to go out there?

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: I'd rather eat Cram every day and never see the sun again then be stuck here... alone.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: I miss my mom... and my dad. You guys are supposed to be here.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: You took me away from my friends and my life all on your stupid promise that things were going to be fine! That this was best!

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: And is it? I can't do this on my own. I don't want to do this on my own.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: I just want things back the way they were.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: To my dearest Abigayle and Calvin.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: I've instructed Ella to give you this holotape on the event of my death. Please don't blame anything you're about to hear on her.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: These are my wishes. Ella has respected them, and I expect you to as well.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: I've been diagnosed with Parkinson's. I've still got plenty of time to live a normal life... well as normal as can be expected...

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: But the time will come where my health will deteriorate and I can no longer care for myself.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: I love you both tremendously, and you know that... but I will not be a burden to you, my children. Especially in these dark times.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: If everything has gone according to plan, hopefully my death has meant something.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: Please understand why I chose not to tell you. Abbie, you are smart enough to see our work through till the end.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: Calvin, you're turning into such a fine young man. Your mother would've been proud, but not as proud as me.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: You two take care of each other. You're going to make it through this. I know it.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: July 15, 2079. Wow. Who would've thought a little radiation would turn this world upside down?

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: We were down in those bunkers for what, a couple years? There's no way radiation did all this all by itself in that amount of time.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: I mean, first off, this place is crawling with these orange-red vines, the likes of which there is no precedent for.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: I saw a toad that wouldn't fit in a bathtub, a 12 point with two heads, be still my heart, and insects you don't even want to know about.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: I've started taking samples for analysis. Hopefully, the plants can still be used for some good old holistic treatments.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: Raleigh's getting to work on a series of tests for the water and soil. I guess we can count ourselves lucky the air's breathable.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: But this place... I grew up here and I barely recognize it. There's no way we were prepared for this.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: Toxicity levels, slight mutations, yes. But I'm telling you, Darwin would lose his mind out here.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: May 2, 2080. Jesus I'm tired. Ever since we agreed to help rebuild Harpers, it's just been non-stop work.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: These people are in some bad shape. Some are improving, but it pains me to see our supplies dwindle.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: It's just that logical knowledge of knowing you packed for four and then suddenly you need to provide for eight.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: On the bright side, we met a guy named Derek the other day who said he's with a group of people called the Responders.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: They seem to have realized what we knew all along... that the government wasn't going to lift a finger to help clean up this mess.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: The Responders have been at it from the start with no sign of order, so they took it upon themselves to organize and help those in need.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: It's also a relief to no longer be the only one with a real medical background and training.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: Derek said he can bring back some supplies and help out a bit. At least until we're more settled.

Speaker: 00019A67:NPCF_FS_Ella:VTYP
Text: Lucy's been a great help, but her training as an aesthetician can only go so far.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Things are finally starting to shape up around here at Harpers Ferry.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: We got a lot of defenses up and running, a real perimeter, and people taking lookout shifts.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Niraj is working on some new contraption to help with these brutal storms that sweep through. He said they could filter the air or something.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: And Ella's got a decent clinic set up with the help of the Responders.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: It makes me feel like maybe Raleigh was right, and we can have a real go at this.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Some of these survivors proved they aren't completely worthless, too.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: One guy, Duncan, turned out to be a decent hunter, and another gal, Kendyll, she's a better shot than me.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Still, you look at these people struggling here and just think... You bastards had your chance.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: We practically spelled it out for you and you just turned up your noses and called us crazy.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Bunch of idiots...

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: I feel like it's been non-stop missions for a while now.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Gather supplies, head out, take a beating, set up a thing, take a few more beatings, come home, heal up... rinse and repeat.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Most days, I'm not even sure how we're still alive.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: We've been working on this detection system for so long now, I feel like we'll never see the end of it.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Detectors, lures, uplinks. I think I'd rather die then head back to another relay tower at this rate.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: But Raleigh and Niraj say it's worth it, and I believe them.

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Those Scorched are nasty business...

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: And if I had the means to let people know they're coming, and better yet, maybe take a Scorchbeast out along the way?

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Hell yeah, I'd say that's worth it.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: I was approached today by Miranda Vox.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Yep, the same woman who told me to shove my "movement" where the sun don't shine and get the hell out of "her" town.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: She may be mayor of Harpers Ferry, or what's left of it, but I'm the one who's lived there all my life.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Grudges aside, she came asking for help.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Long story short, the town is a mess. People are dying. They need our "expertise," which I just took to mean help, supplies, you name it.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: So I grabbed Marty and went out there to have a look, and yeah. It's bad.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Maybe... Had I only gone alone, maybe I could keep this hidden from everyone... But Marty couldn't hold back her tears for those folks.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Having said all this out loud, I think I've finally come to a decision.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Now it's just going to be a matter of persuading the others that it's a good idea.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: I think it's time we claimed the Armory as our own territory.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: I'll need to get Eddie and Niraj to help out with some security measures.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Survivors are gonna hate it, but we gotta protect our own, especially against the damn Brotherhood.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Derek told us they've been hitting up the Responders for manpower and supplies and not taking no for an answer.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Well, they've got another thing coming if they try that over here, and we need to be ready.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: It's been... two weeks since I lost Trish and Marty.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Two weeks since we lost Harpers to those... things... those Scorched and that... nightmare.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Two weeks of keeping it together for Mike and Megan... and all the others.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Sam, where the hell are you? I could really use my best friend right now.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: This was our thing, you know. We were in this together.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Then you started in with the secrets, the no shows... You practically shoved Emily out the door, and now you're doing it to me?

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: I was your best friend for over forty years. I trusted you to help me see this through...

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: If you acted like you gave a half a damn about anything besides yourself you could've helped me.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Maybe I never would've made the decision rebuild Harpers Ferry. Maybe half my family would still be alive...

Speaker: 00359E91:NPCM_FS_Eddie:VTYP
Text: Is it recording? Make sure it's recording.

Speaker: 0010D868:NPCF_FS_Abbie:VTYP
Text: I got it, Eddie, it's recording... Jesus.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: All right, Madigan, you want to explain why we found you out there tampering with our stuff?

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Hey, you guys are always holed up in your bunkers, how else can I get your attention?

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Besides, a crazy contraption like that? Of course I'm gonna try to figure it out.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: And by the way you guys came out fully armed and ready to fight, I'm guessing it's pretty big.

Speaker: 00071980:NPCM_FS_Niraj:VTYP
Text: What you nearly broke was a Scorchbeast lure. It's the best defense we have against them.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Whoa, you're telling me you're luring those things down? You've got some balls, Free States.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Even with your numbers, taking on a beast is no easy task.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: It doesn't just lure them down. We found some research and tech at one of the Brotherhood's old outposts.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Ella realized if we can blast a Scorchbeast with a certain frequency, it disorients it long enough for us to go in and take it out.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: Niraj and Abbie started work on the tech. We tested it. And it works.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: This is a real game changer, Raleigh... if what you say is true.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: It's true, Hank. And this system would be done if it weren't for those damn Raiders.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Look, if this is as big as you think it is, the Fire Breathers can handle any Raiders.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: But I need to know how this system works and see it in action first.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: If you think we're just going to reveal our work to an ex-Brotherhood member, think again.

Speaker: 002E5B71:NPCM_FS_Raleigh:VTYP
Text: You want to see how this system works, then you've got some serious trust to earn.

Speaker: 003DC3B3:LC007_Anthropologist_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: As my study of Hopewell Cave continues, I'm struck by the atypical nature of this Adena-based burial complex.

Speaker: 003DC3B3:LC007_Anthropologist_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The Adena culture generally buried their dead in large mounds and similar hill-shaped earthworks.

Speaker: 003DC3B3:LC007_Anthropologist_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Due to the primitive nature of the tools from 1000 to 200 BC, stone carving was not yet a part of their society.

Speaker: 003DC3B3:LC007_Anthropologist_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: However, archeologists who investigated this "skull cave" site removed remains and artifacts belonging to the Adena culture.

Speaker: 003DC3B3:LC007_Anthropologist_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I wonder if it's possible that the remains of the Adena people were moved to this location well after their society ceased to exist?

Speaker: 003DC3B3:LC007_Anthropologist_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: For one culture to treat another's with such reverence is unusual at best. I will continue my research to discover more.

Speaker: 003DC3CD:NPCF_LC161_UnknownGhoul:VTYP
Text: I don't know if I'm sick, or I'm dying, but my body has changed.

Speaker: 003DC3CD:NPCF_LC161_UnknownGhoul:VTYP
Text: I've sought help, but people laugh at my appearance or turn me away.

Speaker: 003DC3CD:NPCF_LC161_UnknownGhoul:VTYP
Text: I'm what people are calling a "ghoul," a name that sickens me to my stomach.

Speaker: 003DC3CD:NPCF_LC161_UnknownGhoul:VTYP
Text: I've been chased out of my own home, and now I'm running from place to place hiding like a criminal.

Speaker: 003DC3CD:NPCF_LC161_UnknownGhoul:VTYP
Text: A week ago, I was begging for food and was almost shot by someone who didn't want me near them. Well, I've had enough.

Speaker: 003DC3CD:NPCF_LC161_UnknownGhoul:VTYP
Text: I found a note from someone named Lucy Harwick. She claims to run a place where people like me can go to live their life without being afraid.

Speaker: 003DC3CD:NPCF_LC161_UnknownGhoul:VTYP
Text: I'm going to head out to Valley Galleria to see if it's true. I hope to god that it is, because I don't know how much more of this I can take.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: When my brother JD & I answered the call to head into Harpers Ferry, we expected to find an organized Free States stronghold.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Now that we're here, it's obvious that no one knows what the hell they're doing.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: The other Free States families are wasting precious resources trying to restore Harpers Ferry and create a safe haven for survivors.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Instead, they should be turning the town into a fort and stockpiling supplies to prep for the long haul.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: We'll still pitch in, but we don't plan on sticking around long to see what happens.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: We don't think that Harpers Ferry will ever be safe, so we're going to use our share of the supplies to reinforce the bunker at our cabin.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: For the past few years, my brother's been bummed out - like really sad, you know?

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Personally, I don't think he's ever recovered from watching the world end. Hell, I don't think any of us have.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: I tried to talk to him about it, but he kept pushing me away and changing the subject.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: But after JD met Brianna Hawke in Harpers Ferry, things turned around. I guess she helped him out by giving him a different shoulder to cry on.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Why JD's more comfortable with her than his own brother, I'll never know.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Yeah, I'm kind of angry, maybe even a little jealous, but I'm going to let it go for his sake.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Still, there's something about Brianna that bugs me, so I'm going to keep an eye on her.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: We were at our bunker when the Scorchbeasts attacked Harpers Ferry. It took them less than an hour to burn the place down.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: When the attack was over, I thought Brianna was dead and that JD would return to his old self. When he didn't, I became suspicious.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Then Brianna shows up at our cabin with a small group of survivors and everything became clear.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: She had conned JD, played him this entire time, pretending to love him to give herself and her friends an invite to our bunker.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Well, there was no way I was going to let that happen. I told her she could march right back to her cave and find her own place to survive.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: When JD tried to stop me, I had to knock him out. That's when Brianna's people pushed back, and I fired some shots into the air to scare them away.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Now I have to deal with JD, and damn is he going to be pissed.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: It's been weeks since I chased off Brianna Hawke, and I feel like I've wasted all of it trying to convince JD that he was better off without her.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: I finally thought I was getting through, until I was cleaning up our cabin and found the goddamn notes they'd been passing to each other.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Instead of heading out to hunt, that hijo de perra's been stabbing me in the back by giving Brianna some of our supplies!

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: After everything I've sacrificed for our family, how could he do this to me?!

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: When he gets back from today's "hunt" we're going to have a little chat about Brianna Hawke. And this time, I'm not going to just look the other way.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: I... I don't even know how to say it... but JD's dead... I... I've murdered my own brother.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: After I found out he'd been stealing our supplies for Brianna Hawke, I couldn't wait, so I rushed out and found him scouting the ridge.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: I... I have a hard time remembering the rest.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: I don't know if he slipped, or I pushed too hard, but my brother... he fell... he's dead and it's all my fault.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: When Brianna found out what happened, she gathered her group and hit the cabin with everything they had. They wanted me dead.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: I killed them all, but they got in a lucky shot, and I don't think I'm going to last much longer. Probably better this way.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: This whole thing... what I did... it reminds me of a passage I read in the Bible once.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer; and you know that no murderer has eternal life present in him.

Speaker: 003DC3D1:NPCM_LC146_JesusSunday:VTYP
Text: I guess... I proved that one right.

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: Responder Dassa gave me some supplies in exchange for my "Survivor Story" so... hi, my name is Scott Shepherd, and things are going all right.

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: I was a nurse before the war, and I guess nothing much has changed. I just work for the Responders now, and I don't get paid! Hah!

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: The government is basically the same now as it was years ago. Wrecked. Disorganized. Cannot be trusted. Everyone knows this!

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: You wanna know why the War actually happened? Aliens. You think I'm joking? Listen. Right before everything went to hell... I saw them.

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: I was grilling hamburgers out in the yard with my dog and I heard rustling from the bushes, and a zapping noise.

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: Next thing I know, I'm light headed and I felt myself falling to the ground... and I didn't even have a lot to drink.

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: I woke up and I saw some little thing run into the bushes with my dog following it, and I knew something was wrong.

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: I found my dog later with a clump of green skin in his mouth. Green. Like moss or something.

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: The bombs fell almost 10 days later. 9 days, 19 hours to be exact. That's 235 hours precisely. You know what that is, right?

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: That's right. The atomic number of the fissile isotope of Uranium -- they had a plan from the very beginning!

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: Why would they come after me first, Scott Shepherd, the nurse? Well. Good question. I'm glad you asked.

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: They have our blood! They knew which ones of us would survive. This is one big experiment to them!

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: This whole thing was staged. Our lives. Our thoughts. Everything was designed for us. Just like this conversation. Every word I'm saying.... planned.

Speaker: 00215D2F:NPCM_RSVP05_Scott:VTYP
Text: Time to wake up, Appalachia! Find the ones holding the strings and cut the cords!

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: Just talk into this? Oh. Am I loud enough? Okay. Hi... What do you want me to say exactly?

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Yeah, so just talk about how you got here and maybe a little bit about your life. This is a historic document. Go ahead, Tabitha.

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: Okay, so... thanks... okay. I've been sober for 9 days. I got here 9 days ago. My name is Tabitha... and this is my story.

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: I just found out about everything. The War, the bombs, I just... I just realized this was uh, really happening.

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: For years I thought the chems were playing tricks with my mind... hurting my brain. Thought it was the worst trip ever...

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: Every time I'd come out of my haze long enough to look for food, I'd find more chems... and well... it kept going. And I kept seeing madness.

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: Look, I would have been wandering around fighting giant rats and eating garbage if not for the Responders... they're good folks.

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: That doc in the Church got me some meds that are helping out a lot, and they have group therapy meetings and... it's good... I think it's helping.

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: But listen... you should avoid the mountains. They'll just get you mixed up. Get you doing things you don't wanna do.

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: Hurting people mostly... and there are so many chems up there. I spent too long there, and... I hurt people... I couldn't think right... I couldn't.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: It's okay, Tabitha. Remember what we said in the group? Take your addictol and rest and things will be okay soon. It's okay. We're here for you.

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: Yeah... I'm taking it. When I feel better... I'm going out west though. Getting out of this place. Getting away from the chems. All of this.

Speaker: 00215D31:NPCF_RSVP05_Tabitha:VTYP
Text: I feel better every day, but... years of chems, years of rads, years of sleeping in the muck... it adds up. I'm gonna get back to sleep now, okay?

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Okay, thanks for sharing your story, Tabitha. Get some sleep. You'll be okay. You're safe now.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: We call it the Great War now. It's not been long, and things have been rough. Welcome to Survivor Stories. I'm Dassa Ben-Ami, a Responder.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: I've been working with the Responders for a couple years now. I'm from Charleston originally, so it was easy to join up.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: What wasn't easy was the work. Rebuilding Appalachia from the rubble while survivors flock to us regularly from all over.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: So many have come and gone, their stories untold, their names lost to time. I thought we should preserve this history somehow.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: I've decided to ask people to record their thoughts, their stories, anything they want to preserve forever. I'll call this series the Survivor Stories.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: I'll start with me. I was an anthropology PhD student at Vault-Tec University. Final year. I was printing my thesis when I heard the sirens...

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: I thought for sure my father, a Vault-Tec employee, could take us all with him, but... only two reservations came through. I refused to go.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: With my little brother, he went into the Vault. They could not persuade me, though they tried. In the end, I pushed them inside and that was it.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: After that, I went back home to Charleston and... well.. survived. Eventually the Responders formed and I signed up right away.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: It was so hard. The flood... was devastating. Relocating to Morgantown Airport and now Flatwoods has been... well... I remain optimistic.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Been with them now for... I guess 2 years. We have big plans! We can do so much to help. Maybe, just maybe, we can rebuild enough to be okay.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: And in the meantime, I will continue to record stories of survivors when I can. We are your history. This is Dassa Ben-Ami, signing off for now.

Speaker: 002B42EF:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Kid:VTYP
Text: Hi... Dassa asked me if I would talk about how I got here. She asked everybody. So I said okay. My name is Colonel, and I'm 13 years old.

Speaker: 002B42EF:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Kid:VTYP
Text: I just wanted to say I'm sorry. I'm sorry for everything... um... the bombs and the messed up people and the cows with two heads. All of it.

Speaker: 002B42EF:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Kid:VTYP
Text: I was bad... just bad. I cheated on my spelling test, I kicked Chip Wilkins in the shins until he cried, I pushed Rosie McCloy down the stairs...

Speaker: 002B42EF:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Kid:VTYP
Text: Um... I cut holes in the bottoms of all the gym shorts, and I put glue in the mashed potatoes in the cafeteria...

Speaker: 002B42EF:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Kid:VTYP
Text: I told Harold Newell to eat ten dead flies a day in order to grow muscles, and um, I put Nuka-Cola in the rat cage water bottles at the pet store...

Speaker: 002B42EF:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Kid:VTYP
Text: And um... I just wanted to say I'm sorry about everything... because my dad said if I wasn't this way then bad things wouldn't happen...

Speaker: 002B42EF:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Kid:VTYP
Text: I haven't seen daddy since the bombs and so I guess he left because of that too... It's okay, I am trying to be good now though.

Speaker: 002B42EF:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Kid:VTYP
Text: *sniffles* I'm not old enough to be a Volunteer but Dassa said I could help collect food and water... so I'm getting better, I promise!

Speaker: 002B42EF:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Kid:VTYP
Text: And um... daddy? If you're listening... I promise I won't be bad anymore so you can come back now. Okay? Okay. Bye. *sniffles*

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Ah, hello person in the distant future! Dassa told us these tapes would be used as historical records someday. Nifty! So, my name is Miguel Caldera.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Let's see, my story begins in an office. I used to be a programmer at Vault-Tec, one of many. Nobody special, you see. And that's okay.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: I used to stare out that window by the coffee machine and think... shucks, I wish I could leave this job and hike in the woods every day.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: I'd dream about walking the Appalachian trail, setting up camp wherever I liked, and traveling with close friends! Ah.. the dreams kept me going...

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: And well, when the bombs fell... I was terrified just like anybody else. I wasn't in a vault, so I just, you know, had to figure it all out too.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: The Responders found me. I had a little campsite, some supplies. I hacked a protectron to guard me while I slept, but... I missed people. I did!

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: It's been all right, you know? The apocalypse and all. I know that seems weird but... I have freedom now. I can actually help people...

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: I even met somebody - a Volunteer who delivers supplies. Imagine that, right? Even when you think everything is over... it's... it's not. It goes on.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: I mean it's awful too, don't get me wrong. All the people dead and hurt. But, well, those are things beyond my control, so I'm making the best of it.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: These days I'm important. People treat me like I matter because... well, there are so few of us that we can't afford to think otherwise.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: So, for all you future people... just know that we lived through something... horrible. But we did it. Somehow, we're alive...

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: And if you're hearing this, then well... I guess at least some of us made it. Right? So hey, chin up, kiddo! You'll be okay. Okay?

Speaker: 002B42DE:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Adult:VTYP
Text: Boy! I think it's been like 10 years since I did one of these. Dassa said she lost my original one though. Bummer. My name is Colonel, so hey, hi!

Speaker: 002B42DE:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Adult:VTYP
Text: So, let's see. Bombs fell when I was a kid, my dad died in the War, you know, this is all pretty normal. My story is, I guess, boring.

Speaker: 002B42DE:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Adult:VTYP
Text: So Dassa found me when I was 13 or so, and she brought me to the Responders. They taught me everything. I became a Volunteer... it was great.

Speaker: 002B42DE:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Adult:VTYP
Text: For the past 5 years, I've been a Responder myself! I help kids who lost their families... get them safe, trained, and just act like a big brother.

Speaker: 002B42DE:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Adult:VTYP
Text: Every year we find fewer people though, so I dunno. Things are not good out there. Just getting simple food and water is tough.

Speaker: 002B42DE:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Adult:VTYP
Text: And the Brotherhood, well.. we thought that would be different. We thought everything would be different though.

Speaker: 002B42DE:NPCM_RSVP05_Colonel_Adult:VTYP
Text: Er, well, so anyway. Maybe in 10 years, Dassa will ask me to do another one of these Survivor Stories. Hah! Til then. Peace, Appalachia.

Speaker: 002B4342:NPCF_RSVP05_Sofie:VTYP
Text: Is this thing on? Great. Hello survivors of this garbage dump! I'm Sofie and this is my stupid survivor story!

Speaker: 002B4342:NPCF_RSVP05_Sofie:VTYP
Text: How does this dumb shit go? Oh yeah. Before the bombs I was a librarian, and now I can read everything all the time. Wee, look at me! I'm lucky!

Speaker: 002B4342:NPCF_RSVP05_Sofie:VTYP
Text: Wait, no, maybe I was one of those farmers who prepared for years for the end times. Some sort of religious thing. Yeah, that's right!

Speaker: 002B4342:NPCF_RSVP05_Sofie:VTYP
Text: No no! I got it. I was a sweet little kid and lived off some cat food containers in a super duper mart for months near my parents' rotting carcasses.

Speaker: 002B4342:NPCF_RSVP05_Sofie:VTYP
Text: Nobody came. Nobody. I learned how to deal. You should too. The Responders are a JOKE. Nobody helps anybody anymore. Get a grip.

Speaker: 002B4342:NPCF_RSVP05_Sofie:VTYP
Text: If you're not a total idiot, you'll get out of this dump before the Responders get you KILLED! Leave the sick behind, they're better off. Trust me.

Speaker: 002B4342:NPCF_RSVP05_Sofie:VTYP
Text: Whiny babies can stay here and play make-believe, but anyone with half a brain will go up to the Mountains and drop the dead weight!

Speaker: 002B4342:NPCF_RSVP05_Sofie:VTYP
Text: Delbert already tried to stop me, sorry to say nobody will be around to teach you how to eat shit now, Flatwoods! Bye, suckers! Love always, Sofie!

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: Dassa asked me to make a recording about my life since the bombs or something, you know, for history.

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: I'm on my way to Morgantown to take some food supplies up there. I do this once a month or so to make sure everything's ok.

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: Mostly though, I do it because I get to spend a bit of time with the other Responders. I'm just a Volunteer right now, but, well. One day.

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: I get to also spend some time with Miguel, who's a brilliant programmer. He built a lot of the robots before and after the war.

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: Excuse me...

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *gunshots*

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: Ahem, where was I? Ah yes, Miguel. The dreamboat. Sure, it's chaotic and the end of the world and all that but... you can't plan love, right?

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: So, in the meantime, I walk from the Airport to Flatwoods delivering supplies. Sometimes Miguel comes with me. Those are the best times.

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: I hope I'll get transferred up there soon... they said after I become a full Responder. But becoming a Responder is hard!

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: Miguel made the Kiosk system to train volunteers, and he hopes to add onto it so Volunteers can become Responders one day...

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: Until then, I just carry the supplies. I don't know if it's particularly important but... I hope it is. Hang on.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *gunshots*

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: Before the bombs fell, I just played a lot of games. You know Red Menace? I have the highest score on the east coast, I think. Atomic Command, too.

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: I also read every comic I can find. Grognak is, of course, my favorite. I used to have a full Grognak outfit, too. Even a real axe!

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: I like to think of myself as Grognak sometimes, cutting through the hordes. Miguel would be the Manta Man, and together we'd be Unstoppable!

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: I'm originally from Charleston but, well, my home was probably destroyed. I don't want to go back... even for my axe. It's just not worth it.

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: Maybe one of Miguel's robots can fetch it for me someday! Or maybe we can go there together, like Grognak and Manta Man!

Speaker: 002B91E7:NPCM_RSVP05_Garry:VTYP
Text: Anyway, it's not so bad out here if you just pretend you're Grognak. Remember kids... be a hero and not a minion of the Man-Saurian!

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *gunshots*

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Dassa asked us all to document our stories for posterity, you know. Seems like a fine idea. So hi, I'm Kesha McDermott.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: When the bombs fell, I was in Watoga coordinating a state-wide science fair for that year's high school kids. The theme was, "the Future of Energy!"

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: After the bombs, everything was pretty chaotic. Scavenging for food, fighting off rabid survivors, just a bad time all around.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: I found a couple of surviving kids from the high school whose parents didn't make it, and we holed up in an old house in town for a while.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: After a bit, I was able to solder the circuitry in an old radio and we tuned in to a broadcast from the Responders. We were overjoyed!
