Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: The trip from Watoga to Flatwoods was rough, mind you. The kids and I ran into a group of assholes in the mountains who stole our food and water.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: I can't tell you how happy I was to find the Responders in Flatwoods. Tents for everyone, open kitchens, medical supplies, protection - we were safe.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: They had a problem though: their water sources were contaminated heavily. People were boiling water, but not long enough to make it safe.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: So I stepped up, I said: "I'll build a testing kit to monitor the contamination, and I'll teach folks how to properly boil water." And I did.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: The world is getting better, but slowly. We need to make sure it doesn't relapse, too. It's going to take time and care, that's all.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Well -- time, care, and science!

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: Reverend Delbert Winters here. Born and raised in this very town. Lent my own Church to the Responders for their outpost here. And you're welcome.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: The Responders are on a true mission, ya see. Helpin' folks through thick n' thin. Until the heavens open again and take us all up anyways.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: When this all happened, I figured like most... it was time. This was the End. But... but it wasn't, was it? We're still here.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: At first I thought it was a mistake. That we was missed, forgotten. Maybe we did some wrongs...

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: Didn't give enough to charity maybe... didn't praise His name even in the worst of times... maybe thought some things that ought not to been thought.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: So I asked Him. I asked... how? Why? I fought your wars on Earth. I'm ready to fight them up there by Your side!

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: Then, in my despair, I saw some survivors eatin' raw rat carcass behind a dumpster. "You ought to cook that first," I warned em. Seemed obvious.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: We tried, but got sick, they said, covered in their own filth. I realized right then and there that I was being tasked.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: From then on, I built kitchens. Cooked good food. Fed anyone who walked up with an empty belly. And I was thankful for my task in life. Thankful!

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: Next time hell or high water land at my stoop, I'll be swept clear away with it. But until then, let's share a homecooked meal together, all right?

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: I pressed the button, hush. I think it's recording now. Shush. Hello? Hello there? I think it's working. I hate these things.

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: This is Willie Mae, and I was asked to talk a bit about my life since the war to help educate future children someday. I think that's nice.

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: I thought I'd just watch my programs and entertain the grandkids in my retirement, but that didn't turn out to be the case...

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: I'm just glad they all made it to the vault in time, you see. When I saw it in a dream, I knew my prayers were answered.

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: My husband Frank used to work in the mines. Just a bit before the war there was news of tremors, and he didn't come home...

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: I don't know what happened to him, or why he never came home for sure. And between you and me, I'm fine with that.

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: Since the war, I just read my old newspapers and listened to music. It's very peaceful for once, which is just right nice by me.

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: Ever hear of the Watoga Times Atomic Lottery? The winner got ten years worth of Blamco Mac & Cheese, Salisbury Steak, and Nuka-Cola of course.

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: I played that lottery for 20 years, and I finally won the month before the war. It lasted only 8 years though, but who can you complain to?

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: By the time it ran out, I had heard the Responders radio broadcasts, so I went out to find them and get supplies. Bless their hearts.

Speaker: 0037AB16:NPCF_RSVP05_WillieMae:VTYP
Text: Well, I'm going home now... for a bit anyways. How do I turn this thing off? Blast these things. Not this button, not this one, oh here it is.

Speaker: 002B7BD6:NPCM_LC182_Soldier:VTYP
Text: The world is over. I think that's the first time I've said it out loud. It sounds... strange.

Speaker: 002B7BD6:NPCM_LC182_Soldier:VTYP
Text: After the bombs hit, people kept looking to us for answers. And I'd tell them, "Don't worry, help is on the way!" It's clear to me now that there's nobody left.

Speaker: 002B7BD6:NPCM_LC182_Soldier:VTYP
Text: Winter has been brutal. It started a few weeks after the bombs hit and shows no signs of letting up. Hell, maybe Winter is all that's left now.

Speaker: 002B7BD6:NPCM_LC182_Soldier:VTYP
Text: I remembered this cave from grade school. Kids called it the Wendigo Cave. I was scared of it then, absolutely terrified. Now it's the only thing keeping us alive.

Speaker: 002B7BD6:NPCM_LC182_Soldier:VTYP
Text: We'll stay here to survive the cold, then we'll get back out there. The men trust me to keep them alive, and I haven't let them down yet. Here's hoping that record holds.

Speaker: 0031C716:NPCM_RE_ObjectSM01_PRCScientist:VTYP
Text: I leave a message for my comrades - assuming any are left. If not, our mission has failed. My only solace is that the capitalist dogs are doomed as well.

Speaker: 0031C716:NPCM_RE_ObjectSM01_PRCScientist:VTYP
Text: When the bombs hit, it was clear we had failed the primary directive. Station Chief Xi ordered us to disperse and blend with the local populace. This... has been challenging.

Speaker: 0031C716:NPCM_RE_ObjectSM01_PRCScientist:VTYP
Text: I do not understand the people of this country, nor do I care to. I miss my people, the Motherland, and... I grow weary.

Speaker: 0031C716:NPCM_RE_ObjectSM01_PRCScientist:VTYP
Text: If I am wrong... maybe it is not too late to advance our work at Fujiniya. I will not be around to find out. Forgive me. Hail the People's Republic!

Speaker: 0031C716:NPCM_RE_ObjectSM01_PRCScientist:VTYP
Text: *Gunshot*

Speaker: 0046830F:U01_NPCM_Pledge:VTYP
Text: *Sigh* It's been... hours? Days? Well, who the hell knows. Trapped... starving, thirsty. Since everyone drank that goddamned drink.

Speaker: 0046830F:U01_NPCM_Pledge:VTYP
Text: This was our final initiation. Me and my buddy Max over there. Locked in here for the party and then we were golden. One last test...

Speaker: 0046830F:U01_NPCM_Pledge:VTYP
Text: They passed out red cups at the end. To celebrate. Called it 'Nukashine'. I dumped it when they weren't looking. Max here... didn't.

Speaker: 0046830F:U01_NPCM_Pledge:VTYP
Text: Everyone was fine at first... well, until they weren't. That sound... I'll never forget that damned sound. I... I can't... *Sigh*

Speaker: 0046830F:U01_NPCM_Pledge:VTYP
Text: And now... now, I'm stuck here with no food, no water, and an old saw that won't cut through shit. Stuck here with ol' Max Posey.

Speaker: 0046830F:U01_NPCM_Pledge:VTYP
Text: I... I gotta think of something soon. He's a swell guy but... I'm getting sick of his company.

Speaker: 00469AE5:U01_NPCM_Lewis:VTYP
Text: Personal log, timestamp 1120761344. My special edition Nuka-Cola lamp arrived in satisfactory condition. After a few... modifications, I am greatly pleased.

Speaker: 00469AE5:U01_NPCM_Lewis:VTYP
Text: I clearly now have the greatest Nuka-Cola collection in the city, but I've pushed the capacity of this meager hovel to the limit.

Speaker: 00469AE5:U01_NPCM_Lewis:VTYP
Text: Solution - I need to procure a warehouse in Morgantown for further expansion. But first, I need the proper financial capital...

Speaker: 00469AE5:U01_NPCM_Lewis:VTYP
Text: I clearly need to strategize a successful commercial enterprise. University students are plentiful. But what do they want...

Speaker: 00469AE5:U01_NPCM_Lewis:VTYP
Text: Aha! Proposal - students love alcohol. And I love Nuka-Cola. I shall formulate a high-proof distilled spirit with Nuka-Cola. The perfect beverage!

Speaker: 00469AE5:U01_NPCM_Lewis:VTYP
Text: Hmmm... it just needs a name. Nukahol? Nukamash? Nukabrew? Ah, I'll get to that part later.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Greetings to you, the lucky finder of this golden holotape! That fresh golden glaze comes courtesy of the delicious box of BlamCo Mac and Cheese you just opened!

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: I'm Dick Shale! You may recognize me from contests like the Pulowski Preservation Shelter Squat and the Red Rocket Gas-A-Thon!

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: If you're hearing this, it means you've won a free Extreme Adventure tour upgrade at the world-famous Uncanny Caverns! Base ticket price not included.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Be at the front gates at 10 AM on October 1st and don't be late! In your wildest dreams you could not imagine the uncanny surprises that await you!

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: And as the official Uncanny Caverns tour guide... assuming the check clears... I'll see you there too! This is Dick Shale, signing off!

Speaker: 00511741:NPCM_LC130_ChemAddict:VTYP
Text: Mmmmm, yeah. Yeah, that's the good stuff. Yeahhh... I'm flying man, I'm flying! Oh wow, wow! I'm in a different planet, man! I'm in outer space!

Speaker: 00511741:NPCM_LC130_ChemAddict:VTYP
Text: Guys, do you feel this? Do you feel this, guys? Guys? Huh, where did everybody... AAAAAH, WHAT THE HELL IS THAT??

Speaker: 00511741:NPCM_LC130_ChemAddict:VTYP
Text: OOOH MAN, please tell me you see that? Guys, do you see that? Becky, there's a lighthouse there, right? Right Becky? Steve? Oh god! OH GOD!

Speaker: 00511741:NPCM_LC130_ChemAddict:VTYP
Text: Stay calm man, stay calm. You're up too high, there's no water around, no boats around. It's not a lighthouse, you idiot. They don't build lighthouses on mountains.

Speaker: 00511741:NPCM_LC130_ChemAddict:VTYP
Text: It's the chems, haha! The chems, of course! I'll just close my eyes, and when I open them... three, two, one... NO! OH NO! NO NO NO NO NO! Where am I? Where am I?? WHERE AM I??
This is the Test Radio.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Entry three.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Sylvester left the team some time ago. We heard his screams echoing through the mines only minutes after he left.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Rita and I are all that's left. Despite the odds, we've somehow made it to the beacon. We've done it.

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What's supposed to happen when we activate that beacon?

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I don't know, I suppose we'll get Melody Larkin's next instruction about how to get out of here.

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Well, there's no reason for us to stand here and wait. Push the damn thing.
<Beacon Noise>

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Oh my god...

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: They're everywhere. I... I don't know if we're going to make it, but we didn't come this far just to give up.
<Gun bolt sliding into place sound>

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm with you, Max.
<Gun bolt sliding into place sound>

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If we don't make it out of here, I just wanted you to know it's been a real honor, Rita.

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Likewise. Now let's go show those Scorched what it means to be a Fire Breather.

Speaker: 00136E6F:MTR06_SylvesterTate_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Okay, "squad leader." Tim and Andrew are both dead. Now what the hell are we supposed to do!?

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Shut up, Sy... she's recording.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Entry two.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: We've lost Timothy Wolfe and Andrew Rhodes to a swarm of Scorched, and the rest of us barely made it past them alive.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm beginning to think Melody Larkin may have underestimated the difficulty of this exam.

Speaker: 00136E6F:MTR06_SylvesterTate_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You're damn right she did! This is suicide! Well, the hell with this, I'm going back!

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: No you're not. You're sticking with us.

Speaker: 00136E6F:MTR06_SylvesterTate_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Why? So we can get picked off one by one until we're all dead!? No way, not me!

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You know what, Sy?

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You've been acting like a coward ever since we started tackling the Scorched at the farms. And now Tim and Andrew are dead because of you!

Speaker: 00136E6F:MTR06_SylvesterTate_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What the hell are you talking about!?

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I saw him, Max.

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: When those Scorched pushed through the tunnels, they came at us from all sides.

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Tim and Andrew were holding and they told Sy to watch the back. But he didn't. He ran away and left their rear flank wide open.

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: That's what took them down!

Speaker: 00136E6F:MTR06_SylvesterTate_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Bullshit! She's lying Max!

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Both of you, knock it off!

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Sylvester, if you want to go, go. But you're going back alone. And I guarantee we didn't clear everything behind us.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: But even if you make it, mark my words, you'll never be a part of this squad again.

Speaker: 00136E6F:MTR06_SylvesterTate_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Fine, to hell with both of you. I'm out of here!

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You're seriously letting him go?

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Yeah, Rita. We're better off without him.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Is it on?

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Yeah, the red light is on, so it's recording.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: This Maxine Ballard, squad leader of The Scorchslayers.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: We're making this recording to document our descent into the Belching Betty Mine for the final exam.

Speaker: 00136E83:MTR06_AndrewRhodes_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Well, say which exam...

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Oh, right.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: For the Fire Breathers final exam. We're supposed to head inside, find the emergency beacon and watch out for Scorched.

Speaker: 00136E59:MTR06_TimothyWolfe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Piece of cake.

Speaker: 00136E6F:MTR06_SylvesterTate_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I don't know. If it's so easy, why hasn't anyone else completed the exam?

Speaker: 00136E59:MTR06_TimothyWolfe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Because they weren't us.

Speaker: 00136E59:MTR06_TimothyWolfe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: We've been hunting Scorched at the farms for days. How much harder could the ones in the mines be? Grow a little backbone.

Speaker: 00136F52:MTR06_RitaWilcox_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Come on, guys. Let's stick together on this.

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: All of you, shut up!

Speaker: 00136E86:MTR06_MaxineBallard_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Okay, Scorchslayers. Time to lock and load. Let's get the job done.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Sergeant Madigan, is it?

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Was. Not sure that really applies anymore.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Cause you quit the Brotherhood.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Our interests no longer aligned.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: And why is that, exactly? Brotherhood's been a good ally to us. Taking you on could be seen as an act of bad faith.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Taggerdy's Brotherhood was a fine organization. Maxson's Brotherhood's only cares about locking away every bit of technology they can get their hands on.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: I was a fire fighter before the war. It's my opinion that looking after the people of Appalachia should be top priority.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: From what I've heard, Responders do too.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I'm guessing Paladin Taggerdy didn't recruit a fire fighter because she liked how you looked in fatigues. What were you before your civilian life?

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Marine Recon.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: No shit.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: And why would the Responders need a Marine-turned-Brotherhood defector in their midst?

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Because I guarantee you don't have someone like me. I find things. People. Supplies. Solutions. And I'm good at it.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: You guys have a lot of mouths to feed and a lot of people to keep safe. I can help you do both. All I ask is regular rations and my own bunk.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: And how do we know you ain't just sellin' us a bill of goods?

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: I'm willing to prove it. Gimme a job. I'll show you what I can do.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: How would you feel about getting back into a fire suit?

Speaker: 002B9173:NPCM_MTR_Welch_QuentinArlen:VTYP
Text: I hate it when you talk like I'm a criminal, Ma.

Speaker: 002B9173:NPCM_MTR_Welch_QuentinArlen:VTYP
Text: I'm a businessman. People demand things, and I supply them. Capitalism at its finest, right?

Speaker: 002B9173:NPCM_MTR_Welch_QuentinArlen:VTYP
Text: While back I was doing a little run for the Duchess, and found out just how much this city loves me.

Speaker: 002B9173:NPCM_MTR_Welch_QuentinArlen:VTYP
Text: Picked up the goods, and had the usual uneventful trip most of the way back. Hit the outskirts of Welch, and whad'ya know - the local sheriff is waiting for me.

Speaker: 002B9173:NPCM_MTR_Welch_QuentinArlen:VTYP
Text: I'm just about to pull my weapon and make things "interesting", when a group of old coal men show up. They start hollering about how those Auto-Miners have gone topsy-turvy, and are causing all kinds of mayhem back in Mine Shaft Elaine!

Speaker: 002B9173:NPCM_MTR_Welch_QuentinArlen:VTYP
Text: The lawman bails, I pay the boys a little distraction fee, and everyone's happy. The people understand me. The people need me! And I'm pleased to provide.

Speaker: 002B9174:NPCF_MTR_Welch_JulianaWheatley:VTYP
Text: What do I think about how things are going in Welch? Well, it can't get much worse.

Speaker: 002B9174:NPCF_MTR_Welch_JulianaWheatley:VTYP
Text: Earthquakes every other day, lawless thugs walking right down main street, and we're practically swimming in every kind of drug known to man!

Speaker: 002B9174:NPCF_MTR_Welch_JulianaWheatley:VTYP
Text: If I didn't care about this place so much, I'd be on the first bus to Watoga.

Speaker: 002B9174:NPCF_MTR_Welch_JulianaWheatley:VTYP
Text: But I'll stick it out. I'll try to make things better. Someone has to.

Speaker: 002B9174:NPCF_MTR_Welch_JulianaWheatley:VTYP
Text: If we're going to pull through this, it's going to take nothing less than bullheaded determination to put us back on the right path.

Speaker: 002B9174:NPCF_MTR_Welch_JulianaWheatley:VTYP
Text: Who needs money when you've got stubbornness?

Speaker: 00331C98:MTR05_DanielHornwright_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Hanover. This is Daniel Hornwright.

Speaker: 00331C98:MTR05_DanielHornwright_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I presume you've seen to it that the Technology Support group has updated the Senior Executive exam with my clarified answers.

Speaker: 00331C98:MTR05_DanielHornwright_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm growing... weary of the spineless ... "executives" you've been sending me.

Speaker: 00331C98:MTR05_DanielHornwright_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You find me some candidates with the wherewithal to survive here or else I'll find someone who will.

Speaker: 00355941:EN04_Hought_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Mitchell. Higher-ups need a fresh batch of tissue samples infected with F-7n. Today.

Speaker: 00355941:EN04_Hought_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: They received a furtive message from Agriculture. And Secretary Eckhart is not a man to be kept waiting.

Speaker: 00355941:EN04_Hought_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: F-7n proved a bit more... potent than expected, so you'll need my password to collect a canister from the dispensary. Promethean7.

Speaker: 00355941:EN04_Hought_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Once you've deposited that into the ingredient collector upstairs, you'll just need a host to allow the sample to gestate.

Speaker: 00355941:EN04_Hought_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Subject #113 should be able to take another harvesting.

Speaker: 00355941:EN04_Hought_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And be aware. We were also forced to tweak the formula, after Subject #21 left without authorization.

Speaker: 00355941:EN04_Hought_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: A phermonic component was added to mark the gestating hosts. So if for some reason one gets away again... you may use the dogs to find them.

Speaker: 0038CD63:NPCM_MTR06_Buck:VTYP
Text: Hey Rita. So, right now, you're asleep, enjoying your last peaceful night's rest for God knows how long...

Speaker: 0038CD63:NPCM_MTR06_Buck:VTYP
Text: ... and I thought I'd record something for you to remember me by while you're locked away inside Charleston Fire Department...

Speaker: 0038CD63:NPCM_MTR06_Buck:VTYP
Text: ... training for the prestigious opportunity to dive face first into a bunch of mine fires with the rest of those Fire Breather nut jobs.

Speaker: 0038CD63:NPCM_MTR06_Buck:VTYP
Text: Heh. Honestly, though... ain't no Responder alive who's a better pick for that crew than you.

Speaker: 0038CD63:NPCM_MTR06_Buck:VTYP
Text: Just make sure you don't forget the basics with all this fancy new training. Always check your seals. It's stop, drop, then roll. The order's important.

Speaker: 0038CD63:NPCM_MTR06_Buck:VTYP
Text: And, most important, don't come back all crispy. Because I love what I'm looking at right now.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: All right. We're recording.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Good, 'cause now we can get on record that I think this idea's god-damned looney.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I'm not thrilled about sending our people into a place that's actively toxic either...

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: ... but there are whole towns down there we still haven't reached out to: Welch, Beckley, Bramwell.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Bramwell? Come on, now! You really think the Hornwrights or the Garrahans didn't fly off to some private island the moment the air raid sirens turned on?

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Most likely they did. But right now we don't know and don't have a safe way of finding out.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: And that's why I wanted your help, Melody, on how we can get there.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: ... fine. We got a couple folks from the Charleston Fire Department.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: I can talk to them, see what they have to say about gettin' set up for those sorts of operations.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Thank you.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Anyone you send into all that smoke is going to need training, though. Need to be whip smart if they're gonna survive someplace that hostile.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: And breathing equipment's finicky as hell. Whole lot of care and maintenance if they're gonna be out there for hours, let alone days.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: You're talking about a whole new division here.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I understand what I'm asking.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Tell you what you ought to do... you ought to give 'em a name.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: A name?

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Green Berets. Smokejumpers. Navy Seals. You want someone to sign up for dangerous duty, needs to be some prestige behind it.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: You give 'em a name, a new designation, extra rations, maybe, I'll guarantee you'll get the volunteers you're looking for.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Hmm. Any suggestions?

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Huh... well, gramps was a moonshiner. Made hooch so strong, normal folk couldn't come within a quarter-mile of it.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Everyone called him and his boys the "Fire Breathers." Resilient sons-a-guns. What about that?

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: ... I suppose we don't need to go with the first idea we come up with. But for now, I'd like you to reach out to those firemen.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Convince them to get onboard with the... Fire Breathers. Let them know it's important. Prestigious.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Oh lordy, I think she likes it.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: I'll work on getting them a place to train. Charleston Fire Department seems like the natural spot.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Certainly won't have to travel far to get yourselves into trouble.

Speaker: 0010E1F0:NPCF_MariaChavez:VTYP
Text: Good. We should get started. If there's anyone still alive down there, I think they've suffered enough.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Welcome, recruit, to your final exam. I'm Hank Madigan, Fire Breather lieutenant.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: I'm going to try and make this brief - the Scorched coming through Big Bend Tunnel need to be stopped...

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: ... and the toxicity of the area means there's no better crew to do it than the Fire Breathers.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Exam's simple. Reach the bottom of the mine, hit the emergency beacon down there, and come back up.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: All you've got to do is survive a little slice of living hell and all the Scorched that call it home.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: I get this is extreme, but we need to know if you can hack it before you've got a half-dozen other people counting on you.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: But you're not going in empty-handed. Along with your suit, you've been issued a modified 10mm.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: We figured out the Scorched aren't big fans of depleted Ultracite. Took a field trip to AMS HQ to figure out how to make the stuff, but it's the most effective tool we've found for putting them down.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: So, time to prove you can put it to good use. Suit-up, strap-in, and move out, recruit.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Hello again, recruit. And congratulations. If you're hearing this, it means you've earned yourself a place in the Fire Breathers.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Head back to Charleston Fire Department and have the active captain register you for duty.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: That'll grant you access to our internal computer system. Once that's done, your captain should be able to point you to your first assignment.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: But there's no time to waste. Get a move on, recruit. And welcome to the Fire Breathers.

Speaker: 003CB497:NPCM_MTR_Welch_DaltonYaborough:VTYP
Text: Mr. and Mrs. Armand Kaminski. This is your final warning. Your domicile is situated on top of AMS property.

Speaker: 003CB497:NPCM_MTR_Welch_DaltonYaborough:VTYP
Text: You have 15 seconds to exit your home. If you do not do so, my men and I are well within our rights to remove you by force.

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: Don't think they're coming out, boys.

Speaker: 003CB497:NPCM_MTR_Welch_DaltonYaborough:VTYP
Text: Sir, this does not concern you. Please step back.

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: You company boys take our jobs. Take our dignity. Now you want our homes, too? I'd say it concerns me plenty.

Speaker: 003CB497:NPCM_MTR_Welch_DaltonYaborough:VTYP
Text: Sir, I'm going to ask you one more time. Get back in your house. The only people in trouble are the Kaminskis ... for now.

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: That's where you're wrong, son.

Speaker: 003CB499:NPCF_MTR_Welch_AngieDecland:VTYP
Text: Agent Danger, reporting, ma'am.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Oh, it's Agent Danger today?

Speaker: 003CB499:NPCF_MTR_Welch_AngieDecland:VTYP
Text: Yes, ma'am. Agent Tornado's retired. Too much collateral damage during missions.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Is that so?

Speaker: 003CB499:NPCF_MTR_Welch_AngieDecland:VTYP
Text: Yes. Momma said we can't play Agent Tornado anymore. Didn't say anything about Agent Danger.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Well, aren't you a sharp cookie.

Speaker: 003CB499:NPCF_MTR_Welch_AngieDecland:VTYP
Text: That doesn't sound like a particularly good cookie, ma'am.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Hmm. I suppose it doesn't. Now, to what do I owe the distinct pleasure?

Speaker: 003CB499:NPCF_MTR_Welch_AngieDecland:VTYP
Text: Momma said, go ask Ms. Duchess if she can cop us a two extra tabs of Buffout. Gerald can't work without it and she knows we're good for it.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Momma sent you to do her begging.

Speaker: 003CB499:NPCF_MTR_Welch_AngieDecland:VTYP
Text: Yes, ma'am.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Because she knows you're my one weakness in this world.

Speaker: 003CB499:NPCF_MTR_Welch_AngieDecland:VTYP
Text: Uh, I think so, ma'am.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Agent Danger, would you be willing to take a mission for me? I need three of the coldest, iciest Nuka-Colas they've got down at Wabash's.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: If I gave you some money, would you be willing to go get them for me? One of 'em's got your name on it.

Speaker: 003CB499:NPCF_MTR_Welch_AngieDecland:VTYP
Text: Agent Danger can do that!

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: That's my girl. Go quick and you can have Butch's too!

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: ... Butch.

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: Yes, ma'am?

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Go pay Betty a visit. Let her know this is the last credit she's ever getting.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: I'll keep Agent Danger occupied while you make your point crystal clear.

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: Yes, ma'am.

Speaker: 003CB49F:NPCM_MTR_RustyPick_Pitchman:VTYP
Text: Looking for a new career? Like working with your hands? Finding solutions to challenging problems? Fixing complex machinery in exciting environments?

Speaker: 003CB49F:NPCM_MTR_RustyPick_Pitchman:VTYP
Text: Then its time you joined the Hornwright Industrial Auto-Miner Support Squads!

Speaker: 003CB49F:NPCM_MTR_RustyPick_Pitchman:VTYP
Text: We're looking for talented men ... and gals! ... interested in earning good pay for hard work...

Speaker: 003CB49F:NPCM_MTR_RustyPick_Pitchman:VTYP
Text: ... keeping Hornwright Industrial's fleet of advanced Auto-Mining robots active and kicking!

Speaker: 003CB49F:NPCM_MTR_RustyPick_Pitchman:VTYP
Text: Pop the Hornwright recruitment booth in downtown Charleston and sign-up today!

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Hello Mick.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Wanted to let you know I've procured those tools you and your boys were asking after.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Along with all the nails and safety equipment you could need.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: But we don't do deliveries.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: Bring the money to my place in Welch.

Speaker: 003CB49A:NPCF_MTR_Welch_Duchess:VTYP
Text: You know where to find the Duchess.

Speaker: 003CB4A7:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_Ed:VTYP
Text: You got that thing recording, Walter?

Speaker: 003CB4A8:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_Walter:VTYP
Text: It's on.

Speaker: 003CB4A7:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_Ed:VTYP
Text: Good. Dan, tell him what you told me.

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: Uh, yeah. Sure. So we were unloading the 197 from DC. Huge set of containers. Industrial-sized. Locked up like Fort Knox.

Speaker: 003CB4A8:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_Walter:VTYP
Text: Uh huh.

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: And as soon as it's off the train, this creepy guy in a suit comes out of nowhere, starts questioning me.

Speaker: 003CB4A8:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_Walter:VTYP
Text: Wait. The 197?

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: Yeah. Guy said his name was Grey. Kept asking what I was doing. If I'd seen anything.

Speaker: 003CB4A7:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_Ed:VTYP
Text: See! I told you, Walter. There's something screwy going on. This is the third shipment this month--

Speaker: 003CB4A8:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_Walter:VTYP
Text: Look, I don't know what you think you saw, but there is no 197 out of DC. Here. Can look at the manifest yourself.

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: But, but that's not true. We saw it. We unloaded the damn thing.

Speaker: 003CB4A8:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_Walter:VTYP
Text: Boys, there is no 197 from DC. And if you know what's good for you, you'll stop asking questions about it. Now gimme that tape.

Speaker: 003CB4AA:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_James:VTYP
Text: My name is James.

Speaker: 003CB4AA:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_James:VTYP
Text: And I like trains.

Speaker: 003CB4AA:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_James:VTYP
Text: So here I sit.

Speaker: 003CB4AA:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_James:VTYP
Text: Waiting in vain.

Speaker: 003CB4AA:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_James:VTYP
Text: The trains don't go.

Speaker: 003CB4AA:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_James:VTYP
Text: Since the world did blow!

Speaker: 003CB4AA:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_James:VTYP
Text: Now it's just James.

Speaker: 003CB4AA:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_James:VTYP
Text: And a pile of dead trains.

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: James? James! There you are! You can't keep coming back here! It's not-- shit. Put your mask back on. Lets go!

Speaker: 003CB4AA:NPCM_MTR_MountBlair_James:VTYP
Text: Sorry, papa.

Speaker: 003CB4B4:NPCF_MTR_LodeBaring02_Luann:VTYP
Text: George. George! You hear that? Listen.

Speaker: 003CB4B5:NPCM_MTR_LodeBaring02_George:VTYP
Text: I don't hear anything.

Speaker: 002D113D:EN07_NukeVoice_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Attention citizens. Nuclear strike imminent. Please exit the area at your earliest convenience. Thank you for your cooperation.

Speaker: 003CB4B4:NPCF_MTR_LodeBaring02_Luann:VTYP
Text: What'd it say?

Speaker: 003CB4B5:NPCM_MTR_LodeBaring02_George:VTYP
Text: Something about "convenience." Probably just an ad for Red Rocket, we get 'em all the---

Speaker: 003CB4B5:NPCM_MTR_LodeBaring02_George:VTYP
Text: What the hell was that? Was that a...

Speaker: 003CB4B4:NPCF_MTR_LodeBaring02_Luann:VTYP
Text: Nuclear strike. It said nuclear strike.

Speaker: 003CB4B5:NPCM_MTR_LodeBaring02_George:VTYP
Text: No. No. No. No. Jesus Christ. We need to get out of here.

Speaker: 003CB4B4:NPCF_MTR_LodeBaring02_Luann:VTYP
Text: Out of here? Are you crazy? We need shelter. This is shelter.

Speaker: 003CB4B5:NPCM_MTR_LodeBaring02_George:VTYP
Text: This isn't a vault, Luann! We don't know if this place will hold!

Speaker: 003CB4B4:NPCF_MTR_LodeBaring02_Luann:VTYP
Text: You don't have the slightest idea what's happening up there!

Speaker: 003CB4B5:NPCM_MTR_LodeBaring02_George:VTYP
Text: Get off me, Luann! I'm leaving.

Speaker: 003CB4B4:NPCF_MTR_LodeBaring02_Luann:VTYP
Text: Jesus, George. Don't ... fuck. George! Come back!

Speaker: 002D113D:EN07_NukeVoice_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Attention citizens. Nuclear strike imminent. Please exit the area at your earliest convenience. Thank you for your cooperation.

Speaker: 003CB4B4:NPCF_MTR_LodeBaring02_Luann:VTYP
Text: Oh god. Oh my god.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: You don't mind if I record?

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: You're captain, Melody. Don't need my permission.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Hmph. So, how's it look out there, Hank?

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Well, I found some more survivors. Started shooting at me the second they saw me, like the rest.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Sounds about par for the course. Seems there's not a sane mind south of Mount Blair. Anything else?

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Ash is piling up faster than we expected.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: But going by the maps the earlier teams did, it at least doesn't seem to be spreading anymore.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: So we've only lost Welch, Beckley, Lewisburg and everything around 'em. Little blessings, I suppose.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Oh. And actual good news. Garrahan Mining.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Been a long time since I've heard "good news" and "Garrahan Mining" said back to back.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: No kidding. But that Excavator armor they made. Ruined the company? Rumor is it's tough as nails, and they've still got the plans on site.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Could you imagine what a patrol would be like if we could figure out how to make those things?

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Locals would hopefully be a lot less inclined to shoot first.

Speaker: 0039433D:NPCM_MTR06_HankMadigan:VTYP
Text: Bingo. You give me a day or two, I can head back down there, see what I can do.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: No. Garrahan can wait. You need rest. Head up to Morgantown. That Excavator armor'll still be there. Now go.

Speaker: 003CD8D3:NPCM_MTR07_BuckNixon:VTYP
Text: Whew, I'm damn glad that headquarters upgraded the Rockhound's power system.

Speaker: 003CD8D3:NPCM_MTR07_BuckNixon:VTYP
Text: Now that we have reactors installed, we can finally stop depending on the local power grid and diesel engines to keep this baby humming.

Speaker: 003CD8D3:NPCM_MTR07_BuckNixon:VTYP
Text: I can't even count the number of times the machine stalled because of blackouts or the engines quit.

Speaker: 003CD8D3:NPCM_MTR07_BuckNixon:VTYP
Text: Of course, working right next to four nuclear reactors isn't as cozy as it sounds.

Speaker: 003CD8D3:NPCM_MTR07_BuckNixon:VTYP
Text: The engineers say those things are perfectly safe, but they aren't the ones that'll be vaporized after a meltdown.

Speaker: 003CD8D3:NPCM_MTR07_BuckNixon:VTYP
Text: Still, those fat bonuses I've been getting on my paycheck are hard to ignore, so looks like I'll be staying for a while.

Speaker: 003CD8D3:NPCM_MTR07_BuckNixon:VTYP
Text: Anyway, it's almost time to change out the Ignition Cores. I'll record more later if I have the time.

Speaker: 003CD8D5:NPCM_MTR02_HaroldFrost:VTYP
Text: I can't believe we lost.

Speaker: 003CD8D5:NPCM_MTR02_HaroldFrost:VTYP
Text: We had one chance to prove that our Excavator Power Armor could beat the Hornwright Auto-Miner, and we blew it.

Speaker: 003CD8D5:NPCM_MTR02_HaroldFrost:VTYP
Text: Why Vivian came up with her ridiculous challenge is beyond me.

Speaker: 003CD8D5:NPCM_MTR02_HaroldFrost:VTYP
Text: She never even consulted with us first, just rolled it out there like a prize fight.

Speaker: 003CD8D5:NPCM_MTR02_HaroldFrost:VTYP
Text: Then the newspapers got a hold of it, and everything blew out of proportion. Now we're the laughingstock of the mining industry.

Speaker: 003CD8D5:NPCM_MTR02_HaroldFrost:VTYP
Text: Who in their right mind would buy any products from us after that? No one.

Speaker: 003CD8D5:NPCM_MTR02_HaroldFrost:VTYP
Text: So here I am, staring at the phone, waiting for the inevitable call to shut the R&D department down.

Speaker: 003CD8D5:NPCM_MTR02_HaroldFrost:VTYP
Text: Vivian betted all our chips on this project, and Garrahan Mining has wiped out.

Speaker: 003CD8D5:NPCM_MTR02_HaroldFrost:VTYP
Text: I wonder if Hornwright is hiring.

Speaker: 004E719E:NPCM_HarperRosiak:VTYP
Text: 9 AM - Degenerative Neurological Conditions, Room 121.

Speaker: 004E719E:NPCM_HarperRosiak:VTYP
Text: 10:30 Radiation Therapy Training, Lab 206.

Speaker: 004E719E:NPCM_HarperRosiak:VTYP
Text: Noon. Family Medicine rotation, Vault-Tec U Free Clinic.

Speaker: 004E719E:NPCM_HarperRosiak:VTYP
Text: Keeps going like that. Your daughter Judy's a busy woman, Senator. But not hard to find.

Speaker: 004E719E:NPCM_HarperRosiak:VTYP
Text: You've been sticking your nose where it doesn't belong, Samuel. And now you've gone too far.

Speaker: 004E719E:NPCM_HarperRosiak:VTYP
Text: We're coming for you. And your family. This was your warning.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: All right. It's recording. Thank you again for reaching out to me. I can't tell you how shocked I was to find out your letter was the real deal.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Of course, Ms. Carter. I hope the trek wasn't too arduous.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: It was ... an experience. Not a lot of my interviews start with a bag over my heard. Just glad it didn't end up being a prank, I suppose.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I apologize for that. Maintaining a low profile is a requirement for us now.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And why is that, Senator? Why did you leave your position so suddenly?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Leaving was the only way I thought I'd be able to protect my family, Ms. Carter.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: But I've since realized that I'd left a lot of other people I care about in grave danger. I was hoping you could help me correct that.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What are you talking about Senator?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: There are sinister forces at work in the halls of government.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I and my fellow members of the Free States will no longer be shackled to the putrefying corpse of this nation.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Nor should anyone who values their lives. There is only one recourse left for the people of the United States: strike out on your own.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Take whatever you can carry, get off the grid and get there fast. The end is coming, Ms. Carter.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And when it does, your government has no interest in keeping you safe.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Sinister forces? The end is coming? Senator, you're making some big claims here. Do you have evidence to back it up?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: This is not some doomsday fever dream, if that's what you're asking, Ms. Carter. I received my information from reliable sources, yes.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And I'm just supposed to take your word for it?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You're going to have to, Ms. Carter. I'm trying to save lives, not put more at risk by exposing my sources.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Senator, I'm not trying to be rude here, but it sounds like you're trying to start a panic, and without evidence, I'm not willing to be a part of that.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I also have it under the strictest confidence that you've been seen making multiple visits to a certain Charleston neurologist as of...

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: My health is not the issue here, Ms. Carter! These are peoples' lives!

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The Executive branch, captains of industry, the Department of Agriculture! I peeked into their world and they threatened my life! My daughter's life!

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: We're just pawns to them! And the only way we survive ... is to step off the board. All I'm asking ... is that you share that message.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: ... I, I meant no offense. You just have to know how this looks from my end.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I, I understand. It's just a ... sensitive topic.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Would you mind if I asked you one last question?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If it means you'll get the word out, go ahead.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You never resigned as Senator. Is that something you're planning to do?

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I am. Consider this interview my formal resignation. Spread the word, Ms. Carter. All I ask is that my warning goes with it ... and nothing else.

Speaker: 001999BF:EN01_SamBlackwell_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Now, if you wouldn't mind. My daughter and I have a lot to do. We're on our own out here, after all.

Speaker: 0052E51E:NPCM_RE_SceneBB04_Larry:VTYP
Text: Hey, Seth and I took off to find some dinner. Why don't you clean up around camp and then go check out that plane crash we saw a while back.

Speaker: 0052E51E:NPCM_RE_SceneBB04_Larry:VTYP
Text: We should be here when you get back and you can tell us what you found.

Speaker: 0052E51E:NPCM_RE_SceneBB04_Larry:VTYP
Text: By the way, learn how to read so I don't have to record one of these stupid things every time I want to leave you a message. Don't die out there.

Speaker: 00511B61:NPCM_LC058_Jonathan:VTYP
Text: There's some weird shit going on here, man.

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: What are you talking about?

Speaker: 00511B61:NPCM_LC058_Jonathan:VTYP
Text: I know we just started our internship here, but I can already tell there's something off about this place.

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: Like what?

Speaker: 00511B61:NPCM_LC058_Jonathan:VTYP
Text: I heard a couple of the full-timers talking about some off-the-wall stuff, and... wait, are you recording this? What the fuck, man? What's going on?

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: You were told to keep your head down and do your research, Jonathan.

Speaker: 00511B61:NPCM_LC058_Jonathan:VTYP
Text: Wait, who are they?

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: We need you to come with us, Jonathan.

Speaker: 00511B64:NPCM_LC011_Chris:VTYP
Text: Hey Matt, I made it back to the safe house... but you probably guessed that.

Speaker: 00511B64:NPCM_LC011_Chris:VTYP
Text: Stupid, you're so stupid! He knows you made it to the safe house, you idiot! YOU IDIOT!

Speaker: 00511B64:NPCM_LC011_Chris:VTYP
Text: Umm... unfortunately, I had to stash the duffle on the way because I was being chased. I'm sorry, I'm really sorry, Matt.

Speaker: 00511B64:NPCM_LC011_Chris:VTYP
Text: Idiot! You stupid IDIOT!

Speaker: 00511B64:NPCM_LC011_Chris:VTYP
Text: So, yeah... I tossed it under the porch in the Southwest corner of the white hotel, the one up on the cliff.

Speaker: 00511B64:NPCM_LC011_Chris:VTYP
Text: Anyway... I'm gonna take off, Matt. It's too dangerous around here. I'm gonna head back into the mountains, I think. Farewell.

Speaker: 00511B64:NPCM_LC011_Chris:VTYP
Text: What the fu... farewell? Nobody says that. You're so stupid, you idiot. Stupid IDIOT!

Speaker: 00511B65:NPCM_POI286_Greg:VTYP
Text: Ok gang, the boss wanted me to leave you some instructions.. since you apparently can't run this mine without me holding your hands.

Speaker: 00511B65:NPCM_POI286_Greg:VTYP
Text: We're gonna light this place up today. The holes are drilled, so just get the dynamite packed in and wired up.

Speaker: 00511B65:NPCM_POI286_Greg:VTYP
Text: Make sure everyone's a safe distance this time. Tommy, you DO NOT TOUCH the plungers, got it? You're the reason we're down two guys this month.

Speaker: 00511B65:NPCM_POI286_Greg:VTYP
Text: Carl, you're in charge... Don't fuck this up.

Speaker: 0052E51D:_Cut_NPCM_RE_ObjectBB01_Darryl:VTYP
Text: Listen up Soldier! I need you to head to the Relay Tower nearby to make sure everything's up and running.

Speaker: 0052E51D:_Cut_NPCM_RE_ObjectBB01_Darryl:VTYP
Text: While you're up there, you might as well secure some supplies from the stash. Here's the key.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *patriotic music*

Speaker: 002B945E:LC024_RadioAnnouncer_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Are you tired of taxes going to incompetent government bureaucrats?

Speaker: 002B945E:LC024_RadioAnnouncer_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Come out on November 2nd and cast your vote in favor Ballot Measure 6! The Appalachian Prosperity Act!

Speaker: 002B945E:LC024_RadioAnnouncer_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Automate Appalachian government and give the boot to bureaucracy!

Speaker: 002B945E:LC024_RadioAnnouncer_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: This ad paid for by the Citizens for Automation Fund.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Speaker Poole! Wait! Please just a moment of your time!

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Just what I need... I'm sorry, don't have time right now Ms. Carter.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Are we still looking for Governor Evans? Is it true that Holbrook is the acting Governor?

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: No. The line of succession clearly states that the Speaker out ranks the Majority Whip.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Look, I don't have time for-

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Is it true that a mob of zombies attacked the southwestern check point?

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What? What foolish-

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: No. It was people affected by the radiation. There's a passel of them over in the medical center.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Poor souls...

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Has there been any word from Washington yet, ma'am? Are we still at war?

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What about the mutations? And the reports of the people seeing the Mothman?

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Okay, that's enough. The Herald used to be an upstanding paper and y'all'r fixin' to turn it into a rag.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: This is a Closed Session. Marshall, see that our friend finds her way out.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Mothman... really.

Speaker: 002B9458:LC024_MarshallBarber_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You heard her. Closed Session. No reporters.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Dammit.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Fine. But there HAVE been reports of people seeing the Mothman.

Speaker: 002B9458:LC024_MarshallBarber_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Uh huh. Get out of here before I pull your press badge.

Speaker: 001906E7:EN01_QuinnCarter_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Okay... Okay! I'm going, you don't have to shove...

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Alright, settle down recruits.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: I know it looks hard, but the course ain't no hill for a climber.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Just follow the arrows and keep your head on a swivel.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Once you get down a piece, you'll see the capitol.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Give that button a whack and follow the course back on over here.

Speaker: 0043C542:NPCM_LC023_FirebreatherTrainee:VTYP
Text: *Muttering*

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: What was that?

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: You got something to say, you spit it out.

Speaker: 0043C542:NPCM_LC023_FirebreatherTrainee:VTYP
Text: I just don't see why we gotta go running through all that muck.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Now you listen to me before I smack both eyes into one.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: My husband is somewhere down in "that muck."

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: So's yer father. And her gran. And their sisters.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: We spent weeks crawling through "that muck" pulling people out.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Thousands of people died in the Christmas Flood.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: More still were never found. Drowned or buried alive.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: We pulled people out of there for a full year.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: So you show some respect.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: You got anything else to say?

Speaker: 0043C542:NPCM_LC023_FirebreatherTrainee:VTYP
Text: No ma'am.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: What was that?!

Speaker: 0043C542:NPCM_LC023_FirebreatherTrainee:VTYP
Text: No ma'am!

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Good!

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Alright Fire Breathers, get out there and run that course like your friends lives depend on it.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Oh, sit down Tanner. I swear, you could talk the bark off a tree.

Speaker: 002B9457:LC024_TannerHolbrook_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Stuff it, Abigale.

Speaker: 002B9457:LC024_TannerHolbrook_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What is this nonsense about throwing a Christmas party? We are already rationing supplies and if we have another winter like '78...

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Our people need this. They've been struggling on for years through the war, radiation, mutants, and raiders...

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: They need something normal. Something to give them hope that things will be better.

Speaker: 002B9457:LC024_TannerHolbrook_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: We don't have the supplies! We need to keep them for the war effort!

Speaker: 002B9457:LC024_TannerHolbrook_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And waiting to hold the town hall till I was out meeting those Brotherhood rebels is beyond deceitful.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You think I'm some dumb hick, just on account o' the fact that you abandoned your people and your accent.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I know that you're trying to sway the vote next spring by letting your friends horde food.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I've checked the ledgers. Don't do in the dark what you don't want brought out in the light, Tanner.

Speaker: 002B9457:LC024_TannerHolbrook_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I- You! Infuriating!

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If you're fixin' to have a fit, best sit down before you bite your tongue clean off. Wouldn't want to ruin my carpet.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: It's all gonna be donated food, and we'll only keep the lights on for a couple hours.

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And if your sweet, I might even let you wear the Santa suit.

Speaker: 002B9457:LC024_TannerHolbrook_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I. WILL. NEVER!!!

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You forgot your Christmas present! It's bourbon! To remind you of where you come from!!

Speaker: 002B9456:LC024_AbigalePoole_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Good. Melody deserves this more anyway.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Test log 9-23-77-A10.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Animal subject shows no marked increase or decrease in muscle mass.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: However, those in the flora lab have said that this test run showed an increase in growth by as much as 25%.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: We felt certain that, due to the component make up fo the solvent, it would have a marked effect on fauna as well...

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: ...but even the inclusion of a matching protein sequence into the solution the resultant distillate fails to show an increase in size or growth rate.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Whoa! Okay down... Hey, down! Jessie can you grab it? Aaah!

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Ugh. What was that about? Thanks.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Ancillary observation: The test subject seems to be strongly drawn to the solution. This bears further testing. Is it the similar protein sequence?

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Test Log 3-12-78-A14

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Eyes appear glassy. Subject seems to be experiencing decreased blood pressure and heart rate.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: While this new solution appears to trigger a vasovagal response in subjects with a complimentary DNA structure, no other reversal.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: It's no good. I don't know how much of the mutations we've seen are from radiation and what is from the compound we'd been working on.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I don't understand how Samson got clearance for aerosolize testing before we even completed lab trials.

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Did we cause this... skin disease... or is it just a mutation. And what of those whose minds have degraded?

Speaker: 002B9468:LC167_NatalieIngesson_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Oh great. The breakers just went out. This winter is taking a toll on the lab. Guess I better get to fixing it before the plants freeze.

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I dunno what all they put in the furnace, but it's gaumed it up but good.

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Wouldn't have been so bad if ya'll had just shut damned thing down for a few weeks and cleaned out the blast.

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: But at this point? Whatever it is, at this point it's fused with every damned part from the Furnace to the Smelter and the Mills.

Speaker: 002B9474:LC052_GraftonSteelSupervisorFortney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Look Mason, I don't need to hear it. Can you keep it running or not?

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Ain't gonna be easy. Whatever's going on chemically, it's pretty toxic and corrosive at that.

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You're gonna have to keep making near constant repairs. I can mark the areas, but that's not gonna stop the ash...

Speaker: 002B9474:LC052_GraftonSteelSupervisorFortney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Foreman doesn't give a damn about the ash. The workers brought it on themselves, now they get to live with it.

Speaker: 002B9474:LC052_GraftonSteelSupervisorFortney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Besides, the bots don't give a damn. All the more reason to continue the workforce change over.

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: So that's it then? Just... keep replacing bots and machinery. Let the plant destroy the valley and break up the strikers?

Speaker: 002B9474:LC052_GraftonSteelSupervisorFortney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If you've got a problem with that, we can cancel payment.

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: It's just...

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Aw, shit. Just get me in the van and get me out of here before anyone sees me.

Speaker: 002B9474:LC052_GraftonSteelSupervisorFortney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Pleasure doing business with you. We'll recommend you to our friends.

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Don't. Don't ever contact me again after this.

Speaker: 002B9471:LC052_GraftonSteelDonnaMason_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And erase my name off that holotape. I went over the needed repairs, that's enough.

Speaker: 002B9474:LC052_GraftonSteelSupervisorFortney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Fine.

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: Well, it seems the little birdy brought one back alive.

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: Get up.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *zapping sound*

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: Aahhgh!! Fuck! When I get ou-

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: Jim Greyson was a good man and I'd as soon see you hang for what you did to him and his.

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: But before that, you're going to tell me what Thorpe is planning.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: I was just in town to get him a Christmas present.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: You know how it is... you always plan get it done, but end up shopping on the evening-

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: AAAAaaaaaghghahhh!!

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: When he finds out where I am he's gonna-

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: Thorpe's not gonna do anything because right now he thinks you're dead.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: What?

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: Heard a little birdy saying they'd captured you. She and Poole wanted to plan a trade in exchange for a cease fire. Obviously it'd never work.

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: So I sent word ahead to your boyfriend saying you were dead and that they're trying to lie to him. He won't believe a word they say.

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: I figure that'll give you and I plenty of time to talk.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: You inbred, backwoods fucking idiots.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: You have no idea what he's going to-

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *Distant explosion*

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: What was that?

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: I- I don't know.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *Distant rush of water*

Speaker: 002B9454:NPCM_LC024_TannerHolbrook:VTYP
Text: What in god's name has he done?

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *Chaotic sounds of flooding*

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: No no no no! Godammit David!!!

Speaker: 00354E51:SF06_EMPLOYEE_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I don't know if anyone will hear this, but it's worth a shot. I need help.

Speaker: 00354E51:SF06_EMPLOYEE_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: CINDY, the manager AI of the Galleria and someone I once called a friend, has built a dismal set of dopplegangers to replace the former staff.

Speaker: 00354E51:SF06_EMPLOYEE_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I can't believe what she has done. It sickens me to by very core, and cheapens the memories of the fallen.

Speaker: 00354E51:SF06_EMPLOYEE_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I've destroyed them more times than I can count, but inevitably she finds a way to rebuild them.

Speaker: 00354E51:SF06_EMPLOYEE_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I can't do it anymore, but hopefully someone can continue my work.

Speaker: 00354E51:SF06_EMPLOYEE_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If you are a kind soul - please heed my call. Do the right thing and take these abominations out.

Speaker: 00354E51:SF06_EMPLOYEE_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I left some grenades upstairs, use them to destroy the mannequins and give the dead their dignity back.

Speaker: 00354E51:SF06_EMPLOYEE_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: CINDY will of course try and stop you, but don't hurt her. As sad as it is, she's the only thing left from the life I once knew.

Speaker: 00354E51:SF06_EMPLOYEE_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: It was a good life. A life worth living, unlike this one..
(Pounding on door - as if heard from inside a house)

Speaker: 002B784E:NPCF_LC067_Darlene:VTYP
Text: Who is it?

Speaker: 002B784D:NPCM_LC067_SgtTaybert:VTYP
Text: U.S. Army, ma'am. Open up, please.

Speaker: 002B784E:NPCF_LC067_Darlene:VTYP
Text: What do you want?

Speaker: 002B784D:NPCM_LC067_SgtTaybert:VTYP
Text: Just open the door, Ms. Sherman.
(Sound of deadbolt sliding open and door opening)

Speaker: 002B784E:NPCF_LC067_Darlene:VTYP
Text: Y-Yes?

Speaker: 002B784D:NPCM_LC067_SgtTaybert:VTYP
Text: On behalf of the U.S. Army and West-Tek, you're hereby ordered to hand over custody of your child, "Dalton Sherman," over to us immediately.

Speaker: 002B784E:NPCF_LC067_Darlene:VTYP
Text: What? Over my dead body! He's sick, he's not going anywhere!

Speaker: 002B784D:NPCM_LC067_SgtTaybert:VTYP
Text: You have no choice. Where is he ma'am?

Speaker: 002B784E:NPCF_LC067_Darlene:VTYP
Text: The hell I don't have a choice! You're not moving that child one inch or so help me I'll...

Speaker: 002B784D:NPCM_LC067_SgtTaybert:VTYP
Text: Ma'am! If you don't move aside right now, we'll move you ourselves. Do you understand?
(Sound of a knife being lifted from a table)

Speaker: 002B784D:NPCM_LC067_SgtTaybert:VTYP
Text: Put down the knife, Ms. Sherman. I won't ask again.

Speaker: 002B784E:NPCF_LC067_Darlene:VTYP
Text: No! Get out of my house! Dalton is only sick! He'll get better! You people can't take him like you took the others! You can't! I won't let you!
(Sound of a single gunshot and then a body dropping to the ground)

Speaker: 002B784D:NPCM_LC067_SgtTaybert:VTYP
Text: Goddamn it.

Speaker: 002B784D:NPCM_LC067_SgtTaybert:VTYP
Text: Corporal Gibbons, put her in a body bag. Private Zeleski, go find the kid.

Speaker: 002B7850:NPCF_LC106_DoctorJensen:VTYP
Text: I had another patient visit my office complaining of intermittent headaches this week.

Speaker: 002B7850:NPCF_LC106_DoctorJensen:VTYP
Text: I'm certain the root cause is the same as other similar cases, dielectric heating caused by the site's EM field.

Speaker: 002B7850:NPCF_LC106_DoctorJensen:VTYP
Text: As usual, I've prescribed some painkillers and a hood to assist with insulation.

Speaker: 002B7850:NPCF_LC106_DoctorJensen:VTYP
Text: I've asked the site director if we could reduce the array's output to a tolerable level until we have shielding installed throughout the facility.

Speaker: 002B7850:NPCF_LC106_DoctorJensen:VTYP
Text: Unfortunately, our schedule at NIRA is tight, and it appears the director is unwilling to accommodate my request.

Speaker: 002B7850:NPCF_LC106_DoctorJensen:VTYP
Text: Apparently, he considers the project much more important than the health and welfare of our personnel.

Speaker: 002B7851:NPCM_LC110_Cyrus:VTYP
Text: Warm greetings, friend!

Speaker: 002B7852:NPCM_LC110_SimonGladwell:VTYP
Text: Yeah, yeah, warm greetings, and wholeness, and all that... You, uh, wanted to see me?

Speaker: 002B7851:NPCM_LC110_Cyrus:VTYP
Text: Yes, indeed I did, Disciple Simon.

Speaker: 002B7851:NPCM_LC110_Cyrus:VTYP
Text: I'm proud of everything you've accomplished here in such a short time, but I'm having concerns about our "new direction."

Speaker: 002B7852:NPCM_LC110_SimonGladwell:VTYP
Text: You mean the uh, "Transitory Disciple Program?" What's the problem? Are the guests complaining?

Speaker: 002B7851:NPCM_LC110_Cyrus:VTYP
Text: Quite the opposite. By the time they depart, they appear blissful and enlightened. It's wonderful!

Speaker: 002B7851:NPCM_LC110_Cyrus:VTYP
Text: No, it's a far more material issue, I'm afraid. The amount of money that you're spending to advertise the Palace has me concerned.

Speaker: 002B7852:NPCM_LC110_SimonGladwell:VTYP
Text: Don't let those sorts of matters worry you, Cyrus. After all, that's why you appointed me as the Palace's business manager.

Speaker: 002B7852:NPCM_LC110_SimonGladwell:VTYP
Text: You just go and get naked and run around lighting incense, painting watermelons, or whatever you need to do. Leave the rest to me.

Speaker: 002B7851:NPCM_LC110_Cyrus:VTYP
Text: Come now, Disciple Simon. You're beginning to sound similar to when you first arrived at our doorstep.

Speaker: 002B7851:NPCM_LC110_Cyrus:VTYP
Text: Oh my, perhaps your balance has shifted. Did you wish to be anointed in oils for a cleansing?

Speaker: 002B7852:NPCM_LC110_SimonGladwell:VTYP
Text: No, no. I'm fine, quite balanced. Everything is great. No more anointing please.

Speaker: 002B7851:NPCM_LC110_Cyrus:VTYP
Text: Very well. Perhaps I'm worrying needlessly.

Speaker: 002B7851:NPCM_LC110_Cyrus:VTYP
Text: After all, it is you who has gifted us with this new direction and brought so many people here to achieve wholeness.

Speaker: 002B7852:NPCM_LC110_SimonGladwell:VTYP
Text: Yeah, no sweat there Cyrus. Don't even worry about it.

Speaker: 002B7852:NPCM_LC110_SimonGladwell:VTYP
Text: Anyway, uh, since I'm here, I need you to look at these plans for a ventilatio..., uh, I mean " for Spiritual Conduits," I want to have installed.

Speaker: 002B7853:NPCM_LC116_MagnusWestbrooke:VTYP
Text: When DuBois dropped me off at Bolton Greens, I was horrified.

Speaker: 002B7853:NPCM_LC116_MagnusWestbrooke:VTYP
Text: Fourth in line for the Westbrooke fortune, and Momsy and Pa-pa had the nerve to leave me at a glorified daycare center while they travel the world?

Speaker: 002B7853:NPCM_LC116_MagnusWestbrooke:VTYP
Text: Ridiculous.

Speaker: 002B7853:NPCM_LC116_MagnusWestbrooke:VTYP
Text: To make matters worse, I'm forced to hobnob with the other children, some of whom are mere... millionaires. Ugh, the thought makes my skin crawl.

Speaker: 002B7853:NPCM_LC116_MagnusWestbrooke:VTYP
Text: The only saving grace of this prison is that they employ a sommelier in the dining room.

Speaker: 002B7853:NPCM_LC116_MagnusWestbrooke:VTYP
Text: Well, it's time to go fox hunting again. Oh drat, I appear to have scuffed my ostrich jodhpur boots.

Speaker: 002B7853:NPCM_LC116_MagnusWestbrooke:VTYP
Text: I suppose I'll have to use the... ugh, calfskin ones instead.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: Edie, darling Edie... how delicious you were. the sweet taste of your flesh as... as it passed down my throat.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: The syrupy... warmth of your blood... as it filled my stomach.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: Wait... what... what have I done? No! Edie, she's dead! I killed her! I ATE her. Oh no, no no...

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: But... but, I had to. I must eat... so hungry, starving. Need more... more flesh, more blood. Need more... find... more...

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: Thorpe, we got a bit of a situation here I want to report. Gonna send this here holotape with a runner to ya, soon as I can.

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: Me and the other Trappers set up this camp here near Devil's Backbone just like we all agreed on, and it's been workin' out for us.

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: Plenty of game to catch, plenty of unlucky saps wanderin' in from the East still.

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: But uh... You know how we said stay out of Huntersville, and don't drink the water near there?

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: We thought it was just some sort of quarantine zone full of sick people, so we made sure not to poke at it.

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: We started hearin' some noises comin' from the town a bit back, so I done reckoned we'd better send someone to check it out.

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: Well he come back talking 'bout some big 'ol green 'uns stalkin' around. tryin' to rip up the fence 'round town, and bustin' up stuff real good.

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: First I heard. So I get him to show me, and I don't believe my eyes. These... big green fellers were in there, looked like, ransacking the town.

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: Next thing you know, them Brotherhood of Steel folks are marchin' on it and clashin' with the other guys, and they ain't doing to well against 'em.

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: Soon as it looked like the armored goons were losin' the fight, we hauled ass back here, and that's where we're at.

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: Fightin's still goin' on, and we'll keep an eye on the situation, but if things go belly up...

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: <Gunfire and shouting>

Speaker: 0037D25C:NPCM_WalterGriswold:VTYP
Text: Aw shit! It's those green bastards and they've got guns!

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: Edie and I have been feeling a little extra hungry as of late, and the others are starting to ask questions.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: Morris, how can you be hungry when you're still so fat? Well, you know what I say to that?

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: I'm hungry because I'm the boss here! It takes a lot of effort to wrangle these useless idiots so we don't all starve, and that works up an appetite!

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: Honestly, it's been several days since we've come across any more food. The usual unsuspecting travelers have been harder to come by.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: I can only assume the damn Cutthroats have been scaring them all away, or not sharing their finds with us.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: The others won't like it, but we're going to have to go to plan B. Edie's on board with me.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: I've been thinking about Gregory. He's got a lot of meat on him, and he's been rather useless lately. No one will miss him.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: Well, maybe his wife. And his little girl, perhaps.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: But Vanessa will know what's good for her, and she's too much of a good fighter to eat just yet. And the kid... well, I'm not a monster.

Speaker: 0037D25B:NPCM_MorrisStevens:VTYP
Text: Besides, kids are too scrawny.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Hey, turn it off. Do you want my wife to find out about this?

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: Aw c'mon! I wanna make a recording of us! You said you were gonna ditch that old hag when we got back, anyway.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Hmph. Fine. But it goes with you when we leave, and you need to promise to destroy it if word ever gets out about us.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: I have too much to lose in a divorce and leaving evidence like that laying around will only make it worse.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: Oh don't be an ol' stick in the mud. No one's gonna find out. Pinky swear!

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: Hey, you got any more of those chems with you?

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Yeah, what do you want, Daytripper? Help yourself, just don't take too much. Don't, uh... get addicted.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: Yes sir. Input received, sir. Awaiting orders.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: <Rosalynn popping pills>

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Okay, I get it, you're not a robot. I know you don't like it when I order you around like that.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: You're my darling Rose. I just don't want anything bad to happen to you.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: Aww, baby! You goin' all soft on me now? Haha! You know I love ya! <kiss>

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: Hey, you wanna hit the slopes, or do you maybe have something else in mind?

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: All right, you little minx, now you really have to turn off the recorder.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: Meg here. I've gotta say something before it's too late. I think ol' Margie's off her rocker, man.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: You know, we're all tryin' our best here, but this whole idea of being a Raider without killing is way harder than it sounds.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: I mean, yeah, I get it, but, damn girl! This is life and death out there!

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: Some of these people are just tryin' to make it, like anyone else after the bombs. I don't want to kill 'em if they don't give up their stuff.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: But you know, we got to eat, and so do they. Wavin' a gun around used to scare 'em, but now they got nothin' to lose, so they wave one right back.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: I keep tellin' Margie we're losin' people out there because we're told not to fire first, and it ain't getting' any easier.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: She don't know it yet, but a lot of us've been firin' first anyway, so's to save our skins.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: Margie'd be pissed, but she ain't out there like the rest of us. So, to heck with her.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: Only reason we don't up and mutiny her ass is because she's got that piece of the key for the cache, and a few loyalists to protect her.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: And honestly, it still beats hangin' with any of the other gangs. That deal we've got with the Palace is pretty sweet. All told, we got it good.

Speaker: 002CB4BA:NPCF_MegGroberg:VTYP
Text: Ah well. Guess all we can do is keep on keepin' on, ya dig?
