Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Interrogation of one, Jane Doe, sole captive raider in custody after a deadly attack here, at approximately 10:30 PM tonight, December 24, 2082.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Girl, you and yours've got some nerve! On Christmas Eve, no less! Now, I'll ask again, what is your name?

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: Fuck you! That's 'F' as in Frank, 'u' as in...

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: <Loud smack> Unghf!

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: If that's how we've gotta do this, then that's how we do it. Now, cut the crap or he'll hit ya again.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: <Rosalynn laughing>

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Oh that's rich, you think this is a joke? You killed a whole mess of people out there, and now you're gonna answer for it.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: David's gonna come for me, and when he gets here, he's gonna be mad. He'll kill every last one of you if he has to, so here's how it's gonna be.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: You're gonna let me walk right out of this cell.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: You'll send me off with a big bag of Christmas goodies to take home to my David. And maybe we'll forget any of this ever happened.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: David, huh? So we've got David Thorpe's what... girlfriend here?

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: You know he's the guy who killed two very brave and selfless Responders who went up to your... resort up there to offer help, way back when.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Well, well, gentlemen. I think I know how to finally draw our number one most wanted outlaw outta hiding.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: You wouldn't... you won't! He'll kill you, He'll kill you all!

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Keep her locked up. We'll worry about findin' a way to send a message up there tomorrow.

Speaker: 0031964E:NPCF_LC137_Repo:VTYP
Text: Put the gun down, we're here to talk.

Speaker: 0031964F:NPCM_LC137_Frank:VTYP
Text: Fine.

Speaker: 0031964E:NPCF_LC137_Repo:VTYP
Text: You repping the Cutthroats?

Speaker: 0031964F:NPCM_LC137_Frank:VTYP
Text: Maybe. Who's asking?

Speaker: 0031964E:NPCF_LC137_Repo:VTYP
Text: Name's Repo. I'm repping the Diehards.

Speaker: 0031964F:NPCM_LC137_Frank:VTYP
Text: Frank. So what's this all about?

Speaker: 0031964E:NPCF_LC137_Repo:VTYP
Text: It's about survival. Our gangs are getting picked off one-by-one.

Speaker: 0031964F:NPCM_LC137_Frank:VTYP
Text: Yeah, by other gangs. That's how things work.

Speaker: 0031964E:NPCF_LC137_Repo:VTYP
Text: The hell with that! We're dying out here. All of Appalachia's trying to kill us, and it's got nothing to do with turf or loot.

Speaker: 0031964F:NPCM_LC137_Frank:VTYP
Text: You talking about the Gourmands? Those idiots ate each other to death.

Speaker: 0031964E:NPCF_LC137_Repo:VTYP
Text: Not just the Gourmands, but the Blackwater Bandits, the Trappers - hell, all of us.

Speaker: 0031964F:NPCM_LC137_Frank:VTYP
Text: Yeah, it's a rough world, I get it. So what's your point?

Speaker: 0031964E:NPCF_LC137_Repo:VTYP
Text: My point is we need to band together. Watch each other's back. If we don't, we might just end up disappearing.

Speaker: 0031964F:NPCM_LC137_Frank:VTYP
Text: What's in it for us?

Speaker: 0031964E:NPCF_LC137_Repo:VTYP
Text: Staying alive? Do you understand what I'm saying or you too stupid?

Speaker: 0031964F:NPCM_LC137_Frank:VTYP
Text: Don't ever say that again.

Speaker: 0031964E:NPCF_LC137_Repo:VTYP
Text: This is what I'm talking about. Pointing that gun at me again isn't going to solve anything.

Speaker: 0031964F:NPCM_LC137_Frank:VTYP
Text: Yeah it will. It'll get you to shut the hell up.
<Single gunshot rings out>

Speaker: 00318D35:NPCM_LC137_Dale:VTYP
Text: What the hell?! He killed Repo! Shoot him... shoot him!
<Gunfire, multiple shots from different guns>

Speaker: 00331C99:NPCM_MTR05_DanielHornwright:VTYP
Text: I'd like to thank the Monongah Township Council for letting me attend your meeting today.

Speaker: 00331C99:NPCM_MTR05_DanielHornwright:VTYP
Text: For those of you that don't know me, I'm Daniel Hornwright, CEO of Hornwright Industrial.

Speaker: 00331C99:NPCM_MTR05_DanielHornwright:VTYP
Text: I'm here with an offer...

Speaker: 00331C99:NPCM_MTR05_DanielHornwright:VTYP
Text: No, strike that. I'm here with a proposal so beneficial and so incredibly lucrative, that simply calling it an "offer" doesn't begin to do it justice.

Speaker: 00331C99:NPCM_MTR05_DanielHornwright:VTYP
Text: I want to purchase the mining rights to Monongah Mine from your town. Not only for a generous sum of cash up front, but for perpetual...

Speaker: 00331C99:NPCM_MTR05_DanielHornwright:VTYP
Text: ...that means forever... royalties for every single ton of coal that we extract.

Speaker: 00331C99:NPCM_MTR05_DanielHornwright:VTYP
Text: What do you have to provide in return? Nothing. How much money does the town have to outlay initially? Not a penny.

Speaker: 00331C99:NPCM_MTR05_DanielHornwright:VTYP
Text: All I need is for you to sign on this dotted line, and sit back while the money rolls in.

Speaker: 00331C99:NPCM_MTR05_DanielHornwright:VTYP
Text: No risk, all reward. And most important, no chance that anyone from this town ever gets hurt in that mine again. I humbly await your reply.

Speaker: 0031C156:NPCF_LC020_GeraldineFitzsimmons:VTYP
Text: It's been barely a week since the bombs fell, and supplies have become scarce.

Speaker: 0031C156:NPCF_LC020_GeraldineFitzsimmons:VTYP
Text: The former guests at the resort are exploring the feasibility of sending out scavenging groups to hunt down whatever they can find.

Speaker: 0031C156:NPCF_LC020_GeraldineFitzsimmons:VTYP
Text: What's starting to dawn on us is that there will be people outside the resort sending groups of their own.

Speaker: 0031C156:NPCF_LC020_GeraldineFitzsimmons:VTYP
Text: Who knows if they'll be friendly, or simply take what they want?

Speaker: 0031C156:NPCF_LC020_GeraldineFitzsimmons:VTYP
Text: Instead of waiting to find out, we've concluded that our goods should be locked up for safe keeping.

Speaker: 0031C156:NPCF_LC020_GeraldineFitzsimmons:VTYP
Text: It's a smart move and one that will keep our belongings protected until the government rescue teams arrive.

Speaker: 0031C156:NPCF_LC020_GeraldineFitzsimmons:VTYP
Text: It's good to know that there's still some rationality left amidst all this chaos.

Speaker: 0031C155:NPCM_LC020_HoldenMcMerrick:VTYP
Text: Ever since the bombs dropped, the former guests at the ski resort have lost their minds.

Speaker: 0031C155:NPCM_LC020_HoldenMcMerrick:VTYP
Text: If being a member of the Honorary Mock-Naval Yachting Society has taught me one thing, it's that preparation is the key to survival.

Speaker: 0031C155:NPCM_LC020_HoldenMcMerrick:VTYP
Text: The idiots here have locked up their belongings and split up the access key, stashing away valuable items we could be using for barter.

Speaker: 0031C155:NPCM_LC020_HoldenMcMerrick:VTYP
Text: Every decision being made is foolish!

Speaker: 0031C155:NPCM_LC020_HoldenMcMerrick:VTYP
Text: Instead of using this facility as a headquarters and sending out hunting parties to look for scraps, we need to find a new base of operations.

Speaker: 0031C155:NPCM_LC020_HoldenMcMerrick:VTYP
Text: We should band together in larger groups and take anything we find along the way.

Speaker: 0031C155:NPCM_LC020_HoldenMcMerrick:VTYP
Text: They're convinced the government is going to rescue us, but the truth of the matter is that we're on our own.

Speaker: 0031C155:NPCM_LC020_HoldenMcMerrick:VTYP
Text: The only people that can help us now are ourselves.

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: So I, uh, found this old holotape to record onto... Look, I know this is stupid. You can't hear me, not anymore. I dunno. Maybe this is more for me.

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: I just... miss you, Lucie, more than you could ever imagine. And, I can't help but feel responsible somehow.

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: They were firing up the snowmakers, and I knew you didn't like skiing, so I didn't even mention I was going. I thought you'd talk me out of it.

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: I wish I had told you, though. We're both hard-headed, but one of our stubborn asses would have caved and then we'd be together, one way or another.

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: Maybe it's for the best. These... people I'm with probably wouldn't understand us either. I've had to get even tougher than before.

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: I've had to steal, and kill, and worse still, I've had to hide who I am behind this facade. I'm alive...I guess? But who am I now?

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: Am I still the same Alfreda you knew? Would you even still like me? I'd hope you would understand.

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: Gotta be strong to survive, and if that means playing mean and leading a bunch of other monsters to prey on the weak, then that's what I gotta do.

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: <distant muffled shouting and commotion>

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: Sounds like the boys are getting back. I'd better go. Put that mean face back on.

Speaker: 0037D25E:NPCF_FreddieLang:VTYP
Text: I wish the bombs never took you from me, Lucie. I love you. Always will.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: They're talkin' crap about you again, David. This time I'm gonna record them so you can hear it yourself.

Speaker: 0037D25D:NPCF_RosalynnJeffries:VTYP
Text: <Quiet movement>

Speaker: 002F034A:NPCF_MTNL01_MargieMcClintock:VTYP
Text: I know, Harland, I know. But what are we going to do? David's... not a very reasonable man.

Speaker: 003A0808:HarlandMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You saw what he did, Margie! He killed those innocent people who came to help us. He killed them in cold blood! And for what? A few measly supplies?

Speaker: 003A0808:HarlandMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The man's defied you at every turn. He does what he wants. The people chose you to lead them, not that blowhard!

Speaker: 002F034A:NPCF_MTNL01_MargieMcClintock:VTYP
Text: Lower your voice, Harland. You don't need to yell at me.

Speaker: 003A0808:HarlandMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm sorry, dear. You're right. I just... I don't know what to do anymore. I don't want to live like this, like some sort of...

Speaker: 002F034A:NPCF_MTNL01_MargieMcClintock:VTYP
Text: Like some sort of savages? I know, don't worry. We'll deal with it. I'll hold a trial with the aim to exile him for his crimes.

Speaker: 003A0808:HarlandMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And if he chooses not to participate in this trial, what then? You're aware more and more people are starting to side with him, right?

Speaker: 002F034A:NPCF_MTNL01_MargieMcClintock:VTYP
Text: Not everyone is willing to follow a foolish madman. Trust me, Harland. Reason will win out in the end.

Speaker: 003A0808:HarlandMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'll tell you. I'm inclined to go over there and give him a piece of my mind.

Speaker: 002F034A:NPCF_MTNL01_MargieMcClintock:VTYP
Text: Now Harland, dear, don't do anything stupid...

Speaker: 003A0808:HarlandMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Oh you know me, I'm just upset is all. It might just be pissin' into the wind, but I'm still going to talk with him. I'll be civil. Promise.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: It's been a helluva week, I tell ya. We lost more good people fightin' off those damn scorched things again.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Now I got Chavez tellin' me we're pickin' up a new radio signal. Someone askin' for help.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: She wants me to take my team and follow it 'til we find 'em. Can't be too far. Already tracked it gainin' strength South a' here.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: Problem is, we'd have to go straight on through Raider country to find 'em and I don't have the time or men to spare right now.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: So, I hate to say it, but I gotta tell her it ain't gonna happen. Not now.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: My team's the last line of defense, and if I take 'em on some wild goose chase, we're leavin' ourselves open for another Christmas Flood situation.

Speaker: 00235D8D:NPCF_MelodyLarkin:VTYP
Text: And, you can bet your ass I ain't gonna let that happen again, even if it means someone out there might need us. Man alive, times 've changed.

Speaker: 0037E12D:NPCM_CrashedTruckPOI_JohnBunton:VTYP
Text: Damn it, is this thing... Okay. Okay, it's recording. Ol' JB here. And you would not believe what I'm seein' right now!

Speaker: 0037E12D:NPCM_CrashedTruckPOI_JohnBunton:VTYP
Text: I'm sittin' here drivin' this truck, and what do I see ahead, but a sky full of... well there's these streaks of light like nothin' I ever seen.

Speaker: 0037E12D:NPCM_CrashedTruckPOI_JohnBunton:VTYP
Text: Boy howdy, it's majestic. Like shootin' stars in the early mornin' light, only I ain't never seen 'em in the mornin' like this.

Speaker: 0037E12D:NPCM_CrashedTruckPOI_JohnBunton:VTYP
Text: It's like a rocket streakin' through the blue sky, or like a... oh... oh shit. It's a nuclear...

Speaker: 0037E12D:NPCM_CrashedTruckPOI_JohnBunton:VTYP
Text: <Faint nuclear explosion in the distance>

Speaker: 0037E12D:NPCM_CrashedTruckPOI_JohnBunton:VTYP
Text: Aw shit, it exploded. I was starin' right at it, and I... I can't see! I... I'm going to...

Speaker: 0037E12D:NPCM_CrashedTruckPOI_JohnBunton:VTYP
Text: <Sound of a truck running off the road, metal screeching, and glass breaking>

Speaker: 0037E12D:NPCM_CrashedTruckPOI_JohnBunton:VTYP
Text: <Nuclear blast shockwave hitting>

Speaker: 0037E12D:NPCM_CrashedTruckPOI_JohnBunton:VTYP
Text: <Sound of something large pounding on the metal walls of the truck's trailer and ripping the door off the back>

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Pleasant greetings, friend. Thank you for your purchase of our take-home meditation session.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: This recorded meditation will guide you on a spiritual journey towards transcendence.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: We will begin shortly. Take a moment to appreciate your surroundings. And remember, your generous donations make this spiritual journey possible.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Are you ready? Close your eyes. Take a deep breath. Inhale 2... 3... Hold 2... 3... Exhale 2... 3... 4.... Good. And repeat.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Imagine your path to enlightenment as three transcendent pillars, rising towards the sky.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Now, imagine orbs of sublime energy around you. Reach out and gather them. Bring them to your pillars. This is how we will attain transcendence.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: As you build your Pillars of Transcendence, you may find yourself surrounded by Discordant Forces that seek to hinder your spiritual enlightenment.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Banish them using whatever positive affirmations you wish, and do not let them tear down your pillars.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: You are strong. You can overcome this and any other negativity.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Sometimes, the Discordant Forces prove to be too difficult to keep out and your Pillars of Transcendence may falter.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Take solace, for the Holistic Light shines bright when you need it the most. Bathe in its glow until you feel it reinvigorate your pillars.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Now that you have everything visualized, I will begin a series of positive affirmations while you act to achieve Transcendence.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Punish any discordant forces that stand in your way. Do not let them harm you spiritually.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: If you feel your physical self reacting to their presence, that's okay, but please be aware of your surroundings and do not damage our property.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Maintain a sense of tranquility. Push aside any internal strife. It's important to transcend your physical boundaries while at peace with yourself.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Your existence on this world is merely temporary, the Palace of the Winding Path will help you ascend beyond that limitation.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Align your spiritual aura with the Pillars of Transcendence. Draw in energy from the outside, attune it to your spirit, and pass it through.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Free your mind from all distractions and worries. Focus on the Pillars of Transcendence. Focus on keeping out the discordant forces.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Follow my voice. Listen to my meditations. Let them calm you, let me guide you to a place of peace and tranquility.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Gather that sublime energy and let it flow into the pillars.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Let the warmth it provides guide your spirit toward a new plane of existence beyond the physical.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Empty your mind of all your troubles. Leave them behind you as you ascend to your new spiritual existence.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Discordant forces may leave lasting physical harm if you let them damage your spiritual self.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Discordant forces may also be drawn in by spiritual incense, seeking its blissful embrace.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Believe in yourself. Believe in the powers of others like you.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: You can attain enlightenment together and reap the rewards of a higher state of consciousness.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Peer at yourself through the lens of your mind's eye. See yourself as others see you. Examine yourself from a short distance at all angles.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: You may find you gain a new perspective on life.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: You're feeling so relaxed right now.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Feel the sublime energy surround you. Embrace it, feed it into your pillars, and allow it to lead you along your path to transcendental bliss.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: The outside world has no meaning while you focus on your inner self.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Imagine you are floating along in a cloud of pure emotional bliss. If the cloud is mauve colored, chant a calming phrase until it is not.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Discordant Forces form in response to our fears, doubts, and insecurities. Gather your courage and confront them head-on.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Feel the warm relaxing energy flow into your body. You can feel it flow into your arms. Into your legs. Into your fingers and toes.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: This sensation brings with it a wave of tranquility and deep relaxation.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: The light in your mind, body, and soul grows as you build the pillars of Transcendence. Open your heart to it and feel its peaceful embrace.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: You feel as if you are one with nature, with the universe, with everything.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Only through complete transcendence, will you attain true enlightenment and exceed your physical bounds.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: After you transcend, it is completely normal to feel a need to abandon your material wealth. Seek one of our gurus if you wish for help with that.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Breathe in deeply through your nose... hold it... and let it out through your mouth.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Your transcendental journey may be long, but patience is key to spiritual well-being.

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: Be sure to book your next stay with us now and save ten percent off a future spiritual aura cleansing

Speaker: 00180016:AnnouncerM_MTNM03_GuidedMeditation:VTYP
Text: This concludes our Guided Meditation session.

Speaker: 002F0349:MTNL01_MargieMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: This is Margie McClintock of the Diehards. Heh, what a joke. We deluded ourselves into thinking our victims would fear a name like that.

Speaker: 002F0349:MTNL01_MargieMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: But now, everyone out there is as desperate as we are. When every confrontation could mean life or death, people take their chances. They fight back.

Speaker: 002F0349:MTNL01_MargieMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: So we have to kill, we have to murder innocent people... Well, not me. I don't care what this world has come to, it's not taking me down with it.

Speaker: 002F0349:MTNL01_MargieMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The whole idea of the Raiders is sick. It's inhuman. I'm destroying that stupid key fragment.

Speaker: 002F0349:MTNL01_MargieMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: <Sound of Margie smashing a holotape>

Speaker: 002F0349:MTNL01_MargieMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Those bastards don't deserve their treasures unless they return to their senses and quit this whole murderous power game they're playing.

Speaker: 002F0349:MTNL01_MargieMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If that ever happens, Vincent knows what to do. Maybe he'll be more successful than I was

Speaker: 002F0349:MTNL01_MargieMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: As for me, I'm leaving. I'll... find some chems, and I'll go out that way, peaceful, without pain... I'm done.

Speaker: 002F0349:MTNL01_MargieMcClintock_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'll see you soon, Harland, my love. It's been too long.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: This is my first interview with another survivor, Kesha McDermott.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: She found me trying to break into a Nuka-Cola machine and showed me a different way.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: So Kesha... can you tell us a bit about how we can make sure our water is safe for drinking? Try to keep it to the basics for training purposes.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: It's not complicated, really. Find water and strain out any big particles and chunks.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Then boil it in a pot over an open fire for a minute or two, then let it cool. Should be fine. Like making tea, right?

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: You joined the Responders a while ago and helped develop a program to train volunteers. So, were you a survivalist prior to all of this?

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: You could say that. I taught high school kids!

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: I used to talk about this very thing to them - practical application of the sciences.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: It's fascinating, but... you never realize how important some things will be down the road, do you?

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: I guess not. So, if we were students of yours, what would you tell us about the world now? How can we survive?

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: That's a good question, Dassa. I would tell you all first of all, to remain calm and focus on surviving.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: The first thing you need to do is get yourself some clean drinking water. It's likely all you'll find is dirty water, but that's ok! We can fix it.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Dirty water carries a small chance of disease and is a bit radioactive. You'll probably survive if you drink it, but you shouldn't take that risk.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: It's better than toxic water or nuclear waste though, which are both very harmful and should be boiled thoroughly first. Got that, Dassa?

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Yes'm - contaminated waters should be boiled. Ok. That sounds easy enough. So boiled water is safe?

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: It's mostly safe, but still a bit radioactive. What you really want is purified water.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Ohh, purified water. How do I get that?

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: You can build machines that will do it for you, and that's the most reliable way. Building them requires some space and time, and plenty of materials.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: But on my way up here from Watoga, I found purified water occasionally in supply caches and medical kits. So keep your eyes peeled.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: If I boil water and that's mostly safe - aside from a teensy bit of radiation - what about tea? Most folks around here are tea drinkers, as you know.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: I recall many a night sipping tea on the stoop, watching lightning bugs and reading a book in peace and quiet. Tell me that's still ok, Kesha?

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Oh, bless your heart. It's probably as good as boiled water, anyway! Maybe even better if you add anything medicinal to it.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Some survivors add all sorts of flowers and herbs to boiled water, and they swear by it. Personally, I stick with purified water. To each their own!

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Switching tracks a bit, I know you're awfully busy with your latest research in Flatwoods. Can you explain that a bit?

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Of course! I'm testing local, natural water over time in Appalachia. Gathering data, monitoring the radiation and contamination levels, all of that.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: I analyze the data in my lab to look for long term trends, and use those trends to determine how we can use the water right now.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: We use the water for more than just drinking, you know. It feeds our plants which feed our animals... so we need to know how things are changing.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: You've got a lot of work cut out for you. I'm glad you joined the Responders -- that data sounds invaluable!

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: It is. I've integrated the data collection and research into the Responder Survivors Volunteer Program as well. I am still a teacher, after all.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: If anyone wants to help, just become a volunteer in Flatwoods and get a water testing kit from me. It's a fast process but it helps a lot.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Dip the test strips in the river and in the water pump's water and analyze the test strips at my terminal in the lab. That's all. Easy, right?

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Help me with this research and you'll help everybody live a little safer. And you can see how our environment has changed first hand - with science!

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Wow, and there you have it, folks. Thanks for talking with us today, Kesha. And thanks for showing us all how to live a little safer.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Mhmm. Class dismissed!

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Interview two. Reverend Delbert Winters! Hi! I met you in the woods near the Morgantown Airport. You were picking flowers. Why?

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: I was harvesting a lot of stuff, actually. I hunted a deer recently. It looked... strange. But tasted fine.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: What's a basic, easy meal that someone who's been surviving on cans could make?

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: You can make tea with dried flowers. It's not much, but it can soothe your stomach.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: I don't know what this flower is called, but I call it a Soot Flower. If you add it to water, you can make a tea.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: Same with rabbit meat or chicken meat, you can easily make soups with boiled water.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: God willing, we can adapt old recipes to new types of food.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: What do you mean by that?

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: Back in the army, we got sent off to places with weird fish I never heard of, and weird veggies I'll never see again. You know?

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: We had to cook with 'em still. Just pretend it's catfish or something and see how it turns out.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: But now, well, lemme say that I've seen some weird stuff.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: I thought maybe it was unholy, but... these are all the creation of our lord even if man has manipulated them, and dang it, they're still edible.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Oh, um, well. What kind of veggies do you eat?

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: Yeah there are still some edible veggies out there, like melons and carrots and gourds.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: You know, I found some tomatoes and potatoes growing together. They're somehow pollinating each other or something.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: I ate one and it was kind of like ketchup-flavored cardboard, but hey, I'm alive.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: You might have to experiment like that. Don't be too picky if it keeps you alive to see the end of times.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Sounds like you've been thinking about this for a while.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: You could say that.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: I knew the end was coming for a good long while, and well, it's here... and the end will come again.

Speaker: 003B75FA:NPCM_RSVP02_DelbertWinters:VTYP
Text: I have faith that there's a reason for all this, and that we need to survive to see our Lord again. And well, we need food to survive.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Fair enough. Thanks for the tips, Delbert.

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Interview three. I was hunting for rabbits and met Miguel Caldera who had a really nice campsite. Miguel, can you tell us about it?

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Yeah, I mean. Why not. You said this will help people, right?

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: I don't know, but I hope so.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: You know, I used to work in an office. Pushed papers all day. Filed reports. Shot the shit around the water cooler.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: The thing I did the most was watch the clock. I couldn't wait to get out of there and plan my next hiking trip into the mountains.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Saved all my days off for a hike down the Appalachians, you know? Looks like I got way more time than a week now!

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: So you were a nature lover before all of this?

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Yeah, yeah, of course. I love it. I dreamed of retiring to live as a hermit in the woods or something.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Anyway, I guess we are all hermits now! It's a blast -- *laughs* Pun not intended!

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: What would you tell other survivors who are trying to figure all of this stuff out for the first time?

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Oh that's easy. You need to build a campsite that's going to keep you safe.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: You want your camp to be hard to spot by predators and people, but close to resources.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: You also want to be able to wake up and find something to eat close by, you know?

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Sure! Of course. Makes sense. What else has changed for you since the bombs and, uh, all of this started?

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Well, for the first time in a long time... I met somebody, and that has been good for both of us.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: He works at the Flatwoods outpost, so I try to make excuses to visit when I can. You know how it is.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Programmed elaborate pointless systems just so I could be there for a while. Kept running into issues, you know, so I could stay longer...

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Wait, are you saying the Volunteer program was an elaborate ruse so you could spend more time with Garry?!

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: You've got to be kidding me!

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: *clears throat* Um... I meant to say that... you find ways to combine work with the things you love, right?

Speaker: 003B330E:NPCF_RSVP00_Dassa:VTYP
Text: Ugh! This interview is over. We need to talk. Miguel. What the F---

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Responder Survivors Volunteer Program: Advanced Training: Camping. By Miguel Caldera -- robot programmer extraordinaire!

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Part 1: Finding the perfect camping location.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Now that the world has changed, it's hard to stay safe. Used to be that camping was safe as houses. *laughs* Well, until there was a strong wind.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: These days, nothing is really safe. Even in your camp, someone might hurt you. The perfect spot doesn't matter now. It's all about your defenses!

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: You can build near people you trust who will watch your back, or build things that will watch your back for you! No problem! Anyone can do it.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Remember, camps are mobile. We're all explorers now, camping in a strange land full of adventure, wonder, and danger. So camp often, and rest a lot.

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Before the war, I was going to retire and go camping. Now I can do it every day, forever! It's a dream come true! Do what you love, right?

Speaker: 003B75FB:NPCM_RSVP03_MiguelCaldera:VTYP
Text: Now come to my camp and I can show you some knots and framing techniques. Then I'll direct you on to some helpful supplies! Good luck, Volunteer!

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Responder Survivors Volunteer Program: Advanced Training: Secure the Supplies! by Kesha McDermott.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Volunteer Responders like you must help stock our supplies regularly. If any of our caches are depleted, we'll run into a heap of trouble.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Since this is your first time on patrol, I will walk you through it. First, head to the triage center.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: This exercise will take you around the primary Morgantown Airport. You'll want to restock these caches regularly.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Now start heading over to the medical center. You want to keep your patrols pretty quick so the Responder Database doesn't lock you out.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: We use the processing center to hold food and drink supplies for any new survivors brought back for triage. So it's real important to keep stocked!

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: It's been such chaos keeping things well stocked ... since the Scorched ... well ... since the bombs ... seems like forever now.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Like I used to tell my students: things are always a different kind of tough, and so are you. You only need to be tough enough to make it.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: But the addendum is... you also need to have resources and support to make it, and nobody can make it entirely alone. Okay. Go on to the clinic now.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Good work, Volunteer. The triage center sees the heaviest of casualties, so the supplies here are probably always running low.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Restock, then head out to the tarmac. Responder Rocky's set up in the processing camp, in a cargo container. Hey - you're doing good work, Volunteer.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: I know it's tough to walk through the wounded and just restock shelves, but we need you to do this. Other Responders will take care of them.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: We need people to depend on. You know, if we're all safe then we can rebuild anything. The world isn't destroyed, you know, it just needs help.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Anyway... the next supply cache has a key, but you'll need to pick it up from Responder Rocky. Just tell him that Kesha has you doing patrols.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: While you're here, ask the doctors if they have any special supply requests. After that, head over to the control tower for your last stop.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: As you can clearly see, we need to constantly restock all of these supplies to keep our heads above water.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: And there's just no signs of it getting any quieter any time soon! The control tower is on the tarmac, and it's your final patrol stop.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: I'm so glad we established the volunteer program. We've gotten many good Responder Volunteers this way. Dassa does good work in Flatwoods.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: That wasn't so hard, right? Miguel has programmed some of the bots to restock these supply caches, but no where near the rate that we need.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: So the goal is that we'll pull in Volunteers to do at least one patrol for formal advanced training.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Your assistance is greatly appreciated. When you log in to the Responder Database, you'll be able to look up additional caches.

Speaker: 003B330D:NPCF_RSVP01_Kesha:VTYP
Text: Thank you for your service, Volunteer! And remember: helping others will help yourself.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: We're in the mission boundary, right, Weber?

Speaker: 0043C463:BoS_PrivateWeber_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Uh, we're at... Spruce Knob. Uh. Two clicks. We're two clicks from the edge.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: So we hug the line, move hard, move fast. And we may catch the marines with their pants down.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: LT, you may want to listen to this?

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: What is it, Moreno?

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: The comm. The chatter's weird. Let me...

Speaker: 00013ADD:FemaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: Confirmed nuclear strike on New York. Shit. Shit.

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: Oh god, it's the end... The end!

Speaker: 000CEAA3:MaleOld:VTYP
Text: Keep all the- *static*

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: The whole channel's been... blocked? Not sure how they're doing that.

Speaker: 0043C463:BoS_PrivateWeber_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Man, the brass has gone all out. Is this part of the war game, Lieutenant?

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: In the event of a nuclear exchange, we are to immediately seek orders from a superior.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: For the purpose of these war games, however, we are completely on our own. Cut off from command.

Speaker: 002894CA:NPCM_KnightWilson:VTYP
Text: Any standing orders we can fall back on, Lieutenant?

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: None that I know of-

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Whoa. Did you...?

Speaker: 0043C463:BoS_PrivateWeber_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: There's one over there, too.

Speaker: 002894CA:NPCM_KnightWilson:VTYP
Text: Mother of...

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Uh, this isn't no war game?

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Turn that off.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Trying band.. uhhh... AH-13. *sigh*

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Lieutenant! I got something!

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: I can't make anything out.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Sorry. Working on it.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: ... Maxson to Appalachia. I repeated, this is Captain Roger Maxson.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Give that to me.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Seeking any-

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Lieutenant Taggerdy here. Captain? It's you?

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Lizzy? Damn, it's good to hear a friendly voice.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Captain. I heard... I heard you're a traitor.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Traitor? If disobeying unconscionable orders makes you a traitor, then I suppose I am.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Lizzy, I'm glad you're alive but I need to find someone in Appalachia. Someone dependable.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: That's where I am. The Thunder was running war games against some jarheads.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: They still in one piece? By god, Lizzy. This... This is good news.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Roger, you're a traitor. I could be court-martialed even talking to you.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Look around, Lizzy. The Army's gone. America's fallen.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: I know you have questions, but we need to talk. There are things I learned at Mariposa.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: I got a scientist with me... Doctor Takano. We'll set up a secure channel.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: I'll answer all your questions, then.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Captain...

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Lizzy, you know me. We need to talk.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: We'll monitor this band. Taggerdy out.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: Marge. I keep recording these. Hoping one day I can make it home.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: I found these Brotherhood of Steel guys outside of Grafton.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: Heard about them. Some weird military cult.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: Seeing them in action... made me... I remember when my unit would roll in like that. All shock and awe.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: I'll tell you what, these Grafton raiders didn't stand a chance.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: One of them, Knight Moreno, noticed me. Came over and chatted.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: Nice guy. Really made me rethink the stuff I've been told.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: It came out I was in the cavalry at Anchorage, he said they had a place for me.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: Marge, I'm sorry. I've made it maybe 400 miles since the bombs.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: At this rate Texas might as well be a million miles further.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: I need... a unit. A place to belong. I feel like the Brotherhood may be it.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: Marge. It's been a couple weeks.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: I've had three squares, showers, working lights... Camp Venture's got power, proper power, Marge.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: I'd feel almost human if it weren't for the Senior Knight and the training.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: I graduated basic easy back in the day, and I know I may be a bit softer... but...

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: Wilson's an Army Ranger, or well, was one. And the drills they're making us do.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: But as beat up and worn out as I feel, that first time getting back into the 51b.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: You can call yourself Knight, Paladin, Grand Poobah of the Roman Empire, I don't care.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: Just don't take my power armor away.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: They're rushing training. A big battle with Super Mutants happening.

Speaker: 002B730B:NPCM_KnightTexRogers:VTYP
Text: Good. I got some aggression I need to unleash.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: So I got my own command now. Bet you never thought that would happen, right?

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: But with all the new blood Sarge is training... I mean Knight. Senior Knight.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Met up with a representative of the Responders.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: I told him our mission: to escort trade caravans, keep the freaks from the Savage Divide away from civilization, and maybe get the Dam operational again.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: She was so grateful, it was almost embarrassing.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Day one complete and so far so good.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: But I miss you. And the hot shower! But mostly you.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: The old rules about fraternization... I don't know if they apply in the Brotherhood.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Maybe we can just come clean and tell Paladin Taggerdy about us?

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: I know you'd like kids one day, too, and we're not getting any younger.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Promise you'll think about it.

Speaker: 0026B313:NPCM_KnightMoreno:VTYP
Text: Love you!

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Civilization.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: The Brotherhood and Responders together have paid a high price to make that word mean something in Appalachia.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Despite all the changes, farmers have worked the land, people have learned new skills, and we've built a new world.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: And the Super Mutants threaten all of that.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: I'm a soldier, a Paladin, and I tell you that this is our moment.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: We will never be stronger, and the Super Mutant's never weaker.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: If you are thinking in the heat of battle to run, live to fight another day, know this.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: There is no other day. We win here, now, Responders and Brotherhood together... or we will die.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: So look to your left, look to your right. Promise to give your all to protect them, and they will protect you.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Make no mistake, this will be the toughest fight of our lives.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: But we will win, because we're fighting for something. For each other, for our children, for civilization.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Now let's show these Muties what we're made of.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: If you're hearing this, stranger. I'm dead. The Brotherhood is dead.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: But I'm relieved. Relieved there is someone, anyone, alive.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: I honestly don't care if you're Chinese, American, or whatever. You're a human being.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: I don't have much time. But the Scorched are more of a threat than you can ever imagine.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: You have to find a way past the security I installed.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: If you're former military, all you need is your government issued military ID card.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: If not... find a way.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: I know, some... ghost... isn't probably very persuasive. But look past your own skin, and consider there's so much at stake.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: We did. And that's why I'm going out to die.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Ad victoriam. Scribe Grant signing out.

Speaker: 002B7310:NPCF_SquireDeSilva:VTYP
Text: Recon notes to self. I knew it. I remember coming here on a school field trip.

Speaker: 002B7310:NPCF_SquireDeSilva:VTYP
Text: The walls are as strong as I remember.

Speaker: 002B7310:NPCF_SquireDeSilva:VTYP
Text: Paladin's going to love it. Power lines run underground and connect up to Thunder Mountain.

Speaker: 002B7310:NPCF_SquireDeSilva:VTYP
Text: And so much space to grow into.

Speaker: 002B7310:NPCF_SquireDeSilva:VTYP
Text: But boy is the whole thing a fixer upper. And the smell.

Speaker: 002B7310:NPCF_SquireDeSilva:VTYP
Text: And there's the small problem of the Ghouls. But we've got Power Armor and miniguns for that.

Speaker: 002B7310:NPCF_SquireDeSilva:VTYP
Text: Do I want to live in a madhouse? Well, it's better than being crammed in like sardines at Venture.

Speaker: 002B7310:NPCF_SquireDeSilva:VTYP
Text: De Silva out.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Congratulations, Appalachia.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Paladin Taggerdy told me of you victory at Huntersville. I know it was costly, but future generations will thank you.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: As I'm thanking you now. It makes me proud.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: But that's not why I'm calling.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: One of the Brotherhood's standing orders is being on the look out for valuable technology.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Anything that would help us in our efforts.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: But as I look in every direction I see chaos. The lights are out, and men have become little better than barbarians.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Civilization. Civilization is something I think of every day. I know Lizzy's probably sick of the word by now.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: To rebuild that. To reclaim that. Our successors are going to need the secrets of the past.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: And those secrets are in danger of slipping through our fingers forever.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: So far our Scribes have been tools to help protect our Knights and maintain our bases. That needs to change.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: The Brotherhood is going to be more than an armed fighting force, we're going to be guardians of civilization.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: So we have to grab every schematic, every holotape, every book, and every goddamned note that holds the building blocks of the Old World before it's too late.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Our Scribes will hold onto them, preserve them, perhaps even progress beyond them.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: And the Knights will protect them. Like a hard shell around a precious seed.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: One day, when the time is right, that seed will grow. And a new civilization will be born.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: This... This is why we were born, don't you see it?

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Helping your fellow man is a good goal, a soldier's goal.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: But this... We will be the catalyst that changes the world.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: I'm sure you have questions, Paladin Taggerdy is fully briefed.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: I have every faith in you, Appalachia. Elder Maxson out.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Thank you, Captain. It's just us.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Lizzy. What's on your mind?

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: A Brotherhood of Steel? What's that even mean? The men over here are confused.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: We need to do something bold.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: We can't just stay the US Army.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: What's going to happen, and this is only a matter of time, is some general, or some goddamned politician is going to exit a Vault and start ordering us around.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: And worse they'll order some grunt to start the whole damned cycle again.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Another wave of nuclear death. And if that's not enough they'll do it again.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: You know they will, Lizzy. It ends with us. We won't let them.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: I... I understand. But a Brotherhood? Knights? I'm supposed to call you, what, Elder?

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Words have power, Lizzy. They build identity. They take on a meaning if you keep using them, even if it didn't exist to begin with.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: It was the Knights and Scribes after the fall of Rome that protected what was left of Western civilization.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: So we are the new Knights and our role is similar.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: But we'll need more than names. We'll need new traditions, our own, well, mythology.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Something people can believe to their core.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Is this necessary?

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: What else can I do? Declare myself President? Make you a Senator?

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Look around. Something's killing us more than the rads and freaks out there.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Depression. People have lost everyone. Every goddam soul. Wives, kids, loved ones, heck even the mailman.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: We need to replace it with something otherwise people's souls will wither. We'll be little more than walking dead men.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: I'll do my best to see the orders carried out, sir.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Give it time, Lizzy. People have a hunger to believe in something. Just let them work their way to it.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Is this urgent, Lizzy?

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Elder. I've read Scribe Takano's reports. I've talked with Grant a lot, too-

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Spit it out.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: The Sonic Generators work but there's just too many Sierra Bravos. This strategy of ours, it's just delaying the inevitable.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: You're not giving up on me?

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: No. Of course not. But I think we may need something bigger. More final.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Go on.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: One of the squires on patrol found a nuclear silo. Still functional.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: What? Even you, Lizzy?

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Are you out of your god-damned mind? Look around. Look at everything.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: The death, the destruction, the End of the World. That came from the nukes.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: But if we don't deal with the Bravos once and for all, they could kill everyone.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: All life on this continent. That's what Takano said, right?

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: There will always be a reason to use a weapon. Always.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: But nukes? Never again. I'd mothball the whole technology if I could.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Am I clear?

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Yes, Elder.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: I consider this matter resolved. I don't want to talk about it again. Maxson out.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Lizzy. Takano says the satellite's failing. So this is it.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Elder, I'm not ready for this. Can't the Scribes do anything about it?

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: No. The infrastructure of the Old World is failing.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: You are the absolute best second-in-command I've ever had the pleasure of working with.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Now is the time for you to be in charge, Lizzy. I know you're up for it. I know you won't let your men down.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Roger, we don't have the men for the mission. The Bravos just keep coming.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Then find new men. Think outside the playbook.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: Elder, you trust the outsiders too readily. They will betray you.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: You, too, Paladin? Everyone around me keeps saying shut the world out, only look out for ourselves.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Even my goddam son. But the Brotherhood alone can't rebuild what's lost.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: We need them. Hell, our whole plan is for them.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: I'm not thinking of some far off future, Elder. I'm worried about today. And tomorrow.

Speaker: 002894BF:NPCF_LizzyTaggerdy:VTYP
Text: We're fighting non-stop to keep the Bravos contained. I can't afford a weak link.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: I trust your judgment.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: If our Scribes find anything new, I'll see if we can get word to you somehow.

Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: And Lizzy *static*

Speaker: 002B8ED1:NPCM_TrainyardSupervisor:VTYP
Text: The Niner's fully automated.

Speaker: 002B8ED1:NPCM_TrainyardSupervisor:VTYP
Text: Slows down, drops freight, loads it, maybe ten porters manage the whole shebang.

Speaker: 002B8ED1:NPCM_TrainyardSupervisor:VTYP
Text: I know people keep complaining about jobs. Jobs this. Jobs that.

Speaker: 002B8ED1:NPCM_TrainyardSupervisor:VTYP
Text: Don't they know we got a war to win?

Speaker: 002B8ED1:NPCM_TrainyardSupervisor:VTYP
Text: You think the Commies care if you have to tuck in your belts a little?

Speaker: 002B8ED1:NPCM_TrainyardSupervisor:VTYP
Text: Their Chairman's going to work all of them to the grave.

Speaker: 002B8ED1:NPCM_TrainyardSupervisor:VTYP
Text: So you can tell the CEO here in Charleston, we're committed to the project.

Speaker: 002B8ED0:NPCM_McClintockSergeant:VTYP
Text: Camp McClintock has been training US Soldiers, US Army Soldiers, for five glorious years.

Speaker: 002B8ED0:NPCM_McClintockSergeant:VTYP
Text: You, class, are the last graduates taught by honest to goodness human drill sergeants.

Speaker: 002B8ED0:NPCM_McClintockSergeant:VTYP
Text: Go out there and show them that the old ways are the good ways.

Speaker: 002B8ED0:NPCM_McClintockSergeant:VTYP
Text: I want you to...

Speaker: 0027E578:NPCM_GovernorEvans:VTYP
Text: If I may interject, Sergeant? That'll be all. Thank you, thank you.

Speaker: 0027E578:NPCM_GovernorEvans:VTYP
Text: I want to say, as your governor, I am enormously proud of all of Appalachia's sons and daughters today that are graduating.

Speaker: 0027E578:NPCM_GovernorEvans:VTYP
Text: And I want to say the future of Appalachia is going to be even brighter as we bring in a new age of automation.

Speaker: 0027E578:NPCM_GovernorEvans:VTYP
Text: To train new soldiers for the fronts faster and more efficiently.

Speaker: 0027E578:NPCM_GovernorEvans:VTYP
Text: But today, and tonight, is yours to celebrate.

Speaker: 0027E578:NPCM_GovernorEvans:VTYP
Text: Thank you!

Speaker: 002B8ED4:NPCM_IsaacGarrahan:VTYP
Text: The majestic sloth.

Speaker: 002B8ED4:NPCM_IsaacGarrahan:VTYP
Text: So misunderstood. So intelligent.

Speaker: 002B8ED4:NPCM_IsaacGarrahan:VTYP
Text: Yes, they move cautiously. With great precision.

Speaker: 002B8ED4:NPCM_IsaacGarrahan:VTYP
Text: But it is not mere laziness, oh no, my friend.

Speaker: 002B8ED4:NPCM_IsaacGarrahan:VTYP
Text: It is... evolution.

Speaker: 002B8ED4:NPCM_IsaacGarrahan:VTYP
Text: So many of their predators with their keen sight. Adapted so well to catch prey in flight.

Speaker: 002B8ED4:NPCM_IsaacGarrahan:VTYP
Text: But do they catch you? No, no they don't.

Speaker: 002B8ED4:NPCM_IsaacGarrahan:VTYP
Text: I am just a branch, aren't you, my lovely?

Speaker: 002B8ED4:NPCM_IsaacGarrahan:VTYP
Text: Don't worry. Your protector... Your savior, Master Isaac, yes, I will keep you safe.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: Appalachia online, Captain.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: I know most of you love America.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: The good old red, white, and blue.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: But those of us that served at Mariposa know something.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: America failed.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Not because its citizens, who lived clean lives filled with hardship in a never ending war.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: And certainly not because of its fighting men and women. God bless them.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: No, its leaders failed us. Senators, Generals, Presidents, all those bastards.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Their failure almost destroyed all mankind.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: But I look around here and I see survivors.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: People too stubborn, too damned ornery to die.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: We've fought and we've endured and finally we have a small patch of safety.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: But having a home isn't enough. We need something more.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: What we need is... purpose.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: But we cannot look to the America of old for that purpose.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: We have to build our own.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: So tonight, as we break bread together, let us forge together something new. Something strong.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Something we can be proud of. Something we can build upon.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: We'll preserve what's best of what's come before and use it. And one day, we will reclaim what was lost.

HolotapeName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
Speaker: 00007299:NPCM_RogerMaxson:VTYP
Text: Let us forge a Brotherhood of Steel.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: Is the connection good?

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Yeah. I'm reading you.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: Excellent. I'm transmitting the program now. We'll send it multiple times. The static is playing hell with data integrity.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Three copies should be enough to deal with any corruption.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: We've wracked our brains over here and we've come across a solution for where you can use this program. Vault-Tec University. Can you get there?

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: VTU? Shit. That's in the heart of Responder territory.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: Who? That's not important. If the facility is still operational they have a fully Automated Research Lab. It's perfect.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Do you have any other options?

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: No. We don't. Keep transmitting any viable DNA sample you get of these... Scorchbeasts.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: We'll help as long as we can. But if we go dark, that lab can give you the information you need.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: Our preliminary research... Well, it's a possible mass extinction event if the threat isn't contained.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: ...Jesus.

Speaker: 002894C8:NPCF_ScribeTakano:VTYP
Text: Listen, if we don't talk again... Know that our thoughts are with you, Grant.

Speaker: 002894C3:NPCM_ScribeGrant:VTYP
Text: Thanks. Appalachia out.

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: We got them on the run, Sally. Beckley's ours!

Speaker: 000CEAA2:FemaleOld:VTYP
Text: I got 'em for you. But... What if no one comes?

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: The governor's got to give in, the whole town's unified.

Speaker: 000CEAA2:FemaleOld:VTYP
Text: Even if the marshals don't break us up, all they have to do is sit... Starve us out.

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: What's gotten into you? Our families' been mining here for generations.

Speaker: 000CEAA2:FemaleOld:VTYP
Text: I just-

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: What? What's that?

Speaker: 000CEAA2:FemaleOld:VTYP
Text: Nothing, nothing-

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: Are you wearing a wire? A goddamn wire?

Speaker: 000CEAA2:FemaleOld:VTYP
Text: Oww, oww.

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: Get her. Get her!

Speaker: 0000002D:MaleRough:VTYP
Text: Listen up, Governor Evans, your paid lackeys can't stop us. Beckley. Is. Ours!

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: This is Alisha Parker speaking, valedictorian of the last graduating class of Vault-Tec University.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: I believe it is my duty to record the events of Morgantown's final days for future generations.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: With any luck, someday a dweller from 76 will find this and know what happened here.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: After the bombs, Morgantown was a hellhole. Everything was on fire or dead.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: I don't remember much to be honest. A few of us hid inside the University but rations forced us out after a few weeks.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: When we emerged, we found ourselves in the perfect real-world scenario for exercising all the training we acquired at VTU. Yeah. Lucky us.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: Some of the kids with Overseer training took the lead. And a few of the Greek houses started communities.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: I don't even remember what they were called.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: The largest of them, Kappa something something, started absorbing the smaller houses and slowly expanding their territory.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: If the world wasn't over, I might have found it interesting how feudalism was reimagined against the backdrop of nuclear war.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: We lost a lot of students in the first year. Some to radiation poisoning. Others to typical things like hunger and thirst.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: One kid was attacked by a large rat in the VTU courtyard, but we never found it. But we mostly lost kids to the House wars.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: The RadAway shortages were terrifying.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: Some guys were fighting over a cache they found in a nearby pharmacy, and things got heated. They drew their guns and fired.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: The first student death by a fellow peer was recorded. This was the new Morgantown.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: The two biggest houses are the Roof House and the Street House -- named after the territories they control.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: A great student war unfolded -- but this wasn't the cute kind of hazing ritual known by VTU students. This was life or death.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: Without RadAway, the effects of intense radiation were already taking their toll.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: Kids were falling over dead, their hair and skin were falling off.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: Only the most powerful student houses were able to keep order among their ranks.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: This was only possible by eradicating the smaller groups of student survivors and stealing their supplies.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: Every dose of RadAway kept the powerful elite at the top of the food chain.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: Even now, I'm in hiding. On a roof somewhere far away from most of the other kids.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: There's one guy on the roof next over that I sometimes talk to, but we usually keep to ourselves to not attract attention.

Speaker: 002B92EF:NPCF_LC095_AlishaParker:VTYP
Text: I think his name is Victor.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: I feel like I'm losing my mind.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: I can't leave this roof or I'll die.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: Alisha has stopped talking to me.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: I have nothing to do but obsess over my work.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: *laughs* How is that even remotely sane? I'm cataloguing constellations and the world has ended.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: I have officially lost it.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: I know I have, because lately I've been resisting the temptation to go down to street level.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: There's roving bands of murderous kids. People who I used to help cheat on their exams, can you believe it?

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: I got them an A- and now they want to beat me to death with a wrench for a bag of chips.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: I wish I wasn't on this nightmare planet.

Speaker: 002B92F0:NPCM_LC095_Victor:VTYP
Text: I wish I was somewhere else, somewhere out there in the stars.

Speaker: 002B92F1:NPCF_LC095_StreetHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: We lost another group of freshmen today.

Speaker: 002B92F1:NPCF_LC095_StreetHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: I ordered them to start scaling the escape ladders at nightfall but it was a trap.

Speaker: 002B92F1:NPCF_LC095_StreetHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: The whole thing was covered in oil and the roof asses lit them all on fire.

Speaker: 002B92F1:NPCF_LC095_StreetHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: And I can't keep doing this!

Speaker: 002B92F1:NPCF_LC095_StreetHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: We keep trying to starve them out since we control the roads into and out of town, but somehow they keep finding food, man!

Speaker: 002B92F1:NPCF_LC095_StreetHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: They've even started to throw their empty food boxes down on us as mockery.

Speaker: 002B92F1:NPCF_LC095_StreetHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: How are they surviving up there? Where are they getting their supplies?

Speaker: 002B92F2:NPCM_LC095_RoofHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: The kids down there are so incredibly oblivious to the fact that windows exist.

Speaker: 002B92F2:NPCM_LC095_RoofHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: We've sent scouting parties in the dead of night through different adjacent buildings.

Speaker: 002B92F2:NPCM_LC095_RoofHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: They keep returning with more food, more ammo, it's nuts.

Speaker: 002B92F2:NPCM_LC095_RoofHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: We're gonna outlast this siege for years.

Speaker: 002B92F2:NPCM_LC095_RoofHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: The big problem though is RadAway. We're finding less and less of it every day, and people are starting to get sick.

Speaker: 002B92F2:NPCM_LC095_RoofHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: I'm still certain that we'll be the victors after all is said and done. The rooftops and the monorail are our own personal highway, after all.

Speaker: 002B92F2:NPCM_LC095_RoofHouseLeader:VTYP
Text: Those dumb street kids have no idea who they're messing with.

Speaker: 002B92F7:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter01:VTYP
Text: I have really started to feel much happier lately.

Speaker: 002B92F7:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter01:VTYP
Text: I've got a great place with fantastic roommates. And I've got the job of my DREAMS!

Speaker: 002B92F7:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter01:VTYP
Text: Working at VTU as an actual full-time Vault designer?! Research division. Full access. God, I've been dreaming about this my entire life.

Speaker: 002B92F7:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter01:VTYP
Text: The creative freedom is unparalleled in this industry.

Speaker: 002B92F7:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter01:VTYP
Text: My car runs great. My coworkers are great. The students, though I don't get to interact with them much, are really bright and remind me of myself.

Speaker: 002B92F7:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter01:VTYP
Text: Morgantown is... not like Seattle, but I couldn't be happier doing my best work here.

Speaker: 002B92F7:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter01:VTYP
Text: I think I'm going to have a really successful chapter here. I just can't wait for what the future holds.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: Oh, my books.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: My big, beautiful bound books filled with stories and knowledge and history.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: I love my books. I always will.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: But lately, I've been feeling like books are on their merry way to becoming antiques.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: Nobody reads from paper anymore.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: I saw some University kids in the store the other day just reading the covers and nothing more. Can you believe that?

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: Completely summarizing the contents of a published work by judging the cover?

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: Absolutely unbelievable.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: But now it's all holotape this, terminal that.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: Thank you, RobCo, for ushering in the death of books and, to be honest, our entire civilization while we're at it.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: And no, for anyone snooping in, the irony that I'm recording this rant is not lost on me.

Speaker: 002B92FB:NPCF_LC095_BookstoreOwner:VTYP
Text: I can still mourn for the death of my favorite pastime without getting left behind in the past, thank you very much.

Speaker: 002B92FC:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter02:VTYP
Text: I tell ya, those filthy rich college kids are ruining everything.

Speaker: 002B92FC:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter02:VTYP
Text: Rent's going up another hundred dollars this year. Monorail rates? They almost doubled since I moved in.

Speaker: 002B92FC:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter02:VTYP
Text: The landlord is even thinking about billing us for maintenance requests. I'm not sure that's even legal.

Speaker: 002B92FC:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter02:VTYP
Text: Oh, and to top it all off, yeah, they're actually building another Slocum's Joe downtown.

Speaker: 002B92FC:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter02:VTYP
Text: I mean, seriously, do we really need more donut shops? This is getting ridiculous!

Speaker: 002B92FC:NPCM_LC095_ApartmentRenter02:VTYP
Text: I'll tell ya, this is not my Morgantown.

Speaker: 002B92FE:NPCM_POI238_FreakShowOwner:VTYP
Text: Welcome... to the Freak Show!

Speaker: 002B92FE:NPCM_POI238_FreakShowOwner:VTYP
Text: No, that's not right. Take two. *clears throat*

Speaker: 002B92FE:NPCM_POI238_FreakShowOwner:VTYP
Text: Welcome to the FREAK show!

Speaker: 002B92FE:NPCM_POI238_FreakShowOwner:VTYP
Text: Too much emphasis in the middle there.

Speaker: 002B92FE:NPCM_POI238_FreakShowOwner:VTYP
