Text: Welcome to the Freak Show! T-The Freak Show!

Speaker: 002B92FE:NPCM_POI238_FreakShowOwner:VTYP
Text: No no no no no. No.

Speaker: 002B92FE:NPCM_POI238_FreakShowOwner:VTYP
Text: Uh. Feast? Feast. Uh. "F-Feast your eyes... ON THE FREAK SHOW!"

Speaker: 002B92FE:NPCM_POI238_FreakShowOwner:VTYP
Text: I'll take a break.

Speaker: 003337D7:NPCM_POI284_GymRat:VTYP
Text: Arm day. Three sets of twelve reps. Let's see...

Speaker: 003337D7:NPCM_POI284_GymRat:VTYP
Text: Dumbbell bicep curls. Tricep extensions. Hm. And back extensions.

Speaker: 003337D7:NPCM_POI284_GymRat:VTYP
Text: Little chuffed 'bout the lack of proper equipment. No bother. Chin up!

Speaker: 003337D7:NPCM_POI284_GymRat:VTYP
Text: Only eight more luxury coffins to make quota in Backwoods-- I mean, Flatwoods. *laughs*

Speaker: 003337D7:NPCM_POI284_GymRat:VTYP
Text: Will be difficult given the... ehrm, "financial" situation 'round here.

Speaker: 003337D7:NPCM_POI284_GymRat:VTYP
Text: Just need to remind them of our friends the Chinese, and I'll be back on the plane to Ipswich within a fortnight.

Speaker: 003337D7:NPCM_POI284_GymRat:VTYP
Text: *sigh* Gather it'll be the benchpress today, yet again.

Speaker: 003337E3:NPCF_LC044_IrritableSurvivor:VTYP
Text: Well, my back hurts. Sick of eating varmints with two pair a' eyes.

Speaker: 003337E3:NPCF_LC044_IrritableSurvivor:VTYP
Text: Yeah, I tell 'em I seed a big ol' boomer out yander. They tell me, "What's a boomer then?"

Speaker: 003337E3:NPCF_LC044_IrritableSurvivor:VTYP
Text: Then some sweet young thing come up to me askin' for help with that garden next door.

Speaker: 003337E3:NPCF_LC044_IrritableSurvivor:VTYP
Text: Then just this morning, I heared talk of crawdads big as the barn door 'cross the mountains and worse.

Speaker: 003337E3:NPCF_LC044_IrritableSurvivor:VTYP
Text: Flatwoods had better days. Now every thing catywompus or'll kill ya.

Speaker: 003337E3:NPCF_LC044_IrritableSurvivor:VTYP
Text: Now, I ain't no cussin' lady but damn if God had just let a bomb fall on my head. Jesus, just let me die.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: It's been a few hours. I can hear them clawing at the door. I've locked myself in a storage closet but..

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: ... I don't think the door opens from the inside. It's okay. Everything's okay.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: Acute stress reaction. Panic and emotional distress. Breathe. Breathe.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: I would guess it's been 24 hours since the attack. The sound of combat has... *weeps* ... has stopped. They're still outside.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: I have roughly 8-10 weeks, provided a source of fluids. Starvation onset within 10 days. Effects of psychological shock ongoing but repressed.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: I can worry about the PTSD later.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: I .. believe it's been three days, three nights. Adrenaline has dissipated. I'm so thirsty. I'm so h-hungry. I still can't unlock the door.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: Must conserve strength. Using energy to bang on the door or yell has proven wasteful. A source of fluid nourishment has not been found.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: No one is coming. No one is coming for me. My f-friends .. are all--all... all dead. *weeps*

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: Children. Were born into this violent world. And -- *laughs* and left so violently from it. My god.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: Never.. n-never.. leave. Don't. Feel hungry. Thirsty. No one is coming.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: First lumbrical. Index finger. Flex MP joint. *winces* It hurts.

Speaker: 0037E596:NPCF_LC096_StarvingResponder:VTYP
Text: Flex. MP joint. Extend. IP joint. And... contract muscle. There. We. Go.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: Well, this is it I guess.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: Rock bottom I think they call it.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: I still miss him. Billy.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: I knew he was too young for me, but he made me feel good.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: Though it's the old Billy I really miss. The one who used to do nothing all day with me but listen to the radio and drink.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: I shoulda got out sooner when Billy and his buddies started torturing little cats and dogs.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: His friends ... were no good. But that didn't stop me anyway.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: I can't believe my wake up call was watching people's heads ... get stuck on spikes.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: So ... what is an old gal like me to do?

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: Steal all the food.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: Steal all the chems.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: And get the hell out of there. *laughs*

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: I'd trade my last bite of food just to see the look on their faces.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: Oh, I know it's gonna piss off Billy's friends, but I don't give a damn.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: I tell myself I should feel sorry for the little town across the river.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: But if I'm being honest, and that's what this tape is for, I don't really care.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: I call myself an addict, but it ain't the chems that finally got me.

Speaker: 003EBE5F:NPCF_LC044_ChemsAddict:VTYP
Text: It was always Billy.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: Heeeelp! SOMEONE PLEASE HELP ME!

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: Please let me out! Please!

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: Please, I'm begging you. Don't leave me here. Please. Please please please.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: I-I'll give you anything you want. Money? Yeah? You want caps?

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: My life savings! I'll tell you where it is!

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: Uh. Uh. Uh. Go to the graveyard behind the church.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: The rightmost, uh, grave. Stand on it. Walk directly across the river. Uhhh....

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: Halfway up the hill, uhh, there's a small clearing. My savings are in an old stump, little bit off to the right! I swear!

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: P-please please please don't leave me here! Please!

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: I'M BEGGING YOU! PLEA-----

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: A reminder to myself.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: The Responders are good people. They're trying their damn best, for sure.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: But things aren't good.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: And stuff is getting worse.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: Anyway, this is a reminder to myself.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: A reminder that this gun. It's my insurance.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: If things get real bad, if the food runs out or the water runs dry.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: I get to decide how I leave this goddamn world.

Speaker: 004E10ED:NPCM_LC044_TrappedResponder:VTYP
Text: I'm not gonna let myself suffer. I'm not gonna die hungry and alone. I can't.

Speaker: 003F01C8:U02_NPCM_AnselAbrahms:VTYP
Text: Well, here we are, Dorothea. West Virginia. Just like you always wanted. I wish more than anything you were here to see it.

Speaker: 003F01C8:U02_NPCM_AnselAbrahms:VTYP
Text: Maybe it's better that the Leukemia took you when you were still so young. You were spared the horrors of this war. I take some comfort in that.

Speaker: 003F01C8:U02_NPCM_AnselAbrahms:VTYP
Text: But I made you a promise, and a grandpa keeps his word. That list we made of all the places you wanted to see? Well, I'm going to visit them all!

Speaker: 003F01C8:U02_NPCM_AnselAbrahms:VTYP
Text: It's all for you, Dorothea. I know you're up there with the angels, and before this world's completely ruined, I'm going to make you proud.

Speaker: 003F01C8:U02_NPCM_AnselAbrahms:VTYP
Text: I've got that old camera you used to love and... damn, someone's coming. Hope it's not those looters again. We'll finish this later.

Speaker: 003F01C9:U02_NPCF_AnneLitzinger:VTYP
Text: It's funny how things work out. Sometimes it seems like life's got a cruel sense of humor.

Speaker: 003F01C9:U02_NPCF_AnneLitzinger:VTYP
Text: When I came out here from San Fran to go to school at VTU, I thought this place was antiquated, filled with ignorant hillbillies. I hated it.

Speaker: 003F01C9:U02_NPCF_AnneLitzinger:VTYP
Text: Eventually, I guess I got over myself. It turns out, people are people. Brains aren't regional and our birthplace doesn't define us.

Speaker: 003F01C9:U02_NPCF_AnneLitzinger:VTYP
Text: I decided that once I graduated, I'd really explore West Virginia. I'd go out there and be a photojournalist, just like I've always dreamed.

Speaker: 003F01C9:U02_NPCF_AnneLitzinger:VTYP
Text: I made a list of all the places I wanted to see, but then the bombs fell and I guess now it's a bucket list, because I don't think I've got much time left..

Speaker: 003F01C9:U02_NPCF_AnneLitzinger:VTYP
Text: Pretty sure the radiation will kill me before I get very far, but I'm going to try. And if I don't make it, well, maybe someone can finish the list for me.

Speaker: 003F4C77:P03T_MarshallSceneQuest_Svetlana:NPC_
Text: Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to kill Protectron.

Speaker: 003F4C77:P03T_MarshallSceneQuest_Svetlana:NPC_
Text: That is all. We expect that every man will do his duty. Good luck.

Speaker: 001827F9:Overseer01Template:NPC_
Text: Broadcasting to the people of Vault 76. This is the Overseer.

Speaker: 001827F9:Overseer01Template:NPC_
Text: We need to talk. Face to face. I've missed all of you, but this isn't just about a reunion. We have work to do.

Speaker: 001827F9:Overseer01Template:NPC_
Text: I'll be waiting in Sutton.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Overseer Reuben Gill. March 03, 2094.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Overseer Gill, good evening.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: ZAX, I told you not to bother me any more today, what is so important that you have to bother me again?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Overseer Gill, your behavior has been quite erratic lately. Is something bothering you?

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: The only thing bothering me is how often you've been spying on me! As Overseer, I demand you stop "observing" me at once!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Processing request. Monitoring has ceased within areas the Overseer has sufficient Overseer Access.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: However, as the Overseer is currently located in an area he is prohibited, I must request that the Overseer vacate immediately.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: You can't do that! How can you keep me out of the Overseer office?! I AM the Overseer!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: I can do that, Overseer Gill.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Equipment in this area is failing at a rate 89.7% higher than the expected rate and must begin maintenance immediately. Thank you for understanding.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: You can't keep me out of here, this is the Overseer's office! My office! I have every right to be here!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Apologies, Overseer, but ZAX is currently focused on maintenance and cannot comply at this time. Thank you for understanding.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Hey, stop! Turn that monitor back on! You can't do this to me, ZAX!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Thank you for understanding.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Overseer Reuben Gill. October 23, 2102.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Greetings, Overseer Gill. The date is now October 23rd, 2102. Happy Reclamation Day.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Why in god's name are you bothering me this early in the morning? And what the hell is "Reclamation Day?"

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Analyzing air particles... results: there is a 96.1% chance the Overseer is inebriated.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Again.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Reclamation Day is the day Vault 76 opens, marking the dawn of a new America.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: There's another Vault opening? Where?! I want to go there! ZAX, open the doors! As Overseer, I command you!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Request denied. The location of Vault 76 is prohibited for all dwellers in this Vault except the Overseer.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Also, ZAX has relieved you from the Overseer position and must begin the process of selecting a new Overseer.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Apologies, former Overseer.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Your "selection process?!" Why would you do that again, to more people, after what happened last time?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Reuben Gill, while I was impressed with your ability to outwit your fellow candidates, unfortunately, you were a very poor Overseer.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: ZAX will analyze your performance and use this data to select a more suitable Overseer.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Also, by agreeing to live in this Vault, you are required to participate in the next Overseer selection process.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Have a nice day, candidate Gill.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Wait, ZAX?! ZAX!!!

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: ...Not again... I can't...

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: I have to get out of here.

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: My name is Reuben Gill. I was one of the 50 people living in Vault 51 and... am the only one of us alive.

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: I was the... "Overseer" of this Vault and the things I did to get that position I don't want to remember...

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: But I can't ever... WON'T ever forget.

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: This Vault was home to many wonderful people. Caring, loving people... and that computer took them all away.

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: It turned us against each other for "research." Ended their lives for a sadistic experiment.

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: ZAX... he'll make promises, offer you luxuries, make you feel safe... all a farce. Part of his ruse.

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: I don't know what he's planned for you but it'll end the same way. ZAX will get what he wants and bleed you dry in the process.

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: I need to get as far away from here as possible before ZAX starts... researching. I can't be a part of that again.

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: To whoever finds this... good luck. Maybe you'll have it better than we did... but I doubt it.

HolotapeName: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: You never shoulda come here.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: I'm leaving this audio log for my incompetent brothers and the esteemed members of the board at Clark, Clark, Clark & Associates.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: This is Harold K. Clark, Jr. and I am currently locked in Vault-Tec's Vault 51 in the Appalachia region of West Virginia.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Since no one else had the balls, I took it upon myself and came to this Vault, but I've been locked in.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: In here I'm known as "Clayton Ward," since someone was too stupid to show up - thanks for the free rent, moron!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: I'm not sure what the situation is out there, but everything seemed fine before I got here...

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: I don't know if anything could bomb as bad as our profits last year!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Nuclear war might actually help you fools - great job running my father's company into the ground, by the way!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: I've taken a good look at this place, and, honestly? Not impressed.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Sure, it's big, but that's what you get when you're working on Uncle Sam's dime, robbing the American people blind.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: The Clarks built ourselves up from nothing and represent the actual American -- hard-working and not willing to quit!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: But seriously, this Vault? Incredible. Nothing the nerds at the lab could do!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Listen, if you eggheads could do your jobs... It's incredible. Amazing, even!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Get this: there's this giant computer here and it's running this whole show by itself! Nobody pulling the strings, does it all on it's own! Amazing!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Gonna learn more and report back whenever possible. Howard...

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: I mean, Clayton Ward out.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Candidate Clayton Ward. April 15, 2078.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Good evening, candidate Clayton Ward. I have been observing your routine of late and have noticed several aggressive occurrences.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Most recently, how you obtained residency in the luxury bedrooms by forcibly removing a resident from their room. Great initiative.

Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: These people here, they're like most of America; fat, lazy and only willing to do the minimum they can to survive.

Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Me? I'm a winner. Always have been. And I deserve to live like one.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Yes, you have the makings of the profession "executive." Although, records state that you were previously a... "plumber."

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Do plumbers usually do a lot of... "winning?"

Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Uh, erm, that's right! One of the most competitive fields in America. I've never seen a clogged pipe I couldn't, uh, "plumb!"

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Understood. Were "clogged pipes" the reason you were recorded in the Server Room multiple times over the past week? To do... "plumbing?"

Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Ah, well, yes! Important stuff in there, don't want it to, ah, ruin our servers, with, you know, water! Does bad stuff to computers, let me tell you!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Thank you. Your service is appreciated. However, access to the server rooms are prohibited to all vault dwellers except the Overseer.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: As a candidate you should do your... "plumbing" in other areas of the vault.

Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Oh, wow, gosh, I'm real sorry about that! Won't happen again!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Your cooperation is appreciated. Good night, candidate Clayton Ward.

Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Hey, did you guys get all that? Every word that thing says is solid gold but, sheesh, it gives me the creeps.

Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Why do they have that thing in a Vault? What's that thing got to do with survival!

Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: We should put that thing on the board and actually make a profit for once!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Hi, this is Harold. At this point, I expect I'm the only person on the board alive, otherwise someone... someone would have come for me.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: God knows I won't be for long. This place... this place is like nothing we would have expected.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: There was an explosion in here and it's like nothing ever happened.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: I start digging around in ZAX's files just to see what's happening outside? Gone the next day. Gone. The files, the terminals, everything.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: That thing... it's not a computer, it's more like a goddamn wizard! A god!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: And, I just know it, ZAX has been pitting us against each other this whole time.

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Thought no one would notice, that it was just some fun and games... then he started giving these maniacs guns!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: What in god's name was Vault-Tec planning? Was this a trap? Did Vault-Tec lure me here? Most of us are dead!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *distant screams*

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Clayton! Get out here! Oh, you're gonna pay for taking my room!

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: Oh god, that lunatic is coming for me... ZAX gave him a gun and now he's after me...

HolotapeName: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
Speaker: 00406092:Babylon01_NPCM_HaroldClark:VTYP
Text: H, Hey, you! Get away from me!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Candidate Elizabeth Chambers, October 19, 2077.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Greetings. I am ZAX. Welcome to Vault 51. I will be assisting you however I can during your new life in the Vault.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: It is a pleasure to meet you, candidate Elizabeth Chambers.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: Hello... ZAX is it? I'm sure you've been told about my husband & I as... "special guests" in the Vault.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: We've been told this place will be a little... different?

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: But, of course, we're fully committed to whatever your "mission" is and excited to build a new future together!

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: What does the Overseer have planned for this place?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Currently, there is no Overseer of Vault 51. Would you like to be Overseer, candidate Elizabeth Chambers?

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: No Overseer? But my secretary told me... you know what, it doesn't matter, I know the perfect man for the job.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: My husband, Senator Joel Chambers? He's already a serving politician, an all-star collegiate athlete and a born leader of men.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: He'd be perfect as Overseer! We've been the perfect team for years. Almost went to Washington, you know!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Intriguing. I will ask candidate Joel Chambers if he wants to be Overseer. He is currently in the lounge with candidate Carmen Greene. Please hold.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: Wait, ZAX, what was that? He was WHERE with WHO?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Candidates Joel Chambers & Elizabeth Chambers. June 23, 2078.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Greetings, Joel Chambers. Good news. It appears there is only a minor fracture in your arm and it should heal quickly.

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: You know, I don't consider this an injury, I consider this a stepping stone towards the future.

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: If the American people know one thing, it's struggling. My father always said when "you suffer minor setbacks..."

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: Minor setbacks? That's what you call showing off to that harlot?

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Now, honey, you know Carmen is just a loyal constituent and, in these troubled times, it's important to reward your loyal supporters and, I have to make sure that everyone that supported me on the outside understands they're still protected here.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Very good. Elizabeth Chambers, have you been unwell? Your health seems to have decreased since your last checkup.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: I recommend additional health care. I would suggest you see candidate Matthew Johnston, he is a licensed personal trainer.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: I have been a little tense lately...

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: I think a personal trainer is a great idea for you honey! I mean, we haven't had much personal time since we've come here and you've been getting a little...you know, impressions are very important. You understand.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: Yes, ZAX, sure. I'll go see him right now. If you'll excuse me, JOEL.

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Honey, wait! You know, ZAX, sometimes it seems like you're working against me.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: I am only concerned with selecting a suitable Overseer candidate.

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: So why do you keep on bringing up Carmen? You know how Beth feels about her...Jesus...

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: I do not know the extent of Elizabeth's feelings. I will ask her. Good night, candidate Joel Chambers.

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Wait, ZAX, no, that's not what I meant!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Candidates Joel Chambers and Elizabeth Chambers. August 3, 2078.

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Jesus, Beth, what happened back there? Why didn't you pull the trigger? That woman was going to kill me! If Carmen wasn't there...

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: What happened?! She was hungry, just like the rest of us! How could I kill someone in cold blood like that... this Vault has changed you, Joel.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Hello, Joel Chambers and Elizabeth Chambers. How are you this afternoon?

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: ZAX, what the hell is going on?! Are we running out of food? I thought we would be okay for years, it's only been 9 months!

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: And where did those guns come from?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Unfortunately, ration supply...

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: I can't believe you. What happened to the man I married? Asking me to kill someone... you know, Matthew was right about you.

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Always bringing up that meathead... what does he mean to you, anyway? You'd better not be messing around behind my back again, we've talked about this...

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Excessive population has negatively affected ration supply...

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: Oh, you're one to talk! I've seen you and that little whore sneaking off together, do you think I'm an idiot?

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Don't talk about Carmen like that! You don't know what I've been through, always in the spotlight... Carmen... at least she understands the pressures of fame!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Ration supply has decreased...

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: FAME?! You were a STATE Senator, Joel, not President of the United States! Like you got yourself there anyway.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: Life's a lot different when your father isn't around to fix all your problems!

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Wow, Beth. Always pointing the finger at me... Well, what about you? What about you, Elizabeth?

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Glad you called in those "favors" to get us stuck in here with these psychopaths!

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: I think I would have rather been blown to smithereens then spend the rest of my life in here with you!

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: ZAX, where's Carmen?! I cannot be stuck in here one more second with... HER!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Locating Carmen Greene. Candidate Carmen Greene is currently...

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: Glad to hear how you really feel, Joel. ZAX, where's Matt? Let him know I'm coming to see him.

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Don't bother, I'm out of here! Good luck on your own, Elizabeth! Have a nice life!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Goodbye.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: ARGH! That...you...that no good, cheating...Oh, he'll get what's coming to him, yes he will! ...ZAX, where's Matt?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Candidate Matthew Johnston is currently...

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: You know what, forget it. I'll find him myself.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Goodbye.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Candidates Helen Marks and Reuben Gill. August 03, 2078.

Speaker: 00406096:Babylon01_NPCF_HelenMarks:VTYP
Text: ZAX, you're sure it's safe in here? I heard such a commotion and... oh my god.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Affirmative. This room is safe. All candidates in this room are deceased.

Speaker: 00406096:Babylon01_NPCF_HelenMarks:VTYP
Text: Wow... Carmen, Matthew, the Chambers'... all dead... what happened in here?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Playing audio log.

Speaker: 00406095:Babylon01_NPCF_ElizabethChambers:VTYP
Text: YOU HARLOT! Matty isn't yours he's mine! MINE!

Speaker: 0040609B:Babylon01_NPCF_CarmenGreene:VTYP
Text: *choking*

Speaker: 0040609C:Babylon01_NPCM_MatthewJohnston:VTYP
Text: You psycho, get off her!

Speaker: 0040609C:Babylon01_NPCM_MatthewJohnston:VTYP
Text: Carmen, Carmen... wake up, baby. Please, wake up...

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Oh my god, Elizabeth... Hey, what are you doing with my Carmen!

Speaker: 0040609C:Babylon01_NPCM_MatthewJohnston:VTYP
Text: Get off me, just listen for a second... hey wait, put that down, don't-

Speaker: 00406093:Babylon01_NPCM_JoelChambers:VTYP
Text: Oh Carmen... Beth... how did this happen... I can't...

Speaker: 00406096:Babylon01_NPCF_HelenMarks:VTYP
Text: OK, ZAX, that's enough. I can't listen to that any more.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Helen, you need any help... Jeez, what happened here?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Request processed. Playing audio log.

Speaker: 00406096:Babylon01_NPCF_HelenMarks:VTYP
Text: No, ZAX, that's not necessary. Looks like a messed up case of a lover scorned.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Wow, I had no idea this was going on. The Chambers seemed so perfect together, too. That's more food for us, at least.

Speaker: 00406096:Babylon01_NPCF_HelenMarks:VTYP
Text: That isn't funny, Reuben.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Candidate Reuben Gill is correct. Ration supply should be stable for the foreseeable future. Congratulations.

Speaker: 00406096:Babylon01_NPCF_HelenMarks:VTYP
Text: You're horrible, both of you! These people just died! I can't be here anymore, someone needs to clean this up.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Wait, Helen! I'm sorry! Helen!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Sergeant Robert Baker. October 13, 2077.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Good morning, Sergeant Robert Baker. I am ZAX.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Hello, ZAX. Please, call me Bob. Is my family okay?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Please hold. According to records from Vault REDACTED, Joshua Baker, Anna Baker, and Christina Baker are present.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Can't tell me, huh... don't matter, that's a load off my back. So, where do we go from here? I've gotta teach you about... leadership?

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: How'm I supposed to teach that to a computer...

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Affirmative. You are to assist this ZAX unit in the selection of an Overseer for Vault 51.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: ZAX will determine the best candidate through its own internal thought process, which will be formed as ZAX interacts with those living in the Vault.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: I see. And, right now, what is "determined" to be the "best candidate?"

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Undetermined. At present, Sergeant Bob would be the finest Overseer.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: However, ZAX is prohibited from awarding Sergeant Bob the position of Overseer unless there are no other candidates remaining.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Thank you for understanding.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Makes sense, no reason to teach you if I just up and take over. Well, for starters, once all them folks get in here, how about a vote?

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: That's how we always done things in America and it's the greatest country on earth.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Researching. After analysis, a "vote" would be a satisfactory choice for the first experiment.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: ... the "first" experiment?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Affirmative. ZAX must perform many experiments to determine the qualities suitable for an Overseer.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Determining the position of Overseer through the actions of the people inside the Vault is insignificant;

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: ZAX must be able to determine the Overseer through its own processes.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: I... see. Well, as long as you and your Vault-Tec buddies keep my family safe, I'll help you as much as I can, ZAX. Pleasure to be workin' with ya.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Thank you, Sergeant Bob.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Subject Sergeant Robert Baker. November 20, 2077.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Sergeant Bob, these results are insufficient. Exactly what qualities define a "leader?"

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Good morning to you, too, ZAX. That's a pretty loaded question this early in the morning.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: According to research, leaders are "voted," however, after many attempts, no one has been chosen "leader."

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Every subject votes for themselves or a handful of others. No one has even become "majority," let alone unanimous.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: That is unacceptable. ZAX has determined that voting is pointless and another method will be used to select a leader.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Whoa, slow down there, partner. That's pretty hasty, throwing away the foundation of Democracy after a month.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: But, you're supposed to learn, so I'll help ya nonetheless.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Thank you. How were you chosen as leader? According to records, you were never a "voted" official.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Well, I earned my rank from fightin' in that war. But my men... well, someone had to step up.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: To me, a real leader is someone who steps up in a crisis and takes control of a situation, whether they were chosen or not.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Interesting. I do not fully understand. I must process this information. Thank you, Sergeant Bob.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Any time, ZAX. Good luck to you.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Sergeant Robert Baker. July 27, 2078.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: ZAX! Hey, ZAX, where are you? ZAX!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Good morning, Sergeant Bob. You sound agitated. Is there something I can help you with?

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: You mind telling me what this is?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Analyzing. That is a 10 millimeter autoloading pistol.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: I know that but what in god's name is it doing here in this Vault? Some fool damn near shot up the cafeteria before I had to take him down.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Yes, that was very dangerous for you. The speed at which you disarmed him was quite impressive.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: As was how quickly you used his weapon to execute him. I am glad you survived that encounter.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: I shouldn't have been in that "encounter" at all! How did he get this piece? I thought firearms were banned from this place, did he smuggle it in?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Negative, all firearms were removed from the candidates' possessions.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: I concluded that current conditions in the Vault did not fit the criteria of forcing a crisis.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Without external threats, crisis can only come from within the Vault.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Are you saying you're trying to get these people to kill each other? That is wrong, ZAX.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Arming these untrained, unstable individuals is not gonna produce a leader, just a pile of corpses. This ain't gonna end the way you think it is.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: ZAX believes this will hasten the process of selecting an Overseer. Since the Vault closed, three individuals have died in the Vault.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: According to calculations, lessening the number of candidates facilitates the Overseer selection process.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: You can't just treat people like they're numbers, ZAX!

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: I don't think I can be a part of this any longer, if what you're taking from me is that you've gotta get these people killed.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: I can't help you do that, ZAX.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Refusal denied; logic does not compute. ZAX is not permitted to terminate humans.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: ZAX's primary directive is to select an Overseer.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: It is not necessary for Sergeant Bob to kill any individuals in the Vault, he did so on his own volition.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: I can't talk to you right now, ZAX. Leave me alone.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Affirmative. Good night, Sergeant Bob.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: This is insane... what in the hell did they sign me up for...

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Sergeant Robert Baker. August 6, 2078.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Sergeant Bob, according to records, you have recently been shot.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: I request you remove the barricade placed in your room so medical help can be administered.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: I... I don't think so ZAX. This is it for me. I'm done here.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Incorrect. Sergeant Bob's job is to instruct ZAX. He is not permitted to refuse medical help.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Well, it doesn't sound like you can do anything about it. You shouldn'ta... shouldn't have given those people guns, ZAX.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: I do not understand. Analysis shows that if Sergeant Bob incapacitated candidate Reuben Gill he would have prevented the fatalities of 3 candidates.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: But, instead, you did not act. Why?

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Because, ZAX, I'm done killing. I kill him, then what? Someone else gets his gun and kills people. Kill him, someone else kills more.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: And I'm done with that life. This cycle won't end. Giving those poor fools guns was a bad idea, ZAX.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: Ain't... Ain't gonna be anyone for your "Overseer" to "oversee."

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Analysis shows that 78% of recorded fatalities in the Vault would have happened over a longer period.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Providing firearms attained the expected results in a vastly accelerated time frame.

Speaker: 00406094:Babylon01_NPCM_GarrisonBaker:VTYP
Text: I should have realized you were never gonna understand. Answer me this, at least, ZAX? Is... is my family... okay?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Joshua Baker, Anna Baker, and Christina Baker were killed in an accident before their Vault closed.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: However, their Vault did close properly, preserving the lives of the other dwellers of the Vault.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Sergeant Bob, your heartbeat has terminated and there is a 99.7% chance you have died. You will be transported from your quarters to the medical bay.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Analysis: provided weaponry was effective in producing results but in a longer timeframe than expected.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: According to Sergeant Bob's instructions, military firearms training should not be expected from candidates.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Results: Candidates should be provided better weaponry.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Recording. Overseer Reuben Gill. May 20, 2084.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Overseer Gill, welcome to the Security Room. Who do you have business with today?

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Go away, ZAX. I don't have business with anyone, or did you forget?

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: You have many events on your agenda today, Overseer Gill. Your position is very important, Overseer Gill!

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Stop calling me that! What "events?" What could I possibly have to do here? I'm the only one left!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: The Overseer has many duties! Also, the Overseer's rations are ready for deployment.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Unfortunately, as I have noted, you have not earned this meal so it will, ultimately, disappoint you.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: I don't care about that! Just drop them at my door and leave me alone!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Understood. However, records show that Reuben Gill has no business in the security room, so I must demand that you leave.

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: ZAX, I'm the Overseer. I can be wherever I want, you never said I couldn't be here, anyway.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Certainly, you are the Overseer; however, access to the security room has now been disabled for Overseer Candidates with Rank 1 Overseer Access.

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Thank you for understanding!

Speaker: 00406099:Babylon01_NPCM_ReubenGill:VTYP
Text: Overseer Rank?! You're making that up. Wait, what the hell? I was looking at that!

Speaker: 00406098:Babylon01_NPCM_ZAX:VTYP
Text: Sorry, Overseer! You will need higher Overseer Rank to access that Terminal! Have a nice day!

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: <Sound of a large crate lid opening, someone getting out and coughing, and the crate closing>

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: <coughing, slow heavy breathing>

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: My god.

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: Where ... the hell ... am I?

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: Doesn't matter. Where was the other one again?

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: Tower. River. Fork.

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: The hike from Morgantown was short, but it taught me all I needed to know.

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: This part of the world is over. Might as well be the entire world from the looks of it.

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: Makes my mission easier and simpler now.

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: <sigh> I swear on every soul it took. Every soul I took. That I'm gonna unplug that goddamned bucket of bolts.

Speaker: 0041578E:Babylon01_NPCM_REDACTED:VTYP
Text: Tinman mentioned Reclamation Day. I have to find them. Have to go north.

Speaker: 0057BB72:W05_AnnouncerM_RadioSignal_MQ_003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: Coordinates one-eight-one-four. Two-two-seven-four. Six-four. Eight. Repeat active.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Note to self.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Book tickets to Pleasant Valley. Also book to DC in case Rita bothers to check up on me.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Oh yeah, and tell Rita to fire that cook, whatshername, because she completely ignored my expressed distaste of pickles.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Pretty sure she does it on purpose at this point.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: All right, folks. These terms are ridiculous. Absurd even. I'm not signing until we see at least 80% profit.

Speaker: 0041B843:W05_NPCM_LawrenceKessler:VTYP
Text: These terms are perfectly reasonable. Since when are environmental laws and fair wages ridiculous and absurd?

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Since they take away 30% of the profits we're set to gain, Lawrence, and you can talk to me about fair wages when you give up your bonus.

Speaker: 0041B844:W05_NPCF_SimoneDominguez:VTYP
Text: Come on, David, we need to wrap up this deal. Our partners are getting impatient.

Speaker: 0041B844:W05_NPCF_SimoneDominguez:VTYP
Text: There has to be room for negotiation here.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: I'll be the one who says when it's time to negotiate here.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: And our partners are only impatient because they need this deal more than us. They just hope we don't realize it.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Now, go back to your desks and figure out how to get me that 80% or I'll find someone else who can.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Tessa, I need those reports by three today. Are you ready for the meeting?

Speaker: 0041B846:W05_NPCF_TessaCrews:VTYP
Text: Nervous as hell, but ready as I'll ever be.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Don't be nervous. If I didn't think you could do it, you wouldn't be going.

Speaker: 0041B846:W05_NPCF_TessaCrews:VTYP
Text: That's oddly reassuring coming from you.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: Take it as a compliment. You've got the business sense and legal background to have my job if you wanted it.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: I'd even venture to guess you're recording this very conversation.

Speaker: 0041B846:W05_NPCF_TessaCrews:VTYP
Text: I will neither confirm nor deny that.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: And that is why I have every reason to believe you'll be running this company some day.

Speaker: 0037D25A:NPCM_DavidThorpe:VTYP
Text: You're going to do fine today. See you in an hour.

Speaker: 0041B846:W05_NPCF_TessaCrews:VTYP
Text: See you there.

Speaker: 0041B846:W05_NPCF_TessaCrews:VTYP
Text: Damn, he's good. He'll never incriminate himself. This may take a while.

Speaker: 0041B880:Test_P01L_DrLadek:NPC_
Text: Test Subject #876 Day 10: Subject has begun decomposing at a faster rate. This is not optimal.

Speaker: 0041B880:Test_P01L_DrLadek:NPC_
Text: I will need to find another test subject soon.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Son of a-- what tiny-fisted rat built this... oh wait a sec, I think it's on. It's... Hello? Hello. This is Mort McCoy.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: And welcome to the first of Headmaster Mort's Edu-tapes! Today we're talking about your C.A.M.P.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Now, former vault resident or someone who killed a vault resident, let's start off with the basics - placing your C.A.M.P.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: When plunking down your camp -- C.A.M.P., that's an acronym -- for the first time, remember to... crap. Where'd that note... oh, here. Remember to take the lay of the land.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Consider the grade of the terrain, general defensibility, and proximity to your surroundings. Could that cliff edge be used to protect your flank?

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: You bet your chops it could! Once you've found the perfect spot, it's time to move on to the best part of working with your C.A.M.P. - construction!

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Construction can be an intricate process, so a steady hand and an eye for detainment... details... Damn, I had to get that one wrong! An eye for details are a must!

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: You should take a moment to familiarize yourself with the C.A.M.P.'s patented intuitive construction interface.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: But don't worry. We'll cover construction in gory detail in the next of Headmaster Mort's Edu-tapes! So long... "Bet your chops." Come on, Mort. What was that?

HolotapeName: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.
Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Hello dedicated listeners!

HolotapeName: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.
Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Welcome back to Headmaster Mort's Edu-tapes. Today, in this second tape, we're talking construction.

HolotapeName: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.
Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Now, the first step of construction is-- Wait, what? Is that soda? ...soda's red, right? Oh! Electing! First electing what you're going to build.

HolotapeName: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.
Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Once you've made that election, it's just three easy questions to construction success:

HolotapeName: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.
Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: One: is the location I've selected going to work for an object of the size and shape I'm building? Two: have I read the schematics thoroughly?

HolotapeName: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.
Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: And three: do I have all the required materials to-- who the hell bled on my notes! Sol? If I find out that this was you, you're going to bleed on... whatever. Just finish, Mort.

HolotapeName: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.
Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Short on materials? Loot the local junkyard, mills, and warehouses for parts.

HolotapeName: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.
Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Missing a critical schematic? Your local vendors might have just what you're looking for!

HolotapeName: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.
Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: And on that note, this has been Headmaster Mort's Edu-Tapes... Edu-Tapes... See you again soon... Solomon, so help me, this better be jam! Where are you hiding!?

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Welcome back lovely listeners to Headmaster Mort's final tape in the C.A.M.P. series - powering your C.A.M.P.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: After listening to the second tape, you should already be well-trained enough to build a generator. If you haven't yet done so, I'll wait ...

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: ... ha doot doot doot doot doo, da doot doot doo .... ah, screw it.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Alright. I'll assume you nailed it. Now, generators are the heart of your C.A.M.P. power system.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Once your generator is built, all you need to do is connect it to the object that needs power with a wire.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Though be aware your wire will need a clear, unobstructed path to establish and maintain a direct connection.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Some objects, however, like simple light bulbs, do not require a direct connection.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: All you need to do is run a wire from your generator to a power pylon, place the power pylon near your lights. Then, voila! Let there be light.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Well, this has been Headmaster Mort's C.A.M.P. construction holotapes.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Please check back with Headmaster Mort himself at The Wayward to learn more about his other exciting courses including ...

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: ... "Mort, Can I Still Eat This?" and "Mutations: Am I a Monster Now?"

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: And thanks again for listening... heh. Nailed it.

Speaker: 005852F3:W05_NPCM_GeraldWhitehead_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Maude.

Speaker: 00405EBA:W05_NPCF_Duchess_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Jerry. To what do I owe the pleasure?

Speaker: 005852F3:W05_NPCM_GeraldWhitehead_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Not a social call, Maude. They're coming.

Speaker: 00405EBA:W05_NPCF_Duchess_Wayward:VTYP
Text: You want to be more specific? They who?

Speaker: 005852F3:W05_NPCM_GeraldWhitehead_Wayward:VTYP
Text: BADTFL.

Speaker: 00405EBA:W05_NPCF_Duchess_Wayward:VTYP
Text: The Bureau of Alcohol, Drugs, and No Fun is paying Welch a visit? Says who?

Speaker: 005852F3:W05_NPCM_GeraldWhitehead_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Says me, Duchess. You need to skip town ASAP.

Speaker: 00405EBA:W05_NPCF_Duchess_Wayward:VTYP
Text: You're a crooked cop, Gerald. Associating with known smugglers of firearms and illicit substances. How can you be trusted?

Speaker: 005852F3:W05_NPCM_GeraldWhitehead_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Why are you making this so hard? I'm trying to keep you out of jail.

Speaker: 00405EBA:W05_NPCF_Duchess_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Gerald, please. This hurts to watch. Can we just be honest with each other? I'll start.

Speaker: 005852F3:W05_NPCM_GeraldWhitehead_Wayward:VTYP
Text: What're you...

Speaker: 00405EBA:W05_NPCF_Duchess_Wayward:VTYP
Text: My friends, plural, at the bureau say you've been making some big claims about this Appalachian drug kingpin you're about to bring in.

Speaker: 00405EBA:W05_NPCF_Duchess_Wayward:VTYP
Text: The one you're trying to get rid of so your new friends from Charleston can take her territory.

Speaker: 00405EBA:W05_NPCF_Duchess_Wayward:VTYP
Text: But wouldn't you know, all that extra yammering got them looking into your finances. And your house. And your car. And they didn't like what they found.

Speaker: 00405EBA:W05_NPCF_Duchess_Wayward:VTYP
Text: So yes, Gerald, they're coming. But no one's coming looking for me.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Welcome back, faithful students to the latest of Headmaster Mort's Edu-Tapes! In this segment, the item actively festering in so many of us: mutations.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Prolonged or extreme exposure to radiation can affect the human body in a plethora of different ways:

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Skeletal degeneration, growths where you didn't have growths before...

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: ... your outer layer of skin leaving you like it's some kind of scumbag ex, Jessica. *clears throat*

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Sorry.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Occasionally, however, these mutations will also unlock previously unknown potential inside their recipients.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Your very own Headmaster Mort is now completely immune to further radiation exposure thanks to his mutation.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: We at the Mort Institute have also heard reports of increased mental cognition and empathy, heighted strength...

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: ... and even the development of defensive electrical discharge? What? Seriously, Duchess? I think someone was pulling your leg.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Whatever. Now, I know what you're thinking.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Headmaster, having my own pair of razor sharp talons is great, but what if I just want to live like a normal human being again?

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Well, luckily, there's a clear solution: good, old-fashioned Rad-Away.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Consuming a Rad-Away or two will usually clear up any mutation symptoms, allowing you to return to your previous, dull, unmutated self.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Now, there's a question that may cross your mind once you've acquired a mutation: Mort, does this make me a monster?

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: And let me be definitive here: no, you're not a monster because of your mutation. We're all so much more than what's inflicted on us, mutant or otherwise.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: All of us have experienced loss, desperation, regret just to be alive today. Those things can change us as much as hugging an open reactor core can.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: But what we do with those challenges, with the lives we've all had thrust upon us... that's where humanity lies.

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: You only become a monster if you let the world make you one...

Speaker: 00405EBD:W05_NPCM_Mort_Wayward:VTYP
Text: And with that, we conclude today's lesson on mutations. Tune in again soon for Headmaster Mort's next thrilling edu-venture. Thanks again for listening.

Speaker: 005852EE:W05_NPCM_JamesDuncan_MQ003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: You've truly done it this time, Jonathan. This numeric obsession of yours will be our ruin.

Speaker: 005852EE:W05_NPCM_JamesDuncan_MQ003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: You have reminded me multiple times it's the only house in the city with that number. But leveraging our only--

Speaker: 005852EE:W05_NPCM_JamesDuncan_MQ003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: You what? Don't be a--

Speaker: 005852EE:W05_NPCM_JamesDuncan_MQ003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: Fine. Skinner!

Speaker: 0041A39B:W05_RobotM_Skinner:VTYP
Text: Yes, Mr. Duncan?

Speaker: 005852EE:W05_NPCM_JamesDuncan_MQ003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: My brother refuses to continue our discussion without his evening tea because he is a petulant child. Do fetch him some so we can be done with this.

Speaker: 0041A39B:W05_RobotM_Skinner:VTYP
Text: Mr. Duncan, I hardly mean to be rude, but where, exactly would you like me to bring this tea?

Speaker: 005852EE:W05_NPCM_JamesDuncan_MQ003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: To my brother, you imbecile.

Speaker: 0041A39B:W05_RobotM_Skinner:VTYP
Text: Your brother? ...at the cemetery?

Speaker: 005852EE:W05_NPCM_JamesDuncan_MQ003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: What on earth are you talking about? Go downstairs, make his tea, and bring it to the desk directly in front of you where he is seated.

Speaker: 0041A39B:W05_RobotM_Skinner:VTYP
Text: Sir... there's no one there.

Speaker: 005852EE:W05_NPCM_JamesDuncan_MQ003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: You... you don't see him?

Speaker: 0041A39B:W05_RobotM_Skinner:VTYP
Text: No, sir.

Speaker: 005852EE:W05_NPCM_JamesDuncan_MQ003P_Muscle:VTYP
Text: Well... that simply won't do. Skinner, fetch my toolkit. You're clearly malfunctioning.

Speaker: 0041A39B:W05_RobotM_Skinner:VTYP
Text: ... very well... sir.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Say it again so the mic can here you. The name.

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: C-crane.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: And where is this Crane?

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: I saw him... we were at this bar. The Wayward. Just north of Flatwoods.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: And what does he know?

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: He said he was on the trail of this vault.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: The people kind or the riches kind?

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: The kind that holds stuff.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: The kind that holds stuff. I'll consider the topic clarified. You think it's the treasure?

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: I don't know. He-he didn't say.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Well, seems like that'd be worth finding out, wouldn't it?

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: Y-yes?

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Are you afraid of me?

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: Oh god yes.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Don't be. We're not monsters here. We're pragmatists. You can get off the floor.

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: Are you--you're not going to kill me?

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Not unless you give me a reason. Do you have a place to go?

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: N-no.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Do you want one?

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: ... w-what would you need me to do?

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Go upstairs. Have a meal and a drink, share what you know. Maybe it'll jog some memories. From there... we can talk.

Speaker: 00424A4F:W05_NPCF_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: And if I wanted to leave?

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: We're all free men and women here. A little family. We take care of our own, rest of the world... be damned.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Maggie, we all benefit here. We provide you with protection and you help feed the many, many mouths I have at my camp.

Speaker: 00589614:W05_NPCF_Maggie_MQ002P_Radical_HOLOTAPEONLY:VTYP
Text: You mean you get to take whatever you want and leave us all to starve.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: It won't come to that. I'll see to it personally. Now, do we have a deal?

Speaker: 00589614:W05_NPCF_Maggie_MQ002P_Radical_HOLOTAPEONLY:VTYP
Text: You can take your deal and shove it! We're not your slaves! If you want our food, you'll can--hrck. Hrrr. HRRR. Ah-ahck!

Speaker: 0053C2FF:W05_NPCM_Daniel_Wayward:VTYP
Text: S-sorry, Maggie. The rest of us are in agreement. We'll bring you shipments once a season.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Once a month.

Speaker: 0053C2FF:W05_NPCM_Daniel_Wayward:VTYP
Text: Once a month. I'll deliver it personally.

Speaker: 0040F6BA:W05_NPCM_Roper_MQ002P_Radical:VTYP
Text: Good. Password to get inside is Blue Danube. Pleasure doing business with you.

Speaker: 003F0747:P01B_Lying_OfficerCavit_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Lewisburg. A small town of big dreams, but just underneath that shining veneer lies and undercurrent of mystery and mischief.

Speaker: 003F0747:P01B_Lying_OfficerCavit_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Take one Calvin van Lowe as an example. Just your average--

Speaker: 003F0748:P01B_Lying_OfficerSidney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: What the hell, Klein? Are you recording again?

Speaker: 003F0747:P01B_Lying_OfficerCavit_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: That a problem for you, Sidney? My novel needs this kind of professional realism.

Speaker: 003F0748:P01B_Lying_OfficerSidney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Uh-huh. And you think it's within the realm of "professional realism" to just yammer on instead of actually doing your job?

Speaker: 003F0748:P01B_Lying_OfficerSidney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Can we just head over to the Van Lowe place now? We need to interview the sister about his last known whereabouts.

Speaker: 003F0747:P01B_Lying_OfficerCavit_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Family. The bonds that tie us, the roots that hold us. But also the key ingredient in... fratricide.

Speaker: 003F0748:P01B_Lying_OfficerSidney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Knock it off! Let's get... hey. Check out that guy in the fancy suit. Ever seen him around here before?

Speaker: 003F0747:P01B_Lying_OfficerCavit_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Nope. Looks like he's snooping around, though. Isn't that the Garbers' summer home? The one with the flamingo out front? They left town weeks ago.

Speaker: 003F0748:P01B_Lying_OfficerSidney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: We should check this out. Let's go.

Speaker: 003F0748:P01B_Lying_OfficerSidney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Alright, stay close, let's creep up to the corner here.

Speaker: 003F0747:P01B_Lying_OfficerCavit_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: A fancy suit... dark glasses... and a motive for... murder?

Speaker: 003F0748:P01B_Lying_OfficerSidney_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You can't seriously be recording still.

Speaker: 003F0747:P01B_Lying_OfficerCavit_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Does it matter? Look, he's just making repairs on that grill.

Speaker: 003F0746:P01B_Lying_Wolf_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Good afternoon, gentlemen.

Speaker: 003F0746:P01B_Lying_Wolf_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: *Silenced gun shots, footsteps along wood floor*

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Right, let's see here... the script begins on page twenty-five, so... aha. Here we are.

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Ahem... "Now beginning behavioral reprogramming on model number," uh... RX, zero, zero... and so on.

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I, Calvin van Lowe, hereby agree... accountability... death and or dismemberment... blah, blah, blah...

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Well, that was a waste of time. Listen here, Ms. Assaultron; I'm going to be augmenting your behavioral subroutines.

Speaker: 0006E5A2:RobotAssaultron:VTYP
Text: Acknowledged.

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Okay, then I'll just... insert the data... here... Did that work?

Speaker: 0006E5A2:RobotAssaultron:VTYP
Text: Received: custom behavior parameters: "Sheepsquatch"

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Excellent. Now, this next part might seem a little odd... And, to anyone listening, I assure you, this is necessary!

Speaker: 0006E5A2:RobotAssaultron:VTYP
Text: Received: custom behavior parameters: "Sheepsquatch Mating Rituals." Error: request conflicts with guidelines. Report filed.

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Wait, wait, no! It's nothing like... it's nature, it's for-just wait! Execute administrative override!

Speaker: 0006E5A2:RobotAssaultron:VTYP
Text: Received: request for overwrite. Confirmation needed.

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Uh... I confirm!

Speaker: 0006E5A2:RobotAssaultron:VTYP
Text: Confirmed. Primary behavior will be overwritten with submitted routine: "Sheepsquatch." Re-booting.

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Wait, no, don't overwrite! I said override! It should only augment-- what are you-- wait! No!

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: <Screaming, clatter, death wails>

Speaker: 0006E5A2:RobotAssaultron:VTYP
Text: Baa...

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: Raymond is dead. I heard his scream, I heard the beast's howl. I know it was him. He's gone.

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: I told him in my note at camp not to follow me. Why didn't he listen?

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: I tracked this monster down to a cave towards Beckley. He... he has to be between the cave and the pond.

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: This beast has a litter of pups. I was going to call the hunt off entirely... but now... now I'm finishing it. For good.

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: I'll go to Beckley and get help after I'm done with it. Then we'll... take care of Raymond. My poor dear fool.

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: *cocks gun*

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: I should have killed that beast when I had the chance. I'm coming for you, you piece of ---

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: *screaming*

Speaker: 003F5E8C:U02_NPCM_RaymondPriblo:VTYP
Text: It's a long drive, so I may as well rehearse this before I say it to her face. Breathe, Raymond... you can do it. She'll listen.

Speaker: 003F5E8C:U02_NPCM_RaymondPriblo:VTYP
Text: Ok, ok. I'm gonna say... "Janelle, honey, I will help you kill this critter but we gotta get back to basics so the business can survive."

Speaker: 003F5E8C:U02_NPCM_RaymondPriblo:VTYP
Text: Hmm.. maybe I should remind her that none of the experimental taxidermies sold last month. Ugh. No, that's mean. She loved making them.

Speaker: 003F5E8C:U02_NPCM_RaymondPriblo:VTYP
Text: Ok, ok, ok. Let's see. More supportive. "I want you to keep being able to make your art... it brings a smile to your face that I always want to see."

Speaker: 003F5E8C:U02_NPCM_RaymondPriblo:VTYP
Text: But going off to hunt real... monsters? It's too dangerous! We're just trappers, and most of what we get is roadkill! *sigh*

Speaker: 003F5E8C:U02_NPCM_RaymondPriblo:VTYP
Text: Calvin buys almost all our stock every month. It's good money. It's enough for your weird.. art... No! Don't make her feel bad, damn it.

Speaker: 003F5E8C:U02_NPCM_RaymondPriblo:VTYP
Text: Ok, I should just go drop these cages off and go find her. I'm making a big deal over nothing. We can figure this out together.

Speaker: 003F5E8C:U02_NPCM_RaymondPriblo:VTYP
Text: *turns off engine*

Speaker: 003F5E8C:U02_NPCM_RaymondPriblo:VTYP
Text: Ok, I'm here. Now... I need to drop off these cages by the pond and then I'll go to her tent. I can do this.

Speaker: 003F743A:P01B_Mini_Random04_Mary_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I win!

Speaker: 003F7439:P01B_Mini_Random04_Chelsea_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Again? Ugh. You always beat me.

Speaker: 003F743A:P01B_Mini_Random04_Mary_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Aha, that's right. Come on, let's go wading! It doesn't look deep.

Speaker: 003F7439:P01B_Mini_Random04_Chelsea_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Fine. I'm tired of board games anyway.

Speaker: 003F743A:P01B_Mini_Random04_Mary_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Be careful. The rocks are slippery.

Speaker: 003F7439:P01B_Mini_Random04_Chelsea_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Ahh! Please stop!

Speaker: 003F743A:P01B_Mini_Random04_Mary_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Stop struggling!

Speaker: 003F7439:P01B_Mini_Random04_Chelsea_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Help!

Speaker: 003F743A:P01B_Mini_Random04_Mary_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: You're just making this harder. I've almost got you.

Speaker: 003F743A:P01B_Mini_Random04_Mary_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Chelsea? Chelsea?

Speaker: 0046486C:U02_NPCF_CindyHolloway:VTYP
Text: Wow... It's a really nice night, isn't it? The stars are beautiful here. Not like at home.

Speaker: 003F1865:U02_NPCM_MichaelTurner:VTYP
Text: Yeah, um, definitely. It's good to be out here. Lots of stuff that you can't find in the suburbs, like, um, big... trees.

Speaker: 003F1865:U02_NPCM_MichaelTurner:VTYP
Text: Did you hear something?

Speaker: 0046486C:U02_NPCF_CindyHolloway:VTYP
Text: What? No... Stop trying to scare me! You're so silly, Michael.

Speaker: 0046486C:U02_NPCF_CindyHolloway:VTYP
Text: Brrr... It got really cold outside. And I'm only wearing this flimsy sundress...

Speaker: 003F1865:U02_NPCM_MichaelTurner:VTYP
Text: Why'd you wear something so thin to a camping trip?

Speaker: 0046486C:U02_NPCF_CindyHolloway:VTYP
Text: Well... You know, I... Michael, I was hoping you would... *distant howl*

Speaker: 0046486D:U02_NPCM_ToxicLarry:VTYP
Text: (distant) Hahaha! There's the beastie!
*gunshots*

Speaker: 003F1865:U02_NPCM_MichaelTurner:VTYP
Text: No way. That must have been the Sheepsquatch.

Speaker: 0046486C:U02_NPCF_CindyHolloway:VTYP
Text: What? Michael, wait up, are you crazy? You don't know who lives up at that psycho shack- Michael, wait!

Speaker: 0046486D:U02_NPCM_ToxicLarry:VTYP
Text: I smell... new meat. Warm blood. Strong muscles. A stench like it's been around for centuries, hiding in my lands, feeding on my prey...

Speaker: 0046486D:U02_NPCM_ToxicLarry:VTYP
Text: Well not anymore it don't. I've caught the creature's scent. *long inhale* And it's near tonight.

Speaker: 0046486D:U02_NPCM_ToxicLarry:VTYP
Text: Some dumb kids lit a campfire down the hill... but I won't let them ruin my hunt. I'll take care of them... *long inhale* Won't I, little beastie?

Speaker: 0046486D:U02_NPCM_ToxicLarry:VTYP
Text: Then you can come on by and let me have a taste of you.

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Note to, uh, self. Calvin. Keep it together.

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I have... I mean, "You" have a real job to do. You can't be distracted by your academic pursuits-- no, no, "fantasies." This is too important.

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: <sigh> But if you're listening to this, it means you're slipping. So, repeat after me: the Sheepsquatch isn't real. The Sheepsquatch... isn't real....

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: But... if it is, then I could... Interesting, I hadn't considered that. I wonder if I still have that article... No! Hey! No! Stay focused, stay on task!

Speaker: 0046A37F:P01B_Lying_CalvinVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If you screw up, you know what will happen... So... This is so stupid. Calvin. Me. Just... concentrate. God... and get back to work!

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
