Text: Hello. I assume you're listening to me now because you followed the poster. Well, I'm Shelley van Lowe and I'm looking for my brother.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Let me spoil the surprise now: my brother wasn't eaten by a damn Sheepsquatch, or at least, I doubt that's the case.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: But I think Calvin's obsession with proving it exists may have more than a little to do with his disappearance.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Calvin is... not right. Never been. When he suddenly showed up in town after years of being away, I knew there was something strange going on.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Next thing I know, he's vanished. All his belongings still here, him: gone. But it doesn't feel right, he didn't just move out again.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I contacted the police about trying to find him, but the war broke out and... well, I'm sure you know how it all went.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: So, I'll get to the point: I'm leaving Lewisburg, I don't have a choice. But, I can't just forget Calvin.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If you think you can help, then please... Head up to the office on the third floor. See if you can pick up his trail.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If Calvin is still out there, he needs to know I'm looking for him. And if he's not... well, I think that's something I need to know, too.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: My little brother, Calvin, and I grew up in this strange old place. Our folks ran the shop downstairs and when they passed, the business ended up with me.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Calvin was always the odd sort... and smart, too. After college, he ran off to work for some big-shot company out of state. Barely heard from him after that.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Calvin has... conditions; obsessions. A "research project?" I didn't buy it. It wouldn't surprise me if this had nothing to do with his job, if he even had one.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: (sigh) The last time I saw Calvin was right before I went away for the weekend. Not even a goodbye. When I came back, he was gone.

Speaker: 0046A384:P01B_Lying_ShelleyVanLowe_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The only thing Calvin ever cared about was this god damn Sheepsquatch... I know that's the root of his disappearance, I have no doubt about it.

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: Raymond, I'll mail you a list of things I need tomorrow. But I wanted to tell you what I found, first hand. This is big.

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: This is the real deal. I found a dead bear, shredded by... something, I don't know. I met a woman in Beckley who said there is a pale monster up here. The Beast, she said.

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: Listen, this thing... if it is half as weird as it sounds... it could be a gold mine. Crazy Calvin would pay out the nose for it!

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: Raymond, this is a game changer. We could finally buy the shop outright... or we could get a new truck, or hire some help.

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: Ok, please bring those supplies to my old fishing camp near the pond north of Beckley. This is where I caught that two-headed fish, remember?

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: There's probably a map to my hunting camp in my old truck by the shop. So drive down here and come look for my camp. Park near my car on the road.

Speaker: 0046A5DE:U02_NPCF_JanellePriblo:VTYP
Text: Ok... oh and um, Raymond - I'm sorry I've been on the hunt for almost two weeks. I know it's taken longer than usual... but baby I really think it'll be worth it this time!

Speaker: 003F0746:P01B_Lying_Wolf_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Bo Peep, you failed to make our meeting. How very unlike you.

Speaker: 003F0746:P01B_Lying_Wolf_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm going to give you the benefit of the doubt. You never struck me as someone who would skip town when things go south.

Speaker: 003F0746:P01B_Lying_Wolf_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm going to take a walk in the park. Maybe we'll bump into each other.

Speaker: 003F0746:P01B_Lying_Wolf_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If I get back and you're here, then I'll forget all about that missed meeting.

Speaker: 003F0746:P01B_Lying_Wolf_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: If I get back and you're not? Then we have a problem.
Welcome contestants!

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's... Overseer's personal journal...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I found him. Evan. He's down there, just like I thought he'd be. But I... I didn't think he'd be... one of those things. The green lesions on his face...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Oh god... I did this to him. It's all my fault.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: They told me I could have Vault 76, but not... not if I was married. They would've had to give Evan a spousal exemption and give him space in the Vault.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: But... there was someone more qualified. A civil engineer, someone with the skills to help rebuild. He was a distant cousin of a Vault-Tec executive and almost made the cut...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: 76 was for the best and brightest, and Evan didn't qualify. Deep down, I knew they were right.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: So I broke off the engagement. I... sacrificed him. For the Vault. For Appalachia.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I know what I have to do, but I... I just can't. I love him. I already killed him once, I can't do it again.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Please, I gave 76 everything. You were all so brilliant. The first few years were hard, but we learned to trust each other. You learned to trust me. I was young... So young... Younger than most of you. But you accepted me as your Overseer.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: So I need you to do this for me. Let Evan rest. He didn't deserve any of this.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: The Scorched. Eliminating this plague. It's not just about survival now. It's personal. We have to secure the nukes. Wipe this disease off the map.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's personal journal.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I was in my junior year when I got the news that mom died. Mining accident. Everyone in West Virginia has a story like that in the family. You just... you never think it's going to be you.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Dad was in pieces. I started living in the library more than before, and I was already there most days to begin with.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: And Evan... god... Evan. Mom had introduced us just a few months before. Graduated a year ahead of me, went right to work in the mines. So handsome. And those arms. What West Virginia girl could resist all that?

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I can't believe he stuck with me. After the funeral, I didn't want anyone around, but there he was. Showing up in the library after his shift with a lunchbox for us to share. Every day.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: When the career fair came, and I met the people from Vault-Tec, it was like a light turned on. Protecting families, protecting their future, protecting... America.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: The first thing I did when I got the acceptance letter to Vault-Tec University was head over to mom's grave with dad. He was happy that I was staying in West Virginia. So was I.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's personal journal.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Four years of living, learning, and breathing Vault-Tec. Graduating with honors in the Overseer track. Dad was so proud. He came out even though he was already so sick.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I must have impressed the right people, because I was offered the next available Overseer slot. I had just graduated! It was supposed to take years. Maybe they knew the War was inevitable.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: When I learned that 76 was going to be built, I was so excited I jumped right out of my chair and did a little dance around the living room. Appalachia would be safe, no matter what happened.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Evan chose that moment to propose, that lughead. He knew I wouldn't say no after hearing the news. He knew me better than anyone...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Dad died a few months after Evan and I moved in together. He really wanted to walk me down the aisle. Well, I didn't really get to walk down there, either, so... *cough as tears well up, then sigh*

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I think it's time I went home. I owe Evan that much.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's personal journal.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Vault 76 was built to take the best and brightest, but... that wasn't what all the Vaults were for.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: The Societal Preservation Program. I wasn't supposed to know about it, but when I found out...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Evan wanted me to tell the press, but... I didn't.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Yes, experimenting on Vault residents was ethically wrong, but the goal of finding the most suitable people to repopulate, to understand humanity pushed to the extremes, what if that was the only way for us to survive?

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: We can't save everyone. That's what they always told us. And I thought... I still think... they were right.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Vault-Tec found out that I knew. I thought I was going to be fired, or arrested, but instead they confided in me. Vault 76 was going to be a control Vault. No experiment.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I was so relieved, but... they told me I was going to be assigned to Vault 101, in Washington DC. I had to leave West Virginia... my people... behind.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I couldn't let them do that. No matter what it took.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I'm so sorry, Evan. I wish I could say I would've made another choice. That I would've picked dying in this house together when the bombs fell.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I never stopped thinking about you, and I'm not giving up until I find out what happened. If you're not here, then there's only one other place you'd want to be. The mines.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's... let's call these personal journals. Not an official log. Just... something for me.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: The Agricultural Center. One of my first posts with Vault-Tec. I was so excited because I used to come to this same farm when I was a kid.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I remember one year... at the Autumn Festival. Me running through the corn maze. Going every which way. Mom and dad yelling after me to slow down. Ha! Wasn't going to happen.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I guess I was always hitting life fast. Couldn't just be a Pioneer Scout, I had to make troupe leader. Couldn't just be a good student, I had to have straight A's.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: God, I miss those early days. Just... being a kid. The three of us. Our simple life. Our simple house. I wonder if it's still standing...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Hi mom. Hi dad. I'm home. I'm sorry it's been so long. I... I couldn't get away.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I know neither of you is around to hear this. But I miss you. I miss watching dad grade papers on the living room table. I miss the three of us huddled around the radio, listening to "The Silver Shroud."

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Dad, you were right about what living underground would really be like. Twenty-five years locked in with the same people was a... challenge.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: But watching them pair up, get married, have children... I think I got to know a little bit of what you and mom were always telling me.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Well, since I'm doing this whole trip down memory lane, maybe a walk over to the old high school is in order...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. South of Vault 76.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I knew this wasn't going to be the Appalachia I remembered, but... mutated animals, haywire bots, and no people so far...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: We have to be ready to rebuild in - what I can confirm - is hostile territory. Fortunately, Vault-Tec was prepared.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: You see this? The cooking station, the stash box, the workbenches. All built with the C.A.M.P.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: You need a home base out there. The Construction and Assembly Mobile Platform is designed to give you one. Just add resources, planning, and a little elbow grease.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: When you move your C.A.M.P., everything you've built is stored, ready to be placed back down in the new area. Use this to establish a foothold whenever you're in unfamiliar territory.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I've left my C.A.M.P. behind so you can use it.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I know I'm breaking my own advice by not taking it with me, but after seeing Appalachia for myself, I need to make sure every resident of 76 has a safe haven they can start from. I'll make do without it.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: If it's still standing, the town of Flatwoods is further down this road. Find me there.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: This is Overseer. Signing off.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I had a directive from Vault-Tec: secure the region's three nuclear missile silos. I... WE... had to make sure they didn't fall into the wrong hands.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I knew I couldn't do it alone, so I asked you -- my Vault 76 family -- for help. And what did you do?

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: My God... Why? How could you do this? We were supposed to take control of the nukes. Not engage in an Appalachian arms race!

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Please, stop this madness. The cycle of destruction has to stop.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I... I haven't lost faith in you. I know you are GOOD people, and will do the right thing. If anything I've... lost my faith in Vault-Tec.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: They gave me a mission I could never accomplish on my own. They must have known I'd need your help.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Did they also know what you'd do? It's just so hard not to feel... manipulated.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log, or should I say, direct communication. Because whoever is listening to this had the moxy to try to find out where I've gone.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: But I'm glad you did. Truth is, I need your help. I've been given a task, and... I've decided to break protocol and tell you what it is.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Because If there's one thing I've learned in these past few years, it's that we need to rely on each other.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: There were three active nuclear silos in Appalachia before the bombs fell. They blew up the world before. We can't let it happen again.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: So we've got to locate and secure all of the silos, or die trying. Hopefully the former. Hmph.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: But it's been twenty-five years. I just don't know what we're going to find out there. Or where to start...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: My directive was to go to the nearest population center and assess the situation. I'll set up a C.A.M.P. on the way once I get my bearings. Find me there.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Town of Flatwoods.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: My God... there's no one here. The old tavern, the church. People were using them for shelter, but... they're gone.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Mutations we expected, but there's something else... a disease. I was attacked by... well, it used to be a person.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: But it had these green, glowing lesions. And its voice... Angry, tortured. "We are one." One what?

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Whatever happened here is beyond anything we expected. And we expected a lot.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Before they were wiped out, the survivors called themselves the Responders. Looks like they were made of firefighters, police, emergency medical staff.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: They even have an automated system to teach people about treating water, food, survival.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I'm doing their tests, and you should too.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I know it's even worse than we imagined. But someone's got to know where the missile silos are and how to secure them.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: The Responders are the best lead we have.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: This is the Overseer. Signing off.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Morgantown.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I used to love coming here on weekends. Taking flight lessons. Now it feels like I walked into a nightmare.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Those "Scorched" things are everywhere. I kept quiet... they didn't see me... I managed to observe them for a bit.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Whatever this disease is, it seems to completely take over its host.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: The ones that used to be human, eventually they... go rigid. Like some kind of stasis.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: And if they stay like that too long, they sort of... burn up. From the inside out. Vesuvius in reverse.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I wondered what could possibly cause all this, and then I got my answer. It swooped down from the sky. Screeching. Breathing. INFECTING everything.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I don't know how to fight this. But we need to consider all of our options. Even the nukes.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: We find the source of this Scorched plague and wipe it from the map before it can leave Appalachia.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: But first thing's first. We can't let the disease spread to us. Looks like the Responders were developing some kind of inoculation.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I'm going to pick up their work. You should too. This is the Overseer. Signing off.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's Log. Missile Silo Bravo.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: The security systems are still operational, just like at site Alpha. My guess is that site Charlie will be the same story, but I need to be sure.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Still have no idea how I'm going to get the military credentials to gain access.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: My hope, my fear, is that some other group of survivors tried to figure this out as well. We just have to keep looking.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Grafton.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: The "mayor" of Grafton used to be the automated assistant, and it's gone completely mad. Still trying to run the town. Even holds elections for itself.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: We built these machines to do things without us... and they have. It might be useful if I played along.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: *cough* Overseer's log... Somewhere in the mountains...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: *labored breathing* Ooohhhh... Not good, not good, not good.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Just-just trying not... Trying to focus. But the pain is unreal. So bad... Want to do this now while I can... I'm... I'm afraid I might... pass out.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Was attacked... Some kind of... I think it was wearing a gas mask... a heavy coat... But-but not human... Not human...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: No stimpaks left. Funny joke in here about... practicing what you preach... This is... this is... the Overseer. Signing off. Hopefully not for the last time...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Camp McClintock.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: *phew* Maybe I'm going crazy, but it was nice to put on the uniform and play pretend with a bunch of robot drill sergeants.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I actually think I learned a thing or two about marksmanship.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I wonder, now that I'm in the Army, is my official title "Overseer Private" or "Private Overseer"? *laughs*

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Time to see if I can fool a few automated identification systems.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Charleston Capitol.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: If automation still rules West Virginia, then Charleston is the heart of the machine.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Bureaucracy still pumping away, without any people to serve. There's a lesson there somewhere.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Dealing with these terminal systems like it's just a normal day in America is... somewhere between disturbingly comforting and completely insane.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: But there's a lot of secrets in this old capitol that we'll need to find.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Allegheny.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: A mental asylum as a last stand against the Scorched. Brave, crazy, and crazy-brave, the Army way...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: At least, I'm pretty sure the Brotherhood had former US Army members judging by the security systems.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: If only they had survived. What I wouldn't give to have a few of America's finest watching my back right now.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: As it is, I'll have to find out how they were planning to combat the Scorched on my own. Once I can figure out a way through these doors...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Charleston Fire Department.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Automation used to define life in West Virginia, now it's the only thing left.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: These training programs that the Responders have set up; how many survivors were running through these?

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: It takes a certain calling to voluntarily run into the middle of a fire. Rescue people. Looks like they kept up that spirit even as the dangers changed.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: They must have fought the Scorched up close more than anyone. I need to find out what they knew.

HolotapeName: Overseer's Log - Top of the World
Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Top of the World.

HolotapeName: Overseer's Log - Top of the World
Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: There's someone in control of this old ski resort, and if I ever find her, I'm going wash her mouth out with the first thing vaguely resembling soap I can get my hands on. *exasperated grunt of disgust*

HolotapeName: Overseer's Log - Top of the World
Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Selfish. That's the word. Maybe that's why she's alone. Maybe that's why she's survived. But the only way she'll tell me what she knows is if I help her first.

HolotapeName: Overseer's Log - Top of the World
Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: All the good people I've learned about who've died, and it's the sociopath who still gets to live...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Free States Bunker.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Sam Blackwell and Raleigh Clay. Those damn traitors and their secessionists turned their backs on America to form their "Free States."

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Concrete bunkers. You'd never get that past a Vault-Tec Radiation Proofing inspection, that's for sure.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Sounds like they let go of their paranoia long enough to seek out help from the other survivors.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Just have to hack this terminal. See what they left behind in there, and what they wanted to do.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Camp Venture.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Just who was this Brotherhood of Steel? Survivalists? Former Army personnel? They took their training and their call signs seriously, that's for certain.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Organized, efficient, access to hardware. You'd think they'd be ruling West Virginia by now, but they're gone.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: If they're following military logic, then they'll have a fortified headquarters somewhere. And a leader. Someone who knew what they were planning.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's log. Fort Defiance.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: The more I travel this godforsaken "Wasteland," the more I realize what truly destroyed West Virginia.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: And what destroyed any chance the survivors had of... actually surviving. Mistrust.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: All these divergent groups... Responders, Brotherhood of Steel, whatever.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Separately, they had everything necessary to beat the odds. Brains, brawn, and bravado to spare.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: And what did they do? Close ranks. Get paranoid. Refuse to work with one another.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: And it cost them all their lives.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: People of Vault 76, if you're listening... DO NOT fall into the same trap.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: You find each other. You work with each other. Only TOGETHER will you win.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: This is your Overseer. And I'm begging you, please...

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Save our country.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's Log. Missile Silo Alpha.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: No one's here. Not even any military survivors. That might be for the best. I don't think Vault-Tec asserting jurisdiction over the nukes would've gone over well.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: But, that also means I'm locked out. Access is restricted to the highest ranking officers. It's not going to be easy to fool.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: If we can't secure these sites... My god... the automated factory in the silo... Just how many nukes can it make?

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: Overseer's Log. Missile Silo Charlie.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: I've now verified that all three missile silos still have fully operational security.

Speaker: 004E4A12:NPCF_Overseer:VTYP
Text: No way inside, yet, but I'll scour all of Appalachia if I have to.

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: Ross, if you don't sign those permits, I'm going to -- to - I don't know what. But I'll do something you don't like.

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: The beaver population is on the verge of collapse.

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: What are you talking about?! We had a family of beavers waltzing through our goddamn offices just last week! They are out of control!

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: That's because they've been displaced by your flagrant and continued disregard for their habitat. You never should have authorized that camping exhibition.

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: You know those Scout masters are complete morons --

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: Takes one to know one.

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: - and those boys, don't get me started on how reckless and cruel those little psychopaths-in-training are.

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: That's not fair. Hunting and trapping are important skills every boy should learn.

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: They eat four course meals out of boxes their robot nannies pull out of nuclear powered microwaves!

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: Just sign the damn hunting permits, Ross.

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: No.

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: Wait - are your recording this?!

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: Maybe...

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: Damnit! Gimme that.

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: You going to turn that thing on every time I walk over here now?

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: You going to keep physically abusing me every time I tell you "no" about something?

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: You're such a baby.

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: No, I'm a caring and sensitive individual, which is precisely the type of person we need protecting our wildlife.

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: If you had your way, no one would even visit the park!

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: And if you had yours, we'd let in every maniac with a gun to shoot up the place.

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: Not everyone with a gun is a maniac, Ross. And there's nothing wrong with hunting. It's a manly sport, a time honored tradition --

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: It's murder.

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: It's hunting.

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: Why are you a Ranger, anyway?

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: Because I love nature, and I want to preserve it so that people can enjoy it. Same as you.

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: By "enjoy" you mean "destroy," right?

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: For Christ's sake, Ross! I'm not a monster - Hey, what's that?

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: A trashcan?

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: So that's where my Dandy Boy Apples went. Into your goddamn mouth.

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: I don't know what you're talking about.

Speaker: 002B8D38:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Simon_Male:VTYP
Text: Gimme that!

Speaker: 002B8D39:Holotape_CBLore_RangerOffice_Ross_Male:VTYP
Text: Get away from me!

Speaker: 002B8D3C:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_OldFashionedMom_Female:VTYP
Text: I don't want you hanging around that boy who moved in next door. He's a dirty hippy. I think I can even smell drugs on him!

Speaker: 002B8D3C:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_OldFashionedMom_Female:VTYP
Text: The ladies at the Society are beginning to talk about you. You have no idea how mean those ladies can be.

Speaker: 002B8D3C:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_OldFashionedMom_Female:VTYP
Text: I need you to comport yourself like the lady your father and I raised you to be.

Speaker: 002B8D3D:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_LiberatedDaughter_Female:VTYP
Text: Mom, "that boy" isn't a hippy, he's an artist. Hippies are poor. He's loaded.

Speaker: 002B8D3D:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_LiberatedDaughter_Female:VTYP
Text: And that's not drugs, that's patchouli... okay, and maybe with a little sweat mixed in. I think it's sexy smelling.

Speaker: 002B8D3D:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_LiberatedDaughter_Female:VTYP
Text: Just tell those stuck up hags to get a grip. They don't just let anyone live here. He's bona fide.

Speaker: 002B8D3C:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_OldFashionedMom_Female:VTYP
Text: Deidre. Dear... I mean it. That boy will bring you nothing but trouble!

Speaker: 002B8D3C:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_OldFashionedMom_Female:VTYP
Text: Artists are known for their hedonist life styles. I don't what you associated with sordid things.

Speaker: 002B8D3C:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_OldFashionedMom_Female:VTYP
Text: It's not good for either of our reputations. And a good reputation is the only thing a lady can cling to in this world.

Speaker: 002B8D3C:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_OldFashionedMom_Female:VTYP
Text: And for the love of God, don't ever again use the word "sexy" in my presence!

Speaker: 002B8D3D:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_LiberatedDaughter_Female:VTYP
Text: Mom, I love you, but you're too old fashioned. I'm going to do what makes me happy, other people's opinions be damned.

Speaker: 002B8D3D:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_LiberatedDaughter_Female:VTYP
Text: My reputation is my own, forged by me, not your friends, not you, and definitely not some boy.

Speaker: 002B8D3D:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_LiberatedDaughter_Female:VTYP
Text: Besides, our relationship is strictly business. I've lined up some buyers for his latest work. See, that marketing degree hasn't gone so unutilized, has it?

Speaker: 002B8D3D:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_LiberatedDaughter_Female:VTYP
Text: I'm making a hefty commission. Just between the two us though, I think his work sucks.

Speaker: 002B8D45:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_YoungGirl_Female:VTYP
Text: Help!

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: Stay calm, citizen. Watoga Emergency Services is here to assist you.

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: Please state the nature of your emergency.

Speaker: 002B8D45:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_YoungGirl_Female:VTYP
Text: Mr. Sparkles is in the tree.

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: Citizen, clarify. What is a "Mr. Sparkles?"

Speaker: 002B8D45:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_YoungGirl_Female:VTYP
Text: A cat. And he's in that tree!

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: A cat is in the tree.

Speaker: 002B8D45:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_YoungGirl_Female:VTYP
Text: Yeah! He shouldn't be in there!

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: The cat should not be in the tree. Is this correct, Citizen?

Speaker: 002B8D45:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_YoungGirl_Female:VTYP
Text: Yes! Hurry!

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: Citizen, please stand back.

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: <Sound of laser blasts>

Speaker: 002B8D45:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_YoungGirl_Female:VTYP
Text: *Shrieking* No!!!

Speaker: 0006E5A1:RobotProtectron:VTYP
Text: Situation under control. Cat is no longer in tree.

Speaker: 002B8D45:Holotape_CBLore_Watoga_YoungGirl_Female:VTYP
Text: Mr. Sparkles...

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: Stuck. Again.

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: Carmen thinks I should document when this happens so we can sue the company.

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: I don't know about all that, it's not really their fault, but there's not all that much to do while I'm in here, so here goes.

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: It wasn't easy reaching the recorder, but I think I got it turned on.

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: At least this time I'm in a section you can see from the hallway, so I shouldn't have to wait long. What luck there's -

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: <Muffled sounds of banging on the other side of glass>

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: Michael?! Not again. You okay in there?!

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: Yeah! I mean - it's getting a little hot in here - but yeah, I guess I'm okay!

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: *sigh* So embarrassing...

Speaker: 00013AD2:MaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: What's that buddy? Didn't hear you!

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: Nothing! Forget it!

Speaker: 00013ADD:FemaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: I'm calling maintenance right now. Hang in there, Michael!

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: <Sound of rushing air and a small pneumatic "ca-thunk">

Speaker: 003CB22F:Holotape_CBLore_AMS_OverweightAccountant_Male:VTYP
Text: Great. There goes another hair piece.

Speaker: 000CEAA2:FemaleOld:VTYP
Text: Things are going well. Those Watogan society ladies are falling over themselves to buy my merchandise.

Speaker: 000CEAA2:FemaleOld:VTYP
Text: I've had to resort to "distressing" things myself. Seems to be working.

Speaker: 000CEAA2:FemaleOld:VTYP
Text: I'm going to be able to move to Watoga myself soon enough if this continues.

Speaker: 003CB231:Holotape_CBLore_Bootlegger_Male:VTYP
Text: I'll show those little Watogan Highshcool shits. Think they can intimidate me?! Ha. Let's see how they like them changes I made to their batch.

Speaker: 003CB231:Holotape_CBLore_Bootlegger_Male:VTYP
Text: Might just explode in their bellies. Bless their hearts.

Speaker: 003CB232:Holotape_CBLore_CivicCenter_Female:VTYP
Text: Eugene! You got to tell me when you're going to program them to fail. I lost five big-ones last night. Jesus.

Speaker: 003CB232:Holotape_CBLore_CivicCenter_Female:VTYP
Text: Also, I found the holotape I left you just laying around. Be more careful!

Speaker: 003CB232:Holotape_CBLore_CivicCenter_Female:VTYP
Text: Eugene. You smart bastard. You were right! No one notices that those things won every single night this week.

Speaker: 003CB232:Holotape_CBLore_CivicCenter_Female:VTYP
Text: I mean, they're going to have to catch on sometime, right?

Speaker: 003CB232:Holotape_CBLore_CivicCenter_Female:VTYP
Text: Which means we should probably make them lose sometimes, right? To keep it seeming on the regular?

Speaker: 003CB234:Holotape_CBLore_FloodedTrainyward_OldWoman_Female:VTYP
Text: That was a sight to see. Near a hundred cars slamming on together. What a sound.

Speaker: 003CB234:Holotape_CBLore_FloodedTrainyward_OldWoman_Female:VTYP
Text: I had no idea things that heavy could fly like that. Was like watching dominos tossed by a toddler.

Speaker: 003CB234:Holotape_CBLore_FloodedTrainyward_OldWoman_Female:VTYP
Text: When they hit the levee, I was sure I was gonna be washed away. But I'm still here. But everything's wrecked past fixing.

Speaker: 003CB234:Holotape_CBLore_FloodedTrainyward_OldWoman_Female:VTYP
Text: I need to find a new place to stay. Those pumps don't got it in them.

Speaker: 003CB234:Holotape_CBLore_FloodedTrainyward_OldWoman_Female:VTYP
Text: But I'll never forget that day. Not as long as I live. However long that is. Think I caught that skin thing people been getting. Can't stop itching.

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: All right, settle down now. I'm listening.

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: You recording this?! You agreed this was gonna be private.

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: This is just so we all have a record of what's discussed, is all.

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: Yeah right. You're going to use that to get me canned.

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: Look, I'm on your side. I --

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: The hell you are!

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: I AM on your side. But I got a boss, too. I've kept as many of you on as I could -

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: At a quarter of our wages.

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: Billy, I -

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: Cut our wages.

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: Damnit can I finish a sentence?!

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: ... It was either that or cut more of you completely. I couldn't do that. We're all family here. I'm trying. This isn't easy for any of us.

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: It's easier for those damn eggheads.

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: I know. I don't like those pocket protectors any more than you. I'd put them out on their scrawny butts if I could.

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: But, like it or not, that glass of theirs is paying the bills.

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: Not my bills, it ain't.

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: What would you have me do, Billy? Really.

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: What's one them scientist salaries? Got to be, what, ten of ours. What if there was a little... "accident?"

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: ... Billy! You aren't being serious!

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: Maybe I am, maybe I ain't. All I'm saying -- what the...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: *Sound of distant explosion*

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: There's nothing scheduled that'd cause a quake like that. What the hell was that?!

Speaker: 003CB236:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Worker_Billy_Male:VTYP
Text: Wa'nt ain't me, boss... Honest!

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: Respirators. Now!

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: There was an accident...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: bucket at drop site D4... got loose and popped...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: shaft collapsed, got most out... but I'm stuck here... drift east from Main D, I think...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: not that it matters much... I don't think I'm getting out...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: Heard Doc Sally say China dropped the Big One... God can that be true?...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: If someone finds this... get it to my wife...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: We had a good run, babe... didn't we?... You know... I still remember our first date... at the pool hall...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: don't remember who won... or what was playing on the radio... but I do remember you...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: I remember how I felt looking at you... how it felt you looking at me... how I still feel about you...

Speaker: 003CB235:Holotape_CBLore_GlassCave_Foreman_Male:VTYP
Text: you are my sunshine... ... my only sunshine... ... ...

Speaker: 003CB239:Holotape_CBLore_Kerwood_Worker_Male:VTYP
Text: I don't like it, Sam. Not one bit. They want to drop a nuke down here? And what for again? To get some kind of radioactive glass out?

Speaker: 003CB239:Holotape_CBLore_Kerwood_Worker_Male:VTYP
Text: What'd that labcoat call it, "Ultracite?" You and I both know the main shaft is barely holding together. This is bad news. Don't you let them do it!

Speaker: 003CB239:Holotape_CBLore_Kerwood_Worker_Male:VTYP
Text: You said you'd take care of it, Sam. You promised you'd get AMS to piss off.

Speaker: 003CB239:Holotape_CBLore_Kerwood_Worker_Male:VTYP
Text: What'd it take to buy you off? You got a fancy apartment in Watoga now?

Speaker: 003CB239:Holotape_CBLore_Kerwood_Worker_Male:VTYP
Text: Those boys' deaths are on your hands. You let this happen!

Speaker: 003CB239:Holotape_CBLore_Kerwood_Worker_Male:VTYP
Text: I'm done. I quit. I have half a mind to pay Kerwood's squirt a visit and introduce him to my fist.

Speaker: 003CB239:Holotape_CBLore_Kerwood_Worker_Male:VTYP
Text: In fact, I am going to go do that right now. And don't you try to stop me.

Speaker: 003CB239:Holotape_CBLore_Kerwood_Worker_Male:VTYP
Text: I hope you hear the watery screams of those men, drowning every night in your dreams. Have a nice life, asshole.

Speaker: 003CB23A:Holotape_CBLore_RobCo_AdministratorLisaFields_Female:VTYP
Text: Sergei, I don't know what you think you heard, or who you think you heard it from, but we are not, I repeat, not conducting experiments on overcoming pain threshold tolerance.

Speaker: 003CB23A:Holotape_CBLore_RobCo_AdministratorLisaFields_Female:VTYP
Text: Nor, and I cannot stress this enough, nor are we prototyping appendages for so-called "Mr. Torturers" for any agency of the government.

Speaker: 003CB23A:Holotape_CBLore_RobCo_AdministratorLisaFields_Female:VTYP
Text: And, look, even if we were, which we aren't, it wouldn't be torture. It'd be... "improved interrogation." This is America, for Christ's sake!

Speaker: 003CB23A:Holotape_CBLore_RobCo_AdministratorLisaFields_Female:VTYP
Text: It has come to the Board of Directors' attention that you have been tinkering with the "Voice of Watoga" project to give it the voice and personality of your late mother.

Speaker: 003CB23A:Holotape_CBLore_RobCo_AdministratorLisaFields_Female:VTYP
Text: I understand that you two were close, and I know what it means to lose someone dear...

Speaker: 003CB23A:Holotape_CBLore_RobCo_AdministratorLisaFields_Female:VTYP
Text: But we cannot allow this type of flagrant disregard for project specifications to continue without reprimand, no matter how sympathetic we may be to your personal loss.

Speaker: 003CB23A:Holotape_CBLore_RobCo_AdministratorLisaFields_Female:VTYP
Text: If you do not cease your tinkering and remove all the related changes from the project program and data files, you will be let go without hesitation.

Speaker: 003CB23A:Holotape_CBLore_RobCo_AdministratorLisaFields_Female:VTYP
Text: Thank you for your understanding and immediate compliance in this matter.

Speaker: 003CB23B:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefMilo_Male:VTYP
Text: Silas, I'm going out to scratch up supplies. I'll be back in a couple days.

Speaker: 003CB23B:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefMilo_Male:VTYP
Text: I know you think we should go, that we don't owe these people anything. But... the world ended, man. We can't keep taking advantage of each other.

Speaker: 003CB23B:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefMilo_Male:VTYP
Text: We NEED each other now. All of us need each other.

Speaker: 003CB23B:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefMilo_Male:VTYP
Text: My god... did you see Marty? It's almost as if his skin melted. How is he still alive?

Speaker: 003CB23B:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefMilo_Male:VTYP
Text: Look, just make what's left stretch until I come back. Do what you do best, improvise!

Speaker: 003CB23C:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefSilas_Male:VTYP
Text: Hey Milo um... look... I'm sorry, but I need to bail.

Speaker: 003CB23C:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefSilas_Male:VTYP
Text: Yeah, I know, "where the hell I'm gonna go?", well...*Sigh* I don't know. But I know I can't stay here.

Speaker: 003CB23C:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefSilas_Male:VTYP
Text: We built a great thing here, I even stuck it out when things went sour and we had to switch to our "down home" menu. We made it work.

Speaker: 003CB23C:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefSilas_Male:VTYP
Text: But after the bombs and everything fell apart...Look, I know this is gonna sound terrible, but...I'm not exactly a soup kitchen kind of guy, you know?

Speaker: 003CB23C:Holotape_CBLore_Steakhouse_ChefSilas_Male:VTYP
Text: So, um... Ah, anyway, um... this is goodbye. Don't hate me.

Speaker: 003CB233:Holotape_CBLore_ConcernedMother_Female:VTYP
Text: Headmaster Reinhold, this so-called "SMART" vending machine you have set up during the Halloween season appears virtuous, as it encourages children to trade in candy for useful items.

Speaker: 003CB233:Holotape_CBLore_ConcernedMother_Female:VTYP
Text: If this was all it was, it would be a fine device which I would argue should be installed year round.

Speaker: 003CB233:Holotape_CBLore_ConcernedMother_Female:VTYP
Text: However, it has an insidious immoral quality, that might have gone unnoticed, so I shall helpfully point it out to you.

Speaker: 003CB233:Holotape_CBLore_ConcernedMother_Female:VTYP
Text: The machine promotes gambling in children by use of randomized prizes for large candy deposits. Gambling is an immoral activity and carries with it a risk of addiction and abuse.

Speaker: 003CB233:Holotape_CBLore_ConcernedMother_Female:VTYP
Text: If this machine cannot be reprogrammed to remove the randomization from the rewards, I must insist the device be removed from school property immediately.

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP
Text: I don't have much... longer. Had I known... I never would have... but it's too late now, isn't it... But maybe I can help...

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP
Text: You... listening to this... whoever you are... you can't undo the virus... but...

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP
Text: You just need to get to... my office... there's a scanner... attached to the... the...

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP
Text: <Sound of recording device falling to the floor>

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP
Text: I've locked my terminal and wrote a little "fix" to the building's badge access software to prevent any badge other than my own from accessing my office.

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP
Text: They won't be able to get help from anyone else. Only I will hold the means to their salvation!

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP

Speaker: 002F050D:Holotape_CB04_Saboteur_Male:VTYP

Speaker: 0046F227:U03_NPCF_ChristinaBryan:VTYP
Text: To anyone out there, this is Dr. Christina Bryan. I'm a botanist employed at a classified laboratory deep underneath the Arktos Pharma facility.

Speaker: 0046F227:U03_NPCF_ChristinaBryan:VTYP
Text: We were down here when the bombs fell. We held out as long as we could before sending people to the surface to find out what the hell happened.

Speaker: 0046F227:U03_NPCF_ChristinaBryan:VTYP
Text: That was a mistake. There was nothing up there except death, and these... ghoulish creatures. They got down here somehow and started taking us out, one by one.

Speaker: 0046F227:U03_NPCF_ChristinaBryan:VTYP

Speaker: 0046F227:U03_NPCF_ChristinaBryan:VTYP

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Hey there traveler, Dick Shale here. Welcome to Appalachia! Did you know the AutumnFest takes place the last weekend in October?

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: One of Appalachia's most famous tourist attractions is The Pumpkin House.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: In 1978, the Pumpkin House began with only 4 pumpkins carved for a Halloween display.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Since then, the number of hand-carved pumpkins has grown to 300. Does a house with 300 hand-carved pumpkins attract attention? You betcha!

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Be sure to take the kiddo's and check out all those pumpkins.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Hey folks, it's your favorite Tour Guide Dick Shale! Appalachia has several Historical landmarks worth visiting while you're in the area.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Today I'd like to tell you about Prickett's Fort, where the American Colonist hunkered down and fended off hostile Native Americans and Redcoats.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: The structure standing today isn't the actual Prickett's Fort, but a faithful recreation of how historians pictured it! With a few, um, minor modifications.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: So stop by soon! Be sure to start your visit out with a trip to the famous gift shop and take a little piece of American history home with you!

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Hey folks, it's your favorite Tour Guide, Dick Shale! Appalachia has several Historical landmarks worth visiting while you're in the area.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Today I'd like to tell you about Philippi's Battlefield Cemetery, where the first land battle of the Civil War took place.

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP

Speaker: 00338719:AnnouncerM_TourGuide:VTYP
Text: Make sure to stop by the museum to see all the authentic uniforms, weapons and equipment actually used in the Civil War. We'll see you there!

Speaker: 004ED188:NPCF_LC042_RobotMechanic:VTYP

Speaker: 005119E7:NPCM_LC042_Townsperson:VTYP
Text: A trader came into town the other day. Claimed to be running ahead of a band of raiders, the Reavers.

Speaker: 005119E7:NPCM_LC042_Townsperson:VTYP
Text: Said they'd be heading this way.

Speaker: 005119E7:NPCM_LC042_Townsperson:VTYP
Text: Some of us have already started gutting the crash, building an outpost up in the tower. We're putting it to a vote tonight.

Speaker: 005119E7:NPCM_LC042_Townsperson:VTYP
Text: Do we abandon Helvetia for Horizon's Rest, or do we press our luck, try to weather the storm?

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: There are other things in this world now that cannot be explained. The end of the world has awoken... something.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: We all know the Mothman is out there, stalking and watching us, but what of the unseen.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: There are things we can only glimpse in our minds, great entities, beyond our comprehension.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: The Mothman is a creature, more like us than the unknowable horrors in the peripheral vision of our subconscious minds.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: No longer just a false memory now... I have heard a tale... of this entity made real, deep in the earth.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: The story teller was mad by any reckoning, but his story no less true.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: My name is Jeff Lane, and I will lay bare this...watcher. No matter how deep I must go, I will come to know the true nature of the interloper.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: The Interloper is here, I can feel it clearly. Last night, in visions more real than the senses it called to me.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: And I go to it now. Signs are all around that I am not the only one to hear the call.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: Though where they have failed, I will not, for it summons me alone in the end.

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: Before I go deeper, for the truth revealed changes all by its very nature...

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: Let it be known, in this world, the Interloper has chosen Jeff Lane as the conduit of the unknowable...

Speaker: 005119F2:NPCM_LC117_JeffLane:VTYP
Text: Together the hidden reality becomes manifest at long last.

Speaker: 002B8EEB:NPCM_MarkKinser:VTYP
Text: You know, Tal, everyone's gonna claim you sold out.

Speaker: 002B8EEA:NPCM_Talbot:VTYP

Speaker: 002B8EEB:NPCM_MarkKinser:VTYP
Text: Doesn't it bother you? Nuka-Cola coming in here and plastering logos all over the place, putting in knock-off rides... taking over?

Speaker: 002B8EEA:NPCM_Talbot:VTYP
Text: Of course it bothers me! This fair's been run by my family for 30-odd years now! But I don't have a choice. Can't manage another season on my own.

Speaker: 002B8EEB:NPCM_MarkKinser:VTYP
Text: Maybe if we did like a community fundraiser or something...

Speaker: 002B8EEA:NPCM_Talbot:VTYP

Speaker: 00511D61:NPCM_MTR_DaveJones:VTYP

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: Hey all, thanks for coming out today. I'm Dave Jones, President of the Appalachia Arts Foundation.

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: I'd like to welcome you all to Lewisburg for another year of our outstanding Annual Basket Festival.

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: I'd like to thank everyone for helping to put this together... as you all know, it's a little smaller this year.

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: Good quality wicker is a bit harder to come by these days, but I'm proud of what we've been able to organize.

Speaker: 0043A3A7:CyrusPickens_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: We're spendin' time on baskets when the whole world's gone to hell in one! When are we gonna get serious about things?

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: Folks, Cyrus Pickens... Cyrus, I do believe we had this discussion at the last Foundation meeting.

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: We took a vote on it, and we all agreed that just like we always have, Lewisburg Presses On.

Speaker: 000CEAA3:MaleOld:VTYP
Text: And what about that pack of crazy dogs come through last spring? We need to do less talking, and more fortifying our homes in case trouble comes looking for us!

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: Heh, I'm sorry about this, folks... Cyrus, please, this isn't really the forum...

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: Okay, look. We've got the Crafts Festival next month and then the Painting exhibition the month after that.

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: Now maybe some time after those are done, we can circle back around afterwards and give it another discussion.

Speaker: 00511D66:NPCM_MTR_GlenAtkinson:VTYP
Text: Okay folks, let's get out there and enjoy ourselves! Don't forget to keep your gas masks handy in case the weather takes a turn, and most important of all, have fun!

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: Welcome, Ladies and Gentlemen, to the Lewisburg Wine and Music Festival. I'm Clara Davis, the newly-elected President of the Appalachia Arts Foundation.

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: Before we begin, I'd like to take a moment to thank you all for your kinds words about our prior President, Mr. Glen Atkinson.

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: Glen was a wonderful man, and his passing was unfortunate, if not entirely unexpected given his declining health over the last year.

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: But as we all know, Lewisburg Presses On, don't we folks?

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: I'd also like to thank everyone for being so flexible, and managing to reschedule so much around that unfortunate storm.

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: The weather's definitely a bit more unpredictable these days, and none of us quite expected the storm to last three whole weeks.

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: Here we are now, though... all together, and I'm hoping we can enjoy a bit of... of, uhh...

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: Mr. Pickens, I see your hand raised, and I would just like to remind you that this is neither the place nor the time.

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: You have repeatedly raised your concerns to the Foundation, and we have obligingly listened for years now. We'd like to keep a positive outlook on things.

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: Maybe you could too, sir, and spend some time preparing for next month's Garden Festival.

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: I'm sorry, Ladies and Gentlemen. Please do enjoy the day.

Speaker: 00511D64:NPCF_MTR_ClaraDavis:VTYP
Text: I'm very proud we were able to find three musicians to perform for us this year, and we've verified no less than 4 wines that are 100 percent safe to drink.

Speaker: 00511A5A:NPCM_NukaCola_MarcusTaylor:VTYP
Text: Our latest market survey reports that healthy, on-the-go snacking is up 8% across all market sectors and is expected to propel demand across the next several fiscal years.

Speaker: 00511A5A:NPCM_NukaCola_MarcusTaylor:VTYP
Text: Our first experiments are going to look at reviving Celery flavored sparkling beverages. It's a beverage that has origins in the 1860s and has a built in recognition with demographics that crave outsider status.

Speaker: 00511A5A:NPCM_NukaCola_MarcusTaylor:VTYP
Text: We think that we can balance artificial flavors, package design and marketing to convince people that it has healthy benefits.

Speaker: 00511A5A:NPCM_NukaCola_MarcusTaylor:VTYP
Text: We're working with legal to figure out the limits of what we can claim, but right now we're leaning towards "classic digestive beverage for the new generation" and/or "a green tonic water from America's greatest era"

Speaker: 00511A5A:NPCM_NukaCola_MarcusTaylor:VTYP
Text: New data suggests that snack beverages that have a medical connection are gaining in popularity. We've looked at a variety of potential formulations and our best bet, from a supply side perspective is a fermented, cranberry flavored drink.

Speaker: 00511A5A:NPCM_NukaCola_MarcusTaylor:VTYP
Text: We can use surplus cranberry storage from Raleigh County as a primary source. The key to messaging will be to move the dialogue away from "spoiled fruit" to "premium lifestyle brand".

Speaker: 00511A5A:NPCM_NukaCola_MarcusTaylor:VTYP
Text: Our goal is to tie in with a number of tastemakers in the film and television industries and to combine that with a sleek design and a clear liquid with a more pointed taste.

Speaker: 00511A5A:NPCM_NukaCola_MarcusTaylor:VTYP
Text: We think that we can portray fans of this beverage as having refined palettes and a taste for high quality products, which should drive sales across adult markets.

Speaker: 00511A5B:NPCM_VTU_ScottWarner:VTYP
Text: This is even better than I expected! Growing up in Welch, I never would have expected to get this opportunity! My dad said not to let the big city get to my head, but I can barely stand it I'm so excited!

Speaker: 00511A5B:NPCM_VTU_ScottWarner:VTYP
Text: This list of courses is thrilling, and I'll be learning from some of the best. Dean Elliot is a legend, and Professor Blake literally wrote the book on psychology in confined situations.

Speaker: 00511A5B:NPCM_VTU_ScottWarner:VTYP
Text: I know it's early, but I've been working on my Senior Thesis since I was in grade school, and I've got an appointment with Dean Elliot to go over it with him. I know it's a silly little idea, but I think it can be something real special with his help.

Speaker: 00511A5B:NPCM_VTU_ScottWarner:VTYP
Text: Selective breeding is the toughest but to crack, but I think that the confines of a vault are a fantastic place to put these ideas to the test in a controlled environment. I've studied the history and I have an angle that no one has thought of.

Speaker: 00511A5C:NPCF_VTU_TrishaMiller:VTYP
Text: Turned down by a potential boss once again. If you'd told me when I first got here that I would be anything other than the Overseer of a control vault, I wouldn't have believed you.

Speaker: 00511A5C:NPCF_VTU_TrishaMiller:VTYP
Text: Now that I'm here I'm a little more realistic about things. The Overseer at Vault 96, one of the hottest postings outside of 76, wouldn't even give me the time of day.

Speaker: 00511A5C:NPCF_VTU_TrishaMiller:VTYP
Text: The man sent me a form letter as a rejection for god's sake. At this rate, I'm going to end up shipped out to the west coast to work as a janitor in 29 with a bunch of obnoxious rich teenagers or something.

Speaker: 00511A5C:NPCF_VTU_TrishaMiller:VTYP
Text: It's pretty clear to me now that Vault Tec is a hive of nepotism and ass-kissing. You can't get ahead unless you attend every lecture and write every paper - there's no respect for passion!

Speaker: 00511A5C:NPCF_VTU_TrishaMiller:VTYP
Text: Some of these kids, they just don't understand what Vault-Tec means! Meanwhile, I have to take my third run at a senior thesis. Should be entertaining to get rejected by Dean Elliot again.

Speaker: 00511A5C:NPCF_VTU_TrishaMiller:VTYP
Text: Anyways, cash is tight so I'm gonna take part in hopefully my last thesis project in the sim vault. This kid seems fine and his experiment is about food, so I get to eat well at least.

Speaker: 003F7F4C:P01B_Burrows_Dispatch_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Romeo Squad, this is Defiance. Priority message follows. Intel shows a significant amount of military robotics at the Harpers Ferry Pump Station.

Speaker: 003F7F4C:P01B_Burrows_Dispatch_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Proceed to the location through the city sewer and conduct recon to identify the source. Report back by 0700. Ad victoriam.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Alright people, settle in, settle in. Alright. Now, I asked that all the Burrows folk gather here today because I'm making a little announcement.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: As of right now, the Burrows Boys are withdrawing from our little alliance and claiming ownership over these tunnels.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Now... for some of you that is probably confusing. Maybe you're asking yourself "Marcus, what's that mean for the Burrows? What's it mean for me?"

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Well friends, it's really pretty damn simple. It means that as of now, I own everything in these tunnels!

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: The rats you eat, the mold growing on your mattress, the bricks you are standing on. They're all mine.

Speaker: 0007C61A:_NPC_NoLines:VTYP
Text: *Crowd Murmuring*

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: But, not to worry. I will be a kind and fair ruler. I will let you continue using my facilities if you obey one very simple rule.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: And that is to follow my every order to a T! I tell you to do something, you do it. I need something, you get it.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: I ask you for the moon? You figure out how to pull that SOB out of the sky and bring it right down here to me.

Speaker: 00454C1D:U02_NPCF_Trish_Burrows:VTYP
Text: And if we refuse?

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Well you could do that... you could. But you'd be more screwed than you already are. Look around, Trish.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: My boys are the only ones here with guns, and the only ones that know anything about fighting! None of you can touch us. You wouldn't stand a chance.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: I understand you folks have gotten used to the chummy, love-your-neighbor bullshit, but the new world order is here.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Now, I get it. That is some bitter medicine to swallow. But if I need to help you force it down, just know that I am more than happy to oblige.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Hello, 'Maudy'. Hopefully you're still alive to hear this after my... modifications to the bot targeting parameters.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: If you are, you have probably noticed that all the exits topside are sealed shut and you are... *laughs*... so screwed!

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: I get it, Maude. You thought you were safe. You thought you built a home for all those helpless saps down here and refused to give way to how the world really works now.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Yeah... That's how I knew you'd pull some dumb shit like this.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Before you and your crew ran off into the tunnels like a bunch of rats, you asked me why I was doing all of this.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Now, the reasoning is... it's pretty simple: the mean guys always win, Maude.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Things are no different now than before the bombs. Hell, it's the reason most of us landed down here in the first place!

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: I just figured I may as well be the one to mean up before somebody else beat me to it.

Speaker: 00454C1C:U02_NPCM_Marcus_Burrows:VTYP
Text: *Laughs* Sorry, I was just thinking how my daddy would be so proud of me. You know, that his boy followed in his footsteps in 'waste management'. I will see you in hell, Maude.

Speaker: 00454C1D:U02_NPCF_Trish_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Dylan, I hope you find this when you get back. I need you to listen to me. We can't stay here anymore.

Speaker: 00454C1D:U02_NPCF_Trish_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Marcus, that son of a bitch. I should've known he'd... *sigh*. The point is, you need to grab your things and leave as soon as possible.

Speaker: 00454C1D:U02_NPCF_Trish_Burrows:VTYP
Text: Just don't try to leave through the central chamber. One of his goons will just hold you up and give you shit. I'm heading to Mosstown now. I love you and... I hope I see you soon.

Speaker: 00511A8F:NPCM_LC101_GabeRamses:VTYP
Text: Hi, this is Gabe Ramses and I'm leaving this message to inform the Parks and Rec Department of the horrible experience my family and I had this week at the Alpine River Cabins!

Speaker: 00511A8F:NPCM_LC101_GabeRamses:VTYP
Text: We were all looking forward to a nice, weekend getaway in the wilderness, but between the constant shaking in the cabins, rodent swarms, and blood-curdling screams, I'm more stressed than I was before!

Speaker: 00511A8F:NPCM_LC101_GabeRamses:VTYP
Text: My boys were so upset they swore they saw the picture frames spinning on the walls!

Speaker: 00511A8F:NPCM_LC101_GabeRamses:VTYP
Text: My tax dollars pay your salaries, so I demand recompense or you can bet I'll do my darndest to make sure that money is in someone else's pockets next election!

Speaker: 00511A8F:NPCM_LC101_GabeRamses:VTYP
Text: And one more thing! Maybe you could get off your lazy butts and pick up some of the garbage here. The place is filthy!

Speaker: 00511A8F:NPCM_LC101_GabeRamses:VTYP
Text: I know all the recent hub-bub about atomic war, but that doesn't mean the place has to look like it was just hit with a nuclear bomb!

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: Testing... testing... This is Jay DeeDee. Hope this piece of junk is finally recording.

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: Can't believe I'm using one of these contraptions to send a simple message, but you asked for an update, Earnest. So here you go!

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: Gad is a goldmine! The town that was here may have been gone for ages...

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: ..but between what they left and the gear from the last batch of muck farmers, I could be here for a long while digging it up.

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: There's barely a trickle of water after the dam busted and there are riches poking out of the mud all over the place!

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: I've already built a home of my own. It isn't much, but I'm trying to claim my spot before scavengers show up looking to pounce on the goods.

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: That's why I need your help, Earnest.

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: I know you got guys looking for work over in Beckley. Heard about those machines taking jobs from hard working miners.

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: Tell whoever will listen that I am offering twice what they were making hauling coal to come up to New Gad and lend a hand.

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: Oh! And whatever digging or mining gear they've got would be great too.

Speaker: 00511C83:NPCM_LC142_JayDeedee:VTYP
Text: Might need to bring some protection as well. Someone built a shack only a stone's throw away and it's only going to get more crowded.

Speaker: 00511C85:NPCM_LC012_ForemanScarborough:VTYP
Text: Big Bend Tunnel Mining Operation. Update for Day 163

Speaker: 00511C85:NPCM_LC012_ForemanScarborough:VTYP
Text: This is Foreman Scarborough. My deepest apologies for the delay in sending the last message.

Speaker: 00511C85:NPCM_LC012_ForemanScarborough:VTYP
Text: As I have mentioned before work continues to slow due to the air quality in these tunnels.

Speaker: 00511C85:NPCM_LC012_ForemanScarborough:VTYP
Text: My men are trying their best, but I continue to urge the need for proper ventilation.

Speaker: 00511C85:NPCM_LC012_ForemanScarborough:VTYP
Text: Or at least for the trains to be re-routed elsewhere. Every time one of them comes through it takes days for the fumes to clear.

Speaker: 00511C85:NPCM_LC012_ForemanScarborough:VTYP
Text: Not to mention the smoke from the machinery and equipment!

Speaker: 00511C85:NPCM_LC012_ForemanScarborough:VTYP
Text: I understand the need to expand beyond the regions to the West and that these train tunnels offer an untapped wealth of resources.

Speaker: 00511C85:NPCM_LC012_ForemanScarborough:VTYP
Text: But unless we get fans or gas masks or something in these tunnels soon, I won't have men left to mine it! I beg you to take action.

Speaker: 0052499A:AnnouncerM_FF06_FactoryAnnouncer:VTYP
Text: It's a great day to go to work in the best country on Earth!
