Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: Beverly Solomon, Cryptid Analyst, 10/4/77. Snallygaster witness report.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: Another interesting tidbit from the locals, this time about the Snallygaster. This one's for you, Teddy!

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: Alright, so the witness overheard a loud shrieking sound and was rushed by a dark shape in the woods. It was leaping at them, or maybe flying?

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: They took shelter in an old german settler's barn and it couldn't get at them, which is what really interested me!

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: It screamed and hollered outside all night until dawn, but they knew the seven-pointed star on the wall outside would keep them safe.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: Yikes, I guess I know what my next tattoo is gonna be!

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: Beverly Solomon, Cryptid Analyst, 9/27/77. Grafton Monster witness report.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: This is from one of those spelunkers that roam the hills looking for abandoned mining claims. Can you imagine?

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: Well, the classic four-foot wide shoulders, headless profile, deep sonorous cry, they got a good glance at it. The witness didn't know what it was, but the description is very clear.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: It came out when she started playing a mouth harp, apparently! I'm going to go out to go look. Maybe that sound is the key....

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: Beverly Solomon, Cryptid Analyst, 10/25/77. Wendigo witness report.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: Ooh, this is a spooky tale! Okay, so this is my own personal sighting.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: I was up at the ski lodge this past week, enjoying some well-deserved R&R.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: I guess I can never really be off the clock though, because I happened to see something hunched on the slopes ahead of me.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: I thought it was some old coat, you know? I was moving pretty fast, so I was just trying to avoid it.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: Anyhow, it just unfurls as I get close. Must've been ten feet tall, but just all skin and bones like a dead dog.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: It had a deer's skull cracked open in its hands from the fresh kill it was eating, and as I go by I get this powerful cold feeling through my bones.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: I thought to myself, you know ... Bev, you really lucked out getting that tattoo before coming out here on this trip.

Speaker: 00511CB6:NPCF_SugarGrove_BeverlySolomon:VTYP
Text: I can't imagine what kind of things I'm gonna see next!

Speaker: 00511CBD:NPCM_SummersvilleMansions_Nate:VTYP
Text: I should be sitting here, lying about how I sacrificed myself for my so and so's and I'm quietly fading off and blah blah. I know the drill.

Speaker: 00511CBD:NPCM_SummersvilleMansions_Nate:VTYP
Text: But look, I didn't choose to sit out here and watch the bombs go off in my bathrobe like some venerable old peach. No, I was left here to die because I'm old and mean and that's fine by me.

Speaker: 00511CBD:NPCM_SummersvilleMansions_Nate:VTYP
Text: I like things how I like them, and I am not going to change one bit for anyone. I recorded this just in case anyone saw my body and felt bad for me.

Speaker: 00511CBD:NPCM_SummersvilleMansions_Nate:VTYP
Text: To hell with your sympathy. I'm going out on an IV full of painkillers and you're just jealous that you didn't think of it first. Sucker.

Speaker: 00511CBE:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Kelly:VTYP
Text: Hey Anya, I know we're just supposed to leave useful things in the dead drop so we don't take up a lot of space, but I wanted to tell you something.

Speaker: 00511CBE:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Kelly:VTYP
Text: You're so practical and thoughtful, and you always notice the good stuff first and you always give me things so I can make it out here.

Speaker: 00511CBE:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Kelly:VTYP
Text: You're really special to me. I'm sorry if this makes you mad to hear, you probably don't like me like that.

Speaker: 00511CBE:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Kelly:VTYP
Text: I know I was a grade behind you when the war happened. I guess we have to take chances now though, right?

Speaker: 00511CBE:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Kelly:VTYP
Text: I'll wait for you in the big cabin where we stayed during the field trip and maybe we can talk about it, okay?

Speaker: 00511CBF:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Anya:VTYP
Text: Kelly, I got your message from the dead drop! I've been waiting up here for you but I'm starting to get kinda worried.

Speaker: 00511CBF:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Anya:VTYP
Text: You're probably just hiding in the hedges from those robots, but I'm going to go look around for you just in case. If you get this, just stay here!

Speaker: 00511CBF:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Anya:VTYP
Text: I ran into a few adults who used to live in the big houses here and they said that we can stay for as long as we like. I told the other kids and everyone is pretty sure they're cannibals.

Speaker: 00511CBF:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Anya:VTYP
Text: I don't think it's true, but we should probably try to move on from here if the folks here are taking notice.

Speaker: 00511CBF:NPCF_SummersvilleMansions_Anya:VTYP
Text: Oh hey, they you are now! So ... bye?

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: This is Enola Walker. Don't know if anyone'll hear this, but life finally took the last thing I had left. Figured I should leave something behind.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I lost Joan in '77 and the kids in the Drowning, but I had my damned dogs. It's bad enough that the beast tore up the homestead. Ruined everything.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I could've rebuilt, but it's not worth it without my boys. So if you find this place, I'm willing it to you. Just let anyone listen to this tape and they'll know.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I took the last of my good chems for the bites, but the rest is yours. The last thing I'm going to do is hunt that ugly beast down and kill it before I go.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I hope you have a good life here. But that monster flew off toward the Steakhouse... so maybe avoid that area unless I turned it into a fucking crater.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: It's still flying south. It's like one of those Scorchbeasts the Thunder was fighting off, but looks strange. Bigger? Never seen one up close before.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Looks pregnant but maybe she's just full.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Well, those dogs kept me sane longer than makes sense, so they're getting a proper send-off. You hear that, you monster?

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I don't know why I'm recording all this shit... it helps with the disorientation a bit, I suppose.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Chems didn't seem to help me none, neither. My skin's peeling and my eye won't stop bleeding.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I reckon that if this is it... then I'm gonna make it count.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Alright, I'm off to shove this backpack full of explosives down that Scorchbeast's throat as an after dinner mint.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: You have a good day, whoever you are out there. A better day than me, at the very least!

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Ugh. Joan always wanted to move to this shit town.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Sorry if you found this and you live here.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Mostly because you live here in this abandoned shit town.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Oh, don't mind me. I'm just mad that big Scorchbeast won't slow down long enough to just eat me and this bag of bombs.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: At least she hasn't left me in the dust already. Although... she could've.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Maybe I'm a snack for later? Or she took a bite of me just to take a taste? Too much salt.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Well, it makes no nevermind to me as long as I can get close enough.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: No, she definitely knows I'm following her, and just doesn't care. She circled back just now, like she was looking for me.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I'm coming for you, even if you go halfway to hell! Even if this is a game to you!

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: She finally stopped long enough to maul a mirelurk, but didn't eat the damn thing. Not like she did my dogs.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: She just chewed it up and spat it out like, just she did me. Like we're a chocolate sampler or something!

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I got pretty close before she took off again, I swear she's got no eyes in that great ugly cauliflower looking head of hers.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: She's staying to the side of Watoga instead of going in. Maybe she doesn't like the taste of tin cans?

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: The mirelurk and myself are just following after her wake like a couple of ducklings. Think I'll call him Dave.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Dave doesn't seem to care none about attacking me. Ate up his own nest like a hog in the pantry though.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I can even touch him and he doesn't do nothing but stare....

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I found some more chems but it's getting hard to keep going. My eyes and ears are bleeding, and... I'm hearing and seeing things that aren't there.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Hell, I'm not sure that Dave is really here, except when I'm downwind of that stink. Nobody's imagination is capable of such as that.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I think everybody's dead in Watoga aside from the bots.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I'm dead, too. Just too dumb to stop walking and breathing.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: At least we've got each other, right Dave?

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: It's hard to think straight, but I saw her circling over this pit one minute, and gone the next. My guess is she went in.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: What do you think?

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Dave is following me now that the Scorchbeast went below, but he's about the worst replacement dog I ever had.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: I have to try to find my way down there. I have to keep up with her.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: If you find this and you don't know well enough, you need to get the hell out of here, Joan. I am not kidding with you, neither.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Had to drop my bag. Too heavy. All this for nothing. Couldn't even avenge my boys.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: It's not alone down here. There are smaller ones like it, things like me, like Dave. They don't do nothing but stare.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: They're waiting. Waiting for me.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: My skin's bursting, burning, tight like a shroud.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: Oh, I miss you guys.

Speaker: 00530B81:NPCF_CB15_EnolaWalker:VTYP
Text: This... This... Can't...

Speaker: 0056995F:W05_00_FemaleVigilant:VTYP
Text: This is... A Vigilant Citizen. And this is an interview with Gladys Filtcher.

Speaker: 0056995F:W05_00_FemaleVigilant:VTYP
Text: Can you repeat that?

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: So those soldiers, they drove onto my land and started fencing off the north part of my farm. Two years back.

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: Well, I ain't one to take that lying down. After making a ruckus, their Captain came by.

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: Said it was for my own safety. That there were dangerous level of radiation over there.

Speaker: 0056995F:W05_00_FemaleVigilant:VTYP
Text: Did they say what caused it?

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: They wouldn't say word one. Before I could carry on too much, this man in a black suit comes over. Says it's eminent domain.

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: And he gives me this check with more zeroes in it that I've ever seen.

Speaker: 0056995F:W05_00_FemaleVigilant:VTYP
Text: Did you take it?

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: Damned right I did. These are hard times.

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: Everyone else I know took the deal, too. We was told to keep it quiet. Not to create a needless panic.

Speaker: 0056995F:W05_00_FemaleVigilant:VTYP
Text: Did you ever see any evidence of the radiation?

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: This is off-the-record. Like you said? Right?

Speaker: 0056995F:W05_00_FemaleVigilant:VTYP
Text: Absolutely. You have my word.

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: *grunt* Well, that's just it. I never saw any signs of anything dangerous.

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: I got a couple cows that like grazing that aways. After the fence, I chased the cows off.

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: But the damned animals always went back.

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: Third time I caught them I gave up. Figured they were goners, anyhow.

Speaker: 0056995F:W05_00_FemaleVigilant:VTYP
Text: So there's no evidence of anything suspicious?

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: No. Truth be told, I almost forgot about it. Except for the noise.

Speaker: 0056995F:W05_00_FemaleVigilant:VTYP
Text: Noise?

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: Yeah, you can hear trucks coming and going every now and then. At the damnedest hours, too.

Speaker: 00569960:W05_00_FemaleFiltcher:VTYP
Text: A couple times I heard a train whistle, too. But that's about it.

Speaker: 0000002E:FemaleRough:VTYP
Text: Appalachia. I thought it was going to be in the rear view forever. Coming back... is weird.

Speaker: 0000002E:FemaleRough:VTYP
Text: The Gourmands freaks are all gone. Even those gun-toting maniac Cutthroats.

Speaker: 0000002E:FemaleRough:VTYP
Text: Leaving was humiliating, but Meg called it. And now she'll neeeever let us forget it.

Speaker: 00597986:W05_MQ_101P_A_RaiderHolotape_VoiceOnly:NPC_
Text: So C backed out. I swear, I'm losing more people than recruiting.

Speaker: 00597986:W05_MQ_101P_A_RaiderHolotape_VoiceOnly:NPC_
Text: If we could just crack Foundation, we'd be rich. And we'd own Appalachia.

Speaker: 00597986:W05_MQ_101P_A_RaiderHolotape_VoiceOnly:NPC_
Text: But the damned walls, and they've got numbers, too.

Speaker: 00597986:W05_MQ_101P_A_RaiderHolotape_VoiceOnly:NPC_
Text: I'd go with explosives but Lou won't have anything to do with my "cockamamey plan."

Speaker: 00597986:W05_MQ_101P_A_RaiderHolotape_VoiceOnly:NPC_
Text: *sigh* I could try the Blood Eagles...? Who am I kidding, they'd just lynch me. Damned Foundation.

Speaker: 00013ADD:FemaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: She talks such a big game, but what do we actually do?

Speaker: 00013ADD:FemaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: We pick away at stragglers. We try not to rock the boat.

Speaker: 00013ADD:FemaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: These settlers are on my land. Hell, there's a family living in my old house

Speaker: 00013ADD:FemaleEvenToned:VTYP
Text: Lev. Lev's the solution. Meg's gotta be retired. One way or the other.

Speaker: 005855DA:W05_NPCF_ChineseSpy:VTYP
Text: The capitalists disgust me.

Speaker: 005855DA:W05_NPCF_ChineseSpy:VTYP
Text: Look around? The Americans are so haughty - claiming their precious democracy is better.

Speaker: 005855DA:W05_NPCF_ChineseSpy:VTYP
Text: But I see the ruins all around me. The time of judgment will come.

Speaker: 005855DA:W05_NPCF_ChineseSpy:VTYP
Text: I must admit, though, the spaghetti is quite good. Damn them.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: Meg, I know you will find this tape. Also know we will be gone long time when you find it.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: I know this because you are weak, ineffective leader. You could not lead gang out of wet paper bag. Too weak. Too stupid. Too cowardly.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: When I hear you invite in that cockroach, and want to go off on some ridiculous vault heist to find gold, I call that last straw.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: Surge and Fisher know how stupid plan is, and how terrible leader you are, so they come with me. Leave you behind with freaks and losers.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: Know this. We will gain more men. We will come back, powerful. Then we will wipe you, and all your freaks off map. Sleep tight, blyat.

Speaker: 0040D480:W05_NPCM_Fisher:VTYP
Text: Hey Lou. Not sure you'll ever get this, but I needed to get something off my chest.

Speaker: 0040D480:W05_NPCM_Fisher:VTYP
Text: I know I had once called you friend. It may not mean much, but I am genuinely sorry for what I had to do to you.

Speaker: 0040D480:W05_NPCM_Fisher:VTYP
Text: But you have to understand, I had no other choice. Meg is a terrible leader. I questioned why Lev would ever join her.

Speaker: 0040D480:W05_NPCM_Fisher:VTYP
Text: He always intended to take over one day, but she kept bringing on new people, building loyalty, making it more difficult for him to mutiny.

Speaker: 0040D480:W05_NPCM_Fisher:VTYP
Text: When Meg decided to go on this foolish gold hunt with that vault dweller from seventy-six, it was time to act. She was going to lead us all to ruin.

Speaker: 0040D480:W05_NPCM_Fisher:VTYP
Text: And it was too late for me to reach you, because you were already involved. I couldn't risk the operation if you said anything to Meg.

Speaker: 0040D480:W05_NPCM_Fisher:VTYP
Text: Well I uh... hope your luck holds out and you survive long enough to hear that I'm sorry for all this.

Speaker: 0053C268:W05_NPCF_Surge:VTYP
Text: Hey y'all. Lev wanted us to leave behind some messages to all of you Crater folks who we're leavin' behind.

Speaker: 0053C268:W05_NPCF_Surge:VTYP
Text: Guess it's like a final 'fuck you,' to y'all or something. I dunno. I just do what he says.

Speaker: 0053C268:W05_NPCF_Surge:VTYP
Text: So yeah, I know I won't miss y'all cheatin' at cards. I'm lookin' at you, Johnny.

Speaker: 0053C268:W05_NPCF_Surge:VTYP
Text: I can target a chipmunk's nuts at two thousand yards with my fifty cal, and y'all don't think I see you slippin' that ace outta your sleeve? Please!

Speaker: 0053C268:W05_NPCF_Surge:VTYP
Text: I will not miss sharin' a home with a walkin' corpse, and a green-skinned monster.

Speaker: 0053C268:W05_NPCF_Surge:VTYP
Text: Most of all, I won't miss Meg takin' in all the unnatural freaks of the Wasteland.

Speaker: 0053C268:W05_NPCF_Surge:VTYP
Text: Like Lev says, only a matter of time 'fore one of 'em snaps and kills y'all.

Speaker: 0053C268:W05_NPCF_Surge:VTYP
Text: Heh, I will miss Molly and her supply of good booze. I ain't lookin' forward to doin' without, I tell ya that.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: What are you doing? No need for tape.

Speaker: 0053C25D:W05_NPCM_Rocco:VTYP
Text: Just a little insurance, in case you need a reminder about the terms of our agreement here.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: Whatever. You do what you want. Is worthless anyway. Now, go on. Let us talk payment.

Speaker: 0053C25D:W05_NPCM_Rocco:VTYP
Text: S... sure. Like I said, I'll give you all the guns, ammo, and other supplies I took and hid away from Foundation.

Speaker: 0053C25D:W05_NPCM_Rocco:VTYP
Text: If, and only if you ruin any chances of your people breaking into that vault.

Speaker: 0053C25D:W05_NPCM_Rocco:VTYP
Text: You get it all once you get me that detonator, so I can break in myself and bring the goods back to Foundation. They'll have to let me back in, then.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: Yes, yes. I get location of gun stash, you get to go on foolish endeavor.

Speaker: 0053C25D:W05_NPCM_Rocco:VTYP
Text: You know, you and your crew could always help me break in, get a nice cut of the treasure, right?

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: No. Vault gold is useless. You will see. Ammo, weapons. That is new world currency. To hell with gold.

Speaker: 0053C25D:W05_NPCM_Rocco:VTYP
Text: You're missing out, but I guess we'll agree to disagree.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: Look. As long as you pay up after job is done, I won't regret not killing you when we found you.

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: Can always come back to that if you are lying about stash.

Speaker: 0053C25D:W05_NPCM_Rocco:VTYP
Text: N...n...No lie, no sir! Understood. We got ourselfes an agreement then. Pleasure doing business with you, uh...

Speaker: 0053C259:W05_NPCM_Lev:VTYP
Text: Lev. Now put recorder away. You have alcohol in this shithole? We will drink to seal deal.

Speaker: 00571F73:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_BoardMember:VTYP
Text: Doctors. Hello from Earth. The full Board is here, waiting for your reports. Dr. Carol, can you begin?

Speaker: 00571F72:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrBernard:VTYP
Text: Phase two analysis: Subject Daguerre is responding well. The sleeping pod is performing within all expected parameters.

Speaker: 00571F72:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrBernard:VTYP
Text: Physiologically... her body is in perfect stasis.

Speaker: 00571F72:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrBernard:VTYP
Text: Mentally... it took about five minutes for her to progress into standard R.E.M. sleep after Serum Z was administered at the prescribed 10cc dose.

Speaker: 00571F72:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrBernard:VTYP
Text: Additional Sleeping Pods have been installed for Phase III. Any other questions for me? Standing by.

Speaker: 00571F73:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_BoardMember:VTYP
Text: Thank you, Doctor. Yes, the Board has a question for you. How long can the subject remain in your device?

Speaker: 00571F72:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrBernard:VTYP
Text: I wouldn't expect much degradation to occur for at least a few decades. Hard to estimate beyond that. Over.

Speaker: 00571F73:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_BoardMember:VTYP
Text: Is Doctor Nowak on the line?

Speaker: 00571F74:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_DrNowak:VTYP
Text: Oh! Uh. Yes, that's me. I'm here. And by here, I mean, I'm in orbit in space looking down at the Earth where you all are---

Speaker: 00571F75:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_BoardMember:VTYP
Text: We got it, Doctor. Thanks. We have a question for you. Can you determine whether the connection has been made?

Speaker: 00571F74:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_DrNowak:VTYP
Text: Yes. I can determine that the connection has been made. The A.T.H.E.N.A. unit has full access.

Speaker: 0056C82E:W05_RobotF_Astronaut_ATHENA:VTYP
Text: Confirmed. Pathways are open. Connection is complete.

Speaker: 00571F73:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_BoardMember:VTYP
Text: Thank you. We have a question for Dr. Lee---

Speaker: 00571F76:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrLee:VTYP
Text: I'm here!

Speaker: 00571F76:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrLee:VTYP
Text: *strange banging sounds*

Speaker: 00571F76:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrLee:VTYP
Text: Sorry, just had to fix a transmitter refraction--

Speaker: 00571F73:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_BoardMember:VTYP
Text: Enough. Dr. Lee, how stable is the ship at its current position in orbit?

Speaker: 00571F76:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrLee:VTYP
Text: Uh... fine? It's fine. It should probably last, uh, as long as she does, anyway. Probably. Uh. I mean definitely.

Speaker: 00571F75:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_BoardMember:VTYP
Text: Perfect. Is the ship's U.S.S.A. bot currently available and nearby?

Speaker: 0055F6C4:W05_RobotAssaultron_Astronaut_PandoraBot:VTYP
Text: Affirmative. Pandora Unit is ready for orders.

Speaker: 00571F75:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_BoardMember:VTYP
Text: Excellent. Pandora -- escort the Doctors to their own personal Deep Sleep pods.

Speaker: 00571F73:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_BoardMember:VTYP
Text: You need to say the code, Rob. Your team made it, you should know that. *laughs* Red Sunrise.

Speaker: 0055F6C4:W05_RobotAssaultron_Astronaut_PandoraBot:VTYP
Text: Expulsion will begin in 30 seconds. Enter your assigned pod immediately.

Speaker: 00571F76:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrLee:VTYP
Text: Wait. What? This isn't part of the experiment methodology. Also, we don't agree? Right, Doctors? You can't do this!

Speaker: 00571F74:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_DrNowak:VTYP
Text: Daguerre's sleep pod is inside the main escape capsule. We need to get it out so we can get out of here. Come on, someone help me open this thing!

Speaker: 00571F72:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_DrBernard:VTYP
Text: The Board is in violation of our contract. I want the U.S.S.A. on the line right now.

Speaker: 0055F69E:W05_NPCM_Astronaut_VisitorEmerson:VTYP
Text: The U.S.S.A. is well aware of the current status, Dr. Carol, thank you. Please cooperate now.

Speaker: 0055F6C4:W05_RobotAssaultron_Astronaut_PandoraBot:VTYP

Speaker: 0055F6C4:W05_RobotAssaultron_Astronaut_PandoraBot:VTYP

Speaker: 00571F74:W05_NPCF_Astronaut_DrNowak:VTYP

Speaker: 00590A11:W05_NPCF_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_Ayla:VTYP

Speaker: 00590FBA:W05_NPCF_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_BloodEagleF:VTYP
Text: I am literally going to murder you.

Speaker: 00590FB9:W05_NPCM_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_BloodEagleM:VTYP
Text: But... but... okay. How about... The Bloodiest Eagle of them All!

Speaker: 00590FBA:W05_NPCF_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_BloodEagleF:VTYP
Text: Okay. Bloodiest Eagle. Please wait in the hallway while I finish the report.

Speaker: 00590FB9:W05_NPCM_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_BloodEagleM:VTYP
Text: Guard the door, kill any intruders. I can do this!

Speaker: 00590FBA:W05_NPCF_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_BloodEagleF:VTYP
Text: *heavy sigh*

Speaker: 00590FBA:W05_NPCF_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_BloodEagleF:VTYP
Text: I think we need to ditch the whole "naming" thing. It's getting out of hand.

Speaker: 00590FBA:W05_NPCF_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_BloodEagleF:VTYP
Text: I will also need a new... assistant.

Speaker: 00590FBA:W05_NPCF_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_BloodEagleF:VTYP
Text: Ten survived the chems with no issue. Nine had reactions and were disposed of. One has been sent to see The Eye.

Speaker: 00590FBA:W05_NPCF_COMP_Beckett_Holotape_BloodEagleF:VTYP

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Chapter 7: Constructing the Effigy

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Gather ten to twenty bundles of sticks underneath a new moon.

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Bind them tightly with the entrails of the sacrificial beast, and cleanse and bless your tools with holy incense.

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Construct the form of your effigy with the bundles, using straw or twine to fix them into position.

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Plant a staff of hewn oak down the center of the effigy.

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Hammer the staff firmly into the dirt, and pile more sticks, logs, and wood scraps around the base.

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Anoint your sacred blade with the holy oil made from the Bright One's eggs, and use your blade to bless the effigy for use in your circle.

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Chapter 8: Summoning Rite

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: On the night of a full moon, gather your fellows and sit around the effigy.

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Light the pyre, and have all recite the following incantation as one:

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: O Bright One, we bid thee. Follow this sacred flame with thy ever watchful eyes.

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: See clear as day this holy fire we burn in your honor. Like cattle to slaughter, we die for thee.

Speaker: 00584C89:W05_NPCM_CultistLecturer:VTYP
Text: Bid us welcome as we beckon thee with this Divine Lamp, that we may be blessed by the air underneath thy wings.

Speaker: 00584C8E:W05_NPCM_Diver:VTYP
Text: This here is James Addison, of the Whitespring Resort staff. I tell ya, they never thought I was telling the truth but I found it.

Speaker: 00584C8E:W05_NPCM_Diver:VTYP
Text: I swear by all that is holy, I found it. I knew it was there all along, see, it started with the rumbling.

Speaker: 00584C8E:W05_NPCM_Diver:VTYP
Text: We had some minor earthquakes, you heard me right, earthquakes of all things in this neck of the woods.

Speaker: 00584C8E:W05_NPCM_Diver:VTYP
Text: I knew somethin' wasn't right, and I was gonna prove 'em all wrong. All the other people at the Resort just laughing at me, well, who's laughin' now?

Speaker: 00584C8E:W05_NPCM_Diver:VTYP
Text: I just discovered a fuckin' underground spaceship! And the rocket fuel leakin' off of that thing?

Speaker: 00584C8E:W05_NPCM_Diver:VTYP
Text: Hell, it's making even the rocks glow! I gotta tell the President if it's the last thing I do!

Speaker: 00584C8E:W05_NPCM_Diver:VTYP
Text: I'll be an American hero! Get the Medal of Honor, I bet! All right, 'nuff talkin'.

Speaker: 00584C8E:W05_NPCM_Diver:VTYP
Text: Time to swim back to home, to glory, and to wipin' that damn smirk off Robbie's face! James out!

Speaker: 00572BFE:W05_NPCM_GenericBloodEagle01:VTYP
Text: Smash the weak! Beneath our feet! Prepare for war! Bathe in gore! Blood Eagles! Have no fears! Blood Eagles! Just want your ears! Ha ha ha ha ha ha!

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Well, we arrived. We're finally here. It's a damn sight better than the Pitt.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Hopefully we can make a better go of things, now that folks won't be afraid to start families.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Some of us forgot what green, living things looked like after the war.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: The only green we saw was the poison lingering in the air of the Capital, when we left on the last train out of Union Station.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: There's so much energy to build when you finally think things might be able to last. It's a home, a real home, finally!

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Whenever we get someone new to Foundation, I take the time to meet them. I ask them their name, their story, take their measure. For posterity, sorta.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: More so I don't forget, if I'm being honest. So today I'm talking to Doctor Penelope Hornwright. Are you willing to tell me about yourself, doctor?

Speaker: 0040343C:W05_Settler_Penelope:NPC_
Text: Sure. I was born before the war, around here. My father was something of a well known industrialist.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Of course, Daniel Hornwright. I read the papers. Back when we ... had papers to read. So you're a scientist?

Speaker: 0040343C:W05_Settler_Penelope:NPC_
Text: Yes, a geochemist.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Uh huh. Not much of a job market these days, huh?

Speaker: 0040343C:W05_Settler_Penelope:NPC_
Text: *laughs* I still use it, your farmers will appreciate the soil sample tests that I'm working on.

Speaker: 0040343C:W05_Settler_Penelope:NPC_
Text: But yes, mostly these days, I work with robots. I'm not an expert by pre-war standards, but around here I'm like Merlin.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: I don't want to make you uncomfortable, but you're the first ghoul to join our community. We haven't had the chance to talk to many ghouls. How'd it happen?

Speaker: 0040343C:W05_Settler_Penelope:NPC_
Text: Most communities have a shoot first policy, because of the ferals. As you can see, some of us do retain our essential personhood despite the physical changes.

Speaker: 0040343C:W05_Settler_Penelope:NPC_
Text: I was exposed to a large dose of radiation. I negotiated entry for my child in exchange for fixing a Vault's door.

Speaker: 0040343C:W05_Settler_Penelope:NPC_
Text: I knew I was going to get stuck outside, that I'd get dosed. I was the only one who could fix it, though. That was a long time ago. My daughter's nearly twenty now.

Speaker: 0040343C:W05_Settler_Penelope:NPC_
Text: Oh! Would it be alright if we got back to this later? My experiment timer is about to go off.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Oh, sure. No rush, I'll be here when you want to talk some more.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: I'm worried about Jen. That last mission was rough for her. Who'd have thought her mother was alive and in some kinda underground communist pyramid?

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Certainly not me, I'm not into speculative fiction anymore.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Maybe there's something we can do to raise her spirits. Spaghetti night, or hell, maybe some campfire songs and moonshine.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: *snaps his fingers* Scavenger run into Watoga's comic shop, that's the way. Maybe the good doctor can lend a hand with all the killer robots.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Hell, Fields finally brought his people into the fold. Took him long enough.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: I guess for those three, coming here was about trying to find another unit to join. When that unit ended up being dead, they didn't know where else they belonged.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Well, Foundation's community will do them some good. Do us some good too.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Well, we did it! Hopefully that's the hard work done. This is just a huge step forward for our community, and for Appalachia as a whole.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: I know those raiders can't be too happy, but honestly ... what did they expect? Their philosophy for life is pure hubris.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: It's not freedom to let people just shoot each other up, or steal with no consequences. It's pure chaos.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Anyway, if they come looking to cause trouble, we ought to be ready. I'd tell Ward to double the guard for a bit, but he likely already has.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Next thing we need to do is discuss how we can expand, we have a lot of folks just starting out who need homes, farms, businesses.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Time to start drawing up plans. We don't want to rush into anything without thinking about sustaining this place, protecting the people here. Better call a meeting with Ward and such.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Well, it's done and over with. I guess I understand the desire to divide things up evenly between the folks in Crater and us in Foundation. ...

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: I'm not sure I see any scenario where they use their funds in a way that's good for the overall community of Appalachia, but maybe I'm missing something.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Anyway, we need to focus on making the best of things here for our people. Protecting everybody here and enriching their lives with what we've got.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: I'll have to have a meeting with Ward and some of the others to figure out our plans for expansion, homesteads, and so on.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Not sure how much we can expand and still protect our own, so it's going to have to be planned thoroughly before we do anything. I want to believe we can.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Well, it's done. We raided the Vault, found a bunch of actual, living secret service goons there. Who could've anticipated that?

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Things have been set in motion to maybe change things around here for the better.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: Timeline's iffy though, we'll have to build up some scratch before we're welcome at the table. Then, maybe we can think about expanding around here.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: We've got a lot of newcomers who'll want to put down homesteads, work with Foundation to secure this area against the growing threat of Crater.

Speaker: 003FC006:W05_Settler_Paige:NPC_
Text: We can do this. We've got to do this.

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: Jen's journal, first entry. If you're not an older, wiser me then you shouldn't be listening to this!

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: Naw, I'm kidding. Paige told me I should consider journaling to help me establish future goals. *laughs* Right? Me, have goals?

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: Anyway, he says it also helps to digest experiences. Maybe that's true, maybe not. I guess we'll find out!

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: A lot has happened lately and I feel so grateful that Foundation-Paige took me in years ago, and that everyone's been so kind and patient.

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: We went up against some real challenges and we succeeded. It feels really good, actually.

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: So how's that for digesting my experiences? *burp*

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: Yikes, that was really pathetic! I'm sorry. I expected ... more of myself. Okay, wait, was that a personal goal?! *laughs* I am killing this!

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: I'll make this brief. I'm leaving, and I don't want anyone to come looking for me. I already said my goodbyes to some of you.

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: If I didn't say goodbye, it's probably because you're a jerk. Maybe that's shocking to hear, I don't know, I don't really care.

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: So uh ... if you run into me in the Capital Wasteland then kindly leave me alone. Thanks in advance, and bye forever!

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: Hey asshole, I left this tape here just for you.

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: I bet you came here to see if you could get your gold back, didn't you? Well, tough luck.

Speaker: 0041B767:W05_Settler_Jen:NPC_
Text: You'll never see me again ... but I might be seeing you. Bye now!

Speaker: 005427AA:W05_SecretService_DerekGarrison:NPC_

Speaker: 005427AA:W05_SecretService_DerekGarrison:NPC_

Speaker: 00589137:E06_PocketWatch_EarleWilliams_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Hey Mags... listen, I know I messed up. I never should have came into this mine in the first place... a few supplies ain't worth all this.

Speaker: 00589137:E06_PocketWatch_EarleWilliams_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Don't you for one second start thinking that I left you on purpose, and don't be going and blaming yourself either.

Speaker: 00589137:E06_PocketWatch_EarleWilliams_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I can't be there for you anymore, but you're tough and I know you'll be okay... Never forget your pops loves you more than anything.

Text: Dear Diary: I've left a flyer for my utterly legitimate medical practice over by the bookshelf. I'm hoping it'll attract some business.

Speaker: 005A1A92:Test_JoshMorettoNPC_01:NPC_

Speaker: 005A1A92:Test_JoshMorettoNPC_01:NPC_
Text: Dear Diary: Rebecca's mean, but I can't help thinking about her. Maybe it's that she's the only non-horse-fetishist around, but my heart's a-flutter.

Speaker: 00424A52:W05_NPCM_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: Alright, everyone gather 'round. Ward wanted us to record some instructions on how to use these things... Where's Mike?

Speaker: 00424A52:W05_NPCM_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: Hey... Mike! Stop messing around with that terminal and grab one of those rocket launchers.

Speaker: 005D2C72:BS01_NPCM_MikeTiller:VTYP
Text: O-oh! Sorry, I wanted to lock the terminal first. Let me put this in my bag really quick.

Speaker: 00424A52:W05_NPCM_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: Give it up, Mike, that could be decades old. Just grab one of them and come here... Wait, Mike, I told you not to pick it up like that!

Speaker: 00424A52:W05_NPCM_GenericSettler01:VTYP
Text: (Explosion)

Speaker: 005D2C72:BS01_NPCM_MikeTiller:VTYP
Text: Oh god... What have I done?

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: Starting recording, Knight Alan Connors, Brotherhood of Steel... Aw, one second, lemme toss another one on the fire.
(Wood crackles as a log is tossed on the fire)

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: Ah screw it, I'll do a status report later. This one's... off the record.

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: Odessa, Daniel... I'm about half way through the night shift, and it's gotten me thinking.

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: I know it's been tough on you two. Neither of you are quite the grizzled old timers that Leila and I are.

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: I just want you both to know how proud I am. Not just to see you rise to the challenge, but to see you do it with such vigor and determination.

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: For every bit of trouble this trip has been, it's only just started. But I hope you can enjoy calm nights like these... And take a moment to relax.

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: Look, each of us have our reasons for being here... including Leila. You may not always see eye to eye, but know that she cares deeply for both of you.

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: And Daniel, I know you probably feel she cares too much, but that's just her way.

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: Leading from the heart has always worked out for her in the past... And trust me, man, I've been through the thick of it with her.

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: In this journey ahead, we're going to need to rely on each other with unwavering support. The toughest trials have yet to come.

Speaker: 005E542D:BS01_NPCM_Connors:VTYP
Text: But remember: we're more than a Brotherhood now; we're a family.

Speaker: 005C44B4:BS01_Rahmani:NPC_
Text: Attention people of Appalachia. This is Paladin Rahmani of the Brotherhood of Steel, broadcasting from Fort Atlas.

Speaker: 005C44B4:BS01_Rahmani:NPC_
Text: You are no longer facing the Wasteland alone. The Brotherhood has returned.

Speaker: 005C44B4:BS01_Rahmani:NPC_
Text: Our mission is to help you lead a better, safer life, free from the dangers left behind in the wake of the Great War.

Speaker: 005C44B4:BS01_Rahmani:NPC_
Text: If you require aid, or if you wish to join us in our mission, find us at Fort Atlas.

Speaker: 005C44B4:BS01_Rahmani:NPC_
Text: A new dawn is here for Appalachia. Join us in building the future. Rahmani out.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Personal Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Return to Appalachia.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: After all these years, I have come back. Back to Appalachia. To West Virginia. To the home of my greatest personal and scientific failure.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Academic research was a dead end; the world was descending into riots and ruin, food shortages were increasing...

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Generating papers in a university lab to attempt to secure tenure seemed pointless. It felt irresponsible in the face of everything happening.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: West Tek approached me about joining the Greenhouse Initiative. Genetic engineering to produce new crops and multiply production.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: It swept away my concerns about joining the private sector. Here was a chance to be on the cutting edge and solve real problems at the same time.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Doctor Dumont described the goals of the Pan-Immunity Virion and the Greenhouse Initiative in terms that set my mind ablaze.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: There was satisfaction to be had there. Doing the best work, advancing humanity, making the world better than it was.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Then the funding vanished. The research staff was being cut, with no explanation, simply "a shift in priorities".

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Dumont begged me to stay, promising the new work would be vital and challenging. To my everlasting shame, I did.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Personal Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Huntersville.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I should never have allowed Dumont to convince me to stay with West Tek when they shuttered the Greenhouse Initiative.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The Pan-Immunity Virion was intended to shield us from biological warfare and make the population safe from the horrors war could unleash.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The Greenhouse Initiative turned the same work to feeding the ever-increasing starving masses. Noble goals and worthy science.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The discovery of the FEV abandoned all that. The awesome potential of the virus, what it could do if harnessed to those same ends - ignored.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Instead they saw a weapon. Super soldiers. Small-minded bureaucrats and their pet scientists had the keys to human evolution and saw profit and war.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Dr. Khan - a disgrace to that title, in the end - took over, and even those miserable goals were cast aside in favor of the perverse.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Infecting the water supply of Huntersville just to observe the effects - why? We knew the virus in its current state produced horrors.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Had we been looking for a cure, perhaps it could have been justified. But Khan had no such interest. He did it because he could.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Were I a better man, a better scientist, I would have left immediately. My belated resignation does me little credit.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Research Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Number One.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Under any other circumstance, it would feel foolish to begin recording these before my work has even meaningfully begun.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I developed this habit during my graduate studies. A tool, helping me as much to retain insights as to preserve my failures.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Here, when nothing about what I am to undertake is normal, I break with tradition and start these logs now. Posterity requires this moment be kept.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: What I am about to do will almost assuredly make of me a villain in the eyes of many. My work is distasteful, and must be conducted in secret.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Here, for whatever person may one day hear this, I say for the record that what I will do I do out of love. An unselfish love that knows no rest.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Not for a person. No clichéd deceased spouse or lost child motivates me. Humanity is my love, though none would accuse me of excess sentiment.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: We are a species tormented by the ravages of the Great War, reduced to vermin eking out an existence in the rubble of the world that was.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The mistakes of my past are writ on the face of every survivor living in fear of the mutated horrors that stalk the Wasteland.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I can correct this. I must. We are not meant to live like this. There is a way forward, to free us from the horrors we...I...created.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Yet, I fear the failures that lie between me and the future I see. They will be many, and they will cause a great deal of pain before I am done.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The sins of West Tek must be undone. The price will be extreme, but it must be paid. If my life is included in that price, I will pay it gladly.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I record this log not to seek forgiveness. I neither deserve nor require it.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I ask only that you, my hypothetical listener, know that the things to come are not the product of ill-intent or a sadistic mania.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: One day, good will come of the evil I am set to do. I hope that you are there to see it, and understand.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Research Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Number Five.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The creators of the Forced Evolutionary Virus were idiot savants. They saw weapons, soldiers to win a war that would end almost as soon as it began.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: They had discovered a means by which we could seize the reigns of human evolution, and all they could envision was more efficient death.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: My colleagues at West Tek were likewise fools. They made the virus a plaything and Huntersville their ant farm, shaking it to watch them scurry.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The FEV was never meant to create abominations. At its core is something wondrous and hopeful. I will free it from what they made of it.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Humanity will have the future it should have had, and a better human will build that world, free from fear.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Research Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Number Thirteen.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Whatever the prior occupants of this Vault may have done, I must thank them, especially Chief Engineer Doctor Memling.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The good doctor, while a respectable scientist in his own right, had the classic engineer's idiosyncratic approach to maintenance.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: His additions to the Vault reactor and electrical subsystems provide me with ample points of connection to directly access mains power.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Between this and certain defects in reactor shielding, I have invaluable resources for my research.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: My first attempts in this area are more disappointing, however. Lacking Memling's expertise, my electrical impedance tests failed dramatically.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The unintentional discovery of a new method of rapidly cooking a mole rat fails even in that regard:

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Molerat exposed to several thousand volts at significant amperage does not make for an appetizing sight.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Nonetheless, these results are duly recorded and I believe my understanding of the system is sufficient to produce more useful results in the future.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Research Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Number Seventeen.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I am no longer alone in this endeavor. Against all odds, I have made contact with a former colleague, Doctor Farha, whom fate preserved as it did me.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Doctor Farha was reluctant when I first described my aims. The testing that will be required, and the failures, give her pause.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Even at university, we clashed on the ethical boundaries of research. Regardless, I have convinced her to aid me despite her doubts.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I will continue to work here in Vault 96, in secrecy. Doctor Farha, meanwhile has established a laboratory suitable for mass-production.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: She has acquired a foundling of sorts, a young woman by the name of Nellie Wright. She seems something of a prodigy.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I believe it was Ms. Wright's enthusiastic support of my ideas that convinced Doctor Farha to acquiesce to my request for aid.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Farha has also brought in Jain. I knew him from university, and our time at West Tek. This work is his chance at redemption as much as my own.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005F26AF:BS02_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Research Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Number Twenty-Two.

Speaker: 005F26AF:BS02_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: In retrospect, my enthusiasm for the cryogenically-preserved specimens in the Vault was excessive, if not actually misplaced.

Speaker: 005F26AF:BS02_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I am down to the last four viable test subjects. Further research is at an impasse unless I move to human subjects.

Speaker: 005F26AF:BS02_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Obtaining volunteers will be impossible. The necessary experimentation to even approach a functional result will be unavoidably fatal to some.

Speaker: 005F26AF:BS02_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I will have to take extreme measures to obtain subjects. Thousands, perhaps millions of lives will be saved. Utility trumps sentimentality.

Speaker: 005F26AF:BS02_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Research Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Number Thirty-Eight.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The capture of human test subjects is itself less difficult than I imagined.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The people of Appalachia are in bad need of medicine, and lone travelers are easy to approach when one is a doctor.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I tell myself these acts are necessary - the work too important, and I cannot complete it without living human subjects to experiment upon.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Yet as I compound failure upon failure, in my quiet hours I question what I have made of myself in pursuit of this goal.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I began this enterprise fully cognizant of what it might take, but even with that foreknowledge I could not comprehend the weight of it.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Have I become no different from that fool Elias, a font of monsters with no humane end in sight? Am I deluded in believing myself capable of success?

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: These moments pass. I push aside those doubts and focus on the work before me. The people of Appalachia need this. The world needs this.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Let them vilify me when they learn what I have done. I will make a better future for them, even if I do not live to see it myself.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Research Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Number Fifty-Seven.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I begin to doubt my own sanity at times. My efforts, while not without progress, continue to fail to bear real fruit.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: The FEV seems almost deliberately malignant, as if it had a consciousness and rejects my every attempt to bend it toward a benevolent end.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I have come to recognize the signs of imminent metastasis and conversion to the so-called "Super Mutant" state.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I am ill-equipped to deal with the product of such failure, and have taken to disposing of these unfortunates outside the Vault itself.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I regret that my current methods of disposal may, in the short term, increase the Super Mutant population in Appalachia, but it cannot be avoided.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Research Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Number One Hundred and Twelve.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: My work's demand for human subjects has increased dramatically as I make ground toward my ultimate goal.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: To this end, I have contracted with a group of mercenaries calling themselves the Hellcat Company. Trustworthy, if such a term applies here.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: They display a useful moral flexibility. They do not question the nature of my work or my need for human subjects, and I do not illuminate them.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Already they have begun acquiring new subjects at far greater pace than I could, and a contingent remain to guard the Vault itself.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I must be careful. A mercenary is only as loyal as their pay, after all. My control of the Vault security systems keeps them in check for now.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Research Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Number One Hundred and Forty-Eight.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I can feel the end approaching. The equations fall into place, and I can see the shape of it, the perfected FEV, even in my restless dreams.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: That vision of the goal is the only succor now. What I have done to reach it can never be washed away. I have been right, but that is small comfort.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I give them numbers now, and try not to listen when they speak to me, pleading. I prefer to sedate them when removing them from their holding cells

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Unconscious, they cannot weep, or stare accusingly at me. I cannot make them understand that we are alike part of a greater destiny.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: They think me inhuman, uncaring. I know I would be no different, were our roles reversed. I do not blame them for hating me.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: I lie in my cot at night and see their faces. I remember them all, and wait for sleep to carry me to the visions of when I can finally stop.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Final candidate number three is ready for verification. I am within two, perhaps three iterations of success.

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: Will I be able to sleep untroubled when this is over? Or will punishment for what I have done be a mercy, freeing me from its memory?

Speaker: 005C287D:BS01_Blackburn:NPC_
Text: End log.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: This is Pat Gerber, Striker for the Union. Formerly the 42, now with our command up in the 29. Mission log: taking care of unfinished business.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Used to get reports back in the day of something -- some kind of mutant or monster -- lurking beneath the Foundry.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Disappearances, attacks, one or two mangled corpses... nasty stuff. Thought it was Fanatic raids myself, but panic ensued, so I got put on the case.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Of course, losing the Foundry changed our priorities a bit, but now that we're re-settled, I've come home to take a look.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Can't say I'm not a bit curious... Don't get to monster hunting very often.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Will be a change of pace from rooting out spies and Fanatic guerillas, if indeed it is something new on our plates.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Pat Gerber, Union Striker, Local 29. Mission log: in pursuit of a beast. Strange to be back in my old stomping grounds after so long away.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: So much has changed. The streets... well, they've been filthy since the War, of course, but we always used to keep them up as best we could.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Now you can barely move without tripping over old rebar or slipping in a pool of spilled waste... The Fanatics did a number on this place.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Met up with the new Local leader, a woman who goes by Hex.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Guess they've had run-ins with the creatures I'm looking for, so there goes my "Fanatic raider" theory.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: She showed me the body of one of these things... No wonder they had folks running scared.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Going toe-to-toe with these troglodytes would put the fear into anybody. It's a wonder the 42 is still standing.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Best info we have on where they're coming from hasn't changed, though.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Seems disturbances in the Foundry -- raids against the Fanatics -- always stir them up and bring them out of hiding.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Will be quite the task to get in there unnoticed by the enemy, but that's what Strikers are for.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: I know an old route, back door type situation. Should work... If it doesn't, you know where to find my body.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: And send my regards to the rest of the 29. If nothing else, you know I'll take some Fanatics down with me on the way.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Pat Gerber, Union Striker with the Local 29. Mission log: things are getting uncomfortable.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Found a way past the patrols and made it to the tunnels beneath the Foundry.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Place is like a maze, it's no wonder we never scouted the whole thing when we owned this place. And there's evidence of our mutant friends everywhere.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Human bones littered here and there, stripped of all the flesh and muscle... I've got a strong stomach, but it's hard to take.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Must've been dragging folks down here for as long as we suspected. Can't help but think of the friends I've lost...

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: I want to exterminate the whole lot of these creatures.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: The going is getting tougher. No natural light, of course, or artificial for that matter. But more than that, the rads get worse the deeper I go.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: I can feel my body heating up; feel my skin crawling. Stomach is starting to churn, I still haven't found the bastards...

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Pounded some Rad-X, but it's hardly helping. I should know better, but I want to press on.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Maybe a few levels deeper before I turn back and rethink my strategy. Maybe steal a hazmat suit from somewhere, if I'm lucky.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: My damn head's starting to swim... Hope the damage isn't done already.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Pat-- Pat Gerber, uh, Striker with the Union Local... 29. Mission log: pretty sure I fucked up good.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Got a little farther down and came face-to-face with my "prey." Damn thing was hideous... Was limping along, really feeling the rads at this point.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Didn't feel up to a fight, was pretty sure I was a goner. But it didn't pounce, didn't strike. The thing just... stared. It stared at me.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: It... It knew me, I-I could feel it. How that's possible, I-I don't know, but... sent a chill down my spine.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Its eyes... called to me. Felt like an eternity, but after a minute or two it just, just turned around and left. And so did I.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: I made it back topside. Lucky to be alive, honestly, but all I feel is... is an anger.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: It's swelling up inside me, I'm just, so mad. Mad I didn't kill the thing, mad it didn't kill me. It doesn't make any sense.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Don't-- don't think I'm going back to the 29 any time soon. Need-- need to wait for these urges to subside.

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Don't want to hurt anyone. Shouldn't be near other people right now...

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: God, it's so damn bright up here. Was it always so blinding?

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Need to find a little corner, out of the light. Someplace warm. I don't know why it's gotten so cold, either. Too used to the rads, maybe...

Speaker: 0064A882:XPD_NPCM_PatGerber:VTYP
Text: Gerber out.

Speaker: 00648F87:XPD_NPCM_GenericFanatic01:VTYP
Text: I'm doing it this time. I'm gonna kill that beast.

Speaker: 00648F87:XPD_NPCM_GenericFanatic01:VTYP
Text: You? A monster slayer? Hah! Hah! Hah! They laugh and call me names. Tell me to get back on the line, say I'm a coward.

Speaker: 00648F87:XPD_NPCM_GenericFanatic01:VTYP
Text: Pah! I'll show 'em all. I'm not coming back without that damn thing's head. And what's more, I'll do it all with this -- my trusty combat knife.

Speaker: 00648F87:XPD_NPCM_GenericFanatic01:VTYP
Text: Nothing makes a man like killing monsters with a knife. I'll come back with its head and then we'll see who's laughing.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: This is Bella Gerber, Union Runner. I used to run supplies between Union outposts. Now I run civilians to places they might survive.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: People are fleeing their homes to get away from the Fanatics, finding themselves in dangerous places they don't recognize anymore.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: Places like the Trench. I kept encountering them on my runs: people trapped under fallen rubble; broken families; lost wanderers, wasting away.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: I thought, "These people need shelter more than the 42 needs bullets."

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: So I started taking them with me, to the Sanctum. The last bastion of hope we have in this awful, gaping chasm.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: Bella Gerber, Union Runner, continuing my self-appointed route between the Sanctum and the Trench.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: It's getting harder to navigate; the terrain changes every day. If something happens to me, I worry that the people sheltered here will be stranded.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: I need to get back to headquarters and update someone on what's happening here. But at this point... (sigh) I don't know if I can find my way back.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: Today a little boy asked me if he would ever get to go back home. I didn't have the heart to tell him.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: That I... That his home... probably doesn't exist anymore. That I wouldn't be able to guide him there, even if it did.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: All I could do was smile and promise that we'd take care of him here, at the Sanctum.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: I'm Bella Gerber, a Runner for the Union. Or at least I used to be. To tell you the truth, I think we're alone out here.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: Haven't heard from headquarters in months, and they haven't heard from us.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: The Union... we're all trying our best to help everyone, but there's just too many people to help, too much to do, too many hazards in the way.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: We're running low on supplies. I spend every daylight hour scavenging, but it's not enough. I need help. And we're not getting any.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: Some of the survivors volunteered to go out scavenging with me. Young ones. The last partner I had out here was boiled alive in a radpit.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: If even he couldn't... (deep breath) I can't let them risk their lives, not after I promised them safety.

Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: I'm gonna start going out at night too. Maybe then I can gather enough.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: This is Bella Gerber. Used to be a Union Runner. Now I'm a prisoner.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: The Fanatics found us. They took over the Sanctum. Everyone I promised safety... I delivered them straight into the hands of the Fanatics.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: I was so arrogant. So stupid. Forgot that I wasn't the only person capable of navigating the Trench, of learning how to navigate it.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: Pat always told me I needed to learn to trust others, to stop taking the weight of the world upon myself. (sad laugh) But he's the same way.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: I hadn't mentioned it before, but I... I have a husband. Pat Gerber. We promised to meet up after our work for the Union was done.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: But it will never be done, will it, Pat? Things will only get worse and worse.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: I don't think I'll make it out of here. But I could at least give the others a chance.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: The others I condemned, bringing them here with the promise of safety. I have to give them a chance, Pat.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: This will be my final log. Goodbye.

HolotapeName: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
Speaker: 0065F767:XPD_NPCF_BellaGerber:VTYP
Text: And Pat, if you ever find that monster you were looking for... Don't go alone.

Speaker: 00678C30:NWOT_NPCM_ExRaider:VTYP
Text: Oh crap. Oh man. They weren't lyin'. It wasn't a story. There really is a... a thing down here.

Speaker: 00678C30:NWOT_NPCM_ExRaider:VTYP
Text: Thought my mask was broken, and some kinda gas leak was gettin' in... Then I smelled it. Nearly puked up in my damn suit! Pretty sure I... woke it up...

Speaker: 00678C30:NWOT_NPCM_ExRaider:VTYP
Text: Found some of that ore but when I hit it, it wasn't rock, it was... fleshy? Then came the noise, Jesus that noise...

Speaker: 00678C30:NWOT_NPCM_ExRaider:VTYP
Text: Thought it was an earthquake til I saw it. (heavy breathing) shit... SHIT!

Speaker: 00678C30:NWOT_NPCM_ExRaider:VTYP
Text: The wall moved, and had a mouth. Damn near pissed my pants! I don't care if that Ultracite stuff is down there.

Speaker: 00678C30:NWOT_NPCM_ExRaider:VTYP
Text: (panicked breathing) I gotta warn people... Should I? Gotta keep moving.

Speaker: 00678C30:NWOT_NPCM_ExRaider:VTYP
Text: No way I'm going near that, that thing again, it would take a nuke to get rid of it! I gotta get outta here. I gotta-

Speaker: 00678C30:NWOT_NPCM_ExRaider:VTYP
Text: (creature screeching)

Speaker: 00678C30:NWOT_NPCM_ExRaider:VTYP
Text: Oh God no-

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: Welcome to Nuka World on Tour!

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: The only traveling carnival with every minimal acceptable safety standard met!

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: Lost your friends and family?

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: Oh no!

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: Feeling all alone?

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: Good golly!

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: Make your way to our meeting point at the medical stand where we can help what's lost be found.

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: Yay!

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: Hey, Cappy, I'm thirsty!

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: Nice to meet you, Thirsty.

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: Oh, Cappy...

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: Well, Thirsty, if you're feeling parched, head over to our fantastic Nuka drink stalls: the most Nuka-riffic beverages on the road!

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: Do you feel lucky? Spin the Wheel is now open!

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: Head on over to the circus tent to hear the rules.

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: When the sheriff is away, the bandits will play!

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: Head over to the Wild West Showdown for a rootin' shootin' time!

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: Looking for a romantic ride with your special someone? Head on over to the Tunnel of Love! Now open!

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: D'awww!

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: Looking for a heart-stopping thrill ride?

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: You bet!

Speaker: 0066E518:RadioNWOT_Cappy:NPC_
Text: Check out our fabulous coaster: the Nuka Launcher!

Speaker: 0066E519:RadioNWOT_Bottle:NPC_
Text: Wowwie!

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: Ouch! I stubbed my toe!

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: Oh no! What an unfortunate accident!

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: But remember, Bottle, your safety is your responsibility. Nuka-World on Tour is not responsible for any injuries sustained on the premises.

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: Well, I'll be. Guess I should look where I'm going, huh?

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: And how!

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: Had enough of the rides? Full of food and fizztacular Nuka-Cola? Why not try the Nuka-cade!

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: Oh boy! Look at all those prizes!

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: Knock Knock.

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: Who's there?

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: Noah.

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: Noah who?

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: Noah place where I can get some food?

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: I sure do Bottle! Our food stalls have the best fair food around!

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: Hey Cappy, tell me a joke!

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: Did you hear about the the Vim theme park?

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: No?

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: Me neither, I went to Nuka-World Instead!

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: (Laughter)

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: What makes Nuka-Cola so delicious?

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: The Unique combination of seventeen fruit essences, balanced to enhance the classic cola flavour!

Speaker: 0066E51C:NWOT_NPCM_Bottle:VTYP
Text: Gee, Cappy, I'm having so much fun... Sure wish this carnival could last forever!

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: Don't worry bottle! Nuka-World on Tour may come and go, but Nuka-World will last forever!

Speaker: 0066E51B:NWOT_NPCM_Cappy:VTYP
Text: Stop by our customer information booth to find the nearest location to you... Plan your next family Nuka-cation today!

Speaker: 0069947A:Storm_MQ01_AnnouncerF_VaultTec:VTYP
Text: This is an emergency broadcast signal from [BLEEP]. Authentication code Barracuda.

Speaker: 0069947A:Storm_MQ01_AnnouncerF_VaultTec:VTYP
Text: Emergency classification: blast door integrity compromised.

Speaker: 0069947A:Storm_MQ01_AnnouncerF_VaultTec:VTYP
Text: Any available Vault-Tec personnel are required to respond under Emergency Protocol VT-21.

Speaker: 0069947A:Storm_MQ01_AnnouncerF_VaultTec:VTYP
Text: This signal will repeat.

Speaker: 006A22DA:MOON_NPCM_Cat:VTYP
Text: (meow)

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: What the f-- oh, it's just a cat. When's the last time I've even seen a cat?

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Thought Scoot hated cats... Guess things really have changed, huh.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Clearly, it's... been more than a bit since he's been home. That's, uh, probably not a promising sign...

Speaker: 006A22DA:MOON_NPCM_Cat:VTYP
Text: (meow)

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: ... So why come out here, old boy? ... What's this ... truth ... you were so certain of?

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: (typing)

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: (sigh) Oh, Scoot... ... Hm... Geez, I didn't think he was so...

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Well... Nothing recent. Not sure if that's good or bad news, I--

Speaker: 006A22DA:MOON_NPCM_Cat:VTYP
Text: (meow)

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Holy hell, you little bastards are everywhere. You must be repopulating like rabbits.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Repopulating...

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Could it be... ? .... ....

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: No, no, no, no, no... Stop. No, no, no... Come on. Stop it.

Speaker: 006A22DA:MOON_NPCM_Cat:VTYP
Text: (meow)

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: ... but maybe, right? Maybe?

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: No, dammit, shit. Get it together. I gotta get outta--

Speaker: 006A22DA:MOON_NPCM_Cat:VTYP
Text: (meow)

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Oh shut it, furball!

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: (Inhale) (exhale) Ah! Appa-la-chi-yuh!

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: Whoa, watch it, smoothskin.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Sorry, just needed a little stretch to go with that delicious, boggy air.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
