Text: Also, I assure you, the skin under here ain't so smooth, Genie.

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: Don't call me that-- and yeah, whatever, figure of speech. You seem extra chipper, today.

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: Oh... That's right. You're a local here. Been a spell since you've been home?

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Oh, more than a spell, my trigger-happy undead friend.

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: I swear to god, Aries--

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: This step is the first time my feet hath graced these gentle grounds in my decades long absence.

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: You're not listening... Okay, Aries, I'm moving ahead.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Your wayward son returns, you slumbering beast of mists and mystery!

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Re-sculpted and carved into something new, I retread my old grounds with a fresh gleam in my eye, shining brighter than an atomic flash!

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: Oh, brother...

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: ... That reminds me, why now?

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: What?

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: You've been on the Kentucky routes since you started. I thought you enjoyed it there. Why come back now?

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: (Inhale) (exhale) Hmm... Family.

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: Uh... Look I don't know if you heard about that whole Scorched thing, but, well...

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Fear not. My family is here now.

Speaker: 0056EFC9:W05_NPCF_Caravan_Eugenie:VTYP
Text: Whatever you say, Aries. Let's go.

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: Oh shit, it's really you.

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (rasp) Yeah... Hi... Ray.

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: We tried looking for you, we all knew you weren't... But, ya know, things... happened.

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: ... I'm really happy you're all right.

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: If you can call this... (cough) all right... I guess... Listen, Ray. Laura, she's (cough)...

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: Stop. I appreciate what you're saying, but stop. She's coming back, man.

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: No, I mean, I--

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: Enough, Cal. It's good to see you. There's extra supplies in the living room. I haven't heard any break-ins, so they should still be there.

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: Take what you need... And get out of here. Appalachia, I mean. These hills, they... It...

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: I know...

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: No, I mean... it was real, Cal. It... did this to me.

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: I... know.

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: Do me a favor? Grab me a bottle of the good stuff from downstairs before you go? I'd get it myself, but...

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: One step (cough) ahead of you...

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: You're the best, Cal... Take care of yourself, okay?

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: You can... come with me... you know?

Speaker: 006A22D8:MOON_NPCM_RayGary:VTYP
Text: Any minute, Cal. She'll be back any minute.

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: ... Good bye, Ray.

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (Gasped breathing, coming to a rest)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: ... Will yet restore me to the vital air... Death feeds on my mute voice, and laughs at our despair...

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (Pained laughter, coughing)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (Loud rumbles in the distance, sirens)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: The leprous corpse, touched by this spirit tender exhales itself ... in flowers of gentle breath...

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: Like incarnations of the stars... when splendor is changed to fragrance... they illumine death.

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (Coughing, rumbling intensifying)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: ... and... mock the merry worm that wake beneath! (coughing)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: Nought we know, dies. Shall that alone which knows be as a sword consumed before the sheath by sightless lightning? (rumbling)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: The intense atom glows a moment... then is quenched in a most cold repose!

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (coughing, intense rumbling)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (Screeching metal, crunching) (Screams)

Speaker: 006A22DB:MOON_NPCF_SheepsquatchImposter:VTYP
Text: Baa...

Speaker: 006A22DB:MOON_NPCF_SheepsquatchImposter:VTYP
Text: (Mechanical foot steps fading away)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (gasp) (cough) What... Ugh...

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (struggle)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (Dragging along the ground)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (struggle) al... most...

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (Container unlocks) (Fumbling with supplies)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: (Stimpak injection) (Sigh)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: Ack! ... Ah... (wet cough)

Speaker: 006A22D9:MOON_NPCM_PainedVoice:VTYP
Text: This is... Calvin... van... Lowe (cough) Initiate... proto-- (rasp) Initiate Protocol.. Ado... nais...

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Carver. It's Aries. Look, I know we've had some weird... uh... encounters. I mean, even weird by my standards.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: There's something about me-- about us-- that I want to tell you. That you... and your family... deserves to know.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: My name is Calvin van Lowe. I'm the brother of your mom, Shelley. I know she ain't your birth mom, but that still makes you family.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: Take a listen to these tapes, if you need the proof. Show them to your mom, she'll know.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: I'm not planning to up and change my life again. I am who I am now. No going back on that.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: But... I'm hoping, maybe... Maybe someday I can start repairing some bridges. And maybe you can help me with that.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: If... you think that's right. You know Shelley, er, your mom better than I do. Sorry to spring this on ya, kid.

Speaker: 00581F15:W05_NPCM_Caravan_Aries:VTYP
Text: And P.S. - If you call me "Uncle Calvin," I'll leave you in a hole so deep in Big Bend they'll never hear you scream.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: It takes a lot of chems to get thrown out of the Neapolitan, but we were riding the line.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: My confidant and I made the trip to cover the Showmen's Games, a world renowned exercise in high stakes barbarism. Few in the entertainment world could match.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Instead, we spent most of our time getting hopped up on Daddy-O and chugging bourbon in the casino bar.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: It seemed the logical course of action. The Games were notoriously deadly, even for bystanders.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Liquid courage and a head full of hallucinogens were the obvious defense.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: What we didn't count on was the Devil's Blood. We had never heard of the stuff, and for good reason - it's an AC specialty.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: We weren't supposed to have it. It wasn't meant for us, but for the real high rollers.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: The people who, even in a world ravaged by pestilence and war, still managed to come out on top. But we found a way.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: The exclusivity made it all the sweeter. Not because we aspired to that lifestyle - quite the opposite.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 1
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: We wanted to soil the royal concoction inside our mangy, flea-ridden hides.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 2
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: One hit is all it took to realize we'd made a terrible mistake. Even for degenerates as celebrated as ourselves, this was too much.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 2
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: The trip wasn't bad, it was glorious - horrifyingly so. We knew, instantly, that this was what money could buy. And we knew we'd never have it again.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 2
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: We witnessed firsthand the life that was being kept from us, and as much as we wanted to reach out and take it...

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 2
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: ...we couldn't do anything more than slump in our chairs and watch as it drifted away.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 2
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: The consequences would be more than spiritual. Every inch of our bodies yearned for more after that first hit.

HolotapeName: A Night at the Neapolitan, Part 2
Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Addictol won't be enough to cure this hunger. Maybe nothing will.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: It's a long hike to the Metal Dome. Jagged paths up the cliffs above Monongah are the only feasible way for pilgrims to reach this shrine to violence.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: You have to be a certain kind of lunatic to make the journey. One wrong move and you're dashed upon the rocks below, fodder for rabid wolves and mutant lizards.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Not to mention that your future hosts - the engineers of death that call themselves the Rust Eagles - are less than welcoming to outsiders.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Luckily, I am anything but sane. I climbed the mountain to witness with my own two eyes the bloody spectacle these brutal raiders were only too eager to display.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: I knew what I was walking into - or thought I knew - but still I was unprepared for what I was about to witness, and for the feelings it stirred inside me.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: The first thing to reach you is the sound of it. From half a mile away the shriek of steel cutting steel reassures you that you haven't come all this way for nothing.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: But what really sticks with you is the stench. The rot of decaying corpses, the smell of searing flesh, and the stink of oil that pervades every inch of the place.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Fumes that drive the Rusties into an ecstatic frenzy whenever one of their bots extinguishes a human life.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: You settle in to witness the action in the arena, and the worst part is you can't look away.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: You get so sucked in that you forget all about the last shred of humanity you used to have.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: You tell yourself you want the gladiators to win as the carnage unfolds below. It's the only way to justify your sheer captivation.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Yet you acknowledge that it grips you like you never thought possible.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: No matter what else you've seen in this godforsaken world, there's simply nothing like the thrill of it.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: I've taken every drug in the Wasteland. Daddy-O, Mentats, Day Tripper, they each have their ups and downs, but Nukashine took me on a ride.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: I didn't expect it, not from a swig of Appalachian hooch. I grew up on that stuff... Kentucky will do that to you.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: It was almost like a betrayal. The first sip had the same familiar burn, then it kicked you in the head like a two ton Brahmin, and it was all downhill from there.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Colors that I didn't know existed flashed before my eyes. The trees around me morphed into ravenous ghouls.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Beset on all sides, I reached for my gun and pulled a tato from the holster. Useless thing! I shouted.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: By then the ghouls had me, there was little I could do. I took off my shoe and beat them with it, to no avail.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: I decided to succumb. Just devour me, I thought. What's the use in struggling at this point?

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Maybe some lucky cannibal will happen upon my scraps and get a free meal. At least that would give my death some meaning.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: I let my mind wander as my body ceased to be. A cool breeze on the Florida coast. The splashing of the Mississippi.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: The green hills of Appalachia, a violent storm in the distance. I drifted from one to the next as my flesh broke into a thousand tiny pieces of ghoul fodder.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Suddenly, sunlight. I sat up. I was whole, on the temporal plane. Far too pleasant a place to be hell...

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Appalachia, the green hills from my vision. The crisis was over. I was still alive, with an empty jug of Nukashine by my side.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: Dr. G... I hope this message finds you well. I'm closing in on my target, a big man called Little Rob.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: They say he lives somewhere in the mountains. In some kind of hideout.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: You might wonder who 'they' are... I'm talking about people in the know. Squatters, prospectors, gold diggers. They say they've had run ins with the target.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: I met them in a shack in the hills, up near a golf course that's seen better days. But I wasn't there for the greens...

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: We met up and made merry. Don't judge me! You're a merrymaker yourself, you know. They said they could take me to Rob.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: I decided to follow. Dangerous, I know, but you have to take some risks if you're gonna get the big score. That's just how it is in this business.

Speaker: 006DC8F9:NPCM_JackHunter:VTYP
Text: I'll see you on the other side. Hunter out.

Speaker: 0073161A:AC_SQ03_Custodial_TheatreTech_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: And... lights.

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: *door slams open* There you are, you big, stupid animal!

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: How could you do this to me? How could you do any of it?! If you truly loved me... you should have backed off!

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: No! Don't come any closer! Don't!

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: *gunshots, followed by a heavy thud, and crying*

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: It was never supposed to be like this... We had love, all of us. Brutus, for me. Me, for Stratton. Stratton... for his job. We all had so much love.

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: Maybe, after all... It was too much. Maybe... I caused all this...

Speaker: 0073161A:AC_SQ03_Custodial_TheatreTech_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Something's wrong. We have to stop the rehearsal.

Speaker: 0073161B:AC_SQ03_Custodial_Director_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Oh, for Christ's sake. We're not going to stop- *gunshot*

Speaker: 0073161A:AC_SQ03_Custodial_TheatreTech_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Shit! I think they're dead for real!

Speaker: 0073161B:AC_SQ03_Custodial_Director_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Tomorrow is opening night. They can't be dead! Wake up, you idiots!

Speaker: 0073161A:AC_SQ03_Custodial_TheatreTech_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Someone replaced the prop gun! Hurry, get a doctor!

Speaker: 0073161B:AC_SQ03_Custodial_Director_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: God damn it! All this work for nothing. *sigh* Well, they're better dead than incompetent.

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: You're new here. I know all my regulars. How did you like the show?

Speaker: 00744977:XPD_AC_NPCM_Stratton:VTYP
Text: I'm sorry, but that spot's taken.

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: I don't see anyone taking it. A shame... Whoever stood you up clearly doesn't see what they're missing.

Speaker: 00744977:XPD_AC_NPCM_Stratton:VTYP
Text: They're missing the opportunity of a lifetime. If we don't close this merger, it's- You wouldn't understand.

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: Forget the merger, honey. Forget all of it. You're here with me now, isn't that right?

Speaker: 00744977:XPD_AC_NPCM_Stratton:VTYP
Text: No, I'm- I can't be distracted by this right now. Security! I need help with this dancer- Wait, wait! No, it's not me! I'm the one being harassed!

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: Now, Brutus, hold on. Don't be so rough with him. Brutus! *sigh* What a dolt. I was just getting interested...

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: Here we are. It's a beautiful Saturday night.

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: The merger's complete, and after all his hard work, my dear Stratton will have a special surprise waiting for him: me! *excited giggle*

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: Now that everything's done, he has no reason to reject me. And how our love will bloom, like it was always meant to!

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: *calling out* Stratton, dear? Are you home? Stratton?

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: *gasp* No... No, no, no, no! Not breathing... Oh god! *sobbing* You were here all along and I... What happened to you? Did someone...?

Speaker: 0073161D:XPD_AC_NPCF_Stella_HolotapeOnly:VTYP
Text: *viciously* Brutus.

Speaker: 0075BF8D:XPD_AC_CarlyDay_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: The last time I spoke into one of these was during an interview with a muckraker before the bombs. Ironic.

Speaker: 0075BF8D:XPD_AC_CarlyDay_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Some nobody farmer from the outskirts of the city came knocking at my door today. Tracked his muddy boots all over City Hall.

Speaker: 0075BF8D:XPD_AC_CarlyDay_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: Said that I've done a terrible job as mayor, and it's about time someone did something about it. As if someone of his ilk could do better!

Speaker: 0075BF8D:XPD_AC_CarlyDay_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: He told me I have two options. Either I leave and get to keep my head, or he blows it off me. I say let him try!

Speaker: 0075BF8D:XPD_AC_CarlyDay_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: He's not the first loon to try to usurp me, that's for sure. Plenty more have tried and failed, and they had a lot more power than Timothy Lane.

Speaker: 0075BF8D:XPD_AC_CarlyDay_VOICEONLY:NPC_
Text: I'm not going anywhere. My security detail will make quick work of him. Maybe I'll even have Quentino's boys teach him a lesson.

Speaker: 0074D9A6:XPD_AC_NPCM_QuentinoLombardi:VTYP
Text: *groans*

Speaker: 006FD004:XPD_AC_NPCF_Concerta:VTYP
Text: C'mon, Tino. You can do it. Let me help you up.

Speaker: 0074D9A6:XPD_AC_NPCM_QuentinoLombardi:VTYP
Text: I can do it myself! *coughs* I don't need your help. You're only after one thing.

Speaker: 006FD004:XPD_AC_NPCF_Concerta:VTYP
Text: One thing?! Who has sat by your bedside waiting on you hand and foot? Who has covered for you dutifully while you waste away on your own product?!

Speaker: 006FD004:XPD_AC_NPCF_Concerta:VTYP
Text: Antonio sure didn't. Neither did the other caporegimes! I have done everything you ever asked of me for nothing in return.

Speaker: 006FD004:XPD_AC_NPCF_Concerta:VTYP
Text: Why can't you see that? Why can't you look at me the same way you look at them? Why can't you-?

Speaker: 0074D9A6:XPD_AC_NPCM_QuentinoLombardi:VTYP
Text: This is exactly why I can't! *coughs* You are weak, emotional. You are stuck in your own head.

Speaker: 0074D9A6:XPD_AC_NPCM_QuentinoLombardi:VTYP
Text: You think you're special because you're my sister. I'll tell you what, Concerta. Without me, you'd be nothing. You're not special!

Speaker: 0074D9A6:XPD_AC_NPCM_QuentinoLombardi:VTYP
Text: You know the rules, and you aren't above them. Tony will be my heir, and he'll do a fine job as godfather.

Speaker: 006FD004:XPD_AC_NPCF_Concerta:VTYP
Text: How can you say that?! I built this empire! I was there, telling YOU what to do all along!

Speaker: 006FD004:XPD_AC_NPCF_Concerta:VTYP
Text: I never overstepped, I never betrayed you. I played my part. But now, we both know that the inevitable is just around the corner.

Speaker: 006FD004:XPD_AC_NPCF_Concerta:VTYP
Text: Please, just hear me out. Just tell them-

Speaker: 0074D9A6:XPD_AC_NPCM_QuentinoLombardi:VTYP
Text: Enough! *wheezes* I've been crystal clear already. You expect the impossible, and then act surprised when you're told no.

Speaker: 0074D9A6:XPD_AC_NPCM_QuentinoLombardi:VTYP
Text: I shouldn't have to tell you what your place is. You already know. It ain't gonna change after I croak.

Speaker: 006FD004:XPD_AC_NPCF_Concerta:VTYP
Text: Yes, you're right. I went too far. For that, I'm sorry. Antonio is your heir. I need to respect that.

Speaker: 006FD004:XPD_AC_NPCF_Concerta:VTYP
Text: You two won't be apart for long, I wager.

Speaker: 006FBFA9:Storm_NPCM_Oberlin:VTYP
Text: Oberlin Report S-487.

Speaker: 006FBFA9:Storm_NPCM_Oberlin:VTYP
Text: Internal issues: As well as the concerns raised previously there have been several new complaints that have been added to the list.

Speaker: 006FBFA9:Storm_NPCM_Oberlin:VTYP
Text: We're doing what we can but we're having to prioritize and we're spread thin.

Speaker: 006FBFA9:Storm_NPCM_Oberlin:VTYP
Text: External issues: Scouts report the storm is growing. The eye of the storm seems to be above the manor.

Speaker: 006FBFA9:Storm_NPCM_Oberlin:VTYP
Text: Land outside the manor seems to be severely damaged. Unsure if its the storm or something else that caused it.

Speaker: 006FBFA9:Storm_NPCM_Oberlin:VTYP
Text: Strange things are happening to the flora outside, the area around the manor is effectively a dead zone. Areas nearby seem to be corrupted

Speaker: 006FBFA9:Storm_NPCM_Oberlin:VTYP
Text: Other issues: An alarm was tripped in one of the locked off sections and was cut shortly after. Doesn't seem like it was the Lost that tripped it.

Speaker: 006FBFA9:Storm_NPCM_Oberlin:VTYP
Text: Monitoring the situation.

Speaker: 006FBFA9:Storm_NPCM_Oberlin:VTYP
Text: Oberlin Out.

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: Chief, High Knob's been compromised... A group of outsiders rolled in, heavily armed, started setting up camp.

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: Only a matter of time until they find me up here. Pretty sure this is it for me. But... listen, Chief, I gotta come clean.

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: I wanna go to my grave with a clean conscience. This whole thing? The reports, the Army? It's a sham, boss.

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: Every single file has gone straight to Mr. Stolz. We're his men first, Chief, not yours. Not really. There's no military contact... Just Hugo.

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: Those of us in the know have been heading out here to play the part, make you think it's real, but this ain't a drop site, it's our smoke break spot.

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: I'm sorry you gotta find out like this, Chief. You're one of the good ones. Don't trust anyone down there. We're all just his... puppets.

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: [Distant yelling heard]

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: Oh shit -

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: [Sounds of yelling and gunshots]

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: [A thump and labored breathing]

Speaker: 00755908:Storm_NPCM_Dan:VTYP
Text: I'm... sorry...

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: My love... when you hear this... remember that I will always love you. And... remember the me in this recording, not the me I will become.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: We lost so many to this... disease... a-and I can feel myself slipping each day. I know my fate and I have come to terms with it.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: *Chuckle* Hey, remember how we met? New Orleans, my father's gala, one starry night.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: It started with the usual pleasantries, but blossomed into a heated debate on the legacy we leave behind. When we stopped, it was already morning.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: Despite your sight, you have a vision unlike any man I have ever met. I was... always drawn to your keen intellect and unique insight.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: *Sigh* My only regret looking back is that I never was much of a mother... but Audrey is our legacy.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: You must carry on to keep her from my fate. Promise me this.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: After all, I learned over our many wonderful years together, if Hugo Stolz wants something, he makes it happen.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: Hey, do you remember the first night we met? At my father's gala? We- Oh, wait, I... just said that. *Sigh*

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: Goodbye my love. Remember me fondly.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: Well life has taken an unexpected turn. I miss simpler times where all I worried about were our corporate interests, and the odd gala or fundraiser.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: Now it's all about managing resources, people and the Vault projects. All beside my Hugo, at the end of the world no less.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: I shudder to think what would have happened if we didn't manage to secure a place on Vault-Tec's board of directors.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: Considering Anchorage... it was just a matter of time before the bombs.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: We knew it would be a long shot also convincing the board to make Hugo an Overseer, but luckily the potential he offered was just too promising.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: *Sigh* I do wish father and the rest didn't decline Hugo's invitation to the Vault. One day... maybe I'll find out if they made it out there.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: Saying that, it wasn't ideal moving into the Vault while still under construction. At least the workers were still here to finish what they started.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: We generously allowed them to stay in return for their flexibility with all of Hugo's on-going... requests and redesigns.

Speaker: 0072EE3F:Storm_NPCF_Cassidy:VTYP
Text: Perhaps they didn't realize that meant signing up for menial maintenance and custodial duties too, but surviving underground is no vacation, now is it?

Speaker: 0078DEB6:NPCM_GHL00_Quest_LeamonPrice:VTYP
Text: Bandits! Everyone! There are bandits in Appalachia! Scary masked fellas with no mercy or remorse...

Speaker: 0078DEB6:NPCM_GHL00_Quest_LeamonPrice:VTYP
Text: Out of the shadows they came, and took down every one of us in the blink of an eye.

Speaker: 0078DEB6:NPCM_GHL00_Quest_LeamonPrice:VTYP
Text: I'm only alive 'cause they thought I weren't. 'Cause I shut up and clenched my eyes like a coward.

Speaker: 0078DEB6:NPCM_GHL00_Quest_LeamonPrice:VTYP
Text: Maybe I can make it to that Whitespring Refuge before I bleed out. Until then... Warn everybody you meet.

Speaker: 0078DEB6:NPCM_GHL00_Quest_LeamonPrice:VTYP
Text: There are organized killers out there... Swift and sharp as a knife edge. Worse than raiders... Worse than anyone.

Speaker: 0078DEB6:NPCM_GHL00_Quest_LeamonPrice:VTYP
Text: Watch your backs, and sleep with one eye open. Or it may just be you won't ever wake up again.

Speaker: 0079162E:MILE_NPCM_CaravanIntro_LukeVoice:VTYP
Text: H-hello? Is this thing even on? *Panting noise*

Speaker: 0079162E:MILE_NPCM_CaravanIntro_LukeVoice:VTYP
Text: If anyone happens upon this holotape, you gotta take it down to Marley at Milepost Zero.

Speaker: 0079162E:MILE_NPCM_CaravanIntro_LukeVoice:VTYP
Text: It's in an exit tunnel at the bottom of the national park. She'll make it worth your while, promise.

Speaker: 0079162E:MILE_NPCM_CaravanIntro_LukeVoice:VTYP
Text: Marley, if you're listening to this... I'm sorry. I fucked up.

Speaker: 0079162E:MILE_NPCM_CaravanIntro_LukeVoice:VTYP
Text: Thought we could take a shorter route, but Super Mutants raided the delivery and took the cargo. Smelled the Brahmin from a mile away.

Speaker: 0079162E:MILE_NPCM_CaravanIntro_LukeVoice:VTYP
Text: I think it's only a matter of time before they catch my scent, too.

Speaker: 0079162E:MILE_NPCM_CaravanIntro_LukeVoice:VTYP
Text: I'm gonna make a break for it, but I don't much like my chances. Marley, if I don't get to tell you later... oh shit. They, they see me.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log. Day one.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Today we begin an undertaking with the potential to reshape the very nature of energy.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: The true power of Ultracite -- a fountain of untold potential -- will be revealed to us.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: We are all well aware now of Atomic Mining Services' exploitation of this material.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: That is nothing new, and we do not intend to expand on its usage merely as an energy source.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: No, this project, codenamed 'Vulcan,' has a different aim. For while others simply use Ultracite, we intend to understand it.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: That, ladies and gentlemen, is where the true power lies.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Our understanding of Ultracite -- how it is created, how it grows -- will assure our dominance for generations to come.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log. The fundamental course of our experiments is in debate.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: I stand for sonic wave manipulation to stimulate crystal growth. Dr. Robert Gaines argues that radiation treatment is the only path forward.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: To be frank, the heart of the impasse is Robert's popularity... The science is on my side, but the rank and file favor his approach.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: The people here are raw and soft. Fewer true believers than I'd like, even among management. Any attempt to overrule him may lead to rebellion.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: It seems inevitable that we will pursue a dead-end course.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: The weakness of the masses may doom Vulcan before it even begins -- then management will have all our heads.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Though our early experiments yielded little in the way of results, we've finally made a breakthrough -- and the credit goes to me!

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: It was only a matter of adjusting the wave frequency, just as I insisted. And now the bastards have no choice but to admit it.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Robert is finished -- professionally, anyway. His influence still lingers, but I'll make short work of that.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: We'll make something of Vulcan yet. For the glory of the Enclave!

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log. Things are progressing well.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: The Ultracite is reacting, more than we ever imagined. The growth is wild, untamed, dangerous.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: I can hear the plaudits now. If we can harness this new power, this 'Ultragenesis,' then we really will be the masters of Ultracite.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: The Enclave will be truly unstoppable!

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: But how to harness it? I have a few ideas -- building on Robert's research, ironically. Not that he's around to see his theories reach fruition.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Torn apart by his own experiments... A tale as old as time! It looked ever so painful. I do hope they find that saboteur soon.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log. Agitation among the staff.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Exposure to the empowered Ultracite has resulted in disturbing behavior.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: We have observed a marked increase in paranoia, delusions, and hysteria among the infected. There have been casualties.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: The staff blames me for everything... Robert's influence yet lingers. Even in death he'll be my undoing.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Don't they understand this is simply a setback? Scientific advancement demands sacrifice. The timidity of these bastards boils my blood.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: Management commandeered my defensive measures. There will be a trial, in Enclave style of course, meaning this will be my last message.

Speaker: 00796F20:RD01_NPCF_EstherWright:VTYP
Text: I regret nothing. Glory to the Enclave! And a curse on the gutless traitors that doomed Project Vulcan!

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Captain Holloway, Vulcan Research Laboratory. With the EN06 deployed out front, I'm confident that intruders pose little threat to this facility.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Thing has more ordinance than a heavy bomber. Any unauthorized anything that walks in here will be dusted faster than a cowboy says 'howdy.'

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: No, our problems will come from within. Never trust a scientist, I say. Heads get too big for their own good.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: They always build some machine or breed some monster that goes crazy and kills half or more of the people who gave it its unwanted life.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Seen it too many times to count...

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Luckily, management's on my side for once. If any one of these brainiacs steps out of line, we'll be sure to take care of it ASAP.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Holloway's log. The eggheads are at it already.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Dr. Gaines was working in the lab, shooting soundwaves at crystals and pissing off his mutated test subject.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Well what happens when you piss off a mutie? It breaks out of its cage and turns you into a human pretzel.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: They all swore that 'protocols were in place,' that they'd 'double checked.' We saw how well that worked out.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Won't be the first time, won't be the last. Shame, though. Of all these schmucks, I liked him the best.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Captain John Holloway, personal log. I knew it would come to this...

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Give these science types an ounce of control and what do they do with it? Lose it immediately. Never fails.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: I told you, didn't I? Build a machine and grow a forest of radioactive crystals, it makes everyone crazy and people start dying.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Management was quick to act, but not quick enough, I reckon. We've got the place on lockdown, but who knows how long we'll last before the 'fear' gets us, too.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: The Epsilons were called in -- that means extermination mode. Normally I'd find comfort in that, but they're not acting right.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Not sure I'll make it out this time. If anyone finds this, Jimmy gets my car and Sharon my bottlecap collection.

Speaker: 00796F21:RD01_NPCM_JohnHolloway:VTYP
Text: Rick gets nothing, and that's more than he deserves.

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: All right, my pretties! It is time for rehearsal! Let's get into our positions now, please!

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: *Overgrown gurgling* Allistaire, please. You can be a diva after you make it big. Until then, you do as I say. Are we clear?

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: *Overgrown growls* Okay then! We're going to start off with a performance from Violetta. Violetta, please sing the last refrain in E minor.

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: *Floater noises* Gah! Stop that at once! I've never heard a more tone-deaf singer in my life!

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: Oh God, what am I going to do?! These Overgrown are talentless hacks!

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: This Eastern American tour of mine is already falling apart.

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: I originally planned for us to stop and perform in Pittsburgh for several weeks, but we've put the kibosh on that plan for sure now.

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: The whole city is covered in this disgusting smog. Geiger counters sing the opera even on the city lines.

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: If there's anyone left in there, I'm not sure they even have eyes nor ears to witness our show.

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: We'll have to reroute, possibly through the country. By George, just the thought of smelling some unwashed yokels terrifies me.

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: Yet, I have no choice. Damn you Salvatore Sticky Fingers! DAMN YOU!!

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: I've fired Emeric and Jolie. Dishonorably dismissed! They dared question my judgement.

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: Just put the Overgrown down! they said. We don't need them! This is why a show needs a visionary at the top, and not a bunch of short-sighted freaks.

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: *Overgrown noises* Alas, there are times I feel you're the only one who truly understands me, Allistaire. * Overgrown gurgles*

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: Perhaps... perhaps I shall unlatch your cages. No more will you be imprisoned beyond these iron bars! Instead, we shall be equals!

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: *metal noise of latch being unlocked* *Overgrown growls*

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: Wait, what... what are you doing? Allistaire, please, control yourself! *aggressive Overgrown noises*

QuestName: [dialogue quest containing holotapes for Big Bloom]
Speaker: 0079AC27:SSE_NPCM_Magellan:VTYP
Text: No, no, please! Ahhh!! * Overgrown attack noises*

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: To the people of Appalachia, if ye can hear this, know that I am in grave dang-

Speaker: 007ACB4E:Fish_NPCM_Fisherman:VTYP
Text: *Gurgle*

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: Know that we have finally arrived.

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: If ye possess a strong arm and an unwavering countenance, then ye be fit to fish the waters of the wasteland with us.

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: Come find our stall at Fisherman's Rest in the Mire for the finest rods and tackle.

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: Through our many hands, the secrets of these rivers will reveal themselves.

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: Wait... what am I saying? What does that mea- Hngg.

Speaker: 007ACB4E:Fish_NPCM_Fisherman:VTYP
Text: *Gurgle*

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: Ever since I washed up on these shores, my mind's felt more and more adrift. I'm hopin' this might be a way to keep me anchored.

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: My name is Captain Raymond Clark. My father was a bosun and so was his father before him.

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: My mother's name was Deidre and she had long, flaxen hair. Ah, this is foolish. How do I stop this thing? *grumble*

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: It's been a few weeks, or months, since I recorded one of these. Whole seasons seem to go by without my noticing.

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: My head's been so clouded, I can barely keep track of what state we're in. Come on Raymond, hold it together.

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: My name is Captain Raymond Clark. My father was a bosun. My mother's name was... was... Ah confound it!

Speaker: 007ACD7E:Fishing_NPCM_TheCaptain:VTYP
Text: My name is Captain... Captain... I'm a Captain. It's my job to, to fish? To catch as many fish as we can. My father was a fish, and my mother...

Speaker: 007DF78D:BURN_NPCF_Ava:VTYP
Text: Hello? Is this thing even on? I need help. Please, anyone, if you're hearing this...

Speaker: 007DF78D:BURN_NPCF_Ava:VTYP
Text: I'm stuck in some kind of lookout tower, just past that new bridge going into Ohio. I was trying to help my Papa, but I was tailed and I had to hide.

Speaker: 007DF78D:BURN_NPCF_Ava:VTYP
Text: They haven't found me yet, but I'm so frightened and I don't know what to do. Please, God, be kind and let someone hear this.

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: Okay folks, we've finally got the results back from the consumer surveys! These ones were to gauge attitudes towards the Abraxodyne Chemical brand.

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: We did good, but the board thinks we can do better. They've asked for a full rebranding campaign that focuses on cementing a "family-friendly" image.

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: I want us all to put our heads together on this one and come up with some standout ideas. Don't hold back - think big, think bold!

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: What about a new mascot? I-I'm thinking an anthropomorphic bubble named "Squeaky" who teaches kids good hygiene and traditional values.

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: A what? No, Martin, get it together, for Pete's sake!

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: How about a commercial? We have the brand recognition and the budget to make something memorable. Lots of the big brands are doing it!

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: A commercial... I like it. We'll need a catchy slogan to go with it too, of course. Something to really sell the "wholesome" angle.

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: Say no more, say no more, I have got it! "We're soft on fabrics, but hard on Communism!" Not bad, eh? Tell me that's not our pièce de résistance.

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: Ugh, Martin...

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: How about we pick something that showcases our values?

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP
Text: Oh, I've got one. "Abraxodyne Chemical: For families who put clean living first."

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: That's perfect, they'll eat that "family first" baloney right up. Nice work Janice.

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: All right, good work everybody. Now that's out of the way, let's discuss next quarter's recruitment strategies.

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: Our Marketing, P.R. and R&D departments have all been hard at work this quarter crafting our new employee instructional video.

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: As requested, we've covered the major areas of concern that have been "problematic" in recent years. So, let's see what you think. Roll the tape.

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: Welcome, employee. Whether this is your first time donning the Abraxodyne Chemical overalls or the hundredth, this training video is for you!

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: By following these simple steps and adhering to our new mandatory safety protocols, you'll be keeping yourself, and the company, out of harm's way.

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: Employees are expected to take full, personal responsibility for their own actions and for the safety of their team. Remember: safety is no accident!

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: Deviation from our chemical handling procedures can have serious consequences; for you, and for the lab.

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: *Scream*

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: Oops! That's gotta sting. Remember folks, follow the safety procedures outlined in the employee handbook or face the consequences.

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: Our patented cleaning formula should be tough on grime, not tough on you. Report to a supervisor immediately if you encounter any infractions.

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: Here at Abraxodyne Chemical, we like to keep things spotless. But, did you know that cleanliness starts with what you say?

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: That's right. Gossip and rumors leave a nasty stain on you and the company. Best to steer clear of the grapevine and avoid the unwanted repercussions.

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: When you signed your contract with us, you joined something bigger than yourself. Bigger than detergent. You joined a family.

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: And as family, we ask only for the loyalty, commitment, and trust that we've invested into you. Please read your contracts for more details.

Speaker: 00839BB2:BURN_NPCM_Narrator:VTYP
Text: So don't forget, the success of Abraxodyne Chemical lies with you. Stick to these guidelines and we'll all shine!

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: *Sigh*

Speaker: 00839BBC:BURN_NPCM_Moses:VTYP
Text: Something on your mind, Ms. Amrita?

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: No, no. Just another lousy meeting where I'm asked to achieve the impossible.

Speaker: 00839BBC:BURN_NPCM_Moses:VTYP
Text: That so? Was it as bad as the one last week?

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Hah! Worse, in fact. You don't know the half of it Moses.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: You know, sometimes I wonder how we keep getting into these screw-ups, especially after Pittsburgh. I'm always the one left to pick up the pieces.

Speaker: 00839BBC:BURN_NPCM_Moses:VTYP
Text: You're a hard worker, Ms. Amrita. Why, I always see you running around here, busy as a one-legged man in a butt-kicking contest!

Speaker: 00839BBC:BURN_NPCM_Moses:VTYP
Text: Dealing with the bumps in the road ain't easy, but I'm sure the fine folks here appreciate your efforts.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: I really wish I believed you, but sometimes I feel like I'm one bad P.R. statement away from being thrown under the bus.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: I've got to start looking into ways to protect myself a bit more... We've all got to cover our backs right?

Speaker: 00839BB0:BURN_NPCM_Terry:VTYP
Text: Here you go, ma'am, you can call the number on the back to find more details about Abraxodyne's newest-

Speaker: 00839BB1:BURN_NPCM_Ronny:VTYP
Text: Terry... Terry!

Speaker: 00839BB0:BURN_NPCM_Terry:VTYP
Text: What? I'm with a customer right now. Apologies, ma'am, that flyer should have all the info you need. C'mon man, you're distracting me!

Speaker: 00839BB1:BURN_NPCM_Ronny:VTYP
Text: Some guy was just asking me the weirdest questions!

Speaker: 00839BB0:BURN_NPCM_Terry:VTYP
Text: Yeah, so? People are meant to come and ask us questions, that's why we're here.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Here we are sir, let us know if you'd like any more information.

Speaker: 00839BB1:BURN_NPCM_Ronny:VTYP
Text: Yeah, but this guy was crazy. Get a load of this: He was asking me questions about all the "incidents" the company's had in the last few years and-

Speaker: 00839BB0:BURN_NPCM_Terry:VTYP
Text: For the love of God, Ronny! Tell me you didn't give him any details, you're gonna get us both fired!

Speaker: 00839BB1:BURN_NPCM_Ronny:VTYP
Text: Relax, will ya? I'm not an idiot. I remember what they told us in the briefing.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: There we go, ma'am. Come by the booth again, if you have questions.

Speaker: 00839BB1:BURN_NPCM_Ronny:VTYP
Text: Anyways, I tell him to get bent 'cause I'm not gonna accidentally spill the beans to some undercover reporter looking for a scoop.

Speaker: 00839BB0:BURN_NPCM_Terry:VTYP
Text: Oh great, so now we're gonna get written up for insulting the public!

Speaker: 00839BB1:BURN_NPCM_Ronny:VTYP
Text: Take it easy will ya? I did it all professional-like! He told me that he was with the military and that they're interested in our product's potential.

Speaker: 00839BB0:BURN_NPCM_Terry:VTYP
Text: Interested? Interested how?

Speaker: 00839BB1:BURN_NPCM_Ronny:VTYP
Text: I'm not sure. But, it smells like a bonus if we can take it up the chain.

Speaker: 00839BB0:BURN_NPCM_Terry:VTYP
Text: Yeah... Yeah, maybe you're right. Okay, well what are we waiting for? Let's go find him!

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: Come on Martin, you're one good idea away from getting that promotion, I can feel it!

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: The others might laugh at me now, but they won't once I'm in charge, that's for sure.

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: I just need something that will grab the board's attention, something that will really blow their socks off...

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: Ooo! What about a special edition of Abraxo called "Atomic Sparkle" with trace elements of Uranium. "Your clothes will come out glowing... literally!"

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: No, that will never get through the safety tests! Definitely not after our last whoopsie with radioactive ingredients.

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: Perhaps we take a different approach? How about an actual soap opera named "Suds Galore"? Where the laundry is clean but the drama is anything but!

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: We could even have a talking washing machine voiced by a celebrity to plug our latest products and deal bonanzas.

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: No... Far too whimsical, and may give children nightmares.

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: I've got it! A line of air fresheners dedicated to American presidents.

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: We could have Teddy Roosevelt Tang: Raw, musky, slightly peppery. Smells like gunpowder and moustache wax.

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: Or-or Truman Spice: Sharp, direct, strong. A smell that isn't afraid to make hard decisions or send the Communists packing!

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: Voila, it's perfect, I've cracked it! If the board doesn't like this one, I'll eat my hat!

Speaker: 00839BB8:BURN_NPCM_Julius:VTYP
Text: I've told you before, I don't feel comfortable getting in front of any cameras until we've had a proper review of our lab safety requirements!

Speaker: 00839BBD:BURN_NPCF_Sheila:VTYP
Text: And that's been duly noted, Julius. We appreciate you bringing it to our attention, again. Your concern for your fellow lab techs is commendable.

Speaker: 00839BBD:BURN_NPCF_Sheila:VTYP
Text: However, the board has stated several times that they want our lead researcher to be present in this new commercial to add credibility.

Speaker: 00839BB8:BURN_NPCM_Julius:VTYP
Text: If the board wants credibility then they need to put their money where their mouth is, and start listening to our concerns.

Speaker: 00839BB8:BURN_NPCM_Julius:VTYP
Text: Not spending the budget on flashy commercials instead of the proper safety equipment I've had on the docket for over six months!

Speaker: 00839BB7:BURN_NPCM_Harold:VTYP
Text: Your equipment requests have been received and are currently being reviewed by our finance team for validity.

Speaker: 00839BB8:BURN_NPCM_Julius:VTYP
Text: Validity? My guys are burning through a respirator a day with the old kits! We need stronger equipment if you want us to work on this type of stuff.

Speaker: 00839BB7:BURN_NPCM_Harold:VTYP
Text: That's enough, Julius. Or do you need reminding of the confidentiality agreement you signed?

Speaker: 00839BB7:BURN_NPCM_Harold:VTYP
Text: We need you in the new advertisement, simple as that. Anyhow, you're obligated to perform certain public appearances. Check your contract.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: It won't be too strenuous Julius. You'll be fully prepared beforehand and I'll personally see to it that you get your equipment. How does that sound?

Speaker: 00839BB8:BURN_NPCM_Julius:VTYP
Text: Fine! I'll give you one afternoon, but no more. Someone needs to be supervising the lab techs, given the situation.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Well, I'm glad that's finally sorted. Why the sudden need for stronger respirators though? Our standard equipment has served us fine for years, no?

Speaker: 00839BB7:BURN_NPCM_Harold:VTYP
Text: Probably best to leave those details to the experts for now. Thanks for your help today, Amrita. I'll send you the shooting schedule for the ad soon.

Speaker: 00839BBA:BURN_NPCM_Janitor1:VTYP
Text: I mean, how do they expect us to work in these conditions?

Speaker: 00839BBB:BURN_NPCM_Janitor2:VTYP
Text: You said it, pal. Complete joke, if you ask me.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Just a little louder, come on...

Speaker: 00839BBA:BURN_NPCM_Janitor1:VTYP
Text: It's bad enough that they won't give us any of the new hazmat suits, but not replacing clearly broken equipment?

Speaker: 00839BBB:BURN_NPCM_Janitor2:VTYP
Text: It's downright dangerous if you ask me. And with the wages we're earning, it's hardly worth the risk.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Ugh, I can barely hear them. Maybe it was a mistake hiding in here.

Speaker: 00839BBA:BURN_NPCM_Janitor1:VTYP
Text: Jake's the third person working this shift who's gone off sick in a month. Now don't tell me that's a coincidence, 'cause I ain't stupid!

Speaker: 00839BBB:BURN_NPCM_Janitor2:VTYP
Text: Hey, at least you weren't the one who inherited his mop. Look at this thing - what was he mopping up with it? Lava?

Speaker: 00839BBB:BURN_NPCM_Janitor2:VTYP
Text: You can't use that mangled piece of crap. You'd be better off using a wad of paper towels at this rate. Let me grab my spare from the store cupboard.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Oh shi-

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: Hmm, note to self: Check with R&D boys about investigating an edible detergent. A tasty snack that delights the mind and cleans the stomach!

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP
Text: Oh, it's you...

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: Ah, Kerry, hello! I was just looking for you actually. I have another brilliant idea; I think you're going to really like this one.

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP
Text: What is it this time, Martin?

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: I call it "shower-in-a-can": It's an aerosol spray that eliminates the need for bathing. Convenient for the modern go-getter!

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP
Text: Yeah, okay, that's great and all, but listen - I have some actual work for you to do. We have a new... product that we need a company codename for.

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP
Text: Ah excellent, I'm quite a wunderkind at that sort of thing. So, what's the new product? I'll be able to whip up a name for you, tout de suite.

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP
Text: Don't worry about what it is, that's classified information. Just make sure it sounds appealing and, uh... clean. Have it on my desk by five.

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP

Speaker: 00839BB9:BURN_NPCM_MartinFinch:VTYP

Text: Yes, that's it! "Meadow Breeze"! Gentle, yet exciting. Fragrant, yet sophisticated. It screams business but with a delightful je ne sais quoi.

Text: God, I'm good! Note to self: Ask Kerry for a raise.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP

Speaker: 00839BB8:BURN_NPCM_Julius:VTYP

Speaker: 00839BBE:BURN_NPCM_Director:VTYP
Text: CUT!

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: I'm recording this to say, that enough is enough. This... This is getting out of hand now and somebody has to do... something.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: It started out with keeping receipts in case the board ever tried to pin one of their screw-ups on me. Just so I had a bit of leverage... Anything.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: But every stone I've unturned, the rot goes deeper and deeper. The more I look, the more I find...

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Isn't it my job to know the ugly stuff; so I can shield the brand and help us focus on what really helps people?

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Whatever we're doing now, it goes a hell of a lot deeper than the circles I'm part of.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: And this "Meadow Breeze" project I've seen referenced in new data entries... I can't tell exactly what it is, but I do not like the look of it.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: I think... I think I need to keep going. I wish I could put this genie back in the bottle and turn a blind eye but, this has all gone too far now

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Somebody's got to hold them to account. And if not me, then who?

Speaker: 00839BB4:BURN_NPCM_Tony:VTYP
Text: How did we get to this stage in the first place, Kerry? I thought we agreed to can this idea after the failure of the first round of testing?

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP
Text: We did, but, we were very close, so I encouraged the boys to keep working on an improved formula in their down time.

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP
Text: This is unacceptable. Even entertaining the idea of developing this "Meadow Breeze" weapon flies in the face of what this company stands for.

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP

Speaker: 00839BB4:BURN_NPCM_Tony:VTYP
Text: Mother of God...

Speaker: 00839BB5:BURN_NPCM_Wilbur:VTYP

Speaker: 00839BB4:BURN_NPCM_Tony:VTYP
Text: Yeah, and I suppose we do have a national duty to protect our boys in uniform, after all. It'll be great for morale and market share. *chuckle*

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP
Text: I know, ma, but I don't really have a choice right now.

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP
Text: I never thought I'd get promoted out of a secretary position in the first place. I can't mess this up!

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP
Text: It's 'cause of this new "genius" contest idea that Tony came up with. Y'know the "Abraxo-bucks" one?

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP
Text: It wouldn't have been so bad if they'd done the cost projections before committing to it, but now they've realized they can't have "so many winners".

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP
Text: Now I've got to sort through the distribution data and make sure it's "statistically unlikely" for anyone to actually collect enough of these tickets.

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP
Text: I can't demand that, ma.*Sigh* I'm just going to have to keep staying late until it's done. I'm too afraid to make a fuss about it.

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP
Text: I know, I know you're right. Anyways, can you put Mikey's dinner in the oven and put the kids to bed for me please? Love you.

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Hey, Janice.

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP
Text: Oh, hey Amrita, didn't see you back there! Don't mind what I was saying to my mom, she just worries is all. Everything's fine!

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP

Speaker: 00839BB6:BURN_NPCF_Janice:VTYP

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: It's fine, get out of here, go get some rest. Don't worry, I'll lock up around here after you're gone.

Speaker: 00839BB7:BURN_NPCM_Harold:VTYP
Text: For the love of God, I am getting sick of this! It is ridiculous! Every damn thing we say ends up getting leaked to the press somehow!

Speaker: 00839BB7:BURN_NPCM_Harold:VTYP
Text: How are we even meant to have these meetings if there's no guarantee they won't end up in the hands of reporters?

Speaker: 00839BB4:BURN_NPCM_Tony:VTYP
Text: All right, Harold, let's keep calm. Indiscretion has caused enough problems already. We just need to tighten up our flow of information, that's all.

Speaker: 00839BB4:BURN_NPCM_Tony:VTYP
Text: We're lucky that this reporter was caught and dealt with before anything could be published and our brand permanently damaged.

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP
Text: Even so, everything points to this being an inside job! How else would they have heard about project Meadow Breeze?

Speaker: 00839BB4:BURN_NPCM_Tony:VTYP
Text: That is true. How about this then: If the mole is in this room, come forward, and we can smooth this all out. Right here, right now.

Speaker: 00839BB4:BURN_NPCM_Tony:VTYP
Text: No? Well, it was worth a try. So be it, tomorrow we'll begin upscaling our internal investigations and, if needed, we won't hesitate to-

Speaker: 00839BB3:BURN_NPCM_Kerry:VTYP
Text: What was that?

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: Sorry, I, uh... dropped my handbag.

Speaker: 00839BB4:BURN_NPCM_Tony:VTYP
Text: As I was saying, we will do whatever is needed to get to the bottom of this.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: This tape is being recorded for my own protection, as well as everyone else's. They're getting close, but I can't stop now.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: It's taken months and several near-misses, but I think I've collected enough evidence to finally hold these bastards to account.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: I don't even know who I should show this stuff to - a lawyer? The police? Hell, even the press?

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: The important thing is this: project "Meadow Breeze" is not a cleaning product. It's some kind of awful, deadly weapon, and I can prove it.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: How it can decimate crops, ecosystems, hell even metal! It's all here in these reports. God only knows what its long term impact on human beings is!

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: How did I not realize all of this sooner? Julius was practically spelling it out to me all along. I've been so stupid...

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: I'll admit, I've had a part to play in our cover ups over the years, but not this. Never this.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
Text: I don't have much time. The board are tying up loose ends and it won't be long before they notice things going missing. I need to get out, and soon.

Speaker: 0082B8AF:BURN_NPCF_Amrita:VTYP
