Text: Hey! Where'd the... Huh... lo...

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: What's going on here, I'm... who am I? The... lights... coupon...

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: What coupon? You think I need a... Do you know who I am?

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: Do... I know... who I am? Do I... coupon... (Rewinding)

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: What... Why am I remembering this... No, I was never... No, I've never seen this, but...

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: What's going on here? Why am I Chett? I mean, here. Why Jeremy here now coupon? (Rewinding)

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: Huhhh...

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: What happened to the lights? Who's there?

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Everything's okay, Mr. Bolder. This is all just, uh, part of the treatment.

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: Who are you? Where'd that Heidi broad go?

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: She'll, like, be back soon. I'm Iggy Stolz.

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: Stolz? You mean that kraut's behind this place? Look, kid, I'm a goddamn American icon for the big screen.

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: I can't be seen in a place like this. Knew this was a bad idea... Got honey-potted by the blonde again, Bolder! (Rewinding)

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: Who are you? Where'd that Heidi broad go?

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: She'll be back. I'm Iggy.

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: Iggy who?

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Just Iggy, man.

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: You some kind of commie? Who has just one name? Mao. Lenin. That's who.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Vladimir Lenin, but I just wanted to ask a few questions.

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: I knew you were a red! (Rewinding)

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: Who are you? Where'd...

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Burt Rockwell. I'm Burt Rockwell. Nice to meet you.

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: Burt, eh? I didn't know this was a communal spa... but you sound like a guy I could get along with.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Yeah, very cool, man. I just wanted to ask you...

Speaker: 009067A5:RTSV_NPCM_ChettBolder:VTYP
Text: Very cool, man? What kind of pinko bullshit is that?

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: *Exhausted sigh* (Rewinding)

Speaker: 009067A0:RTSV_NPCM_TouyaShirakawa:VTYP
Text: Nanda kyuu ni, teiden ka? Makkura de temoto sura mienai.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Uh, hey there. You're the famous director, Shirakawa, right?

Speaker: 009067A0:RTSV_NPCM_TouyaShirakawa:VTYP
Text: Souda, Shirakawa Touya dayo. Kimi wa haisen no shuuri ni kita no ka?

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Um, I think that was a yes. So, have you ever, like, worked with a man named Stolz before?

Speaker: 009067A0:RTSV_NPCM_TouyaShirakawa:VTYP
Text: Mmm... Nani wo itte iru no ka wakaranai. Sakihodo no josei wo yonde kureru ka? Kanojo no hou ga mada hanashi ga tsuujita.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Yeah, this, uh...

Speaker: 009067A0:RTSV_NPCM_TouyaShirakawa:VTYP
Text: Shikashi, kono kyuu na yami to iu no wa jitsu ni kyoumibukai na.

Speaker: 009067A0:RTSV_NPCM_TouyaShirakawa:VTYP
Text: Fudan wa "kuro" ga hikari no naka de isshun no katachi wo tsukuru koto bakari ki ni shite iru ga...

Speaker: 009067A0:RTSV_NPCM_TouyaShirakawa:VTYP
Text: ... koushite "junsui na yami" sono mono wo mae ni suru to, soko ni mo isshu no bi ga aru mono da.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I'm not sure what I was expecting.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I've gotten through the actors now... just need to dial in on the director...

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: He said foreign... but obviously not that foreign. Let's see what else we got already... (Phone ringing)

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Hello? Oh, Papa. (Muffled yelling over the phone)

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I'm sorry. I mean, Father... (More muffled yelling)

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: M-mister Stolz, I'm sorry, Mr. Stolz. (Muffled talking)

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Of course, I've been able to reconstruct at least three new schematics so far, I just...

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: The power limitations are... (Muffled frustration)

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Yes, sir. Of course, first priority, sir. Um, while I have you, do you know anything about Sonny... (Hanging up, beeping)

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Hello? Papa...?

Speaker: 009067A1:RTSV_NPCM_SergioAmore:VTYP
Text: Shoot, shoot, shoot, that's all you Americans care about, yeah?

Speaker: 009067A1:RTSV_NPCM_SergioAmore:VTYP
Text: You come to my country, you think it is so cheap, you shoot your little movies about shooting...

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Signore Amore, I actually had a question about a different kind of movie. Like, maybe something about a son and his father?

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Does "Sonny, oh my boy" ring any bells?

Speaker: 009067A1:RTSV_NPCM_SergioAmore:VTYP
Text: Oh! I know this one, yeah. Oh, haha, I remember this.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: You do? That's, like, so great. Did you direct it?

Speaker: 009067A1:RTSV_NPCM_SergioAmore:VTYP
Text: No! Never! Because I never work with that, uh, what's it, that writer again. Never, no!

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: The writer? You know who wrote it?

Speaker: 009067A1:RTSV_NPCM_SergioAmore:VTYP
Text: Si, it's the, uh... Spoody, uh, the Spoozio... Spudgio!

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: You mean Spudge? Spudge Dudley?

Speaker: 009067A1:RTSV_NPCM_SergioAmore:VTYP
Text: Ah, never say this name again. The arrogance. Wouldn't even appear on set, always mailing his, uh, corrections, instructions... direction!

Speaker: 009067A1:RTSV_NPCM_SergioAmore:VTYP
Text: Direction? Me! I'm the director, me! Not this writer, this Spudgio Dudley.

Speaker: 009067A1:RTSV_NPCM_SergioAmore:VTYP
Text: So, I don't direct this Sonny Boyo film. I refuse.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Grazie, Sergio. (Machine powering down)

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: Hello? Heidi, dear, I think the lights have gone out.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Hm. Something's wrong here... This should be Spudge Dudley's sample. The screenwriter.

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: Ha, oh, you must be new to the business. That's me. "Spudge."

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Oh, you're, uh...

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: A woman? Very perceptive, darling, even in this blackout.

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: First time bumping into a pen name? Writers need to be a certain make and model to be taken seriously in this industry.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Oh, I'm sorry. It hadn't occurred to me...

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: Exactly, honey.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Um, Ms. Dudley, I had a few, like, questions and stuff, if that was all good with you.

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: Hardly my idea of "restful relaxation", but sure. Under the condition you change that awful tagline. Alliteration doesn't permit redundancy, darling.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Of course. First thing I'll do when this is over. In the meantime, could you tell me if you were the writer on "Sonny, oh my Boy?"

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: That hogwash? You should give me a refund for even implying such a thing. I had nothing to do with it.

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: I was asked to do a few review passes, sure, but I would never put my name on that drivel.

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: But, if you're asking, I guess you don't know: it was originally written by the film's backer, that Stolz fella.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Really? Hugo Stolz wrote it? Did he say what it was inspired by?

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: He said autobiographical, if you can believe it. I didn't. One ridiculous character after another; furthest thing from real drama I could imagine.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Cool, man, cool... Do you know anyone else that was involved? Maybe who was going to direct?

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: Fritz, I believe. Marlo Fritz. We've collaborated a few times, which is, perhaps, why you dared to think I'd have anything to do with...

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Thanks, Ms, Dudley. That'll do.

Speaker: 009067A2:RTSV_NPCF_SpudgeDudley:VTYP
Text: Well, I've... The service here is outrageous. I'm leaving! Wait... my legs, why can't I feel my legs? (Machine powering down)

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: That's right, he did. Shared a cigar outside some grotesquely lavish Hollywood soiree.

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: I warned him that I cut against the grain. I think that's what he was looking for.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I was told he was working with a foreign director.

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: Any man who can string a proper sentence together may as well be a foreigner in this town, my boy.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: So you agreed to it, then?

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: At first. I played with the hypothetical. I had only made the one film, and this one certainly provided the chance to try something different.

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: I took a real shine to the story. I was an orphan, you know.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I, uh, think I read that once. When you say "something different", what do you mean, exactly?

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: Well, a musical. A Broadway production, dragged onto the silver screen. Perhaps old-fashioned, yes, but there was a chance...

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: A chance to do something new and daring with it.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: A musical? Like, singing, dancing, that sort of thing.

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: Yes. Singing. Dancing. That sort of...thing.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: So, what happened?

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: My interpretation of the subject died on the vine of my mind's garden. "A father absent in his child's life."

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: I grew to despise the premise: a picture that might make the boy I once was believe himself undeserving of respect.

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: To wallow in the idea that I could be stuck in the shadow of a man who was never there to cast one to begin with.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Wow, that's something, Mr. Fritz. Do you happen to know if he was inspired by something? Or...someone?

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: Why, of course. He was inspired by his own events. His own personal history.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I thought so. Can you tell me more?

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: Yes, he explained it at length. "Mein vater, mein vater." On and on like that. Tired, overused tropes and uninspired material.

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: His father must have done a real number on him, that's for certain.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Wait... You mean, he wrote it from his own perspective? Like...he's the son?

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: Certainly. He's never had a son of his own, after all. And he always doted on that sniveling little girl of his.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: That's not true, he... He...

Speaker: 009067A3:RTSV_NPCM_MarloFritz:VTYP
Text: What are you going on about? And when will this torturous massage be finished?

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: He said he never had a son. He wrote the songs from his own perspective.

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: Who gives a damn? No one should be writing ditties about anything other than their horse, the open prairie, or gunning down desperadoes.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: It's, uh... It's just so similar to our own situation. I'm just surprised he still...

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: So, what of it? That why you get up in the morning? To live for his approval?

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: You need to be more than what he thinks of you, boy. A man defines himself, nobody else.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I dunno...

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: What is left of you when he's gone? If it's anything less than all of you, it's a damn fool's errand to live like that.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Okay. I guess so.

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: If you want to wallow in your failure like some muck-happy pig, you do that on your time and don't involve me.

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: Leave the sorrows of the past in the past. It's no way to live, carrying them around, haunting you like ghosts.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Oh, sure, I...

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Why am I even talking to you? You're not even really you, just a miscalibration of a has-been actor.

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: Actor? What kind of...

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: *Pained noises*

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: Where am I? Why can't I see anything? It hurts...

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: *Pained noises*

Speaker: 008D4734:RTSV_NPCM_Marshal_Canton:VTYP
Text: Come on, now, those outlaws won't be far. The time for fireside chats is over. Grab your iron and we'll...

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: How I yearn to get you closer,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: How I never knew you so,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: How I must become a father,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Just to understand you more.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: *Taking a sip*

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I've never known the caring,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: That only fathers ever give.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I've never loved my creations,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Least of all the ones that live.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: *Sigh*

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: O' Father, please see my need,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Your Sonny boy calls to you now!

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: O' Father, please believe me,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Some day I swear I'll make you proud!

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Broken toys and stolen candy,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Is that the way you saw me then?

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: The way I see that useless child,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: A mistake to ever bring him in.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: *Long glug*

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: No one else could know this hurting,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Not one person comes to mind.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: I'm the only one who's looking,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: For a Father that is kind.

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: O' Father, please see my need,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Your Sonny Boy calls to you now...

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: O' Father, please believe me,

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: Someday I swear... I'll make you proud...

Speaker: 009067A6:RTSV_NPCM_IggyStolz:VTYP
Text: This is really terrible, man.

Speaker: 008EE1A9:SDOW_NPCM_Debunker:VTYP
Text: Hello, Appalachia. My name's Remington Goodwin, and I speak for The Debunker news radio station.

Speaker: 008EE1A9:SDOW_NPCM_Debunker:VTYP
Text: We have received numerous reports of corpses being displayed in an unnatural and tasteless manner all over your region.

Speaker: 008EE1A9:SDOW_NPCM_Debunker:VTYP
Text: We have reason to believe these killings are associated with a violent group paying homage to the serial killer known as the Pint-Sized Slasher.

Speaker: 008EE1A9:SDOW_NPCM_Debunker:VTYP
Text: We urge you not to panic, but to remain vigilant. For further reports, please tune in to The Debunker radio station. Goodbye, and stay safe.

Speaker: 008EE1A8:SDOW_NPCM_SlasherImpostor:VTYP
Text: Is this thing on? Mic check, mic check! This is Goodwin, back with the news! *Hysterical laugh*

Speaker: 008EE1A8:SDOW_NPCM_SlasherImpostor:VTYP
Text: A little birdie told me our dazzling D. Bonkers has been spreading lies about me.

Speaker: 008EE1A8:SDOW_NPCM_SlasherImpostor:VTYP
Text: So behold, Wasteland! Your Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher is here to put rumors to rest.

Speaker: 008EE1A8:SDOW_NPCM_SlasherImpostor:VTYP
Text: I'm back. I'm better. And I'm bored.

Speaker: 008EE1A8:SDOW_NPCM_SlasherImpostor:VTYP
Text: So say goodbye to your ad hoc society and decorative rules! The Wasteland cannot be tamed, and I'm the king of chaos.

Speaker: 008EE1A8:SDOW_NPCM_SlasherImpostor:VTYP
Text: Oh! And a message to all the upstanding citizens of Appalachia who've placed a bounty on lil' ol' me...

Speaker: 008EE1A8:SDOW_NPCM_SlasherImpostor:VTYP
Text: If you wanted to play, all you had to do was ask. *Laugh*
